Detailed state: ESTADO.md. Performance plan with measurements: PLANO_DESEMPENHO.md.
Requirements

Your own copy of the game (PS2, USA, SLUS-210.87).
Linux (tested on Arch/CachyOS with GCC). Windows/MSVC is PS2Recomp's main target but has not been tried here.
git, cmake, ninja, 7z, g++, glslc (Vulkan SDK / shaderc), libvulkan.
A Vulkan GPU. Optional but much faster: VK_EXT_fragment_shader_interlock (NVIDIA since Maxwell, recent AMD/Intel). Without Vulkan the CPU renderer is used.
~5 GB of RAM per build job and a few hours for the first build (the generated code is huge).

There is no ready-made executable to download, and there won't be. The executable contains the game's translated code, so shipping it would mean shipping the game. Everyone builds from their own copy with the script below.

Build and run
One command extracts the ISO, fetches PS2Recomp at the pinned commit, applies our patches, recompiles the ELF and builds everything:
scripts/instalar.sh "path/to/your.iso"
Use JOBS=1 if you run out of memory. If it stops halfway, run it again: finished steps are skipped.
Play:
cd PS2Recomp && ./out/build/ps2xRuntime/ps2EntryRunner ../extraido_full/SLUS_210.87
Laptops with two GPUs: the window may open on the integrated GPU. Prefix the command with prime-run (or __NV_PRIME_RENDER_OFFLOAD=1 __GLX_VENDOR_LIBRARY_NAME=nvidia).
Controller: a regular USB/Bluetooth gamepad works; the analog sticks have a 25% dead zone.
Useful environment variables (all listed in ARQUITETURA.md §6):

Variable
Effect

MKSM_SKIP_INTRO=1
Skips the intro videos

PS2X_DEINTERLACE=0
Shows one field at a time instead of blending both (harsher image)

PS2X_UNCAPPED=1
No real-time cap (throughput testing; the game speeds up)

PS2X_PERF=1
Prints fps, GS and GPU load every 2 s

PS2X_PIN=0
Don't pin the four busy threads to separate physical cores

PS2X_GS_GPU=0
CPU renderer only

PS2X_GS_RASTER=0
GPU compute tiles instead of the rasterizer

PS2X_VU1_THREAD=0
VU1 on the game thread

How the repository is organized
PS2Recomp is not vendored. scripts/aplicar_patches.sh clones it at the commit in patches/UPSTREAM_COMMIT and applies patches/runtime_atual.diff plus the new files listed in patches/arquivos.txt. The PS2Recomp/ folder that results is ignored by git; you work there and run scripts/atualizar_patches.sh to bring your changes back into patches/.

Path
What it is

sm.toml
PS2Recomp configuration for this game (function stubs, overrides, idle loops)

patches/
Our changes to the PS2Recomp runtime, IOP, recompiler and tests

scripts/
Build, patch and test helpers

ARQUITETURA.md
Architecture: threads, locks, the path of a frame, timing, game traps, testing without booting the game. Start here.

PLANO.md
Log of every fix, with evidence

PLANO_DESEMPENHO.md
Performance plan and measurements

MODDING.md
Game addresses and formats (level select, stage data, bloom...)

ESTADO.md
Technical state and manual build steps

notas/
Investigation notes

The technical documents are in Portuguese. Issues and pull requests in English or Portuguese are both welcome.
Contributing
See CONTRIBUTING.md. In short: never commit game data, keep the renderer bit-exact (there are replay tests for that), and keep the docs in sync with the code.
License
GPL-3.0, the same as PS2Recomp, from which patches/ derives.
Credits

PS2Recomp by ran-j and contributors: the recompiler and runtime this project builds on.
Mortal Kombat: Shaolin Monks © Midway / Warner Bros. Interactive Entertainment. This is a non-commercial fan project with no affiliation to the rights holders.

gh-1354613114.title: GitHub - boburning/portcove: Local-first manager for decompilations, recompilations, and native PC ports.
gh-1354613114.content:
Install, update, and play native game ports.

Project status ·
Download ·
Build from source ·
Documentation ·
Roadmap

Portcove brings native game ports into one local library. Choose a port, add the
game files it needs, and use the desktop app or command-line tool to manage
supported installations, updates, and backups. Some ports use an existing
installation rather than installing or updating files through Portcove.

Windows development build, October 1, 2026: an installed game, available ports,
and real mixed artwork. This is the application, not a mockup; the pictured
design and default covers are newer than the published Alpha 2 preview.
Existing Alpha 1 libraries can be carried forward with the documented
upgrade and recovery procedure.
NotePortcove does not include or download ROMs, disc images, BIOS files, or other
copyrighted game data. It checks game files locally and does not
upload them. You can use their current location, copy them into Portcove, or
explicitly move them after reviewing the consequences. A completed Move
removes the original only after a verified managed copy is registered.

What Portcove does
For players

Browse a catalog of native ports and manage them as one library. Find ports that can use your game files, then check what each one needs.
Keep managed versions side by side so updates can be saved for later, installed,
checked, or rolled back.
Install supported downloads, keep older versions, and switch back when needed. Upstream software can handle its own first-launch setup;
installation review explains who updates the runtime and where player data lives.
Get a recommended upstream release, package and download folder for simpler
setup routes, or register an existing installation while keeping its files and
update workflow under your control.
Adopt an existing installation by copying it into Portcove without changing the original.

Library safety

Check game files locally. A saved location can point to the
current file; copying into Portcove leaves the original in place, while Move
requires separate authorization. Portcove checks known exact identities and
records a local baseline to detect later changes.
Check downloaded files against the expected checksum before installing them.
Catalog-curated acquisition is planned
under #315.
Keep the saved data declared for a port, such as its known save, settings, and
mod locations, separately from installed versions; back up and restore that
managed data. This does not establish save compatibility across game versions.

Launcher use

Launch an installed port through the desktop app or the standalone CLI, with
the selected library and Portcove's current launch checks.
Connect another launcher through the public integration routes.
Launch-only, library and lifecycle integrations have different capabilities;
a named launcher is not a claim that its complete plugin is supported.

Developer and integration support

Use the shared Core behavior through Desktop or the independent CLI.
Discover versioned JSON/JSONL, schemas, capabilities and stable error/exit
behavior through the CLI guide and
external-author workflow.

Portcove keeps its library, saved game-file locations, and application state
local. A GitHub account is optional and is used only to raise the API rate
limit; startup and launching do not depend on an account or a Portcove-hosted
service.
Project status
WarningLatest technical preview: Alpha 2 — onboarding and storage
Portcove is under active development. It is intended for maintainers and technically comfortable testers using disposable or fully backed-up libraries—not general users or irreplaceable setups.

Portcove 0.1.0-alpha.2
is released as an immutable prerelease. It adds first-play source onboarding,
safe Copy and authorized Move intake, shared tool setup, library and per-game
storage controls, recoverable relocation, and the documented Alpha 1 upgrade
path. Alpha 1 remains available with its frozen release evidence.
A port appearing in the catalog does not mean every platform has completed hands-on testing. Upstream availability, automated checks, and Portcove's own manual testing are tracked separately for each port and platform.
Current priorities and blockers live in the public Portcove Roadmap. The meaning of Alpha, Beta, RC, and V1 lives in docs/ROADMAP.md. The catalog can continue growing without turning every newly discovered port into a V1 blocker.
The first public beta application release targets Windows x86-64 only, at the
existing supported Windows/WebView2 baseline. Linux is planned for a subsequent
beta; its implementation, support data and completed evidence remain retained.
Shared correctness and security checks still apply wherever they run. This changes
the application host commitment, not the original platforms of the games in the
catalog. The release boundary
describes the remaining qualification and publication requirements. No public beta
or new platform qualification is claimed here.
Download the technical alpha
For the graphical app, choose a Desktop package for your operating system
and processor from the Alpha 2 release.
For terminal use, choose the separate CLI archive. The desktop app does not
require that archive, and the CLI archive is not a graphical app. GitHub's
generated Source code archives are for building Portcove yourself.

System
Desktop package
Standalone CLI archive

Windows x64
Portcove_0.1.0-alpha.2_x64-setup.exe
portcove-windows-x86_64.zip

Linux x64, experimental
Portcove_0.1.0-alpha.2_amd64.AppImage, Portcove_0.1.0-alpha.2_amd64.deb, or Portcove-0.1.0-alpha.2-1.x86_64.rpm
portcove-linux-x86_64.tar.gz

macOS Intel, experimental
Portcove_0.1.0-alpha.2_x64.dmg
portcove-macos-x86_64.tar.gz

macOS Apple silicon, experimental
Portcove_0.1.0-alpha.2_aarch64.dmg
portcove-macos-aarch64.tar.gz

These are the published Alpha 2 choices; check the selected release page for
later versions and their limitations. Application upgrades are manual. Before
opening an existing library, follow the upgrade and recovery
steps. Read the Alpha 2 release
notes for package scope and
known limitations.
Windows packages are unsigned; macOS packages are unsigned and not notarized.
Keep operating-system security protections enabled. Linux and macOS remain
experimental, with hosted build/test evidence and incomplete hands-on package
qualification. Verify the download and read the signing/SBOM limits
before opening it.
Your first game
Use a disposable or backed-up library for this technical preview.
The screenshots show the current development build. In the published Alpha 2
app, Review install presents the plan inline, and the launch action is
Play now or Complete setup and play. The newer build uses the labels
below and a separate installation-review dialog.

Open Portcove Desktop and choose the local library you intend to use.
Open Discover, choose a game, and check which original files the port
needs and whether it has been tested on your system.
Choose your own required game files, or enter their local path. Portcove
checks them locally when you continue installation. An unsupported or changed
input needs attention; do not substitute another edition blindly.
Choose Review installation. Check the version, download size and install
folder, then confirm Install. Wait for verification and preparation to finish.
When the game is Ready to play, choose Play. Some ports perform their
own first-launch preparation or ask a further question. Close the game normally
to return to Portcove.

This captured Windows development-build journey
shows Ship of Harkinian installing from a verified package, recognizing an exact
Ocarina of Time source, preparing its game data, and reaching the title screen.
It is separate from Alpha 2 package qualification and does not establish gameplay,
audio, save compatibility or physical-controller behavior.
Manage, check, update and recover
Use the selected port's requirements and current state to choose the next action.
These CLI examples describe the maintained development contract; check your
selected package's --help and capabilities before using a newer command. The
CLI task guide separates current source behavior from published
preview limitations.

Task
Start here
What the result means

Inspect a library or port
Open Library/game details, or run portcove status PORT_ID.
See which version is installed and which actions are available. This leaves your files as they are.

Check installed files
Run portcove verify PORT_ID.
Installed files are compared with their recorded identities. This does not test gameplay or save compatibility.

Check original game files
Use Game files in Settings, or portcove source inspect PROFILE_ID and portcove source verify PROFILE_ID.
Identify the files or check whether they changed. These checks leave the files as they are and do not test a game version.

Check for a game update
Run portcove check PORT_ID, or use the game's update check.
Checking for an update leaves your current version in use. Review the update before installing it.

Protect managed saved data
Use the port's backups, or portcove backup create PORT_ID followed by portcove backup list PORT_ID.
Check which saves and settings are included. Portcove also snapshots them automatically before an update, activation or rollback, and keeps the newest five per game. Back up your original files separately. Review which files a restore would replace.

Correct a moved game file
Use Update file location in Game files, or the reviewed relink route.
The new location must still match the registered content; relinking does not move files or accept changed bytes.

Recover an interrupted task
Read Activity and portcove doctor, then follow the operation's reported recovery action.
Diagnosis does not itself resume or clean up an operation. Retained files or an unknown outcome need the specific supported recovery.

Report a problem
Use Report a problem or send feedback in a game's details. You review the full text, then send it.
Nothing is sent until you choose: from your GitHub account when signed in, on GitHub, or as copied text. Folder paths and your user name are replaced, and no saves or game files are attached.

Upgrade Portcove itself
Follow application upgrade and recovery.
Published Alpha 2 upgrades are manual. An application update is separate from a game update or catalog refresh.

See feedback and triage for reporting a
problem or sending feedback from Portcove or directly on GitHub.
Bulk check --all, reconcile --all and update --all continue after a
per-port failure and report each outcome. A completed batch can contain failed
ports; inspect every result. reconcile follows each saved update policy and
can download or activate a release, while check only checks. Saving a policy
does not execute it.
Some steps can’t stop immediately. Wait for the task to finish cancelling and
check any recovery instructions.
See safe cancellation and
interrupted library transfers.
Desktop and CLI share library locks and recovery rules; close other clients
before a whole-library transfer.
If a game won’t start
When the last launch of an installed game closed with an error, its details page
says what the failure most likely means, shows the exit code so you can copy it,
and suggests one next step. The wording is a hint, not a diagnosis: Portcove
explains only a short list of common Windows exit codes (a missing DLL or
runtime, a wrong-architecture or damaged DLL, a crash, a game that stopped
itself, a DLL that failed to start). Any other code is shown as “The game closed
with an error.” with nothing guessed. Nothing appears after a normal exit or
when you stop the game yourself. “Restore previous version” appears only when
Portcove still keeps one. The same explanation is in launch show --json as
exit_explanation; see the CLI guide.
Optional disc tools
Some declared disc formats or preparation routes need a local chdman or
DolphinTool. Other ports do not. portcove tool list reports each tool's purpose,
resolution and official setup reference; portcove doctor reports missing or
misconfigured prerequisites. Configure a trusted executable only when the
selected route requires it. Portcove does not silently download these executables
or modify the original disc image. See disc-format requirements.
GitHub access
Anonymous use
An account is optional. Browsing public releases and ordinary local library use
work without signing in; public GitHub requests remain subject to GitHub's
request limits. Startup and launching do not require an account.
Personal access token
Use portcove auth set-token to enter a token with hidden input, or the
documented standard-input/environment route for automation. Tokens are not
accepted as positional command arguments. Saved credentials use the operating
system's credential store. See GitHub authentication.
Device sign-in
portcove auth login starts the configured GitHub device flow. Follow the
displayed instructions; the CLI follows the required polling interval and
reports denial, expiry or cancellation. portcove auth status shows the active
credential source without exposing the token; portcove auth logout removes a
saved credential, but cannot remove an environment-provided token.
Authentication raises the GitHub API allowance. It does not supply game files,
bypass their checks or change a port's support evidence.
Catalog and support
Browse the complete descriptive directory in Desktop's Discover or with:
portcove catalog listings

Listings include projects without managed definitions. Visibility does not imply
managed installation, compatible originals, gameplay qualification or supported
update/backup ownership. Inspect a managed definition's declared requirements and
current evidence through the narrower operational commands:
portcove catalog list
portcove catalog show <port-id>
portcove --json catalog export

Contributors author crates/portcove-core/catalog/ports/<stable-id>.json through
the per-ID authoring workflow.
Their descriptive listing and optional strict integration generate
listings.json and
catalog.json; edit the records rather
than these aggregates. Operational definitions record platforms, channels,
required local files, executable layout, user-data paths and qualification facts.
Stable, Preview, and Rolling are game-port release channels—not quality ratings. Preview retains the beta command and serialized value. See docs/CATALOG.md for the full policy.
Compare implementations of a game
Discover groups projects only through reviewed game identities. Open a comparison
or Why this port? to inspect source editions, platform requirements, evidence
and limitations. A recommended starting point appears only when scoped evidence
supports it; sparse and single-project cases do not imply “best.” Changing the
comparison never changes an installed project, original files, saves or channels.
Search by the original game's title or a project's name. For games with several
implementations, Use saves your deliberate project choice in the current
library. Discover and Library keep the other implementations available; each
retains its own original-file requirements, releases and installation. Viewing an
alternative does not change your choice. A single implementation or an entry
without a reviewed game identity opens directly.
Library offers the chosen implementation's existing actions, or the sole installed
implementation when the choice is unambiguous. If several installed alternatives
need a choice, select one deliberately. Filters match an actual implementation;
a saved choice outside those filters stays saved. A removed choice asks you to
choose again. Missing optional comparison information does not prevent an
installed game's supported offline Play path. Choosing a project never transfers
saves or replaces another installation.
Explicitly follow independent projects for locally deduplicated release notices
when refreshed; use the Followed filter to find them. There is no mandatory
account, telemetry or background notification service. CLI users can run
portcove --json catalog compare PORT_ID for the same Core result.
Build from source
Prerequisites

Rust at the version specified in rust-toolchain.toml
Global Vite+ with environment management
enabled, to select Node from .node-version and pnpm from
package.json. An existing manager providing those exact versions
also works; there is no separate Portcove Node installation.
the Tauri 2 platform prerequisites

Development storage defaults are portable: a checkout may use the Windows system drive when its physical paths and free capacity pass preflight. Prefer an SSD for fixture-heavy work. A stricter machine-local policy can impose additional restrictions without changing repository defaults. See docs/DEVELOPMENT-STORAGE.md for the storage checks and private-policy boundary.
From the repository root, set up frontend dependencies and hooks, then run the
desktop app. Repeat setup after pulling toolchain changes; it refreshes hooks
even when dependencies are already installed.
node scripts/dev-storage.mts preflight
./scripts/bootstrap-quality-tools.ps1 -Profile frontend
node scripts/dev-storage.mts run -- pnpm --dir apps/desktop desktop:dev
On Linux/macOS, use ./scripts/bootstrap-quality-tools.sh --profile frontend
for the setup step. vp env install explicitly provisions the checkout's Node
and pnpm when needed; vp env current shows the selected versions. See
development setup for daily and
Core-only profiles.
Build the CLI using the repository storage wrapper:
node scripts/dev-storage.mts run -- cargo build -p portcove-cli --release
The documented command requires Node.js to run the storage wrapper and preserve
the repository storage checks and configured paths. The underlying Cargo build
compiles portcove-cli and portcove-core; compilation itself does not require
Node.js, pnpm, Tauri CLI, WebView, or frontend packages, and does not build the
desktop UI. Keep the storage wrapper for repository development.
Running a released CLI does not require Rust, Node.js, pnpm, Tauri CLI, WebView,
or frontend packages. It is an operating-system-native program: use the archive
matching Windows x64,
GNU/Linux x64, Intel macOS, or Apple-silicon macOS. Linux hosts need their normal
C runtime and D-Bus/secret-service support when saved credentials are used;
macOS and Windows use their system credential facilities.
For repository checks, packaging, and release work, see CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/QUALITY.md, and docs/RELEASING.md.
CLI quick tour
This example uses Lighthouse, the Banjo-Kazooie native port:
portcove about
portcove doctor
portcove catalog show lighthouse
portcove source add banjo-kazooie "/path/to/Banjo-Kazooie.z64"
portcove plan lighthouse
portcove install lighthouse
portcove exec lighthouse

Use --json for one-result machine output and --jsonl for streaming operations:
portcove --json check --all
portcove --jsonl reconcile lighthouse

Set PORTCOVE_LIBRARY or pass --library <path> to use a specific library root. The CLI is designed for scripts and external frontends; it does not require the desktop app. Current machine behavior is documented in docs/CLI.md, and the capability, ownership, and frontend-support model is documented in docs/INTEGRATIONS.md.
Documentation and contributing
Start with the documentation map. Deeper references cover the architecture, catalog policy, CLI contract, external frontend integration, release stages, and security policy.
Check the live roadmap and
existing issues before starting work. Prefer catalog data and shared core
adapters; use small title-specific core code when it enables a bounded useful
route without duplicating lifecycle authority. See
CONTRIBUTING.md for the full workflow.
Optional signed catalog updates
A signed catalog changes eligible catalog metadata; applying it does not install
game updates or update Portcove itself. No publisher key or scheduled fetch is
configured by default. Trusting a publisher is a se

gh-1452644248.title: GitHub - MertCNOZ/IndyPort: Unofficial native PC port of Indiana Jones and the Emperor's Tomb (Xbox, USA and Europe), with the IndyPort launcher. Bring your own copy of the game.
gh-1452644248.content:
An unofficial native PC port of the original Xbox version of Indiana Jones and the Emperor's Tomb (USA and
Europe), made by statically recompiling the game's code with Xbox XBE Recomp.
It comes with IndyPort, a launcher for choosing your copy of the game and setting up graphics and controls.
PC port by MertCNOZ.
Download the latest release

NoteNo game files are included. The port runs from your own legally acquired copy of the game: a disc image (.iso)
or the extracted files of the Xbox USA or Europe (PAL) release.

Getting started

Download the release and unzip it anywhere.
Run IndyPort.exe.
On the Game page, choose your disc image (.iso, a whole disc dump or an xiso) or the folder of the
extracted game (the one with default.xbe). Nothing is copied; the port reads the game where it is.
Press Play. The first start compiles the game's code for your PC; this only happens once.

Without a choice in IndyPort, the port also finds the game in an assets folder beside it.
USA and Europe releases
Both Xbox releases run: the USA disc and the Europe (PAL) disc, Indiana Jones and the Emperor's Tomb (Europe)
(En,Fr,De,Es,It). IndyPort reads which one you chose and starts the right port for it; the Home page names it.

Five languages on the Europe release: English, French, German, Spanish or Italian, chosen on the Game page.
The first start in a language installs its files from the disc, which takes about a minute.
Saves are shared: both releases use the same saves, so a game saved on one continues on the other.
The modern Xbox and keyboard and mouse button icons cover both releases, including the Europe release's French,
Italian and Spanish trigger and stick icons.

Features
Display and performance

Fullscreen, borderless or windowed, at any resolution.
Widescreen: a wider view at your screen's shape (16:9, 21:9) with the menus and HUD kept in proportion, or
the original 4:3.
Render scale from 50% to 200% (supersampling above 100%).
Frame rate limit of 30, 60, 120, 144, 165, 240, your monitor's refresh rate or unlimited. The game keeps its speed at any
frame rate.
An FPS counter (F9 in the game toggles it).

Picture

Sharp text and HUD: the game's fonts, menus and HUD are upscaled on your PC with smooth outlines, so they stay
crisp at 4K.
Modern Xbox button icons in the game's prompts and menus (LB/RB for White/Black, LT, RT, LS, RS), drawn for
high resolutions, or keyboard and mouse icons drawn from your own key bindings. The original icons are one
click away.
Sharpening (contrast adaptive) and up to 16x anisotropic filtering for the game's low resolution textures.
Draw distance up to 400% of each level's own.
Fill seams: fills hairline cracks between surfaces that can show as pale dots at high resolutions.
Sharper movies: the game's 640 x 480 videos are scaled with a sharper filter.
Texture packs: images in textures\replacement replace the game's textures; the game's textures can be dumped
to make them.

Controls

Xbox, PlayStation and Switch controllers, with hot plugging and rumble.
Remap every button of the game's controller in IndyPort, with a reset to defaults.
Keyboard and mouse: every button and stick direction can be bound to two keys or mouse buttons. Defaults:
move W A S D, action E, attack left mouse / F, jump Space, first person Left Alt, guard right mouse, draw / pack
Tab, reload R, items arrow keys, 1, 2 and the wheel, pause Esc, camera I J K L.
Mouse look, one to one in third and first person: the camera turns exactly as far as the mouse moves, with no
stick acceleration or smoothing, and stays where you leave it. Menus are played with the keyboard; there is no
cursor in the game.
Typing names for new saves with the keyboard.

Saves

Saves live on the port's Xbox hard disk (hdd\E\UDATA beside the exe). IndyPort lists them and backs them up.

Launcher

A Home page with the game's name, Play and shortcuts over a slowly drifting jungle temple painting; the pages as
tabs across the top; buttons that glow under the mouse. The motion follows Windows' animation effects setting.
Mouse, keyboard or controller (LB / RB change pages, Start plays).
English, Turkish and Russian (follows Windows, or chosen on the Advanced page).
Updates: IndyPort looks for a new release on GitHub when it starts (this can be turned off) and installs it
with one click. Only the port's own files are replaced: saves, settings, texture packs and your game files stay.

Screenshots

Graphics
Controls

System requirements

Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit
A graphics card with Direct3D 12

Building

Clone this repository with its submodules, and apply sdk-patches\*.patch to sdk.
Put your extracted game files in the assets folder: default.xbe with the game's folders beside it.
Install Visual Studio 2022 with Desktop development with C++, C++ Clang tools for Windows and
C++ CMake tools for Windows (build.bat offers to add the last two).
For the Europe release's exe as well, copy its default.xbe to assets_eu
(python tools\xiso_file.py <europe.iso> default.xbe assets_eu\default.xbe).
Run build.bat. The first build recompiles the game and takes a while. IndyET.exe, IndyET_EU.exe (Europe)
and IndyPort.exe are written to out\build\release; release.bat makes the zip.

Credits

Xbox XBE Recomp by TGP482, the recompiler and runtime this is built on.
XenonRecomp for the overridable function layout and instruction hooks.
Zydis, toml++,
Dear ImGui and SDL.
The launcher's jungle temple painting is royalty-free art; the modern button icons are drawn by
tools\make_button_icons.ps1 from shapes and text.

Legal
Indiana Jones is a trademark of Lucasfilm Ltd. This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by Lucasfilm,
LucasArts, Disney or Microsoft. It contains no game code or assets; you need your own copy of the game.

1mlxz2l.content: Уровень сложностиПростойВремя на прочтение1 минОхват и читатели557ПостЭто не инструкция, как избежать блокировки или как гарантированно вернуть аккаунт. Делюсь личным опытом, который может быть полезен.Заблокировали Pro-аккаунт Claude, работал в основном через Claude Code. Вход остался, история переписки тоже. Но на любое активное действие присылал ссылку на портал верификации.На одном сервисе цифровых услуг купил за 500р инструкцию, как проходить верификацию. У продавца несколько десятков положительных отзывов. Инструкция из разряда: переходил на красный цвет светофора и меня не сбили, значит так можно. В двух словах в инструкции сказано: используйте загранпаспорт, у меня получилось, как будет у вас хз, ничего не гарантирую. Кроме загранпаспорта РФ другого документа для предоставления у меня нет, поэтому проходил верификацию с ним. Через несколько минут получил блокировку. А если не получалось, то возвращал платеж. Но на кого то же Франция не нападала, и возвращать значит не требовалось. Ну и истории с "гарантированно помогу поступить в ВУЗ" из той же серии.Без особой надежды направил апелляцию. un36l2.title: A common food emulsifier could solve one of rocketry's oldest fuel problems
un36l2.content:
Graphic of the chemical process of fuel creation. Credit: P. Mudaliar & J. John

In propulsion system design, engineers have long faced a trade-off between solid and liquid rocket fuels. Each has advantages and disadvantages, and in an effort to try to min/max the efficacy of different types of fuel, researchers have long placed an emphasis on a hybrid between solids and liquids—in other words, they've been working with gels. Unfortunately, gels have their own sets of problems to deal with.

But a new paper published by Pranay Mudaliar and Jerin John of Concordia in the journal Langmuir uses an uncommon ingredient—lecithin—to elegantly solve some of those problems, though it's typically used in a completely different area of human activity.
Solid rocket boosters, like those that powered the space shuttle, are very stable, durable and quick to ignite. However, they are also impossible to turn off—you have to burn through all the propellant at once.
Liquid fuel, on the other hand, is much more flexible, much like automotive fuel. Liquid-fueled engines can be throttled up and down, restarted multiple times, and generally are much more controllable than their solid cousins. However, liquid fuels also float and slosh around in tanks, which is a particular problem in zero-gravity environments, as that sloshing can cause vapor pockets that can break a turbopump if not filtered out beforehand. Liquids also have a tendency to leak or evaporate over long periods, making them less than ideal for multiyear journeys through the solar system.

Fraser talks about some of the difficulties of orbital refueling.
On paper, gels offer a great solution to that. While sitting in a tank, they would act like a dense solid, but can also act like a liquid when forced into a combustion chamber. However, they suffer from their own challenges, such as shelf life and temperature-dependent phase changes.

The paper details a new type of fuel that uses an unexpected special ingredient. Lecithin might sound familiar, but not in the context of rocket fuel. It's commonly used as an emulsifier in food to keep chocolate smooth and salad dressing cohesive, and can be found on thousands of supermarket food labels. In the context of rocket fuel, lecithin acts simply as an organic gelling agent.
When combined with a trace amount of calcium chloride salt, lecithin molecules self-organize into microscopic wormlike structures called micelles. Chains of these form an invisible 3D mesh that can trap and hold kerosene molecules, a more traditional type of rocket fuel, in place. Lecithin also has the added advantage of being an organic compound made up of carbon and hydrogen, so it will burn right alongside the kerosene rather than acting as simply dead weight like many other noncombustible thickening agents previously used to create gel fuels.

Scott Manley talks about the engineering behind solid rocket boosters. Credit: Scott Manley YouTube channel
But perhaps the most interesting feature of the new fuel is a physical phenomenon known as shear thinning. When the gel is sitting under normal conditions in a tank, it holds its shape firmly like a gelatin, eliminating the sloshing features that cause so many problems in liquid-fuel rockets. However, as soon as there's mechanical pressure or shear force applied—such as when the spacecraft pressurizes the fuel lines—the micellar mesh breaks apart, causing the gel to quickly collapse into a liquid temporarily.
Measurements detailed in the paper show the gel's viscosity dropping by a factor of more than 100, creating an easily pumpable liquid that can be sprayed through injector nozzles. But when the pressure stops, the material snaps back to its rest state as a gel.

There are also two other environmental stimuli that can cause this liquid transformation—if the gel is heated up to between 59°C and 68°C, or splashed with a small amount of ethanol. In other words, localized thermal or chemical triggers could easily intentionally force specific amounts of fuel to liquefy without requiring the bulk of the fuel to do so.
Another appealing feature of the gel, from an experimental standpoint anyway, is that it's clear. Therefore, researchers can watch it with optical high-speed cameras and lasers to analyze its structure as well as its spray patterns. And a final appealing feature is its shelf life—the gel stayed stable in a tank for over a year, with no visible signs of the phase separation that plagues many other gelatin-like fuels.
It is still a very long road from the benchtop to the launchpad, though. The new fuel hasn't actually been sprayed through the high-pressure injectors that would be used on an actual rocket engine. Nor has it been shown to be capable of withstanding the vibrations and temperature shocks that come from being launched into space. But as the Concordia researchers continue its development, this new gel is looking promising for potentially powering a future mission.

Publication details
Pranay Mudaliar et al., Rheology and Thermal Characterization of Lecithin-Based Kerosene Gels for In-Space Propulsion, Langmuir (2026). DOI: 10.1021/acs.langmuir.6c01168

gh-1446041017.content:
Port não oficial para PC do ONRUSH™ (Xbox One, versão final 1.80.100.100).
Roda o jogo nativamente no Windows x64 com Direct3D 12, a partir da sua própria cópia.

Download ·
Início rápido ·
Novidades ·
Reportar um bug

ImportantO RushLauncher não contêm nenhum arquivo do jogo. Para jogar, você precisa da sua própria cópia do pacote do jogo. Os shaders são lidos e traduzidos na sua máquina, a partir dessa cópia.

NoteEste é um projeto de hobby, feito no meu tempo livre, sem manutenção ativa e sem cronograma de atualizações: novas versões saem quando (e se) houver tempo. Pull requests são bem-vindos, mas provavelmente não serão revisados.

Conteúdo: O que é · Destaques · Download · Início rápido · Controles · Configurações · Dicas · Perguntas frequentes · Próximos passos · Para desenvolvedores · Créditos · Licença · Aviso legal
O que é o RushLauncher?
RushLauncher roda o executável de Xbox One do jogo direto no Windows, sem emulador. Ele substitui as bibliotecas do sistema do console por versões próprias e traduz para o Direct3D 12 do PC as chamadas gráficas e os shaders da GPU do Xbox (GCN).
O launcher cuida de tudo: prepara o jogo a partir da sua cópia, aplica o patch da versão final, traduz os shaders e abre o jogo. Veja Como funciona.
Destaques

Nativo no Windows. O código do jogo roda direto na CPU. Os gráficos usam Direct3D 12.
Shaders preparados uma vez. Na primeira vez, o launcher lê os shaders direto dos pacotes do jogo, traduz e compila tudo de uma vez, com uma barra de progresso. O jogo não precisa ser aberto para isso.
Sem duplicar o jogo. Os pacotes grandes (dat\, ~34 GB) ficam na sua cópia e são ligados por atalhos (junctions). Só ~60 MB são copiados.
Versão final do jogo. Se a sua cópia for a 1.0.64980.34, o launcher aplica o patch 1.80.100.100 sozinho.
Controle ou teclado. Controles de Xbox funcionam direto. O teclado também serve de controle, com as teclas configuráveis na aba Controles.
Perfis. Vários jogadores, cada um com o próprio save e as próprias horas de jogo.
Modo foto. F12 salva a imagem do jogo sem a interface, em PNG ou JPG. A aba Fotos mostra a galeria.
Atualização automática. O launcher procura novas versões no GitHub e se atualiza sozinho, mantendo configurações, saves e shaders.
Discord Rich Presence (em implantação), idiomas do texto e da voz do jogo, e launcher em português, inglês e espanhol.

Download

Plataforma
Como obter
Testado em

Windows 10/11 x64
Zip rushlauncher-vX.Y.Z.zip da última release
Windows 11, Ryzen 7 5700, RTX 3060 12 GB

Para conferir o zip baixado, compare o SHA-256 com o que aparece ao lado do arquivo na página da release:
Get-FileHash .\rushlauncher-vX.Y.Z.zip -Algorithm SHA256
O que mudou em cada versão está no CHANGELOG.
Requisitos do sistema

Windows 10 ou 11, 64 bits.
GPU com Direct3D 12 (feature level 12_0) e driver atualizado.
A sua cópia do jogo: o pacote extraído do ONRUSH para Xbox One (a pasta com Mount\ e EmbeddedXvd\). Se ela for a versão 1.0.64980.34, também a pasta do patch da versão 1.80.100.100.
Espaço: ~36 GB para o jogo preparado com o patch e shaders traduzidos.

Início rápido

Extraia o zip nem qualquer pasta.
Abra o OnRushLauncher.exe e escolha a pasta da sua cópia do jogo (o pacote extraído, com Mount\ e EmbeddedXvd\).
Se a cópia não estiver na versão final, o launcher pede a pasta do patch 1.80.100.100 e aplica as diferenças. Os pacotes novos são movidos da pasta do patch para a cópia: no mesmo disco, isso é instantâneo e não ocupa espaço extra.
O launcher prepara o jogo na própria pasta: copia o executável e os arquivos pequenos, liga dat\ e EmbeddedXvd\ à sua cópia e cria o onrush-pc.exe. A sua cópia não é alterada.
Aperte JOGAR. Na primeira vez aparece Preparando shaders: o launcher lê os shaders dos pacotes do jogo, traduz e compila tudo, e só então abre o jogo. Leva alguns minutos (cerca de 3 minutos numa CPU de 8 núcleos e 16 threads, mais a leitura dos pacotes) e acontece uma vez só. Ela só se repete se os pacotes do jogo mudarem ou se uma versão nova do tradutor precisar.
O botão Pular abre o jogo na hora. O que faltou é feito no próximo JOGAR.

Pela linha de comando, OnRushLauncher.exe -setup "D:\caminho\do\pacote" prepara o jogo sem passar pela interface.
Como atualizar
O launcher procura novas versões ao abrir (e no botão Verificar atualizações). Se você aceitar, ele baixa o zip, confere o SHA-256, fecha, instala e abre de novo. Configurações, perfis, saves, fotos, shaders e os arquivos do jogo são mantidos. Para atualizar à mão, extraia o zip novo por cima da pasta antiga.
Controles
Controles de Xbox (XInput) funcionam direto. O teclado também funciona como um controle de Xbox, ao mesmo tempo que o controle de verdade, e só é lido enquanto a janela do jogo está em foco.

Trocando as teclas
Na aba Controles do launcher:

A aba Perfis cria, renomeia e exclui perfis (o nome do perfil é o nome do jogador). Cada perfil tem dois interruptores, aplicados só enquanto o jogo roda (o save não é alterado): Desbloquear cosméticos e Desbloquear tudo (cosméticos e eventos).

Dicas

Deixe a primeira preparação de shaders terminar. Com Pular, o jogo abre antes, mas pode faltar parte da imagem até o próximo JOGAR.
Guarde a sua cópia do jogo no mesmo disco do launcher: os atalhos e o patch ficam instantâneos.
Depois de atualizar o driver de vídeo, o primeiro JOGAR remonta o cache de pipelines (alguns segundos).
A tela cheia sem bordas é a mais estável. Use Alt+Enter para trocar sem fechar o jogo.

Perguntas frequentes e problemas
O jogo não vem junto? Não. Você precisa da sua própria cópia do pacote de Xbox One. O projeto não distribui nada do jogo.
Funciona com a versão 1.0.64980.34? Funciona depois do patch 1.80.100.100, que o launcher aplica sozinho se você indicar a pasta do patch.
A preparação de shaders vai rodar toda vez? Não. Ela roda na primeira vez, quando os pacotes do jogo mudam ou quando uma versão nova do launcher traz um tradutor corrigido. Nos outros casos, o JOGAR abre o jogo em cerca de 1 segundo.
Partes da imagem estão erradas ou faltando. Alguns efeitos ainda não são traduzidos corretamente (veja Próximos passos). Reporte com uma captura: F11 salva 12 quadros seguidos.

Reportando um bug

Se for um problema de imagem, aperte F11 na hora.
Abra uma issue com o que aconteceu, os logs onrush_launcher.log e onrush_d3d12_x.log, as capturas frame_*_backbuffer.bmp e o modelo da sua GPU.

Próximos passos

Corrigir os efeitos visuais que ainda faltam ou aparecem errados (partículas, aura do Rush, efeitos de água).
Otimizar o desempenho e a preparação de shaders.

Sem datas: as versões saem quando estiverem prontas.
Para desenvolvedores
Como funciona

Pasta
Conteúdo

src/launcher
OnRushLauncher.exe: prepara o jogo, aplica o patch, extrai e traduz os shaders, perfis, fotos, configurações, Discord e atualização automática

src/d3d12_x
Ponte D3D12.X (Xbox) → D3D12 de PC: PSOs, descritores, tradução de shaders, ESRAM, modo foto, música

src/kernelx, src/combase, src/EtwPlus, src/MMDevAPI
Substitutos das bibliotecas do sistema do console

scripts/translator
Tradutor GCN → HLSL (gcn2hlsl.py), bypass de tesselação e compilação com o DXC; translate_all.py é o ponto de entrada

scripts/build_translator.ps1
Empacota o tradutor como translator\olauncher-translator.exe (PyInstaller) com o DXC do Windows SDK

scripts/build.ps1
Compila tudo em bin\

scripts/build_fsr2.ps1
Baixa (versão fixa, conferida por hash) e compila o AMD FSR 2 em deps\fsr2\; o build.ps1 chama sozinho

scripts/stage.ps1
Monta a pasta jogável juntando a sua cópia do jogo com os binários

A preparação de shaders tem três partes:

Extração. O launcher lê os pacotes dat\*.dat (fluxos LZ4) e grava cada shader (VS, PS, CS e pares de tesselação) em shaders\, com o mesmo nome que a ponte usa.
Tradução. O tradutor converte o microcódigo GCN de cada shader em HLSL e compila para DXIL com o DXC, em paralelo.
Pipelines. O launcher monta o cache de pipelines da sua GPU.

Compilando
Requisitos: Visual Studio 2022 ou mais novo, com Desenvolvimento para desktop com C++; Windows SDK 10.0.22621 ou mais novo; CMake (para o FSR 2); e, para empacotar o tradutor, Python 3.10+ com pyinstaller.
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\build.ps1 # gera bin\
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\build_translator.ps1 # gera bin\translator\ (Python + pyinstaller)
# opcional, sem o launcher: monta dist_game\ a partir da sua cópia
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\stage.ps1 -GameRoot "D:\caminho\do\pacote"
Para traduzir os shaders sem o launcher (com Python e o Windows SDK): python scripts\translator\translate_all.py <pasta do jogo>.

19wk6av.title: Названы три риска при вдыхании паров незамерзайки
19wk6av.content: Метиловый спирт, который кладут в основу стеклоомывающих жидкостей, – опасный яд. И речь здесь вовсе не о том, что жидкость можно случайно выпить: тяжелое отравление человек получает, просто вдыхая ее пары.С какими именно последствиями для организма это связано и как их избежать, объяснил Андрей Кондрахин, к.м.н., старший преподаватель кафедры фармакологии Института фармации и медицинской химии Пироговского Университета. «Метиловый спирт очень ядовит, он вызывает сильнейшее отравление, потерю зрения, мощнейший панкреатит и летальный исход. Но если мы говорим про применение его в незамерзающей жидкости, здесь вопрос в другом. Вопрос в экспозиции», - отметил эксперт.Под экспозицией, как объяснил Кондрахин, имеется в виду длительность воздействия. При кратковременном использовании концентрация паров в салоне может не достигать критических значений. Однако в условиях дальних поездок, когда расходуются большие объемы стеклоомывателя, регулярное вдыхание испарений в замкнутом пространстве автомобиля может приводить к накопительному эффекту, что представляет прямую угрозу для здоровья.Эксперт рекомендовал при появлении запаха жидкости проветривать салон, на время отключать систему кондиционирования или обогрева, чтобы вентилятор не затягивал пары внутрь, а также включать рециркуляцию воздуха.Однако, по мнению эксперта, использование такой незамерзайки никак не повлияет на здоровье при кратковременных поездках: «Дело в том, что метанол быстро улетучивается. Мало того, спирт гигроскопичен: он быстро с водой соединится, быстро выйдет и улетучится, поэтому ничего страшного не будет».О других осенних неприятностях, которые могут испортить машину, «За рулем» уже рассказывал.Понравилась публикация?Тогда добавьте «За рулем» в список интересных источников: 1. Откройте https://google.com... 2. Поставьте галочку напротив нашего изданияГотово – остаемся на связи! «За рулем» можно читать и в Телеграм

1fgde7a.title: Russian casualties ‘reach 450,000’: What that means for the Ukraine war
1fgde7a.content: Records leaked from Rosstat, Russia’s state statistics agency, have shown that at least 450,000 Russians, most of them soldiers, died in the war in Ukraine up to August this year.Among the dead were more than 4,000 foreign citizens who are believed to have died fighting for Russia, from countries including Uzbekistan, Tajikistan, Nepal, Colombia and Nigeria.The records were obtained by two hacking groups, the Belarusian Cyber Partisans and Ukraine’s Silent Crow.Rosstat confirmed it had been hit by cyberattacks between October 29 and November 1, but said it found no evidence that its databases had been compromised or that protected data leaked.Moscow does not officially publish its military death toll.Deaths can take months, and sometimes years, to be registered, in Russia. Investigations for The Financial Times (FT) have concluded that once late paperwork is counted, the toll up to August will settle at about 550,000.So what do the leaked records show, and what do they tell us about who is fighting Russia’s war? Here’s what you need to know:What was leaked, and is it genuine?The Cyber Partisans and Silent Crow said on November 1 that they had broken into Rosstat’s network.The two hacking groups published their own analysis of the records and shared the files with several news organisations, though the data has not been independently verified.However, media outlets and analysts say they believe it is real.Janis Kluge, an expert on Russia at the German Institute for International and Security Affairs, wrote on X: “There is no longer any doubt that the leaked Rosstat database is authentic. You can find any famous person who has died in recent years.”However, in a later post he added: “The trickier question is: Was the data manipulated to increase the war death toll?” before adding, “This would [be] unbelievably difficult, so this is a highly unlikely conspiracy theory”.What do the records show?A death toll far beyond anything Moscow has admitted so far.The files list about 410,000 deaths directly as war-related, and 42,000 more fighting-age men whose deaths were confirmed in court because their bodies have never been recovered.The FT identified another 12,000 likely military deaths among men who died at or near the front, bringing the total to at least 450,000.(Al Jazeera)Where have most of those Russian casualties occurred?About 120,000 of those with a recorded location died in the area containing Avdiivka and Pokrovsk, and a further 48,000 in Bakhmut, the FT reported.Avdiivka is a small industrial city in the Donetsk region. After Russian-backed forces seized parts of eastern Ukraine in 2014 and 2015, it became part of the so-called “contact line”, and Ukrainian forces spent years fortifying the city.When Russia launched its full-scale invasion in February 2022, it was the subject of two years of bitter fighting before Russia took it in 2024.After the fall of Avdiivka, Russian forces moved towards the coal-mining city of Pokrovsk in the Donetsk region, capturing it in early 2026 after more than a year of gruelling battles that had left the city in ruins.Bakhmut, a city in the Donetsk Oblast and situated at a vital intersection connecting eastern Ukraine with the rest of the country, was the site of the longest and bloodiest infantry battle of the war before falling to Russian and paramilitary Wagner Group forces in May 2023.People attend a fundraising event in Ruaka Town, Kiambu County, Kenya, for Grace Gathoni Kagombe, the widow of Martin Macharia Mburu, who was killed fighting in Ukraine for Russia after accepting a civilian job offer [File: Ed Ram/Getty]Who has been killed?Older men from poorer, often minority regions.The average age of those killed rose from 34 in the first year of the war to 40 in 2025, and men aged 35 to 44 made up the largest group, with 158,000 dead, the FT reported.Ethnic Russians constitute more than two-thirds of Russia’s population of 143 million. The rest are minorities – from millions of ethnic Ukrainians and Tatars to smaller Indigenous groups in Siberia and the Arctic.Zabaykalsky Krai, home to a large community of Buryats, an Indigenous Mongolic people of southern Siberia, recorded about 12,300 deaths, roughly one for every 80 people in the region, the FT reported.Bashkortostan, another region with a large minority population including Indigenous Bashkirs and Volga Tatars, recorded 15,800 deaths.How many foreign fighters have been killed?More than 4,000, and possibly far more.The FT identified 4,141 probable foreign soldiers holding foreign citizenship among the dead.Bloomberg News, using a wider definition that includes people born outside Russia, counted 11,335, with foreign deaths rising from about 630 in 2022 to more than 5,500 in 2025.Deaths of Nepalis were concentrated in 2023 and 2024, and those of Colombians, Kenyans and Nigerians from late 2025, Bloomberg reported.The FT counted the highest death toll from Uzbekistan at 807, followed by Tajikistan with 598. There were also 44 Nepali dead and 98 Colombians, the highest toll from Latin America.About 340 Africans are among the dead, most of them killed since 2025, Bloomberg reported.Nigeria, Cameroon and Egypt had the highest tolls, with 127 deaths between them, according to the FT.Furthermore, Ukrainian officials believe Russia deployed some 14,000 North Korean troops to hold off Ukraine’s 2024 incursion into the Kursk region, but they do not appear in the leaked data.Why are foreigners fighting for Russia?Mostly for the money, and often after being misled.An estimated 28,000 foreigners from 136 countries are said to be fighting in the Russian army overall.An Amnesty International report in September found that people from Brazil, Colombia, Sri Lanka and South Africa had been promised well-paid civilian jobs and then forced into the army on arrival in Russia.The rights group spoke with foreign nationals currently serving with Russian forces and members of their families as well as lawyers, human rights activists and journalists.It found local agents and misleading online job advertisements were being used to deceive foreign nationals in their home countries.Nationals from 36 African countries are known to be fighting for Russia in the four-year war, Ukraine’s foreign minister said in November last year.One South African man who applied online for a driving job in Poland was told to fly to Moscow, pick up a truck, and drive it to Poland.His wife told Amnesty International: “Upon arrival to Moscow, everything was taken from him. He was told that he would not be going to Poland and that he is becoming a soldier.”Many recruits were promised lucrative salaries and sign-up bonuses that were not then fulfilled, Amnesty reported.In Kenya, where intelligence officials say more than 1,000 citizens have been recruited, agencies promised monthly wages of about $2,715 and bonuses of up to $9,309.Moscow denies coercing anyone to fight in Ukraine.What do these casualty figures mean for the war in Ukraine?They indicate that Russia is struggling for manpower.The Institute for the Study of War, a Washington-based think tank, posted an analysis of the leaked data, saying the figures likely understate Russia’s true losses because of reporting limitations.It added that, as of July, Russia’s casualties are now outpacing its recruitment.Kluge told The Moscow Times that the deaths also represent about half a per cent of Russia’s working-age population, which may have little economic impact, so the main significance is political.He added, “You cannot say Russia is winning this war if it is losing population at this rate.”

1eizanf.title: Beware the New AI-Fueled Ransomware Boom
1eizanf.content: Welcome to Kernel Panic, a weekly newsletter by Lily Hay Newman and Matt Burgess from inside the new world of privacy and digital security. To receive this newsletter in your inbox each week, sign up here.With so much going on all the time, you may not have thought about ransomware and data extortion attacks in a minute, even though they’ve been among the the biggest cybersecurity threats to institutions—and, by extension, people—over the past decade. But in the new era of AI-powered and automated cyberattacks, the danger posed by ransomware is only increasing as cybercriminals profit by combining established methods with new techniques made possible or more accessible by AI.It is difficult to determine exact numbers of ransomware attacks, given that victims don’t always disclose incidents and attackers wildly inflate their claims. But researchers who specialize in tracking and attempting to de-duplicate the field agree that claimed incidents have spiked over the last few months. Some put the number of alleged ransomware attacks on leak sites—where groups post alleged victims—at nearly 3,000 attacks over the summer. This would mean a 20 to 40 percent increase since the spring by some estimates. And, crucially, researchers emphasize that while volume always fluctuates somewhat, ransomware attacks overall have been consistently and concerningly elevated in recent years.“What we see is most of the recent increase was fueled by international attacks; the United States was a little more steady, but still high, still a lot of attacks,” says Cynthia Kaiser, former FBI cyber deputy director who now leads research for the anti-ransomware platform Halcyon. “Internationally we’re seeing a lot more attacks. That to me is the really new part, and I do think it is in part fueled by AI.”Fully AI-powered ransomware attacks have yet to emerge, perhaps because the criminal business model already works so effectively. But cybercriminals do appear to be using LLMs for some of the more mundane aspects of their attacks.“We are seeing AI relied on more heavily in certain aspects of the ransomware attack chain, such as creating better phishing emails and in the negotiation process, but the ‘successful’ ransomware groups are still largely human operated,” says Allan Liska, a longtime ransomware researcher and threat intelligence analyst at Recorded Future. “But the fact that these groups are experimenting heavily with AI means that this could change going forward, and change quickly.”Kaiser notes that broader trends in scamming are always relevant to ransomware, because attackers often use the same types of phishing and social engineering techniques to gain initial access to targeted systems. In Japan, for example, successful scamming has spiked drastically in recent months as AI enables foreign attackers to generate consistently convincing content in Japanese for the first time.A few ransomware groups—namely, the Gentlemen, Qilin, and Akira—have emerged as some of the most prominent and stable operations in recent months. However, in their shadow is a range of smaller groups, emerging actors, and fragmentation of the ransomware ecosystem. In recent weeks, multiple new ransomware groups have appeared and quickly claimed to have attacked dozens of businesses. Halycon’s analysis says around 111 ransomware groups made claims of attacks between July and September this year.One new group calling itself Global Secret Group claimed attacks on 48 victims, with more than half of these being listed on the same day, according to security firm ReliaQuest’s analysis. Another, called Storm, listed 71 victims in just 20 days. Not all of the attacks may be legitimate, but they still cause uncertainty for businesses.“That growth has all happened because, in my eyes, this acceleration that AI has provided to these threat actors, essentially allowing for them to go out and start their own groups,” says Brandon Tirado, the director of threat research at ReliaQuest.Instead of being beholden to traditional “ransomware-as-a-service” providers, all of the researchers Kernel Panic spoke to say they have seen more lone-wolf operators branching out. Tirado says his team recently managed to identify who is behind one new group and found that it is being run by an inexperienced teenager who has made more than $800,000 in under two weeks. He declined to name the teen publicly.Halcyon’s Kaiser agrees that more actors are using AI to attempt to strike out on their own with expanded capabilities to trick targets, exploit vulnerabilities, check their code, and even compromise other groups’ remote-access tools to gain redundant access to a victim in case one avenue gets blocked. But she adds that it’s still not clear how successful these upstarts will be long-term. She suspects that many of them may surge initially and then burn out, because they don’t have the institutional knowledge and expanded resources of an established group.While established attackers typically conduct “double extortion” attacks in which they deploy traditional ransomware that encrypts a victim’s systems while also exfiltrating a target’s data and then threatening to publish it online, those operating independently may be more likely to focus solely on data extortion to simplify their operations.“The number of attacks that Recorded Future has seen this year already dwarfs the total number for 2025,” Liska says, “but the number of attacks involving encryption may actually decrease year over year.”Spotted something we should include next week? Let us know at [email protected]. And stay safe out there.

gh-1427205852.title: GitHub - lunchbox-recomp/dragoon: Kirby Air Ride (GameCube, USA) recompiled to run natively on Mac. You build it from your own disc.
gh-1427205852.content:
Kirby Air Ride (GameCube, USA) recompiled to run natively on Mac. You build it from your own disc. Nothing from the game is in this repo.
I loved this game as a kid, mostly playing it on my own. I'm a software engineer, and getting to work on it now as an adult still feels a little unreal. I want Dragoon to be something the people who kept Kirby Air Ride alive are glad exists, so it's built in the open and credits them below.
Status
Tested on one Mac, an M4 Max on macOS 26.

Part
State

Title and menus
Work. The preview on the right of the mode select shows a race

Air Ride
All eight courses a blank card can pick race past the countdown. Nebula Belt is locked on a blank card

City Trial
Runs with one player, or four in split screen at full speed. An effect the tested routes don't reach can stutter the first time it shows up

Stadium
Reached from City Trial. Drag Race plays out to its results with one player or four. Target Flight and Destruction Derby haven't been played

Top Ride
All seven courses a fresh save offers race past the countdown, with one player and three CPUs

Audio
Partial. Voices send to the effect buses and the game's compressor runs. Voices resample through a polyphase filter for nearly all of their playing time, but the low-pass filter isn't applied. Nobody has compared it with a real console (details)

Controllers
Up to four gamepads, one per port. Each takes the port saves/ports.txt last gave it when that port is free. One the file doesn't name takes its player number's port when that's free, and any other takes the lowest free one. Pulling one out frees its port. The keyboard is on port 1. Tested with simulated gamepads, not with four real ones or Steam Input

Picture
4:3 by default. --aspect=16:9 or the in-game menu's Display page widens the world in the race, City Trial and Top Ride routes it was measured on. Air Ride's and City Trial's HUD keeps its 4:3 shape, while Top Ride's HUD and the menus stretch

Other platforms
Not tested

Full numbers are in docs/dev/status.md.
Building
You need:

your own Kirby Air Ride disc (USA, GKYE01) as an .iso, .ciso or .gcm. Convert .rvz and .gcz first
a Mac with Apple Silicon and the Xcode Command Line Tools
CMake and Ninja (brew install cmake ninja)

The first configure downloads the source of SDL 3.4.18 (15.7 MB) and Dear ImGui 1.92.9b (2.1 MB) and checks their hashes. -DGCN_SYSTEM_SDL=ON uses an SDL3 you already have, and -DGCN_OVERLAY=OFF builds without the in-game menu and skips Dear ImGui.
git clone --recursive https://github.com/lunchbox-recomp/dragoon
cd dragoon
ln -s "/path/to/Kirby Air Ride (USA).gcm" rom/game.iso
cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja
ninja -C build
build/dragoon
The first build also runs the game hidden and silent, for about a minute on an M4 Max, so the shaders it draws are compiled before you play. If that run fails, the build stops and says how to skip it. To skip it from the start, add -DDRAGOON_WARMUP=OFF to the cmake line.
The game keeps its memory card and shader cache in saves/, in the folder you start it from. The build's warm-up puts its shaders in the clone's own saves/, so start build/dragoon from the clone's top folder. Started anywhere else, it begins with a blank card and compiles shaders as it goes.
The wrong disc stops the configure step and prints the disc ID it found.
How it works
gcn-recomp reads the game's code from your disc and translates its 20,003 PowerPC functions to C. That C is compiled together with a runtime that stands in for the GameCube's hardware.
This repo holds the Kirby Air Ride side, like function names and the tables that tell the recompiler about the game's quirks. Engine fixes go to our gcn-recomp fork and are sent upstream as pull requests.
AI
Claude, Codex or local models running in Pi write the code. I decide what gets built and check the results by playing it on my own disc. These docs are drafted the same way, and I edit them.
Commits don't carry AI co-author lines. Almost every commit would need one and the tool changes from day to day, so this section covers all of them.
Credits

gcn-recomp by Ethan Nicholas, the recompiler and runtime Dragoon is built on (MIT)
wowjinxy/KAR, a Kirby Air Ride decompilation, for the function names in analysis/symbols.txt (CC0)
doldecomp/kar, the earlier Kirby Air Ride decompilation, where some of those names were first worked out

Legal
Dragoon isn't affiliated with or endorsed by Nintendo or HAL Laboratory. Kirby Air Ride is a Nintendo trademark. You need your own copy of the game to build Dragoon. A build contains the game's code, so please don't share it.
Dragoon's own code is MIT licensed. See LICENSE.

gh-1441934743.title: GitHub - Lucas-blip-png/dkb-pc-recomp: Static recompilation of Donkey Kong Bananza (Switch 2) to native Windows with Vulkan. 0.3.0 plays well past the first level on recent NVIDIA cards. On the bananza branch: AMD device loss fixed for testers, a heavy scene at about 58 fps (was 53), full-resolution 3D (scene_res). Roadmap: #10. No game files included.
gh-1441934743.content:
DKB Recomp is a static recompilation of Donkey Kong Bananza (Nintendo Switch 2, 2025) into a native Windows x86-64 application with a Vulkan renderer. There is no emulator at run time: the game's ARM64 code is translated to C ahead of time and compiled into one executable, and its graphics calls are answered by a host implementation of NVN 2. It is built on TotK Recomp, which does the same for Tears of the Kingdom on the original Switch. As far as we know, no other static recompilation of a Switch 2 game is public. ImportantNo game files are included, and none ever will be. You need your own copy of Donkey Kong Bananza, dumped from your own console. Instructions for obtaining those files will not be provided. The game itself is never downloadable: the release carries the installer, and everyone builds the game from their own dump. Status Playable on recent NVIDIA cards, well past the first level. Players report runs through layer -101, sublayer 200, the Glacier layer, Snow World (Layer 500) and the Tempest layer. The current release is 0.3.0. The latest release carries an installer that builds the game from your own dump: docs/installer.md. What still fails: Device lost on NVIDIA in the Glacier rock ride (#196) and in Layer 500 (#197): one bug, with the same draw in flight in both. Fast-linked pipelines and the pipeline cache are ruled out; a recorded crashing run is being replayed. Device lost on AMD cards with AMD's Windows driver. On 0.3.0, vk_recorder = 0 in dkb.ini stopped it for three players (#84, #155, #142), then #124 and #123, and it is the default on bananza since d161f88. Other AMD reports wait for a retest (#176, #193, #206). GPU hangs under RADV on Linux are still open (#99, #122, #198, #204). Guest crashes in later areas (#148, #157, #136, #218, #229). Missing effects in the Tempest layer (falling golden hail, tornadoes: #221, #183). Heavy scenes below 60 fps (#141, #156, #194, #207). On bananza (70c1b4a) new defaults raise our heavy test scene from about 53 to 58 fps and halve the frames over 25 ms; a stall of about 0.45 s on area loads is left. See docs/dkb-lowend.md. A soft 3D picture: the game's dynamic resolution draws the scene at 2/3 of the output (1280x720 at 1080p, #210). On bananza (9190e6b), scene_res = full draws it at the output size. Progress, day by day: docs/devlog.md. Last updated: 13 November 2026. Phase State F0 CPU ✅ main and sdk (180,061 functions) lift with no unsupported instruction (ARMv8.3 pointer authentication and LDAPR added). Differential tests against Unicorn pass. F1 OS ✅ Boots on TotK Recomp's Horizon host with the Switch 2 differences: RomFS, save, audio, controller. F2 NVN 2 ✅ 700 NVN 2 entry points answered; the game loop runs. 51 new command buffer calls (mesh shaders, VRS, DLSS, push constants…) are accepted but not recorded yet. F3 Shaders ✅ All 4,820 Ampere shader stages of the first 3D scene go through Eglantine's Ampere-to-Maxwell lowering and TotK Recomp's translator to SPIR-V. F4 Vulkan ✅ The title screen and the tutorial's 3D scene render. F5 Playable ✅ Controller, guide movies (VP9), push constants, installer and releases 0.1.0 to 0.3.0. F6 Stability 🚧 Device lost on NVIDIA and AMD, RADV hangs and guest crashes in later areas. F7 Performance 🚧 A heavy scene runs at about 58 fps on bananza, with a stall of about 0.45 s on area loads. F8 Image 🚧 Missing effects, some textures and terrain details. F9 Platforms 🚧 Linux and macOS preview packages, RecompLauncher, audio and DLC. The plan, phase by phase: docs/bananza-plan.md. What is open right now: Roadmap to playable. How it works flowchart LR subgraph offline["At build time, on your PC"] exefs["Your dump: main + sdk
(ARM64)"] --> lifter["Lifter
recomp/"] --> c["C code"] --> clang["Clang"] --> exe["dkb.exe"] end subgraph runtime["At run time"] exe --> host["Horizon host
threads, files, audio, input"] exe --> nvn["NVN 2 front end
runtime/nvn_*"] --> vk["Vulkan back end"] sass["Ampere shaders"] --> lower["Eglantine lowering
Ampere → Maxwell"] --> xlate["Translator
tools/xlate"] --> spirv["SPIR-V"] --> vk end Loading The longer version is in docs/architecture.md (shared with TotK Recomp) and docs/bananza-shaders.md (the NVN 2 shader work). How to help Each open problem is a separate, well-bounded job with its own issue. Pick one, say in the issue that you are on it, and keep each pull request to one topic. Issues labelled in progress are already taken, and the top of the roadmap says what is being worked on right now. No code needed, only your PC and your own copy of the game: #3 Test on your GPU. Everything so far was checked on one NVIDIA card. Runs on AMD, Intel and other NVIDIA cards, with logs, show what breaks there. #7 Play past the tutorial and report where it stops. #9 The GPU fault after the first guide movie: seen on three NVIDIA drivers (617.14, 617.42, 621.01); runs on AMD and Intel would show whether it is NVIDIA's. Code (help wanted): #5 Checkerboard textures on some rock surfaces. The Switch 2 GOB layout (f4f7b17) fixes the gold rock in the tutorial cave; the other surfaces still need a check. #6 NVN 2 calls not recorded yet: mesh shaders, VRS, DLSS and others. Symbols. Function names help debugging. They come from GRAnimated/DKBananza, which welcomes contributions too. Your first contribution, step by step: Build from your own dump (Building from source). Run it as in docs/dkb-testing.md and note how far it gets on your machine. Report it on #3 or #7, or pick an issue above. Before you open a pull request, read CONTRIBUTING.md. Its hard rule: nothing that came out of the game goes into the repository, not in commits, issues or pull requests. Run python tools/check_content.py --staged before committing; CI runs the same check. Questions go to Discussions. Everyone taking part follows the code of conduct. Support the project If you want to support the work without writing code, tips go to ko-fi.com/lucasblippng. A tip pays for time on the project; it buys no game files, builds or early access, and everything stays open source here. Starring the repository and sharing it with people who know GPUs, ARM64 or the Switch also helps. Building from source The toolchain is TotK Recomp's (docs/building.md): MSYS2 UCRT64 Clang, Ninja, Python 3.12 and the .NET SDK for the shader translator. With the Bananza ExeFS and RomFS from your own dump: .venv\Scripts\python tools\build_xlate.py .venv\Scripts\python recomp\gen.py --exefs --out generated\dkb100 --modules main,sdk --patches recomp\patches-dkb100.txt .venv\Scripts\python tools\dkb_expected.py --exefs --name dkb100 --display 1.0.0 .venv\Scripts\python tools\dkb_pack_romfs.py --dir --out build\extracted\dkb100\romfs .venv\Scripts\python tools\build_game.py --version dkb100 --expected tools\data\expected-dkb100.json --exefs --romfs build\extracted\dkb100\romfs Everything the build writes stays under build\ and generated\, which git ignores. The game commits about 14 GB (13.5 GiB at the start and 13.75 GiB after 40 minutes, rising about 6 MB per minute; longer sessions are untested), so 16 GB of RAM plus a large page file is the minimum for now and 32 GB is comfortable. Running and testing: docs/dkb-testing.md. FAQ Can I play it? Partly. One hand-played run went from the title screen through the tutorial, its cutscene and the first stage to its end on an RTX 5060 Ti, with drops while a new area loads; other cards are untested and it can still crash. Follow the roadmap or the devlog. Is there a download? Of the installer, on the release page. The executable is made from the game's own code, so it cannot be shared. Everyone builds it from their own dump; the installer does this for you (docs/installer.md). Which version of the game? Base 1.0.0 and update 3.2.0 (title version 458752, the newest). The installer takes either a .nup file (the container Eglantine and Eden load; with the 3.2.0 update inside it builds 3.2.0) or ExeFS and RomFS folders. Other updates are refused by their hashes. The 3.2.0 build installs and boots, and holds 60 fps for 150 s at the start on an RTX 5060 Ti, but nobody has played it yet. Add-on content (DLC) has a reader (an aoc- folder beside the executable, docs/dkb-testing.md) checked against synthetic packs and a real one, but it has not been tried in the game. Linux? Preview. The release page carries DKB-Setup--linux-x86_64.tar.gz: the sources and a setup script, not a binary. You install the system packages and it builds the game from your dump. The build from source is verified on AMD and NVIDIA GPUs (docs/installer.md, "Bananza Linux and macOS packages"). macOS? Preview. DKB-Setup--macos-arm64.zip is the same kind of package. It builds and boots on Apple Silicon with MoltenVK: the game reaches the mode select (docs/building.md, "macOS"). It is not verified beyond that, and the destructible terrain is missing until the geometry stages have a vertex-stage replacement. Why GPL? The shader lowering comes from Eglantine (Eden Emulator Project), which is GPL. Files that came from TotK Recomp keep their MIT terms. How is AI used? Most of the code and documentation is written by AI coding agents (Claude Code), as in TotK Recomp, and checked by running the game and the differential tests. AI-assisted pull requests are welcome; you are responsible for having read and run them. Credits and origin DKB Recomp is built on TotK Recomp (Tears of the Kingdom, Switch 1) by valentderah and its contributors (MIT, kept in LICENSE-MIT). It uses Eglantine's Ampere shader lowering (GPL-3.0-or-later, runtime/third_party/eglantine/) and Ryujinx's shader translator (MIT, vendored with MacNativeGames' patches), plus the other projects in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. The whole is under LICENSE. TotK Recomp by valentderah, the base of everything here, and the projects it builds on: LAS Recomp, MacNativeGames, nxnative, SavageWindRecomp, Ryujinx, deko3d, hactool and the rest listed in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. GRAnimated/DKBananza for the game's symbols and research. Eglantine (Eden Emulator Project) for the Ampere-to-Maxwell shader lowering and its Switch 2 notes, and Mesa NAK for the SM70+ encodings both build on. libvpx for the movies. Switchbrew for the Switch 2 GetInfo ids, and the Switch homebrew community. License DKB Recomp as a whole is under the GNU GPL v3 or later, because it includes Eglantine's GPL Ampere shader lowering (runtime/third_party/eglantine/). The files that came from TotK Recomp keep their MIT License; third-party code keeps its own license (THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). The license grants nothing for Nintendo's game. DKB Recomp is an independent, non-commercial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Nintendo. Donkey Kong Bananza and Nintendo Switch 2 are trademarks of Nintendo.

gh-1418784471.title: GitHub - erikomis/infamous2-recomp: Recompilação estática do inFAMOUS 2 (PS3) para macOS nativo com ps3recomp e o fork do inFAMOUS 1
gh-1418784471.content:
inFAMOUS 2 — static recompilation for PC (macOS)

🌐 English · Português (BR)
A native port of inFAMOUS 2 (PS3, digital release NPUA80638) to
macOS/arm64, built with static recompilation: the game's PowerPC and SPU
code is translated to C/C++ and compiled into a native executable, with
graphics on Metal. It is not an emulator.
It boots, shows its menus and cutscenes, and New Marais is playable, at
~38-40 fps on Apple silicon in headless runs (the game has no 30 fps cap in
gameplay). Get the app from the
v0.2.16 alpha release
and it rebuilds the game from your own copy (how); from
v0.2.7 on, the app updates itself.

Boot: the studio logos
3D main menu

Comic-book intro (Bink video)
Arriving in New Marais (in-engine cutscene)

Kuo on the pier (in-engine cutscene)
Gameplay: the pier by day

The streets of New Marais, Amp in hand
Late afternoon in the city

Neon at dusk

Frames from the port itself running on an Apple-silicon Mac (M4 Pro),
built from the player's own copy, at the game's 1280×720; subtitles are in
Brazilian Portuguese, the port's default dub. inFAMOUS 2 © Sony Interactive
Entertainment, developed by Sucker Punch Productions; shown only to document
the port.
Built on ps3recomp and, above all,
on NoahBPeterson's inFAMOUS 1
fork, which brought the firmware LLE and the fixes that got the first game
running on the Mac. See CREDITS.md.
WarningAlpha, not tested from start to finish yet. The game runs from boot to
the first missions in New Marais, only on Apple silicon macOS. Nobody has
gone past 1% of the story yet, so later missions may break. What is missing
is in ROADMAP.md.

This repository contains no game data, no firmware, no Sony keys and
nothing translated from them. Everyone generates all of that locally from
their own legitimate copy. A fan project, not affiliated with Sony
Interactive Entertainment or Sucker Punch Productions.

✅
