lc3bnd.title: A giant icy world hiding beyond Pluto could be our sixth dwarf planet
lc3bnd.content:
An enormous icy world discovered beyond Pluto could soon become the sixth officially recognized dwarf planet in our solar system.
The object, temporarily named 2026 ED138, was identified by an astronomer analyzing observations from the Simonyi Survey Telescope at the NSF-DOE Vera C. Rubin Observatory. Early estimates suggest it ranks among the largest dwarf planet candidates ever found beyond Neptune. If its status is confirmed, it would join the five dwarf planets currently recognized by the International Astronomical Union: Pluto, Ceres, Eris, Haumea and Makemake.
The discovery was announced at a press conference featuring Matthew Holman, a senior astrophysicist at the Harvard & Smithsonian Center for Astrophysics, and Mario Jurić, a University of Washington astronomy professor who leads Rubin's solar system team. Holman made the initial discovery, while Jurić helped gather the additional evidence needed to verify it.
"If confirmed as a dwarf planet, ED138 would join a very small family of worlds," Holman said. "Rubin will image the whole southern sky again and again for 10 years, so any others hiding in the places earlier surveys skipped are now within reach."
"Finding an object this big, roughly 1,000 kilometers across, is something that happens maybe once in a generation," Jurić said. "It's the largest trans-Neptunian object found in about 20 years, and Rubin turned it up while we were still commissioning the telescope."
How Astronomers Discovered the Hidden World
The breakthrough occurred on the evening of October 13, when Holman examined observations gathered by Rubin earlier in 2026. He was using specialized software developed with his colleague Kevin Napier to search for previously unidentified objects moving through the solar system.

The program compares billions of telescope detections, looking for individual points of light that appear in multiple observations and move in ways that suggest they belong to the same object. When the software identified ED138, Holman quickly realized that its apparent brightness and enormous distance pointed to something unusually large.
"My first reaction was one of excited disbelief," Holman said. "Objects like this are very rare, so I immediately started checking whether I or the code had done something wrong."
To check the finding, Jurić examined Rubin's stored observations and located 20 additional detections of ED138, including some captured as early as March 2026. The researchers then searched historical records from other astronomical surveys and identified images of the object dating back to 2016.
Together, these observations allowed the team to reconstruct more than a decade of the distant world's orbital motion, strengthening the evidence that the discovery was genuine.
Could This Be Our Solar System's Sixth Dwarf Planet?
ED138 currently lies approximately 46 astronomical units (au) from the Sun. One astronomical unit represents the average distance separating Earth and the Sun. By comparison, Pluto's average orbital distance is about 40 au.

Because ED138 travels beyond Neptune, astronomers classify it as a trans-Neptunian object (TNO). These distant bodies are valuable to scientists because their physical properties and orbital paths preserve clues about the solar system's distant past.
By examining their sizes, compositions, and movements, researchers can better understand how the solar system developed, how its giant planets shifted positions, and how smaller bodies were redistributed during that process.
However, being a trans-Neptunian object does not automatically make ED138 a dwarf planet. An essential requirement is that the object's gravity must be strong enough to shape it into a nearly round body.
Using measurements of ED138's brightness and distance, along with estimates of how much sunlight its surface reflects, astronomers calculate that it could measure anywhere from 600 to 1,500 kilometers across.
An icy object within that size range would generally be expected to have enough gravity to become round. Nevertheless, scientists will need more observations to establish ED138's actual dimensions and determine whether it qualifies as a dwarf planet.
Why Such a Massive World Remained Undiscovered
One of the most surprising aspects of the discovery is how an object this large managed to escape detection for so long.
ED138 occupies a region of the sky near the plane of the Milky Way, where millions of stars create an exceptionally crowded background. Against that dense field of light, the distant object's faint movement was difficult for earlier telescopes and surveys to distinguish.
Rubin Observatory has an important advantage. Its ability to repeatedly observe the Southern Hemisphere sky, combined with advanced computer algorithms, makes it possible to search enormous quantities of astronomical data for subtle changes in the positions of objects.
By examining millions or even billions of individual light detections, these systems can recognize the movement of small solar system bodies that might otherwise disappear into the surrounding stars. This capability was essential to finding ED138 in such a challenging part of the sky.
Rubin Observatory Could Reveal More Hidden Worlds
The newly identified object adds to a growing collection of solar system discoveries made by Rubin Observatory as it began gathering observations ahead of its ambitious Legacy Survey of Space and Time (LSST), which officially started in June 2026.
Even before the survey began, the observatory was producing remarkable results. In April, Rubin's solar system researchers reported observations of more than 11,000 previously unknown asteroids, including approximately 380 new trans-Neptunian objects.
The team described that enormous collection of discoveries as "the tip of the iceberg," anticipating that the full survey would uncover many more objects. The identification of ED138 offers an early indication of just how significant those future findings could be.
Rubin's combination of extensive sky coverage, sensitivity, and rapid observations is also changing how astronomers investigate new discoveries. Once an object has been identified, researchers can search older telescope images to find instances when it was photographed but went unrecognized.
"Rubin is giving us an unprecedented capacity to explore the sky through a combination of speed, depth, and precision," Jurić said. "And the discovery is just the beginning: Once we identify a new object, we can search back months, and sometimes even decades, finding it in images where nobody knew to look. This ability to both discover and 'precover' objects is transforming how quickly and accurately we can determine their orbits and understand the distant solar system."
As Rubin continues surveying the southern sky over the next decade, astronomers expect its observations to uncover additional objects that previous searches missed, potentially revealing more large, icy worlds in the outer solar system.
Anyone interested in exploring ED138 can view its location and orbit using Orbitviewer, an interactive web-based application that displays the solar system in three dimensions and allows users to explore its structure in real time.
Operations of the Vera C. Rubin Observatory are funded by the U.S. National Science Foundation and the U.S. Department of Energy's Office of Science.

1yc9k51.title: Three killed in Russia as Ukraine claims US floated NATO membership option
1yc9k51.content: Zelenskyy says the US asked for the first time whether Kyiv would cede land to Moscow in exchange for Ukraine’s NATO bid.A Ukrainian drone attack has killed a mother, father and their 24-month-old daughter at their home in Belgorod, a Russian region bordering Ukraine, according to Russian authorities.The deadly attack came on Saturday in Proletarsky, about 20km (12 miles) from Ukraine’s border as Russia’s Ministry of Defence claimed the army intercepted 29 Ukrainian drones overnight, including several over the Moscow region.In turn, Ukraine’s air force said Russia launched 96 drones from Friday evening, of which 81 were shot down or electronically suppressed as of early Saturday. It reported hits at eight locations and falling debris at two others, while a local power supplier reported outages in parts of northeastern Sumy.Meanwhile, in Friday’s comments to reporters that were under embargo until Saturday, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said United States negotiators had asked during this week’s Abu Dhabi talks whether Ukraine would withdraw its troops from its eastern region of Donbas in exchange for joining NATO, the transatlantic military alliance.Zelenskyy said the question had been raised for the first time but that no concrete offer existed. Zelenskyy maintained that Ukraine would not withdraw its troops but could put the issue to a referendum if Kyiv received firm security guarantees, funding for its armed forces and money for reconstruction.“NATO is back on the agenda,” he said.Donbas comprises Donetsk and Luhansk, two eastern Ukrainian regions partly occupied by Russia.Moscow demands a Ukrainian withdrawal from areas Kyiv still controls, while also opposing Ukraine joining NATO, whose members pledge to defend one another.Zelenskyy said on Friday that he would not amend Ukraine’s constitution to make it neutral, arguing the move would not guarantee lasting security.Ukraine has been defending itself, with Western assistance, against a full-scale Russian invasion since February 2022.This past week brought a resumption of US-mediated direct talks between the Russians and Ukrainians, which raised hopes of an early end to the war.However, apart from renewed prisoner exchanges, there appears to have been little progress. European representatives are set to take part in the next round of talks.Zelenskyy said the European Union and NATO are Europe’s “only real security” and that Moscow’s bid to review the continent’s security was “dangerous because … it is precisely things like this that lead to wars or escalations”.

69hzvi.title: Владимир Зеленский: США впервые спросили, готов ли Киев отдать Донбасс ради вступления в НАТО
69hzvi.content:
США впервые подняли в переговорах с Украиной вопрос о возможности вступления в НАТО в обмен на отказ от Донбасса, сообщил журналистам президент Украины Владимир Зеленский в пятницу, 13 ноября. Итоги его общения с представителями прессы агентства публикуют 14 ноября.

"Американцы поставили вопрос: "А если Украина будет в НАТО, Украина выйдет из Донбасса?" Это было впервые", - сказал Зеленский. По его словам, если американская сторона и другие партнеры по НАТО подтвердят такое предложение о вступлении, он вынесет его на обсуждение украинского общества, поскольку не может принять такое решение по своему усмотрению. "Безусловно, без какого-либо признания оккупированных территорий за Россией", - подчеркнул Зеленский.

По его словам, Украина в прошлом просила предоставить ей гарантии безопасности по образцу пятой статьи НАТО. "И мой вопрос к американской стороне: "Если вы предоставите нам это "что-то похожее" на НАТО, будут ли американские солдаты на нашей земле?" Их ответ на это: "Нет"", - добавил президент.

Киев обсуждает с партнерами "целостный пакет безопасности", в который входят конкретные гарантии безопасности от НАТО и ЕС, а также "соответствующее количество военных, оружие, финансовая поддержка на определенное время - и Prosperity Plan, то есть План восстановления, подкрепленный деньгами с четкими источниками", сообщил украинский президент.

Зеленский: Путин хочет изменить границы в Европе

Зеленский также заявил журналистам, что, по его мнению, президент России Владимир Путин хочет изменить границы в Европе. "То, что Путин хочет изменить границы в Европе, - факт. Я уверен, что это лежит в его концепции пересмотра гарантий безопасности в Европе", - заявил он.

"Думаю, Путин будет говорить о Финляндии, Швеции. Уверен, будет поднимать вопрос о Венгрии и присутствии американцев в странах Балтии. Поэтому если американцы действительно хотят именно такого диалога, поддерживая инициативность "русских" по структуре безопасности в Европе, то это решать всем европейским странам, которые в НАТО, а не кому-то", - цитирует Зеленского "РБК-Украина".

По его словам, он обсуждал этот вопрос с представителями стран Северной Европы и другими европейскими партнерами.

2f37hq.title: California steels for storms that could trigger massive waves, flooding
2f37hq.content:
A worker carries gasoline during high tides that caused flooding in neighborhoods in Sunset Beach in Orange County, California, in late October.

California was bracing Friday for a storm series packing heavy rain and surf that could once again flood coastal communities and potentially send monster waves pounding shores.

Off the coast of San Francisco, southern Monterey Bay and the Big Sur coast, forecasters warned that up to 30-foot (9-meter) breaking waves could arrive Friday evening, with occasional monstrous sets of 40 to 50 feet (12 to 15 meters) possible.
Such violent waves in the Pacific are a trademark of the El Niño weather pattern, which this year has driven disruptions around the globe as it turbocharges the impacts of human-caused climate change.
"Large breaking waves will run up beaches and crash over seawalls, inundating adjacent, low-lying infrastructure," read the latest National Weather Service advisory.
The U.S. weather agency urged against entering the water and said to stay off waterside infrastructure including jetties, piers and rocks.
"NEVER turn your back on the ocean," NWS meteorologists wrote.
Farther south, near Los Angeles, forecasters said widespread rainfall would begin Friday and continue into Saturday, and elevated surf could fuel dangerous rip currents and breaking waves.
The surf's impact was expected to peak on Saturday and potentially again Monday, the NWS said.
"There is potential for moderate coastal flooding impacts at times, especially Saturday," read the latest advisory from the weather agency.

"Some of these impacts may be moderate to significant beach erosion and shallow flooding of normally dry beaches and walkways."
Storm systems as well as high tides have triggered flooding in recent months in California, causing dramatic property destruction and leaving communities along the coasts feeling particularly vulnerable.
Forecasters anticipate giant storms off the coast will continue to whip up large waves as the El Niño phenomenon is expected to strengthen into the winter.
El Niño raises surface temperatures in the central and eastern Pacific Ocean and causes global changes in winds and rainfall, and this year's edition has proven particularly extreme.
Human-caused climate change can worsen El Niño's impacts. A warmer atmosphere holds more moisture, making rains more intense.
Sea levels off California will likely soon bump even higher due to especially high tides known as king tides, which generally occur in the late fall and winter months.

q681f2.title: Новый концепт Polestar от бывшего дизайнера Audi — будет две новых модели
q681f2.content: В Гетеберге прошла премьера концепт-кара бренда Polestar – Formula 2030, автором которого стал бывший дизайнер Audi Филипп Ремерс.Это первый концепт Ремерса, присоединившегося к Polestar в 2024 году. Его Formula 2030 – это спортивный электрический хэтчбек с приземистым силуэтом и развитыми колесными арками. Фары – в стиле «двойное лезвие» (Dual Blade), колеса 22" крепятся центральной гайкой. Кузов лишен центральной стойки, двери открываются «нараспашку», открывая вид на четыре отдельных кресла с надувными подушками и валиками из льняного композита.Главная фишка салона – изогнутый дисплей 20", центральный экран 12,2 дюйма и рулевая колонка меняют взаимное расположение в зависимости от режима движения. В спортивном – органы управления придвигаются к водителю, а в автономном – напротив, дают больше пространства перед креслом. А еще тут есть восемь физических кнопок, на которые можно вывести нужные вам функции.Силовая установка – полностью электрическая: предварительные данные говорят о суммарной отдаче двух электромоторов на уровне 884 л.с., что даст разгон до 100 км/ч за 2,9 секунды. Но в серию Formula 2030 не пойдет, ее роль в другом: стать стилистическим и конструктивным ДНК для двух моделей – Polestar 2 и Polestar 7, анонсированными, соответственно, на 2027 и 2028 годы.Ранее «За рулем» рассказывал о нашумевшем Jaguar Type 01, также заявленным к продаже в 2027-м. «За рулем» можно читать и в MAX

1jkhoqr.title: SpaceX's Starship set for return to Earth after booster catch aborted
1jkhoqr.byline: Anita Chang Beattie with Charlotte Causit
1jkhoqr.content:
SpaceX's Starship project has been plagued by years-long delays as the company grapples with novel engineering challenges.

SpaceX's Starship spacecraft was "healthy" as it orbited the Earth and on track to return Saturday to its Texas launch site, where Elon Musk's company was planning to "catch" the vehicle for the first time.

It was the 15th test flight of the world's biggest and most powerful rocket system, originally meant to feature a groundbreaking twin capture of both the Super Heavy booster and the Starship.
Successful recoveries of both stages would have marked a milestone in the space industry's decades-long pursuit of fully reusable rocket systems that can drastically reduce mission costs and make frequent launches possible.
But that achievement slipped out of reach minutes after the 124-meter (407-foot) rocket blasted off Friday afternoon from its launch pad at Starbase.
After the midair separation of the two stages, the Super Heavy booster was initially set for capture at Launch Pad 2, SpaceX spokesman Dan Huot said.
But near the end of its descent, "the booster aborted itself for a GNC (guidance, navigation and control) issue that it detected," he said.
It diverted instead to the Gulf of Mexico just off the launch site, where it automatically self-destructed before hitting the water.
Meanwhile, the Starship spacecraft that gives the rocket system its name was orbiting the Earth, which it was expected to do 14 times before returning Saturday.
"Starship and its heat shield are healthy," SpaceX said around seven hours after the mission started.
"We're not tracking any issues right now with the vehicle or with the range for our return, so everything continuing to look good," Huot said.
Starship on Friday launched 26 satellites to join others in Musk's Starlink satellite internet constellation.

Complex catch
Clayton Swope, an aerospace expert at the Center for Strategic and International Studies, called the mission a "mixed bag so far" after the failure to catch the Super Heavy, something SpaceX has done three times previously.
"At least the Starship made it to orbit, like on the last test flight," he said.
Some versions of the Starship spacecraft are designed to launch internet satellites and data centers into orbit, while other iterations will be made to ferry people to the moon and Mars.
U.S. space agency NASA is counting on Starship to serve as a lunar lander on its Artemis mission, and administrator Jared Isaacman congratulated SpaceX on Friday for "another spectacular launch"—without mentioning the booster disappointment.
SpaceX plans to return Starship to Earth after more than 22 hours of flight and recover it at around 3:20 p.m. (2120 GMT) on Saturday.
The "catch" is extraordinarily complex because the spaceship will be falling much faster and from a much higher altitude than the booster.
Like the three previous Super Heavy recoveries, Starship is meant to carry out a controlled descent and nestle between two mechanical "chopstick arms" at the launch site.
"We'll only go for it if the ship passes all of these system checks and decision gates along the way, and there are lots of them," SpaceX commentator Kate Tice said.
Due to the risks of losing control of Starship, SpaceX has planned for various scenarios where it will shorten the test flight and plunge the spaceship into the Pacific Ocean if necessary.

Refueling challenge
Musk, the world's richest person, has already revolutionized the space sector with the partially reusable Falcon rockets, which regularly launch satellites and carry astronauts to the International Space Station.
But the Starship project has been plagued by years-long delays as SpaceX grapples with novel engineering challenges, including the unsolved problem of transferring fuel to the spaceship while in orbit—a requirement for any journey to the moon or Mars.
Following SpaceX's high-profile stock market debut in June that raised about $85.7 billion, the company is investing heavily in production and launch capabilities.
During a tour of its million-square-foot (93,000-square-meter) factory at Starbase on Friday, SpaceX officials told journalists that it now has the capability to produce a spaceship every two weeks and a booster every four weeks.

1vtlzgu.title: OpenAI представила функцию ChatGPT Wallet для покупок с помощью ИИ
1vtlzgu.content: Время на прочтение3 минОхват и читатели2.8KOpenAI анонсировала ChatGPT Wallet — новую платёжную функцию, позволяющую ИИ‑агентам совершать покупки от имени пользователей. Компания начала сотрудничать с такими крупными эмитентами карт, как American Express, Mastercard и Visa. ChatGPT Wallet даёт пользователям возможность безопасно сохранять данные своих кредитных карт и предоставлять ИИ‑агентам право проводить платежи в интернете, не раскрывая при этом реальные реквизиты карты. Например, если пользователь выбирает отель для предстоящей поездки, он может поручить своему ИИ‑агенту оформить бронирование с помощью этой функции.Вот как работают ChatGPT Wallet и процесс оплаты:пользователи могут добавить свои кредитные карты через защищённую форму в настройках ChatGPT Wallet или предоставить платёжные данные по запросу ИИ‑агента непосредственно в момент оформления заказа;после добавления карты пользователю больше не нужно вводить платёжные реквизиты при каждой покупке;ИИ‑агент находит нужный товар или услугу и подготавливает покупку;перед завершением транзакции ChatGPT Wallet отображает информацию о продавце, перечень товаров, итоговую сумму и выбранную для оплаты карту;пользователь проверяет данные и подтверждает транзакцию с помощью биометрической аутентификации — например, через Face ID или сканирование отпечатка пальца;после подтверждения платёжная система генерирует токен, содержащий номер виртуальной карты, защитный код и срок действия;ИИ‑агент использует этот токен для завершения покупки, не получая доступа к реальным данным карты пользователя и не передавая их третьим лицам.В данном процессе ChatGPT Wallet выступает лишь в качестве интерфейса: фактически оплата списывается с кредитной карты пользователя. Это позволяет сохранять все предусмотренные по карте бонусы и привилегии, а также пользоваться защитой прав держателя карты в спорных ситуациях. Несмотря на то что платёж совершает агент, пользователь по‑прежнему взаимодействует напрямую с продавцом, который несёт ответственность за ценообразование, выполнение заказа, возврат товаров, денежные средства и поддержку клиентов. На текущем этапе пользователь должен подтверждать каждую покупку, однако в будущем OpenAI планирует предоставить агентам возможность совершать покупки автономно — в рамках заранее установленных лимитов.Хотя ChatGPT Wallet использует платёжные токены, совместимые с существующими системами оплаты, в OpenAI учитывают, что некоторые веб‑сайты могут блокировать ИИ‑агентов или отклонять правомерные транзакции из‑за работы систем защиты от мошенничества. Например, Amazon заблокировала агенту Muse от Meta* возможность совершать покупки на сайте Amazon.com от имени пользователя. Чтобы решить подобные проблемы, OpenAI рекомендует компаниям настроить свои веб‑сайты так, чтобы они могли распознавать авторизованных ИИ‑агентов, а также сотрудничать с платёжными провайдерами для сокращения числа необоснованных отказов в проведении транзакций. Кроме того, OpenAI ведёт совместную работу с компаниями, специализирующимися на предотвращении мошенничества (среди них Forter, Riskified, Sardine и Signifyd), а также с платёжными операторами, такими как Adyen, Checkout.com и Stripe.Функция ChatGPT Wallet становится доступной для подписчиков ChatGPT Pro в США, достигших 18 лет. Для использования сервиса необходима кредитная карта, выпущенная в США, и американский платёжный адрес. К числу поддерживаемых карт относятся карты платёжных систем American Express, Chase, Mastercard и Visa.Важно отметить, что на данный момент ChatGPT Wallet работает только в рамках «агентов» (dots). Функция недоступна в обычных чатах ChatGPT, версии ChatGPT Work или отдельных сессиях Codex. Кроме того, на этапе запуска в кошелёк нельзя добавить виртуальные карты.В июне платёжная система Visa объявила, что интегрирует свою сеть с ChatGPT, наделив чат‑бота возможностью самостоятельно совершать покупки и завершать транзакции.В мае сама OpenAI запустила ChatGPT, предназначенный для управления личными финансами. Теперь пользователи могут привязать к чат‑боту свои банковские счета и консультироваться касательно платежей, подписок, инвестиций, эффективности портфеля и других финансовых вопросов.

gh-1422297273.title: GitHub - SulphurS16/ACFA-Port: Unofficial native Windows port of ARMORED CORE for Answer (PS3), built from your own copy of the game. Part of Project Glintburn.
gh-1422297273.content:
A native Windows version of ARMORED CORE for Answer (PS3, USA, BLUS30187). The game's own PS3 code is translated into a real Windows program, built on your PC from your own copy of the game. This project contains no game data, no game code and no keys, and it decrypts nothing.

Not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by FromSoftware, Ubisoft, Sony Interactive Entertainment or any other rights holder. ARMORED CORE is a trademark of its owners.
Highlights

Native, not emulated. The whole game runs as a 64-bit Windows program.
Resolution options. The game draws at your screen's own resolution, in borderless, windowed or fullscreen.
Render scale from 50% to 200%.
High frame rates. 30, 60, 120, 144, your monitor's refresh rate or uncapped and the same game speed at every frame rate. Menus and movies stay at 60.
Full mouse support. By default the mouse works like a precise right stick, with raw input: your AC turns exactly as far as you move it. A camera mode is in PC SETTINGS. The mouse also works in the game's menus, including the ACSIS garage.
PC SETTINGS inside the game. An entry in the game's own SYSTEM menu, where HDD INSTALL was on the PS3: display, frame rate, mouse, keys and game options, all in game.

How it works
Static recompilation. A recompiler reads the game's ~4.5 million PowerPC instructions and turns them into C++: about 71.000 functions, with every indirect jump resolved. Your PC's compiler then builds a native 64-bit Windows program.
SPU programs are translated ahead of time too, with an interpreter as a safety net. The RSX command stream becomes Direct3D 11, and the game's shaders become HLSL, drawn at your resolution. Graphics, audio, input, files and saves are reimplemented in C++. a few complex firmware parts run as recompiled code from your own system files, so they behave exactly as on the console: the SPU task system and the movie and audio decoders.
It shares this runtime with the Armored Core 4 port. The two games share an engine family and middleware.
Nothing from the game is in this repository. Everything game-derived is generated on your PC from your own copy. Setup downloads a compiler toolchain (about 250 MB) once and takes a few minutes.
Install
What you need

Your own copy of ARMORED CORE for Answer (US disc, BLUS30187). You need the disc's files, meaning the folder that contains 'PS3_GAME'.
RPCS3, used once during setup to decrypt a few of your game files.
The PS3 system software 4.93 file 'PS3UPDAT.PUP' from Sony's PS3 system software page.
Optional: the game's update 01.35, the file 'UP0001-BLUS30187_00-AC45000004141906-A0135-V0100-PE.pkg'. Without it, the game uses the disc's own balance data.
About 4 GB of free disk space and an internet connection.

Steps

Download ACFA-Port-<version>.zip from Releases.
Right click the zip, choose Extract All..., and pick a folder with enough space, for example 'C:\Games\ACFA-Port'.
Open that folder and start 'ACFA-Launcher.exe'.
Under Game folder, choose the folder that contains 'PS3_GAME'.
Optional: under Game update, choose the update file. If it is inside the game folder, the launcher fills it in by itself.
Click Prepare files and choose your 'rpcs3.exe' and 'PS3UPDAT.PUP'. The launcher uses your RPCS3 to decrypt the files the port needs. When RPCS3 asks "Install firmware?", click Yes; if you chose the update, click Install when it asks about the package. This takes about a minute and doesn't change your RPCS3.
Click Set up. It downloads the build tools and builds the game. This takes a few minutes and is only needed once.
Choose whether you want a desktop shortcut and a Start menu entry.
Click PLAY.

From now on, you can start the game from the shortcut.
NoteAlready decrypted the files yourself? Skip step 6 and choose their folder under Decrypted files instead. More... > Which files does the port need? lists them.
Got the update later? Choose it under Game update, click Install update (your RPCS3 installs it), then Set up.

Update
Unzip the new release into a new folder or over the old one, start its launcher and click Set up. It finds your earlier install and rebuilds only what changed; your settings and saves stay. If your game data is in the old release's folder, keep that folder, or choose Move it beside this launcher.
Uninstall
More... > Remove game data..., then delete the launcher's folder. Saves and settings stay unless you tick their box; they then go to a backup folder.
Controls
Controllers work like the PS3 pad and can be connected at any time:

PlayStation (DUALSHOCK 4, DualSense, DualSense Edge; USB or Bluetooth): Options = START; Share / Create or the touchpad click = SELECT. No extra program needed. No vibration yet.
Xbox and other XInput controllers: A = Cross, B = Circle, X = Square, Y = Triangle, LB / RB = L1 / R1, LT / RT = L2 / R2, Menu = START, View = SELECT, stick clicks = L3 / R3.

All connected controllers play together as one pad, so a second device for the same controller (for example Steam Input's or DS4Windows' virtual controller beside the DualSense itself) does no harm. A controller's buttons are set in the game's own options (ACSIS > OPTION > CONTROL OPTIONS); PC SETTINGS changes the keyboard and mouse.
Mouse and keyboard support
Keyboard and mouse in missions (defaults). The keys keep these actions under every control type (KEY TYPE):

Action
Keys

Move
W A S D

Turn and look
Mouse

Left / right arm weapon
Left / right click

Shoulder weapon
E

Switch right / left weapon
C / Ctrl

Boost (hold to rise) / quick boost / overed boost
Space / Shift / Q

Quick turn left / right
Z / X

Reset view
V

Lock (L3)
Middle click

Pause
Tab or Escape

SELECT / D-pad
Enter / arrow keys

Release the mouse
F1

Fullscreen
F11 or Alt+Enter

The mouse works like a precise right stick (MOUSE MODE: STICK, the default): your AC turns exactly as far as you move it, as fast as it can turn. A fast sideways flick with quick boost does a quick turn. MOUSE MODE: CAMERA moves only the camera, freely; the AC turns after it at its own speed, and aims and moves as in the game. Both modes use raw input, with no mouse acceleration.
Not on a key until you choose one in PC SETTINGS: 2-stage quick turn left / right, 2-stage quick boost, quick boost half press and assault armor (needs an overed boost part that has it).
In menus:

Mouse: point and click; right-click goes back; the wheel scrolls; drag sliders. This includes ACSIS (ASSEMBLE, STABILIZER, SHOP, TUNE, DESIGN). The colour editor, the emblem picker, DESIGN's tabs and TUNE's values still use keys.
Keys: arrows or W A S D move, Enter or Space choose, Escape or Backspace go back. This works on the title screen and in mission briefings too.
PS3 buttons: the game shows these. Tab = START, Q / E = L1 / R1.

All keys can be changed in game under SYSTEM > PC SETTINGS, which also shows the PS3 button each key presses.
Settings and saves

Display mode, resolution, render scale (50–200 %) and frame rate (30, 60, 120, 144, your display's rate or uncapped) are set in the launcher or in game under SYSTEM > PC SETTINGS. Game speed is the same at every frame rate.
The launcher has presets for modest PCs and handhelds under More....
ORDER MATCH AI FIXES (PC SETTINGS > GAME, on by default) corrects slips in some ORDER MATCH opponents' AI scripts. They then fight as their scripts were written, and some are harder than on the PS3. Turn it OFF to play them as on the PS3.
Settings and saves are in Saved Games\ARMORED CORE for Answer. More... in the launcher backs up and restores saves. Saves don't work on a PS3.
PS3 saves work once you have decrypted them. Copy each save folder (named 'BLUS30187...') into the savedata folder above.
RPCS3 saves should work as they are. Copy the same 'BLUS30187...' folders from RPCS3's savedata folder.

Only saves from the US version (BLUS30187) are found.
AC schematics and paint from ARMORED CORE 4
The title menu's IMPORT DATA brings over your AC schematics and paint data from ARMORED CORE 4 (US version), as on the PS3.

From the ARMORED CORE 4 PC port: nothing to copy. The import finds your AC4 saves in Saved Games\ARMORED CORE 4 by itself.
From RPCS3 or a PS3: copy the folders BLUS30027ASSMBLY064 (schematics) and BLUS30027PAINT014 (paint) into Saved Games\ARMORED CORE for Answer\savedata. PS3 saves must be decrypted first; RPCS3 saves work as they are.

Mods and community regulations
Files in Saved Games\ARMORED CORE for Answer\mods replace the game's files of the same name, while the game's own files stay untouched:

A community regulation (for example 1.99): put its regulation.bin into mods, then choose the regulation in game under ACSIS > OPTION > REGULATION.
Other mods: use the same folder layout as the game's PS3_GAME\USRDIR, for example mods\bind\ingamescript.bnd.

The folder is read when the game starts. Remove the files to play with the game's own data again.
Community
For more ports, questions, discussion and help join the Discord.

ulqcra.title: Туск: Польша пока не будет финансировать закупки оружия США для Украины по программе PURL
ulqcra.content:
Польша приняла решение на данном этапе приостановить взносы в программу закупок европейскими странами американского вооружения для Украины в рамках программы PURL (Prioritised Ukraine Requirements List, "Список приоритетных запросов для Украины"). Об этом премьер-министр Польши Дональд Туск заявил в пятницу, 13 ноября, в Дублине, где прошел неформальный саммит ЕС.

По словам Туска, он сообщил генеральному секретарю НАТО Марку Рютте, что "на данный момент мы пока не будем вносить взносы в программу PURL", в рамках которой европейские страны финансируют закупки в США оружия для Украины.

Причина - бюджетный дефицит и высокие расходы на оборону

Среди причин такого решения глава польского правительства назвал большой бюджетный дефицит и высокие расходы Варшавы на оборону. "Мы помогали и продолжаем очень серьезно помогать Украине. Но, учитывая наши финансовые возможности, Польша не будет вкладывать дополнительные средства, поскольку у нас есть собственные расходы на оборону и безопасность, которые являются одними из самых высоких в Европе", - пояснил Дональд Туск.

О запуске механизма PURL (Prioritised Ukraine Requirements List) президент США Дональд Трамп и генсек НАТО Марк Рютте объявили в июле 2025 года после того, как Вашингтон отказался передавать оружие Украине безвозмездно. В рамках этого механизма американское вооружение для ВСУ оплачивают европейские страны и Канада. Речь идет о продукции, которую не производят в Европе, или которую США могут поставить быстрее, чем европейские партнеры и Канада.

Туск: Польша будет играть ключевую роль в мирных переговорах

Польский премьер также сообщил, что Польша будет "играть ключевую роль" в работе европейской переговорной группы по прекращению войны России против Украины. В ходе неформального саммита ЕС в Дублине европейские лидеры договорились, что представлять Европу на будущих переговорах будут представители институтов Евросоюза и стран E5 - Великобритании, Германии, Италии, Польши и Франции.

Туск подчеркнул, что европейским странам следует избегать ненужных уступок России и отклонить любые изменения в архитектуре безопасности Европы, которые принесли бы пользу Москве. "Мы будем и должны говорить о мире в Украине - справедливом мире - и о будущем Украины в ЕС и НАТО, но мы точно не согласимся на изменения в архитектуре безопасности Европы в пользу России", - заявил он.

Mouse: point and click; right-click goes back; the wheel scrolls. This includes ACSIS (WEAPON, ASSEMBLY, PAINT, SIMULATOR). PAINT's color sliders, the postgame MISSION LIST's tiles and STABILIZER still use keys.
Keys: arrows or W A S D move, Enter or Space choose, Escape or Backspace go back.
PS3 buttons: the game shows these. Tab = START, Q / E = L1 / R1, R or Ctrl = Triangle (GARAGE in the hub), F = Square, Z = L2, X = SELECT.

All keys can be changed in game under SYSTEM > PC SETTINGS, which also shows the PS3 button each key presses.
Settings and saves

Display mode, resolution, render scale (50–200 %) and frame rate (30, 60, 120, 144, your display's rate or uncapped) are set in the launcher or in game under SYSTEM > PC SETTINGS. Game speed is the same at every frame rate.
The launcher has presets for modest PCs and handhelds under More....
Settings and saves are in Saved Games\ARMORED CORE 4. More... in the launcher backs up and restores saves. Saves don't work on a PS3.
PS3 saves work once you have decrypted them. Copy each save folder (named 'BLUS30027...') into the savedata folder above.
RPCS3 saves should work as they are. Copy the same 'BLUS30027...' folders from RPCS3's savedata folder.

Only saves from the US version (BLUS30027) are found.
Game update, mods and community regulations
ARMORED CORE 4 has no update package: its updates were regulation files (the balance data) that the game downloaded while online, into its game data. If you have such a file (regulation.bin, for example from the game data folder BLUS30027\USRDIR of your PS3 or RPCS3), choose it under Game update in the launcher. The launcher shows its version, and the game uses it instead of the disc's Ver.1.00; choose the regulation in game under SYSTEM > REGULATIONS. Clear the row to go back.
Files in Saved Games\ARMORED CORE 4\mods replace the game's files of the same name, while the game's own files stay untouched:

A community regulation: put its regulation.bin into mods.
Other mods: use the same folder layout as the game's PS3_GAME\USRDIR, for example mods\bind\....

The folder is read when the game starts. Remove the files to play with the game's own data again. The game checks its regulation: one it does not accept shows "The game data is damaged" at the start. Choose OK there (the game goes on with its own regulation) and remove the file.
Community
For more ports, questions, discussion and help join the Discord.
Please don't share game files, keys, decrypted files or download links here or on the discord.

sgwh7d.title: Торвальдс: исправление ошибок в ядре Linux с помощью ИИ становится нормой
sgwh7d.content: Время на прочтение2 минОхват и читатели2.8KПостИсправление ошибок с помощью ИИ становится всё более распространённой практикой при разработке ядра Linux, заявил основатель проекта Линус Торвальдс. Он отмечает, что в только что выпущенной версии 7.4-rc2 присутствует всё больше исправлений, подготовленных с участием ИИ.Торвальдс предполагает, что иногда это даже помогает разработчикам опережать поток сообщений о новых ошибках.Он упомянул, что значительная часть недавних работ по поддержке ядра была выполнена с помощью ИИ, и добавил, что, возможно, в будущем нет смысла каждый раз отдельно упоминать об этом в анонсах новых версий.«И да, многое из этого стало возможным благодаря различным исправлениям, предложенным ИИ. Думаю, я перестану повторять это — будем считать, что так оно и есть», — написал Торвальдс.Он также привёл весьма позитивный комментарий от Алексея Старовойтова, отвечающего за подсистему BPF: по его словам, темпы исправления ошибок в BPF сейчас превышают скорость поступления сообщений о новых багах.Если такая динамика сохранится, это может означать, что разработчики наконец‑то начали сокращать накопленный список известных ошибок, а не просто успевают реагировать на вновь обнаруженные проблемы. Впрочем, Торвальдс подчеркнул, что пока нельзя говорить о подобном прогрессе в масштабах всего ядра.«Думаю, в большинстве других областей до этого ещё далеко, но это, по крайней мере, знак того, что ситуация, возможно, начинает меняться к лучшему», — отметил он.Эти комментарии прозвучали в связи с выходом Linux 7.4-rc2. Торвальдс охарактеризовал этот выпуск как довольно объёмный — вслед за первым релиз‑кандидатом (rc1), который стал самым крупным в истории ядра Linux. Столь значительный объём во многом объясняется автоматизированными обновлениями, выполненными с помощью инструмента Coccinelle.Важно отметить, что Торвальдс не уточнил, какие именно ИИ‑инструменты использовались для подготовки исправлений, и не указал, какие конкретно патчи были созданы с помощью ИИ. Ранее Торвальдс высказался по поводу ИИ на конференции Open Source Summit Europe. Он заметил, что ИИ может быть полезен для поиска и исправления ошибок в ядре Linux. Однако разработчик оговорился, что инструмент становится полезным, если использовать его именно как инструмент.Летом Торвальдс написал пост рассылки, подтверждающий позицию разработчиков ядра Linux о том, что они не против ИИ, и отвечающий на критику некоторых мейнтейнеров, выступающих против использования LLM в проекте. Он заявил, что ядро ​​Linux не является «анти‑ИИ» и что ИИ/LLM следует рассматривать лишь как инструмент, помогающий разработчикам. При этом разработка не обязывает использовать такие инструменты, но сам он выступает против тех, кто критикует подобные решения.

wkus5c.title: Ukraine, Russia race to build military satellite networks as war rages on
wkus5c.content: Kyiv, Ukraine – Looking like a tiny desktop tower with wing-like solar panels, the Obria Nano satellite is a small step that could herald a giant leap for Ukraine’s military.Launched by Himera, a Ukrainian company known for ergonomic military radios, and GomSpace, a Danish small-satellite manufacturer, the first Obria Nano could eventually grow into Kyiv’s own constellation of military satellites, its creators hope.Recommended Stories list of 4 itemslist 1 of 4Why is Ukraine attacking Russian warships in the Baltic Sea amid talks?list 2 of 4Kyiv says Starlink restored as attacks in Ukraine and Russia continuelist 3 of 4Palantir harvests battlefield data that Ukraine pays for ‘with blood’list 4 of 4Ukraine claims record 3,000 Russian casualties in one day as war drags onend of listThe nanosatellite marks Ukraine’s “first historical step toward establishing resilient and sovereign satellite communications capabilities,” the company said on October 27, almost four weeks after the Obria Nano had reached orbit.In mid-October, Kyiv also signed up two Finnish companies, the Nokia telecoms giant and the ICEYE space startup that owns a “self-illuminating” radar technology for obtaining high-resolution satellite imagery in any weather, to look into developing a network of military satellites.Kyiv’s efforts are rooted in one concern – the nearly total dependence of Ukraine’s military communications on SpaceX, Elon Musk’s satellite communications giant that operates Starlink, a constellation of more than 10,000 low-orbit satellites.On Thursday, the speeds of Starlink and Starshield, its military component operated by the Pentagon, were limited for Ukraine, leading to “significant disruptions” of their operation along the front line, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said. Before this, Starlink was also disrupted last month.Kyiv realises that “it’s possible to create an absolutely new system, but it will take several years,” Anatoly Zak, a US-based space expert, told Al Jazeera. “In the nearest year or two, Starlink and [its military-grade component] Starshield are absolutely necessary.”Since 2022, Ukraine developed a love-and-hate relationship with Musk, his volatility, shifting loyalties and political demands.“Musk’s mood swings play a significant role,” Volodymyr Fesenko, head of the Kyiv-based Penta think tank, told Al Jazeera. “There were times when Musk helped Ukraine, and times of very negative reactions.”Ukrainians hailed Musk’s decision to provide Starlink services and modems to Ukraine free of charge. The military, hospitals and government agencies operating critical infrastructure quickly made a backbone of their communications.But in late 2022, Musk refused to activate Starlink coverage in Russia-occupied areas, slowing down or stopping Ukraine’s successful counteroffensive.The world’s wealthiest man also said that Kyiv should remain “politically neutral” in the future, officially cede Crimea to Moscow and conduct United Nations-supervised referendums on Russia-occupied territories.“If you want to understand what Russia has done here, come to Ukraine and you will see it all for yourself,” Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said in response. “And then you will tell me how to end this war, who started it and when it can be ended.”Meanwhile, Russia has reportedly smuggled thousands of Starlink terminals and used them for comms and drone attacks. This February, Musk put an end to the practice by allowing only certified modems to operate in Ukraine.Servicemen of the 68th Oleksa Dovbush Separate Jaeger Brigade of the Armed Forces of Ukraine set up a Starlink satellite internet system near the front-line town of Pokrovsk in Donetsk region, Ukraine, on April 10, 2025 [Inna Varenytsia/Reuters]Kyiv’s attempts to find an alternative to Starlink followed the October 14-24 speed limits for Ukrainian drones imposed without prior warning by Starlink and Starshield.Drones and drone interceptors moving faster than 60km/h (37mph) lost signal and could no longer reach their targets.Musk accused the Pentagon of limiting the speed and admitted that the decision was his only after The Wall Street Journal reported that Musk had personally authorised the slowdown.Both Musk and Kyiv realise that Starlink and Starshield are the Ukrainian military’s survival tool.When it comes to his highly publicised position towards Ukraine, Musk has to balance his own emotional outbursts and the interests of SpaceX, the crown jewel of his business empire that comprises two-fifths of his net worth, analyst Fesenko said.“If he tries to throw Ukraine under the bus, it may work as very negative advertising for his business, including the Starlink system,” Fesenko said.Russia’s bid to create military satellitesAnother factor is Russian President Vladimir Putin’s calculated flattery towards Musk – on October 28, he called him a “real genius”.“Putin apparently wants to use the methods he’s used towards [US President Donald] Trump – flattery, unlimited flattery,” Fesenko said.Putin mentioned Musk while talking about Russia’s attempts to create its own version of Starlink.“We are in close contact with our American partners – including Mr Musk – because it’s very important, in orbit, not to get in each other’s way and to maintain a certain level of discipline and order,” Putin said.(Al Jazeera)The attempts have not been very successful so far.The military satellites for the upcoming Rassvet (Dawn) constellation turned out to be Qianfan satellites, which are similar to first-generation Starlink satellites and manufactured in China.Bureau 1440, a Kremlin-controlled space company that runs the Rassvet system, plans to have 900 satellites in orbit by 2035.In August, the Institute for the Study of War, an international military think tank, claimed that more than a third of Rassvet satellites failed to reach “sustainable operational altitudes”.By early November, Moscow lost two of the 32 Rassvet 3 satellites launched in the past seven months.The second satellite that burned in the Earth’s atmosphere on November 1, failed to launch its propulsion to correct its position, according to The Defence Express, a Ukrainian military publication.Ukraine can also try negotiating a switch to Starlink’s rivals, but they are smaller and less effective.The US-based Iridium has 66 satellites flying at about 800km (497 miles) above Earth.OneWeb, operated by the French Eutelsat company, has up to 650 satellites that orbit the Earth at 1,200 kilometres (746 miles). But it is not authorised to be used for military drone strikes.An average terminal in Ukraine sees five dozen Starlink satellites simultaneously – and only 11 OneWeb satellites. A light, compact Starlink terminal costs up to $500; a much heavier and bulkier OneWeb one costs $9,000.According to Pavel Luzin, a space and military analyst with the Jamestown Foundation, a think tank in Washington, DC, Kyiv has two options to get its own satellites.It could work towards heavy and pricey satellites in geosynchronous orbit – or Earth-centred – that could serve for up to 20 years and cover all of Ukraine’s military needs.Or option two is a focus on launching a system of hundreds of cheaper low-orbit satellites that will need propulsion engines to maintain position, but they will eventually fall down because of contact with the upper atmosphere, and will constantly need to be replaced, he said.Kyiv can also use much cheaper alternatives such as stratostats or stratospheric drones that serve as “quasi-satellites,” he told Al Jazeera.A satellite fleet necessary to provide coordinates to long-range drones makes each drone strike pricier, and AI-driven drones that can be “taught” to recognise their targets could bring the price down – and make the satellites unnecessary.The development of ballistic missiles is another alternative, because they do not need satellite connection but can cause damage equal to the boom from several drones that have gotten through Russia’s air defence system, he said.“Such decisions are made with all calculations considered, not because Starlink – that depends on current political trends in Washington – needs to be replaced with an alternative,” Luzin said.“I don’t rule out that Ukraine won’t have to create any alternatives, because SpaceX is definitely interested – even if someone in the company doesn’t realise that – in Ukraine using it further,” he said.

gh-1442390491.title: GitHub - thefixinhixon/woohoo-flight-school: Unofficial native PC port of Pilotwings Resort (3DS) by static recompilation. Bring your own game dump; no game data included.
gh-1442390491.content:
Play your own copy of Pilotwings Resort (3DS, USA) as a native PC program. The tools here translate the game's code
from your dump into C (static recompilation), build it with your compiler, and run it. Nothing from the game is
included in this repository. How it works: docs/architecture.md.

Screenshots: 4x 3D resolution, 16x anisotropic filtering, sharp bilinear scaling, large screen layout.

Disclaimer. Woohoo! Flight School is an unofficial fan project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Nintendo or
Monster Games. Pilotwings, Pilotwings Resort, Nintendo 3DS and Mii are trademarks of Nintendo. The
repository contains no game code, graphics, sound or other game data and no decryption keys. You need your own,
legally obtained copy of the game, dumped from your own console. Please don't ask for ROMs or built binaries: a
built pwr contains code translated from the game and must not be shared.

Status
Works: the title intro, Mii sign-up, the trial flights with all three vehicles (plane, rocket belt, hang glider),
Mission Flight and Free Flight as far as they have been played, saving, sound, keyboard, mouse and gamepad. Tested on
Linux and Windows, at 60 fps, also at 4x resolution.
Added for the PC (all optional, see Display settings):

3D resolution up to 4x;
anisotropic filtering;
AMD FSR 1, FXAA and sharp bilinear scaling;
screen layouts, including one that switches automatically between menus and flight;
longer draw distance;
free look on the right stick;
a settings overlay (F1).

Known issues and limits:

The whole game has not been played through yet. Later missions may still hit untested code; please report crashes
with the terminal output.
Building on Windows itself (the build kit or MSYS2) is newer than the Windows port: it has been tested under Wine and
by GitHub Actions so far. Reports from Windows players are welcome.
No macOS build.
Touch-screen input needs the mouse, also when you play with a gamepad (the signature at sign-up, some menus).
No stereoscopic 3D: the game is shown in 2D.
Free look knows where the sea is, but not the island's ground: flying low over land, the camera can go through a
hillside.
The first run of a scene compiles shaders, which can cause a short hitch. They are kept for the next run.

What you need

A decrypted dump of Pilotwings Resort (USA), title 0004000000031C00, as .cia, .3ds/.cci or .cxi.
Encrypted dumps are refused.

Linux on x86-64, or Windows 10/11 on x86-64 (see Windows).

A GPU with Vulkan 1.3 and the build tools:

Python 3.8+ with Tk (python3-tk);
CMake 3.16+;
GCC or Clang;
glslc (shaderc or the Vulkan SDK);
SDL2 and Vulkan development files;
optionally Ninja.

On Debian/Ubuntu: sudo apt install python3-tk cmake gcc ninja-build glslc libsdl2-dev libvulkan-dev.

Quick start
Easiest on Linux: the build kit AppImage. Download WoohooFlightSchool-Linux-kit-x86_64.AppImage from the
latest release, make it executable and start it
(chmod +x WoohooFlightSchool-Linux-kit-x86_64.AppImage, then double-click it or run it). It holds the launcher, Python,
a C compiler and the build tools (about 140 MB), so you only need a Vulkan driver and SDL2, which most desktop and gaming
systems already have (glibc 2.29 or newer: Ubuntu 20.04+, Debian 11+, Fedora, Arch, SteamOS). The game it builds goes to
the same install folder as below. Windows players: see Windows.
From the source (with the build tools listed above):
python3 launcher/pwr_launcher.py

The first start opens Setup:

Game dump: Browse to your dump. It is verified straight away (container and encryption, title, game-code hash).
Build: recompiles and compiles into the install folder (default ~/.local/share/pwr-port), with the five stages
shown as it goes. One to two minutes on a multi-core machine. Missing build tools are listed under the Build button.
Play: press PLAY at the top right. The profile picker next to it switches, creates and deletes profiles
(each has its own saves and settings).

Display, Graphics and Gameplay & audio hold the profile's settings; they are saved as you change them, and the
in-game F1 overlay changes the same file. Log shows the build output and, while the game runs, its messages
(pwr.log in the profile folder). While the game runs, the PLAY button becomes STOP.
Without the GUI:
python3 tools/pipeline.py check # build tools present?
python3 tools/pipeline.py verify "My Dump.cia"
python3 tools/pipeline.py build "My Dump.cia"
python3 tools/pipeline.py run --profile default
python3 tools/pipeline.py profiles create alice
Saving
The game saves nothing during the first trial flights. To keep your pilot, end the trial-flight period: pause, choose
Return to Office, answer No to trying another aircraft and Yes to ending the trial-flight period. The
instructor then explains the save icon and your profile is saved. If you quit before that, you sign up again next time,
as on the console.
Saves and settings belong to the launcher profile:

Linux
Windows

Save data
~/.local/share/pwr-port/profiles/<name>/save/
%LOCALAPPDATA%\pwr-port\profiles\<name>\save\

Settings
~/.local/share/pwr-port/profiles/<name>/settings.json
%LOCALAPPDATA%\pwr-port\profiles\<name>\settings.json

Copy the save folder to back up your progress.
Windows
Easiest: the Windows build kit. Download WoohooFlightSchool-Windows-kit.zip from the
latest release, unzip it and double-click
Woohoo! Flight School.bat. The kit holds the launcher, Python, a C compiler and the libraries (about 200 MB to
download), so there is nothing to install. Then continue with the Quick start steps: pick your dump, Build,
Launch. The kit contains no game code or data. It is assembled and tested on Windows by GitHub Actions for every release
(tools/make_windows_kit.py).
Or with MSYS2. Build and play from an MSYS2 MINGW64 shell, which supplies the
compiler and libraries:
pacman -S --needed mingw-w64-x86_64-gcc mingw-w64-x86_64-cmake mingw-w64-x86_64-ninja mingw-w64-x86_64-SDL2 \
mingw-w64-x86_64-vulkan-headers mingw-w64-x86_64-vulkan-loader mingw-w64-x86_64-shaderc \
mingw-w64-x86_64-python mingw-w64-x86_64-tk git
python launcher/pwr_launcher.py

The install folder is %LOCALAPPDATA%\pwr-port. bin\ holds pwr.exe and the DLLs it needs, so after building
you can start pwr.exe without MSYS2.
The GPU driver provides Vulkan (vulkan-1.dll). Keep the driver up to date.
Started from the launcher, the game opens no console window; its messages go to pwr.log in the profile folder (as on Linux).
Visual Studio's compiler cannot build the generated code. Ninja is required so that CMake does not pick it.

Controls

3DS
Keyboard
Gamepad

Circle pad
Arrow keys
Left stick

D-pad
I / J / K / L
D-pad

A / B / X / Y
X / Z / S / A
East / South / North / West (position)

L / R
Q / W
Shoulders or triggers

Start
Return
Start

Select
Backspace
Back/Select, if set to "3DS Select" (see below)

Touch screen
Left mouse button on the bottom screen
(use the mouse)

Free look (optional)

Right stick

The gamepad's buttons follow their position, as on the 3DS: the right-hand button is A, the bottom one B.
By default the gamepad's Back/Select button switches the screen layout instead of pressing the 3DS Select button,
because the game hardly uses Select. To give it back to the game, turn off "Pad Back/Select: next layout" in the
launcher or set "Pad Back/Select" to "3DS Select" in the F1 overlay. Backspace on the keyboard is always 3DS Select.

Hotkey

F1
Settings overlay (arrows or D-pad to change, Escape/B/F1 to close; saved to the profile)

F11 or Alt+Enter
Fullscreen on/off

F9 (or the gamepad's Back/Select, see above)
Next screen layout

Display settings
All of these are in the launcher's profile settings and the F1 overlay:

Setting
Values

Screen layout
stacked, side, large (big top + small bottom), top, bottom, auto (stacked in menus, large top while flying)

Auto layout in flight
large (bottom screen small) or top (bottom screen hidden)

Aspect ratio
keep, integer, stretch

Fullscreen
off, borderless, exclusive

Scaling filter
nearest, linear, sharp (sharp bilinear), fsr (AMD FSR 1), fxaa

FSR sharpness
0 (sharpest) to 2

3D resolution
1x (native 400x240) to 4x

Anisotropic filter
off, 2x, 4x, 8x, 16x

Frame counter
on / off

Pad Back/Select
next screen layout (default) or 3DS Select

Draw distance
1x (original) to 4x: the island's cars and boats are shown from further away, and information points, rings and their labels fade in from further away (these from the next flight).

Free look
off / on: the gamepad's right stick orbits the camera around your vehicle; let go and it eases back. Not in the original game; flight chase camera only.

Sound can be muted in the launcher.
Troubleshooting

"the NCCH is encrypted": decrypt your dump first. This tool does not decrypt.
"the game code differs from the supported version": another revision or region, or a modified dump. Only the
USA release with the listed code hash is supported.
Build fails in the compile stage: run python3 tools/pipeline.py check; CMake reports missing SDL2/Vulkan
development files.
It asks me to sign up every time: see Saving.
The gamepad's Select button does nothing in the game: it switches the screen layout by default; see
Controls.
The terminal prints pwr: audio ring fill ..., underruns N: a rising N means audio dropouts; please report it.
Reporting a crash: every run writes the game's messages to pwr.log in the profile folder (the launcher's
Open log folder button opens it; see Saving for where profiles live). The run before is kept as
pwr.log.1, so the log of a crash survives starting the game again. Attach the log, or its last 30 lines, to your
report.

Licence
This project is free software under the GNU General Public License, version 3 or later (GPL-3.0-or-later).
The licence covers the project's own files: the translator, runtime, tools and launcher. It does not cover
Pilotwings Resort, its data or the C code generated from it. Those stay the property of their owners, are not part
of this repository and must not be distributed.
Third-party parts keep their own licences (details in
docs/architecture.md):

AMD FidelityFX FSR 1 (MIT, recomp/runtime/shaders/fsr/);
a font rendered from DejaVu Sans Mono (Bitstream Vera licence).

The screenshots show the game running in this port; the game's graphics in them are © Nintendo.

gh-1445065415.title: GitHub - RodoLy/HMMMGC
gh-1445065415.content:
Harvest Moon: Magical Melody – PC recompilation

English · Español
A native PC version of Harvest Moon: Magical Melody for the GameCube. The
game's own code is translated ahead of time into C++ and compiled into a
Windows program that runs on your processor, Intel, AMD or ARM, with no
emulator in between. It plays in widescreen, at your screen's resolution and
at 60 or 120 frames a second, with a launcher, an options menu inside the game
and mods, among them one that lets the game go on after marrying Jamie.
The game is not included: you need your own disc. The launcher makes the game
from it, on your computer, the first time you play.
NoteVersion 0.1.0, the first playable version. The game starts, plays,
saves and loads, and it has been played on a Windows laptop with a
Snapdragon X. It has not been played from start to finish yet, which is what
1.0 will mean. Expect bugs, and keep a copy of your saves.

What's in it
Screenshots
Playing
How it works
What comes next
For developers
Credits
License

What's in it
The game, running natively

No emulator. Every function of the game is translated to C++ and runs
as native code, on x64 or ARM64. What the GameCube's hardware did is done
by a runtime written for this game (runtime/).
Graphics with aurora, which
draws the GameCube's graphics with WebGPU: Direct3D 12 on Windows, Vulkan on
Linux.
Sound with the console's sound program (the DSP's AX) rewritten in C++
after Dolphin's high-level emulation, and played through SDL.
Controllers: the ones SDL knows (Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo, GameCube
adapters), mapped automatically; without one, the keyboard.
Saves on a memory card that is a folder of .gci files, as in Dolphin,
so a save can be brought over.
Loading straight from the disc image, with no drive to wait for.

Picture, speed and sound

Option
What it does

Internal resolution
As the window, 480p, 720p, 1080p or 1440p.

Widescreen
The 3D shows more at the sides. For now the menus and the text are stretched.

Frames per second
30, as the game, or 60 and 120: the game draws 30 and the rest are made in between.

Pull the camera back
Outdoors, from 0% (the game's camera) to 100% (much more of the farm in view). Rooms and scenes keep the game's camera.

Language
One for the game and the launcher: English, Spanish, French, German or Italian, the ones the disc has. The launcher and the F10 menu are only in Spanish and English. In the game the dialogues change. The menus and the names of the items stay in English.

Turbo
Not an option: hold Tab in the game and it goes at 300%.

Full screen
Also with Alt+Enter while playing.

Frame counter and volume
The frames per second over the game, and the volume from 0 to 100%.

The launcher
HarvestMoonMM.exe prepares the game from your disc and starts it. Its four
tabs are Game (prepare, play, change the disc, open the log), Options
(the table above), Mods and Controls (it shows the mapping and what
each button of your controller is on the GameCube's). It speaks English and
Spanish, and is used with the mouse, the keyboard or a controller. If
something fails it says why in plain words (another game, another version of
it, an image it could not read) and offers to open the log.

Options inside the game
F10, or the controller's Select, opens the same options without
leaving the game, in a plain bar at the top with drop-down menus: the
resolution, Picture, Controller settings, Volume and Mods. The options change
at once and are kept for the next time; the mods can be turned on or off there
too: the two of the character's speed change at once, and Marry Jamie the next
time the game is opened. While the menu is open the game does not get
the controller.

Mods

Mod
What it does

Marry Jamie (0.8.0)
In the original game, the wedding with Jamie is the ending. With this mod the wedding plays and the game goes on: Jamie lives in the house as your spouse and talks as your spouse, with new lines in the five languages of the disc, has a birthday (the 22nd of Winter), and there are the pregnancy, the birth and the special days of the marriage, as with the other partners.

Faster character (0.1.0)
The character walks and runs faster, from 25% to 300% of the original speed (150% by default), only while you control it.

No slowdown when carrying (0.1.0)
In the original game, with something in the hands the character can only walk. With this mod, with the stick fully pushed it moves at running speed.

All come off, like the original game; you turn them on in the Mods tab. How to make one:
mods/README.md.
Marry Jamie, working in the game

The wedding anniversary, in the morning…
…and the dinner, when you remembered

The pregnancy, with its Musical Note
The child's birthday

Playing as the girl, on the anniversary

Screenshots

Widescreen, with the game's camera
The same moment, with the camera pulled back to 100%

4:3, as on the GameCube
The house in the morning

The launcher's mods
The launcher's options

Playing
What you need

Windows 10 (version 1903 or newer) or Windows 11, with an Intel or AMD
processor (the x64 package) or an ARM one such as the Snapdragon (the
arm64 package).
A graphics card with Direct3D 12.
Your disc of Harvest Moon: Magical Melody for the USA (G4AEE9), as an
image: .iso, .gcm or .rvz (Dolphin's compressed format). The launcher
checks that it is that game and that version.
About 2 GB free: an .rvz image is converted to .iso, and the prepared
game takes about 100 MB.

Steps

Download the zip for your processor from
Releases.
Before unzipping it, right-click it → Properties → tick Unblock →
OK. Otherwise Windows may stop the tools that prepare the game.
Unzip all of it into a folder and open HarvestMoonMM.exe. The program is
not signed, so Windows may say that it does not know the publisher:
More info → Run anyway.
Choose Prepare the game and pick your disc image (or drop it on the
window). The first time, the game is made for your computer: it takes a
few minutes, and then never again until the next update.
Press Play.

Controls
The first controller you connect plays, mapped automatically. Without one,
the keyboard plays, with the same keys as Dolphin by default. You can change
them in the game: F10, then Controller settings. Pick a part of the GameCube
controller and press the key (or a mouse button) or, for a controller, the
button that should play it; the changes are kept by themselves, each controller
has its own, and Restore defaults goes back to the automatic mapping.
(A controller's sticks always follow the controller's own.)

GameCube
Keyboard

Control Stick
Arrow keys

C Stick
I, J, K, L

D-Pad
T, F, G, H

A, B, X, Y
X, Z, C, S

Z
D

L, R
Q, W

START
Enter

Also: F10 opens the options, holding Tab speeds the game up, and
Alt+Enter switches to full screen.
Your saves
They are in %LOCALAPPDATA%\HarvestMoonMM\Native\USA\Card A, one .gci file
for each file on the memory card. To bring a save from Dolphin, when it keeps
the memory card as a GCI folder, or from the earlier ModernGekko version,
copy its E9-G4AE-HARVESTMOON.gci there. Your choices are in
%LOCALAPPDATA%\HarvestMoonMM\settings.json, and the logs, prepare.log and
native.log, in the Native folder.
If something fails, open an issue
with the log.
How it works
your disc image (.iso, .gcm or .rvz)
│ nodtool turns an .rvz into an .iso; the launcher checks the game and its version
▼
main.dol: the game's code, for the GameCube's PowerPC processor
│ WiiCompiled's translator
▼
C++: each function of the game, as a C++ function
│ clang (llvm-mingw), with the runtime kit, on your computer
▼
hmmm-native.exe: the game, as a program for your PC

The GameCube's processor is a PowerPC, so its code cannot run on a PC as it
is. The translator of WiiCompiled,
the recompilation of Mario Kart Wii, turns each function of the game into
C++, and that C++ is compiled together with a runtime that gives it what it
expects from the console: memory, the processor's special registers, the
operating system's threads, alarms and interrupts, the disc, the memory card,
the controllers, the graphics and the sound.
The translated C++ is the game, so it cannot be handed out. The download
brings everything else: the runtime already compiled (the runtime kit), the
translator, a C++ compiler (llvm-mingw) and Python. The launcher makes the
program on your computer from your disc, and nothing in the package comes
from the disc. The mods are compiled into the program, and the places where
they act are marked in the translated code.
More: docs/NATIVE_PACKAGE.md (the package and the
preparation), runtime/README.md and
docs/NATIVE_RUNTIME.md (the runtime),
docs/PLAN.md (the whole plan).
Before the native version, the recompiled game ran with
DolRecomp on
ModernGekko, which keeps
Dolphin's core for the hardware. That package is still in the repository
(packaging/windows/README.md), and it was the
test bench of the Jamie mod.
What comes next

1.0: the game played from start to finish.
The menus and the text at 4:3 in widescreen, instead of stretched.
The game in Spanish, French, German or Italian: the American disc carries
the translations of a European release that never came out.
More mods: cheats, and fast-forwarding the scenes.
Updating from the launcher, a signed program, and a package for Linux.
Later, the two Wii versions of the game on the same runtime.

For developers

The native runtime on Linux: scripts/build_native_runtime.sh
(runtime/README.md). It needs your disc extracted in
orig/G4AEE9.
The launcher and the Windows package, which GitHub Actions builds when a
version is published: docs/NATIVE_PACKAGE.md.
How the game was analysed: docs/DISC_ANALYSIS.md,
docs/FUNCTION_MAP.md (4,486 functions, checked
against CodeWarrior's exception index) and
docs/VALIDATION.md (the recompiled code compared with
Dolphin's interpreter, during play and instruction by instruction).

Target binary: Harvest Moon: Magical Melody (USA), ID G4AEE9,
revision 0. sys/main.dol SHA-1 5977972cd798d60ecfcf5c1f26a86dcecc36446f.
The analysis tools need Python 3.11 or newer, and Rust to install nodtool:
# 1. Tools
cargo install nodtool # reads ISO/GCM/RVZ
python3 -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt # capstone, pytest, ruff

# 2. Extract your disc to orig/G4AEE9 and check it is the right binary
python3 tools/extract_disc.py path/to/your/disc.rvz
python3 tools/check_disc.py

# 3. Regenerate and check the function map
python3 tools/analyze.py
HM_MM_DOL=orig/G4AEE9/sys/main.dol python3 -m pytest

# 4. Read any function
python3 tools/disasm.py main
On Windows:

Install the x64 Python from python.org,
even if your PC has an ARM processor: capstone ships no prebuilt package
(wheel) for Windows ARM64, and x64 Python runs there through Windows 11's
emulation. (With Visual Studio and its C++ tools for ARM64, ARM64 Python
works too: pip builds capstone from source, as the GitHub workflow does.)

Use py instead of python3. In PowerShell, set the tests' variable like
this:
$env:HM_MM_DOL = "orig/G4AEE9/sys/main.dol"
py -m pytest

If you already use Dolphin you need neither Rust nor nodtool: right-click
the game → Properties → Filesystem tab → right-click the disc →
Extract Entire Disc..., and pick the orig\G4AEE9 folder. Then
py tools/check_disc.py confirms it came out right.

Read CONTRIBUTING.md before contributing.
Credits

WiiCompiled: the translator, and
the example of a recompilation that runs without an emulator.
aurora: the GameCube's graphics,
controllers and memory card, on Dawn
(WebGPU).
Dolphin: the reference for the hardware; the
sound program is ported from its high-level emulation.
DolRecomp and
ModernGekko: the first
playable recompilation of the game.
SDL, Dear ImGui,
nod,
llvm-mingw and the fonts Baloo 2,
Dosis, M PLUS Rounded 1c and DejaVu Sans. The whole list, with the
licenses, is in
packaging/native/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt.

License
GNU General Public License, version 3 or later (GPL-3.0-or-later); the text
is in LICENSE. It is the license of WiiCompiled and ModernGekko and
is compatible with those of DolRecomp and Dolphin. The patches in patches/
modify files derived from Dolphin that are GPL-2.0-or-later and are offered
under those same terms.
This is a fan project, not affiliated with Natsume, Marvelous or Nintendo.
Harvest Moon: Magical Melody was developed by Marvelous Interactive and
published by Natsume. No part of the game is in this repository or in its
downloads.
