1hfzf5o.title: Persona 6 может появиться на The Game Awards - фанаты нашли новый намек на трейлер
1hfzf5o.content:
Поклонники Persona 6 получили новый повод надеяться на скорый показ продолжения серии. Недавнее обновление домена игры может указывать на подготовку Atlus к крупному анонсу, который потенциально состоится уже на The Game Awards 2026.
Пользователь Reddit под ником ronakwya, внимательно следящий за регистрацией доменов Atlus, обнаружил, что компания несколько дней назад обновила сертификаты домена Persona 6. Само по себе это изменение не подтверждает подготовку трейлера, однако фанаты заметили интересную закономерность.
Подобные обновления уже происходили перед крупными показами других игр Atlus. Например, домен Persona 4 Revival обновили примерно за месяц до выхода первого полноценного игрового трейлера. Это позволяет предположить, что студия может готовить новый сайт Persona 6, который пока остается скрытым от публики.
На фоне приближающейся The Game Awards 2026, которая пройдет примерно через месяц, находка выглядит особенно интригующей. Фанаты надеются, что церемония станет площадкой для первого полноценного показа новой основной части Persona почти за десять лет.
The Game Awards действительно подходит для подобного анонса: мероприятие собирает огромную аудиторию и регулярно становится местом крупных мировых премьер. Впрочем, пока Atlus официально не подтверждала участие Persona 6 в шоу, поэтому речь идет лишь о предположениях.
Первый тизер Persona 6 появился в июне, но с тех пор поклонники практически не получали новой информации. Дополнительный интерес к игре подогревают недавние утечки о персонажах и возможный ремейк первой Persona, который, по мнению некоторых фанатов, может быть связан с планами Atlus на юбилей серии.

3rjagk.title: Netcode Warriors adds PS5 version, launches in 2027
3rjagk.content:
PCPS5

Three new trailers.
Anime-inspired arena fighting game Netcode Warriors will launch for PlayStation 5 and PC via Steam in 2027, developer Son Studios announced. The PlayStation 5 version is newly announced. Son Studios also released three new trailers, including an overview trailer, and gameplay reveal trailers for Emilie & Datakarys and Anuarite & Bajilink.Here is an overview of the game, via Son Studios:Dive into the datascape of Netcode Warriors, an anime-style arena fighter designed from the ground up to take competitive play to its limits. Engage in intense one-versus-one fights, master unique characters and playstyles, then take your skills to the arena.Immerse yourself in the story of Netcode Warriors, where our characters discover a new world that has the potential to change their lives, but they’re not the only ones around, and they’ll have to fight to achieve their dreams and survive.Take your skills online and prove YOU are the best with Rollback Netcode! Play the game in various online modes: climb the ranks and assert your skill, play casual matches with people from all over the world, and invite your friends to play with custom lobbies that include a spectator mode.
Hone your skills in training mode, run through the arcade ladder or play split screen with a friend locally. You can also throw down the gauntlet in the local tournament mode, battle for survival and do some combo challenges.Watch the announcement trailer below.Overview TrailerEmilie & Datakarys Gameplay TrailerAnuarite & Bajilink Gameplay Trailer

2fzv8g.title: A step toward defining the Standard Model on a lattice
2fzv8g.content: The Standard Model of particle physics is an extraordinarily successful theory of nature, describing the known elementary particles and three of the four fundamental forces—the strong force, the weak force, and electromagnetism. The success of the theory rests on outstanding agreement between theoretical calculations and experiments across eighteen orders of magnitude, from the low energies of hydrogen’s 21-centimeter radio emission to the high energies of collisions at the Large Hadron Collider. And yet for all of its successes over the more than fifty years of its existence, a foundational problem remains: how to give the full theory a nonperturbative definition, one that does not rely on treating its interactions as small corrections. In an October preprint⁠(opens in a new window) prepared with the aid of GPT‑6 Astra, I proposed a candidate definition on a lattice—a grid representing spacetime.I had a strategy for tackling this problem, but had not been able to prove that it worked in all the cases it needed to cover. Astra helped turn that strategy into a construction and took the lead in developing the detailed proof. To explain what we did, it helps to start with what is missing from our existing description of the Standard Model.What is missing from the Standard Model’s definition?What does it mean to say that we lack a definition of the Standard Model? Quantum mechanics and special relativity tell us how the particles and forces of the Standard Model interact. Unfortunately, we don’t yet know how to make complete predictions based directly on these interactions. Instead, we often start by imagining that the interactions are turned off, so that electrons would no longer repel each other. We can solve that problem exactly, then put the interactions back in as a series of small corrections. When the corrections get progressively smaller, a few terms can give a remarkably precise answer—for example, it has allowed physicists to predict the strength of the electron’s magnetism to within a few parts in a trillion. This approach is known as perturbation theory.However, much of the richness of the Standard Model lies outside the realm of perturbation theory. Take the mass of the proton: the proton is made up of three quarks, but its mass comes primarily from the motion and interactions of the quarks and the strong force-carrying gluons inside it. If you turn off the strong force, the proton falls apart entirely, so perturbation theory is not a useful guide to understanding the size of the proton’s mass. More powerful methods are needed to access information about the theory nonperturbatively, where the interactions are present from the start and not treated as small corrections.For the full Standard Model in continuous spacetime, we don’t have a nonperturbative definition, or even an understanding of whether the interacting theory is mathematically well defined. A promising alternative is to discretize spacetime into a grid of points, known as a lattice. The spacing of the grid defines the shortest distance our theory can resolve, and studying a finite grid allows us to give a rigorous nonperturbative definition of the theory at a given spacing. It also enables us to put the theory on a computer, where we can calculate its predictions directly without resorting to perturbation theory. This approach, known as lattice field theory, has led to remarkable progress in our understanding of the strong force over the last few decades, including a quantitative understanding of the mass of the proton from first principles.Left-handed particlesIf lattice field theory has been so successful for the strong force, why haven’t we extended it to a nonperturbative lattice definition of the entire Standard Model? Here a crucial difference stands in the way: the Standard Model is an example of what is known as a chiral theory.A chiral theory is one that looks different under reflection in space. Think of gloves in a mirror: the mirror image of a left-handed glove is a right-handed glove. If you have one of each kind, the mirror image does as well, so your collection of gloves looks the same under reflection in space. But if you only have a left-handed glove, the right-handed glove in the mirror is different.This notion of handedness extends to many of the fundamental particles in the Standard Model, known as fermions, including quarks and electrons. Most forces in the Standard Model are not chiral: the strong force and electromagnetism, for example, treat left-handed and right-handed fermions in the same way. Such theories can be put on a lattice more readily.But the third fundamental force of the Standard Model, the weak force, lacks this reflection symmetry. It treats left- and right-handed fermions differently, and so does not look the same under mirror reflections that exchange left and right. This treating of different-handed particles differently is what makes the Standard Model a chiral theory. And it turns out that putting chiral theories on a lattice is profoundly challenging. If we try to put a left-handed fermion on the lattice, the most natural rules give you a right-handed partner you never asked for. This is a surprising outcome, which we’ll unpack momentarily. Whatever the reason, this means a straightforward lattice formulation of the Standard Model gives the wrong particle content for the weak force. Doubling is one reason a complete nonperturbative definition of the Standard Model has been missing since the theory took shape.An analogy with light and mirrorsTo understand doubling, consider an analogy with light. Light has two polarizations, which describe the orientation of the electric field as the light moves through space. (This is familiar if you wear polarized sunglasses, which block the horizontally-polarized light that reflects off water or roads while letting through vertically-polarized light.) Although polarized sunglasses pick out a basis of horizontal and vertical polarizations, for our analogy it will be more useful to pick a basis where these two polarizations are left-circular and right-circular, meaning that the electric field is rotating either clockwise or counterclockwise around the direction of motion. As we’ve said, electromagnetism is reflection-symmetric, so its actual laws are the same for both left-circular and right-circular polarizations. (For the technically inclined, left and right refer to chirality when we talk about fermions. In our analogy with light, they refer to the photon’s helicity, which tells us whether its spin points along or against its direction of travel.)But imagine you wanted to emulate a world with only left-circular light, akin to the way the weak interactions single out left-handed fermions. To study this in the lab, you could put a laser producing left-circular light into a box with a mirror at either end. The light could build up as it bounced back and forth, allowing you to study it carefully—kind of like putting the Standard Model on a lattice. In each case you are bounding the accessible length scales of the theory to gain control—the lattice bounds the shortest accessible distances, while the box bounds the longest distances.If you built the box using ordinary mirrors (like putting a chiral theory on the lattice in the most straightforward way), you’d be in for a surprise: the left-circular light coming out of the laser becomes right-circular when it bounces off the mirror at the other end, so now the box contains both polarizations of light. This occurs because the mirror reverses the direction of the light without changing how the electric field is rotating (as seen from the same end of the box), which flips the polarization. This is a bit like the appearance of doublers when you put a left-handed fermion on the lattice. You supplied only left-handed light, and the box supplied the other hand.There is a clever fix. You can make a chiral mirror using special films whose molecules line up in layers. The alignment turns a little from one layer to the next, tracing a spiral down into the film. For light whose wavelength and handedness match the spiral, the small reflections from different layers reinforce one another, flipping the rotation of the electric field in the light that bounces back. The film sends left-handed light back left-handed and lets right-handed light pass through. Such chiral mirrors have been around for more than a decade, and the phenomenon even occurs in nature: some scarab beetles have a similar spiral in their shiny shells. If you constructed your box using chiral mirrors, then the light traveling in both directions would be left-circular.A similar trick works on the lattice: decades ago, Paul Ginsparg and Nobel laureate Ken Wilson1 worked out the lattice rules analogous to the requirement that chiral mirrors reverse the rotation of the electric field upon reflection. Rajamani Narayanan and Herbert Neuberger2 built the analog of the chiral mirrors by finding the necessary definition of fundamental particles on the lattice, known as overlap fermions. Finally, Martin Lüscher3 showed how to tell the difference between left-handed and right-handed overlap fermions on the lattice, while Yoshio Kikukawa4 and collaborators explored how this might be used to describe weak interactions in the Standard Model. However, one piece was still missing.Getting the phase rightTo identify that piece, let’s come back to our box with chiral mirrors. The circular polarization of light tells us which way the electric field turns as light propagates, but there’s another important property of the light in our experiment: the optical phase. Imagine water waves rolling past the pilings of a dock, and watch the water rise and fall at one piling. The wave’s phase is the stage of that rise and fall you catch it in when you look, perhaps just past its highest point and on its way down. For our circularly polarized light, the optical phase tracks the same kind of cycle at a fixed spot in the beam, with the electric field pointing up at the “crest” and down at the “trough.”The relative phase of two waves determines how much they add or cancel at the same point. At one piling of a dock, two waves arriving in phase lift the water higher as their crests meet, while a crest arriving with a trough can leave the water close to its usual level. Similarly, light with the same phase in the same place builds up, while light with different phases can cancel out. In our box with chiral mirrors, left-circular light is now bouncing back and forth inside the box. After a lap, the returning light meets fresh light from the laser going in the same direction. If their electric fields are in step, they reinforce and the light builds up inside the box. If the fields are half a cycle apart, they point in opposite directions and the returning light cancels some of the fresh light. To build up a strong beam, we want the phase of each return to arrive in step with the source.To get the phase right, we can rotate one chiral mirror relative to the other. Imagine a mark at twelve o’clock on the rim, and spin the mirror about the beam as though the beam were its axle. Moving the mark to three o’clock turns every layer of the film by a quarter turn and shifts the phase of the reflected light by half a cycle. We can set the angle to make up for the phase accumulated on the rest of the trip. Once the returning light arrives in step with the laser, we have a splendid laboratory for studying purely left-handed light.Imagine changing the force fields until they return to where they started. The orange arcs show the phase the left-handed fermions pick up on that round trip, first on the original grid and then on finer ones. Each bracket pairs two neighboring grids. Adding up the differences between their arcs recovers the phase shift on the original grid. The teal arrow undoes that shift, bringing the fermion measure back to its starting phase.Nathaniel Craig/GPT‑6 AstraOn the lattice, overlap fermions give us a way of keeping only the left-handed fermions that we want, and getting rid of the doublers. But this doesn’t tell us how to set the phase. (The phase in question is quite different from the one we’ve encountered in our chiral mirror thought experiment, but the analogy is good.) On the lattice, this becomes tricky because the phase depends on what the forces of the Standard Model are doing at every grid point. Lüscher worked out the phase prescription for a simpler class of theories such as a chiral version of electromagnetism, but the alignment for the full Standard Model remained open for more than 25 years.We can try to assign a phase by starting with one configuration of forces on the lattice and following the allowed left-handed fermions as we change the force fields in small steps. Now take a series of steps that bring the force fields back to where they started. The same states are allowed at the end, yet the way we carried them around the loop can leave us with a different phase. In the box, we adjusted the mirror to compensate for the phase the light picked up on a lap. On the lattice we have to work out how to compensate for the phase picked up around every loop.Building the construction with AstraMy idea was to take the force fields on the grid where we want to define the theory and represent those same fields on a succession of finer grids. Comparing the allowed fermion states on two successive grids tells us one part of the phase correction for a small change in the forces. Adding up those parts gives us the phase rule on the original grid. The proof shows that it gives the right correction around every allowed loop. The correction for a change at one spot depends mainly on the fields nearby, and different mathematical descriptions of the same fields give the same answer. This supplies the measure for the Standard Model at finite lattice spacing, under a bound on field strengths at the scale of the grid.Developing this refinement strategy into a proof required several rounds of work with Astra and discussions with outside experts. GPT‑6 Astra was essential to turning the refinement idea into a working construction. It suggested the right way to carry a given set of force fields onto finer grids, showed that the comparisons on finer grids would converge to a definite answer, and took the lead in developing the detailed proof. Human experts also played a key role; lattice field theorists Maarten Golterman, Andreas Kronfeld, and Yigal Shamir graciously spent time looking over Astra’s proof and asking probing questions that helped me to build confidence in the result. Their experience with the problem and the questions they asked were invaluable as the construction took shape.What comes nextThe result is a candidate nonperturbative lattice definition for the Standard Model, potentially answering a question that had been open for more than fifty years. As with all scientific progress, however, this construction is much more a beginning than an end. Scientific dialogue among experts is required to decide if this prescription has all the properties we desire. The method that Astra and I proposed is far more an answer in principle than an answer in practice; much work lies ahead to make it useful for realistic lattice simulations. Right now I’m thinking a lot about whether this construction satisfies reflection positivity at finite lattice spacing, a condition that helps connect calculations in this lattice model to a quantum theory in which probabilities are conserved.The construction also leaves open the question of defining the interacting theory in continuous spacetime. OpenAI’s recent proof of the existence of Yang-Mills theory (of which the strong and weak forces of the Standard Model are examples) provides the missing puzzle piece. This enabled them to prove the existence of the simplest unified Yang-Mills theory that includes the gauge fields and fermions of the Standard Model by starting with overlap fermions on the lattice and taking the continuum limit. I’m optimistic these developments will lead to new progress in our understanding of the Standard Model.

1jvkraa.title: GTA 6 может стать толчком к увеличению количества внутриигровой рекламы
1jvkraa.content:
«Когда миллионы людей проводят много времени в интерактивных развлекательных средах, для рекламодателей и инвесторов вполне естественно задуматься о том, как они могут в этом участвовать», — Барт Шпигель (руководитель направления медиа, развлечений, игр и спорта в PricewaterhouseCoopers).

Барт Шпигель отметил, что одним из побочных эффектов от выхода GTA 6 может стать ускоренное развитие идеи о внедрении внутриигровой рекламы, из-за чего геймеры эту идею воспримут в штыки, а у издателей и инвесторов потекут слюнки. По его словам, если GTA 6 оправдает ожидания и увлечет людей на десятки, а то и сотни часов, это может продемонстрировать всему рынку, что игровой индустрии пора активнее использовать рекламу.
Реклама мобильных и социальных игр уже стала привычным явлением, но на рынке компьютерных и консольных игр она встречается реже. Конечно, есть примеры, когда компании пытались внедрить рекламу в игры, но результаты были неоднозначными. Геймеры быстро возмутились, когда EA разместила рекламу в игре UFC, и EA была вынуждена незамедлительно убрать ее, чтобы избежать негативной реакции.Несмотря на это, EA недавно объявила о создании нового подразделения EA Advertising, которое будет стремиться размещать рекламу «непосредственно в игровом процессе». Это объявление тоже не вызвало восторга, поскольку фанаты были против того, чтобы им приходилось видеть рекламу еще в одном месте.
Другие примеры были восприняты более позитивно или, по крайней мере, неоднозначно: например, транспортная компания купила рекламное место в серии игр American Truck Simulator, чтобы помочь с подбором персонала.

У Xbox, в свою очередь, большие планы по размещению рекламы в играх. Исполнительный директор Xbox Мэтью Болл заявил, что реклама в консольных играх может помочь решить «двустороннюю проблему», с которой сегодня сталкиваются разработчики ААА-игр. Затраты на разработку продолжают расти и, по словам Болла, реклама, если она не слишком навязчивая, может помочь разработчикам заработать больше денег и укрепить свои позиции на рынке. Конечно, если эти компании будут размещать больше рекламы в играх, это не значит, что они перестанут навязывать пользователям DLC, микротранзакции и прочее. Скорее всего и то, и другое будет происходить одновременно. Однако, по мнению Шпигеля, при правильном подходе реклама может стать большим подспорьем для игровой индустрии.
«Что особенно интересно, так это то, что возможности не ограничиваются размещением рекламы в играх. Существует целая экосистема цифровой рекламной инфраструктуры, технологий и сервисов, которые могут извлечь выгоду из дальнейшего развития сферы. Я ожидаю, что интерес к этим возможностям будет расти, особенно со стороны инвесторов, которые хотят получить доступ к игровой индустрии, не принимая на себя значительные финансовые риски, связанные с разработкой игр-блокбастеров», — сказал Б. Шпигель.

1y9u8px.title: Съёмки "Бэтмена: Часть II" затянутся до 2027 года, подтвердил Энди Серкис
1y9u8px.content:
Съемки сиквела «Бэтмена» от Мэтта Ривза продлятся дольше запланированного и перейдут на 2027 год. Об этом рассказал Энди Серкис, который играет дворецкого Альфреда, в эфире шоу The Chris Evans Breakfast Show на Virgin Radio UK. Актер признался, что еще не снимался в этом фильме:
«Я пока не играл Альфреда, потому что съемки продлили. Сразу после Рождества мы начнем», — заявил он.
Это не совпадает с тем, что говорили ранее. В конце октября Роберт Паттинсон возвращался на площадку и называл фильм «почти готовым», а издание THR писало, что отснято две трети, и осталось всего шесть недель. На деле же производство затянулось, а участие Стивена Содерберга в проекте стало куда более масштабным, чем «финальные недели» — теперь речь идет о месяцах работы.
Помимо Паттинсона и Серкиса, в картине снимаются Скарлетт Йоханссон, Брайан Тайри Генри, Чарльз Дэнс и Себастьян Стэн. Премьера «Бэтмена 2» пока остается на 18 февраля 2028 года, так что у команды есть запас времени.

lkplj1.title: Is bad news for Jensen Huang also bad news for the AI industry?
lkplj1.content:
We didn’t see this coming. Or at least, I didn’t — a week ago, when I wrote about Nvidia’s board opening an investigation into then-CEO Jensen Huang, I assumed his job was safe.

On the latest episode of TechCrunch’s Equity podcast, Rebecca Bellan, Tim De Chant, and I discussed how Huang’s ouster went down and what it means for the larger AI economy. While Tim said he saw it coming (albeit not this quickly), Rebecca said, “I didn’t think it was going to happen at all.”

“Jensen is Nvidia, right?” she added. “And so much of this economy is riding on Nvidia.”

Similarly, I marveled at how quickly Huang’s support seemed to crumble, with more scandals seeming to emerge every day. (At the same time, there are many who’d still like to see him return.) And we also took a moment to wonder what will happen to Nvidia’s investments in the larger AI ecosystem.

Keep reading for a preview of our conversation, edited for length and clarity; you can listen to the whole episode here.

Tim De Chant: I figured this was coming. I didn’t think it would happen this quickly. I thought there would be at least a few days. 

Rebecca Bellan: I didn’t think it was going to happen at all. I mean, Jensen is Nvidia, right? And so much of this economy is riding on Nvidia. And we’ve got nothing but the last few years of data to show us that billionaires can do whatever the hell they want. So it was surprising to me  — it almost restored my faith in humanity, that he resigned.

But someone said to me, “If this were Elon, nothing would happen.” He would not be resigning. Nothing would be going down

Anthony Ha: Which is interesting, because I would have said, as of a week ago, or even just a few days ago, that Jensen is in the same category as Elon. I mean, no one is quite as special as Elon is, but it’s a big, incredibly successful company. Like you said — in a lot of ways, the entire AI economy is built on top of Nvidia.

And for most people, Jensen Huang is Nvidia. He’s the biggest shareholder. He has family members who work at the company, and probably most importantly, there was no succession plan in place. So this was not something that they were prepared for at all.

Rebecca: I think we should actually take a step back, because we just launched into this conversation assuming — rightly so — that our listeners will know what the heck we’re talking about.

But for those who somehow don’t, Jensen resigned on Thursday, after it came out he was having an affair with a former executive at an Nvidia customer called Megaspeed, who’s alleged to have ties to Chinese intelligence. And then there was another reported affair with an Nvidia executive.

So he’s resigned. Nvidia CFO Collette Kress is jumping in as the interim CEO. She’s a longtime board member. I think it’s always interesting when a CFO steps in to be a CEO. It just means we’re going to manage expenses right now, like that’s the key. 

Anthony: I think a big part of the message is: This is not necessarily someone you should expect to be in this role for the long term. No disrespect to her, but it feels like a caretaker appointment while they figure things out.

Just to get into that backstory a little bit more, what has been really remarkable to me has been this sense that a lot of what ultimately brought Huang down, [that] stuff was at least known in intelligence circles for a while. Apparently, this report that [raises] questions, concerns about his relationship with Alice Huang is something that was circulating a year ago, or close to a year ago.

And then suddenly, everything really accelerated, Starting over the weekend, with Jensen Huang admitting to having an affair, the board saying it was investigating, but that it still had a lot of faith in him. And then this week, this other affair being reported on, and it just felt like there was all this bad news coming fairly quickly. 

But also, it wasn’t this thing that no one had known before. I guess a lot of the general public hadn’t known. So it’s this combined feeling of, “Wow, the ground kind of shifted so quickly under him,” even though the worst stuff, the possibility that somehow national security might have been threatened, is something that actually has been known by the government for nearly a year, if not more. 

Rebecca: That’s exactly right. Trump was given some warnings about Huang’s affair with someone who has ties to Chinese intelligence, potentially, and it seemed like he didn’t really mind.

I think what’s important here, though, is to note that Jensen Huang has been an advocate for loosening chip exports to China. And so this is where the crux of it is. Can anyone trust him as the CEO of this company when he’s advocating for loosening chip exports to China? Which a lot of people believe is a national security issue, because that means it will give Chinese AI companies access to our powerful chips, which will help them improve their AI, which could threaten America. 

I mean, there’s two sides of this coin. And I think, honestly, that Jensen does not need a woman to tell him that  — he just wants to sell more chips, and to anybody and everybody, and whether or not that’s good for national security or not, I think is honestly secondary to him.

Tim:  I completely agree. I think the big turning point seems to happen on November 9 — so that would have been earlier this week, Monday, when the Bloomberg report came out and suggested that Nvidia’s head attorney had some role in inquiring about the Department of Commerce’s investigation into Alice Huang.

Things seem to have accelerated in the last few days following that. And I don’t know what role exactly that report played in it, but it seems to be maybe there was a shift within government or within the board, a kind of a daunting realization of the extent to which this had spread just beyond Jensen and some affair. 

Anthony: There’s also just the question of: What does this mean for Nvidia? What does this mean for the broader AI industry? And one of the reasons those two things are very tightly connected is not just Nvidia chips themselves, but also the fact that under Jensen Huang, the company has invested very, very heavily in a number of AI startups.

People talk about the idea of an AI circular economy, and I think Nvidia has been one of the biggest players in that, in terms of both funding a lot of things, [but] also, obviously, providing the infrastructure for a lot of AI projects. So if Nvidia is going into this stage of lockdown, circle the wagons — even if it just means a small pullback, that could have really dramatic repercussions.

Rebecca: Yeah, that’s what I want to know: What happens to the Bank of Nvidia without Jensen? Is he the one leading this? 

Just to throw some numbers at you, Nvidia apparently accounts for roughly 80% of the AI GPU market. It reported $99 billion in investments and another $25 billion in commitments, plus $36 billion dollars in cloud service commitments. A lot of those include investments into CoreWeave, Nebius, OpenAI, Anthropic, major data center projects. They’ve got their fingers in literally everybody’s pie.

1af5hgc.title: Our new blog for science
1af5hgc.content: We’re starting the OpenAI science blog to give scientists and academic researchers a place to share what they’re discovering with AI and how they’re doing the work. Our mission is to ensure that AGI benefits all of humanity, and accelerating scientific discovery is one of the most impactful ways we can work toward that goal.We’ll publish work across a broad range of scientific disciplines, including:Research and discoveries: New scientific results and updates on ongoing research from OpenAI, our collaborators, and the broader scientific community.Methods and practical guidance: Examples of how scientists use our models for tasks such as scientific computing, data analysis, exploring literature, and planning experiments. We’ll share approaches others can adapt, including how to check the work and where a method falls short.Perspectives from the scientific community: Firsthand accounts from researchers using AI, what they are learning, and how these capabilities are affecting their disciplines. We’ll also discuss open questions about scientific practice and how to make these tools useful to more people.Science expands our understanding of the world and makes advances possible, from better medicines to new sources of energy. Many of those advances begin with fundamental questions whose practical significance becomes clear only years later.In recent months, we’ve seen an expanding range of scientific problems our models can address. In September, an internal OpenAI system produced a proof addressing the Navier–Stokes existence and smoothness problem⁠, a longstanding question about the equations describing fluid motion. In early October, we released a broad range of mathematical results⁠. Among them was a result on the quasi-Riemann hypothesis⁠(opens in a new window), with a result that gives a tighter bound on the error in a classical formula for estimating how many primes lie below a given number. Later that month, we shared results across mathematics, computer science, and physics⁠ concerning how waves concentrate, the limits of efficient computation, and the mathematical foundations of interacting quantum field theory.In biology, researchers are using AI to analyze complex datasets, connect findings across fields, and develop new hypotheses to test in the lab. Working with PerturbAI and Scripps Research⁠, thousands of agents powered by GPT‑Rosalind analyzed existing experimental data from millions of mouse brain cells in 32 minutes. By connecting the effects of gene disruptions with scientific literature, they identified possible biological mechanisms for scientists to test. Researchers are also developing their own approaches: César de la Fuente’s team uses ChatGPT and Codex⁠ to build algorithms that identify potential antibiotic molecules, which they then make and test in the lab.These capabilities bring new possibilities and changes to scientific practice. In mathematics, systems that generate proofs raise questions about how new arguments are checked, explained, and incorporated into the field. In experimental sciences, exploring more hypotheses creates opportunities — and challenges — in deciding which experiments to pursue. Across disciplines, researchers are considering what these tools mean for training, attribution, and the skills their work requires. The implications will differ by field, and scientific communities should help shape how these tools are used.We hope this blog helps more people understand how AI is changing science and how they can use it to explore new questions and make discoveries of their own.

b7ho02.title: Mojang показала трейлер DLC The Humblers Awaken для Minecraft Dungeons II - релиз 1 декабря
b7ho02.content:
Mojang анонсировала первое сюжетное дополнение для Minecraft Dungeons II. Новое DLC получило название The Humblers Awaken и выйдет 1 декабря. Анонс состоялся на выставке TwitchCon San Diego.

По сюжету в измерении Sift пробуждается древняя угроза — хамблеры, спавшие целую вечность. Они не в восторге от того, что их разбудили, и если их не остановить, они распространятся по всему измерению или, что хуже, разбудят куда более опасного врага. Игрокам предстоит отправиться в глубины Sift, пройти через грибные поля и извилистые подземные норы, чтобы выяснить причину беспокойства.
В дополнении появится три новых артефакта с активными способностями и четыре талисмана с пассивными бонусами. Также игроки получат новые косметические предметы: скин Pearl, питомца Baby Nuzzle и плащ Nacreous.
Одновременно с платным DLC выйдет бесплатное обновление. Оно добавит испытания в подземельях, новое оружие и броню, а также вернет четырех знакомых героев из первой Minecraft Dungeons — Хэла, Хекса, Эдриенн и Валори в оригинальном костюме — в качестве скинов. В честь запуска Mojang также выпустит тематический плащ Snow Golem, который можно будет получить по промокоду, опубликованному 1 декабря.

gh-1308504857.title: GitHub - Laeresh/CSVM: Open-source remake of Crimson Skies (2000) — plays the original game using your own files
gh-1308504857.content:
CSVM is a fan-made remake engine for Crimson Skies (2000, Zipper Interactive / Microsoft):
a modern engine that plays the original game using your own legally-owned game files.
This repository ships code and documentation only. It contains no game assets of
any kind, and reproduces no game code. The engine reads your own copy of the game in place at
runtime: an install, the disc's drive, or an image of the disc (.iso, .cue/.bin/.img,
.ccd/.img).
Status
What this build plays:

The single-player campaign, with its cabin, briefing and flight-check screens.
Instant Action's four mission types: dogfighting an ace, dogfighting a squadron, attacking
a zeppelin, and stunt flying against the clock.
2 to 4-player splitscreen Dogfight deathmatch, and free flight.
Network play: the Dogfight deathmatch and campaign co-op, hosted from the menu and joined by
LAN search or by IP address.
Seated PC VR through OpenXR on Windows, experimental: flight in stereo from the cockpit, menus
and films on a theater screen. packaging/README.md says
how to start it.
11 aircraft and 8 chapter worlds, in the original's liveries, animated and with sound.
Guns and rockets, AI aircraft that patrol, engage and evade, turrets, zeppelins, and world
objects that take damage and die.
Every game file format the engine uses, read by CSVM's own C# readers straight from the
original files, with no extraction step.

This is an early build; the release page lists what is known broken in it.
Download and play
You need Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit, a graphics card with a working Vulkan or Direct3D 12 driver,
and a retail Crimson Skies install, the game's disc or an image of it. Nothing else: the .NET
runtime the engine needs is inside the download, so there is no runtime or framework to install.

Download the CSVM-v<version>-win64.zip asset from the
latest release.
Unzip it wherever you like.
Double-click CSVM.exe. It looks for the game by itself, and when it finds none it asks
for your install folder (the one holding the ZBD and GOSDATA subfolders), the disc's
drive or a disc image. Your copy is only read, never modified. An optional copy puts the
game files beside CSVM.exe (about 830 MB), so a disc or image need not stay in place.
Pick a mode, chapter and plane in the menu.

packaging/README.md is the long form of those four steps and ships in
the zip as the README.md beside CSVM.exe: the SHA-256 to check the download against, the
Windows SmartScreen warning an unsigned download raises, where your logs and saved games live,
and what to read when the game vanishes after it starts.
Reporting a problem, and contributing
Bugs go in an issue.
The form asks for the build version and the newest log file from the logs\ folder beside
CSVM.exe, which between them usually identify a fault without a round trip. A report is
worked on in its own issue and is not copied into the author's backlog issues, so the issue
is the thread to follow.
Small self-contained pull requests are welcome for packaging/, the repo scripts,
the documentation and typo fixes. A change under CSVM/src needs an issue first, because
engine changes land through a golden-image tier a contributor cannot run.
CONTRIBUTING.md has the detail. Security problems go through
SECURITY.md rather than an issue.
Building from source
The rest of this page is about the source tree; nothing in it is needed to play.
git clone https://github.com/Laeresh/CSVM.git

You need a legally-owned copy of Crimson Skies, Godot 4.7 (.NET)
and the .NET 8 SDK. Put your install (or a copy of it) in CrimsonSkiesGame\ at the repo
root, or point CSVM_INSTALL_ROOT at it, then see CSVM/README.md to build
and run. The engine reads the game files in place through its own readers
(CSVM/src/Extraction/, CSVM/src/Mech3/); there is no extraction step and no external tool.
Modding. Players who want to edit the game's archives run unzbd, mech3ax's extractor,
themselves (the build CSVM v0.4.0 bundled writes the layout CSVM reads), edit its output, and
choose its folder on the Modding Folder row of Options' GAME OPTIONS page (Choose folder...),
which keeps it for later launches and also offers an old extracted folder, or name it for one
launch with --mod-folder=<folder>. CSVM loads each
archive the folder holds from there and everything else from the game files; docs/modding.md lists the files it reads.
Build and run
dotnet build CSVM/CSVM.sln
godot --path CSVM res://scenes/Main.tscn -- --plane=player_bhawk

First time only, run Godot once with --headless --import before running scenes. RunGame.ps1
wraps the build step and launches the in-game menu with no args; RunDev.ps1 is the same with
interactive console prompts. Verify a change with .\scripts\RunTests.ps1 — one command, one exit code
(build → unit tests → in-engine suites → golden-image hashes).
Package a release build
Godot export templates are user-global, not part of the repo. One-time setup: extract the inner
templates/ files of tools/godot-4.7-mono-export-templates.tpz directly into
%APPDATA%\Godot\export_templates\4.7.stable.mono\.
.\scripts\ExportRelease.ps1

ExportRelease.ps1 builds, imports, and exports the release preset to .scratch\export\CSVM.exe,
checking the export templates are installed and clearing .scratch\export\ before it starts.
This produces a self-contained CSVM.exe (the .NET runtime is bundled, so a recipient installs
nothing) plus its data folder. It then copies the rest of the release in beside it,
packaging/README.md / LICENSE / LICENSE-thirdparty.txt, SDL2 and the WebRTC library,
generates BUILD-INFO.txt, and zips the folder to
.scratch\CSVM-v<version>-win64.zip, the archive to hand over. The version is
application/config/version in CSVM/project.godot, which the exe's file properties and the
first line of every log state as well. See packaging/MANIFEST.md for
the layout and docs/tooling.md for the full export and packaging detail.
.\scripts\PublishRelease.ps1 -NotesFile <file>

PublishRelease.ps1 is the publish itself, in one run: it reads the same version, runs
ExportRelease.ps1 -Linux, runs sandbox\LinuxRelease.ps1 on the tarball (a failure stops
the run before the tag), computes both archives' SHA-256s, creates the annotated tag on the
commit that was built, pushes it, and creates the GitHub release with the zip and the tarball,
so the tag, the executables' version, the archives' names, the published checksums and the
notes cannot disagree with each other. It needs gh installed and authenticated and WSL
Debian for the Linux export, and it refuses a dirty tree and a tag that already exists; a tag
is never re-pointed. -DryRun runs every check and the export and stops before the tag.
Format documentation
The reverse-engineered format reference lives in docs/formats/ — 48 pages
covering the GameZ container, reader archives, paint schemes, animation definitions, world
structure and more. Most of it was decoded by inspecting the game's data and matching
behaviour against the original game. Most of those pages also rest on static analysis of the
retail crimson.exe wherever it settles a question the data cannot, naming the function or
address at the point of use rather than reproducing code. Findings that come from
the executable wholesale live apart from the format reference, in docs/org/: the
flight model, the weapon and particle runtimes, the AI, and the rest of the original behaviour
this engine matches. Those pages describe behaviour and constants, and name the function
addresses so any claim can be re-checked at source. No game code and no game assets are
reproduced or redistributed here; the engine is an independent implementation.
Supporting the project
CSVM is free and will stay free. The engine is GPL-3.0, every release is
on the releases page, and nothing is held back for supporters.
If you'd like to support the work anyway, you can do so on
Ko-fi. Contributions go towards the
monthly running costs of the master server, and towards development
time on the engine, its documentation and its code. They buy no early
access, no exclusive builds, no server privileges and no game content.
The master server is optional: CSVM plays without it, and it is open
to everyone whether they contribute or not. You can even host your own.
Playing CSVM still requires your own legally-owned copy of
Crimson Skies. This is an unofficial fan project and is not affiliated
with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Microsoft or Zipper Interactive.

1ticxyo.content: Михаэль Лайтерс, генеральный директор Porsche, не оценил подход Tesla с акцентом на зрелищные презентации. По его мнению, немецкий бренд должен держаться подальше от таких трюков и делать ставку на настоящие инженерные решения.15 октября обе компании практически синхронно показали свои флагманские спорткары. Tesla превратила презентацию в спектакль: Roadster промчался по изогнутой рампе, взмыл в воздух, крутанулся и приземлился на колеса. Этот трюк стал возможен благодаря пневматическим ускорителям, созданным при участии инженеров SpaceX.Лайтерс обратил внимание на то, что аудитории Porsche и Tesla различаются, так что соревноваться в зрелищности с американцами немцы не планируют. Кстати, Roadster пока существует больше в обещаниях: Tesla анонсировала несколько версий, но ни цены, ни четкого графика производства до сих пор не назвала.Вместо летающего гиперкара Porsche продемонстрировала концепт Mission S – спорткар со средним расположением двигателя. Данные о моторе пока не обнародованы, однако есть все признаки того, что это восьмицилиндровый агрегат – V8 или оппозитная «восьмерка». 1ri8oa.title: This AI Tamagotchi Turns Everyday Objects Into Needy Virtual Pets
1ri8oa.content: You forgot to water the plant. Instead of seeing yellowing leaves, you see a cute plant-shaped pet on a tiny screen, looking sad and dejected. Maybe that'll give you the push you needed to grab the watering can. As you pour water into the soil, the plant pet on the screen gets excited and happy.That's the idea behind OATs, or Object Agent Twins—micro-agent AI avatars on tiny E Ink displays designed to pair with everyday household objects. The tech was created by Daehwa Kim, a fifth-year PhD student in Carnegie Mellon's Future Interfaces Group. Kim presented the project at the ACM Symposium on User Interface Software and Technology in Detroit in early November, a forum where academics and industry experts explore human-computer interfaces, and she earned two Honorable Mention awards.You might remember Tamagotchi, the popular egg-shaped toys from the ’90s that housed digital pets requiring real-time care and attention. Kim’s goal was to bring a similar experience to physical objects in our lives. “We bring this joy of caring from virtual to physical objects,” she tells WIRED. While folks have encouraged Kim to sell OAT kits online, she hasn't decided whether to pursue it as a business opportunity.Courtesy of Daehwa KimKim says everyone spends all day staring at mobile devices, and AI agents—even if they're designed to handle tasks on your behalf—still demand attention from your smartphone screen. OATs were a way to bring those interactions out into the real world.Giving AI a physical body isn't new, as companies rush to create “the next smartphone,” whether that's failed attempts like the Humane Ai Pin, OpenAI's upcoming hardware created in collaboration with famed ex-Apple designer Jony Ive, or Meta's Muse Charm. The pocket-sized gadget houses Meta's popular Muse AI agent and is expected to launch in December. Increasingly, though, companies have leaned on “cuteness” in their strategy for widespread adoption.OATs have an E Ink display connected to internal and external sensors that can track things like moisture, temperature, humidity, light, occupancy, and motion. (The hardware is relatively cheap, around $20 for the main module.) The sprites are created with Google Gemini's Nano Banana image-generation service, creating a suite of emotions for various states based on the sensor data. You can set all of this up through a web portal, where you can name your OAT and choose which sensors to use for the object you're attaching it to.The web app will generate “Positive” and “Negative” behaviors based on your object's name and description. So if the OAT is attached to a plant, positive triggers could be “consistent air temperature readings” and “low humidity levels” if the plant of choice prefers dry environments. However, you can customize these behaviors to suit your specific plant type.It can be used for very simple things. Want to use your skateboard more often? Attach the OAT to your board, and if it hasn't detected motion for a few days, the avatar will look sad and lonely. You don't want that, do you? As Kim says, “These kinds of inanimate objects can be more expressive.” When you hop on the board, the OAT avatar will be happy, with fun faces.The catch is that the system's battery life is really short, showing why this is more of a proof of concept than anything else. OATs last around three to four days, but paired with the sound-level sensor, they'll only last a day. It has a USB-C port for charging the lithium-ion polymer battery.Kim says she distributed OATs to many people and found that they used them in three different ways. One is, “Am I being used?” Like when you attach an OAT to a coffee machine and have the avatar get excited when the machine starts grinding beans. The second is for warning people near an object. For example, 3D printers release toxic fumes during use, and attaching an OAT to one can warn people that the device is operational. And the third is to track their own behaviors. Someone attached an OAT to a dumbbell to track how often they lifted weights, encouraging themselves to exercise regularly so they wouldn't disappoint the AI pet.The demo at the symposium was popular, and Kim turned it into a competition to see who could come up with the most interesting ideas about what objects to pair with the OATs. Kim's website features a gallery with sprites people made, from an animated conference badge to a panda avatar for an Owala water bottle.Courtesy of Daehwa KimBut the demo also ignited a huge discussion about anthropomorphizing artificial intelligence, and whether it’s proper to give these sprites humanlike traits and emotions to make people feel connected with them.It's already a topic in play within the AI industry. Companies often refer to their chatbot behaviors in human terms, like when they “hallucinate.” Anthropic announced a “dreaming” feature this summer where its AI agent cleaned up its local memory as a background process. These anthropomorphized terms can distort moral judgments about AI and cause people to overly trust the tools.Kim says that's why OATs have very limited interactions, restricted to expressive emotions and the E Ink display.“Anthropomorphism can be very useful in certain ways, like helping people to change their behaviors,” Kim says. “People name their car, and they name their bike. I rarely see people who name their iPhone. I feel like in the future of computing we will have more of a relationship with AI, but we should definitely be careful not to abuse this."

В основе лежит 4,0-литровый битурбированный V8 мощностью 789 л.с., а помогают ему три электромотора: два стоят на передней оси, еще один – на задней.Цифры разгона Audi называет такие: 100 км/ч машина набирает за 2,6 секунды, максимальная скорость превышает 350 км/ч. u3gou8.title: «Верните Дженсена!»: за возвращение Хуанга в Nvidia выступили более 100 тысяч человек
u3gou8.content:
Опрос

реклама

Новости Hardware

Самое интересное в обзорах

15.11.2026 [13:40], 

Уход Дженсена Хуанга (Jensen Huang) с поста гендиректора Nvidia на фоне расследования шпионского скандала и его признания во внебрачных связях восприняли в ИТ-сфере неоднозначно. Немало людей выступили против этого. Петиция за его возвращение набрала более 100 тыс. подписей. Также два крупных инвестора призвали рассмотреть все возможные варианты будущего руководства, включая «потенциальное возвращение Дженсена Хуанга».
Источник изображения: Brecht Corbeel/unsplash.com

Как сообщает Business Insider, по состоянию на вторую половину дня субботы петиция под названием «Поддержим Дженсена» (Stand with Jensen), распространяемая в интернете, набрала более 108 тыс. подписей. Среди подписавшихся — влиятельные фигуры в технологической индустрии, в том числе миллиардер Илон Маск (Elon Musk) и генеральный директор компании Replit Амджад Масад (Amjad Masad), которые поддержали петицию в социальной сети X. Маск, в частности, отметил, что без Хуанга компания может лишиться ряда «критически важных сделок».
Сообщается, что среди подписантов — более 58 тыс. акционеров, свыше 5,6 тыс. нынешних сотрудников Nvidia и более тысячи бывших работников компании.

Также с призывом к совету директоров рассмотреть все возможные варианты будущего руководства компании, включая «потенциальное возвращение Дженсена Хуанга», выступили два крупных акционера — Брэд Герстнер (Brad Gerstner), гендиректор Altimeter Capital, и Гэвин Бейкер (Gavin Baker), управляющий партнёр Atreides Management. По состоянию на 30 июня совокупная стоимость пакетов акций Nvidia, принадлежавших этим инвестиционным компаниям, составляла около $2,13 млрд.
В своём письме, опубликованном в социальной сети X и подписанном Бейкером, Брэд Герстнер настоятельно рекомендовал совету директоров Nvidia «подойти к вопросу выбора будущего руководства компании взвешенно, не спеша и обдуманно». Он отметил, что «основатель и многолетний выдающийся руководитель этой исключительной компании заслужил право на то, чтобы процесс поиска преемника был продуманным и не сопровождался излишней поспешностью — особенно до того, как станут известны все факты». При этом в письме не содержится призыва к немедленному восстановлению Хуанга в должности.
По словам организаторов кампании «Поддержим Дженсена», совет директоров отстранил Хуанга от должности без проведения расследования и соблюдения надлежащих правовых процедур: «Нам не представили доказательств, подтверждающих обвинения в шпионаже. Отдав тридцать три года жизни компании Nvidia, вложив в неё всю свою душу, Дженсен заслуживает справедливого разбирательства, а не самосуда». Организаторы также настаивают на том, чтобы Хуанг оставался на посту генерального директора на время проведения расследования.

Как сообщается, министру торговли США Говарду Латнику (Howard Lutnick) предстоит 10 декабря выступить с показаниями перед Банковским комитетом Сената США. Он должен будет ответить на вопрос, «надлежащим ли образом Министерство торговли выполняет свою более широкую задачу — предотвращение получения Китаем передовых чипов для ИИ». Приглашение дать показания также получил Дженсен Хуанг.

ekod9t.title: После российских ударов Черноморск в Одесской области остался без света
ekod9t.content:
Российские военные в ночь на воскресенье, 15 ноября, выпустили по Украине 132 ударных дрона, 106 БПЛА сбили силы ПВО, но в 20 локациях дроны достигли цели, сообщили Воздушные силы ВС Украины.

В Одесской области в результате российского удара по Черноморску пострадали шесть человек. Также были повреждены объекты энергетической инфраструктуры, административное здание, фасады домов и два автомобиля, сообщили в МВД Украины.

По информации украинских СМИ, в результате атаки Черноморск остался без электроснабжения. В ДТЭК подтвердили, что из-за удара по энергетическому объекту 41 тысяча домохозяйств в Одесской области осталась без света.

В Житомирской области под российскими ударами также оказались объекты энергетической инфраструктуры, сообщил глава областной военной администрации Виталий Бунечко. "В результате ударов дронов повреждения получили четыре частных дома. Пока информации о погибших и пострадавших в результате вражеских ударов не поступало", - написал он.

Российские обстрелы Украины в течение суток

Накануне вечером российские удары повредили несколько многоэтажек и десятки автомобилей в Запорожье. В одном из домов начался пожар и пострадали шесть человек, в том числе ребенок, написал и.о. главы Запорожской военной администрации Михаил Семикин. По его данным, Россия выпустила по городу 12 управляемых авиабомб.

В Черниговской области в результате российских ударов по объекту критической инфраструктуры накануне погибли двое мужчин 42 и 45 лет, сообщил начальник Черниговской областной военной администрации Вячеслав Чаус в воскресенье утром. По его словам, в течение суток атаки на энергетику продолжились.

В результате субботних обстрелов Харьковской и Донецкой областей пострадали 18 человек, в том числе четверо детей, сообщили местные власти.

jle9y.title: Anthropic Outlines its AI-Powered Code Review Process for Claude Code
jle9y.content:
Anthropic has outlined how the Claude Code team handles code reviews as AI agents increasingly contribute to its codebase. The approach relies on multiple layers of automated verification, AI-powered reviews, and risk-based human approval, aiming to reduce manual review time without increasing regressions or production incidents.

Addy Osmani, Morgan Westlee Lunt and Qing Wang described how the team's review process has evolved alongside the growing volume of AI-generated code. Between June and September, merged pull requests to the Claude Code repository more than doubled, while the proportion of changes requiring a revert fell by over 40%.

Rather than relying on traditional line-by-line reviews, the team has moved much of the verification earlier in the development process. Before opening a pull request, Claude runs tests, builds, and linters, while a separate agent reviews the changes in a fresh context.

Every pull request then goes through several automated checks. Claude-powered reviewers inspect code changes for potential bugs, with multiple agents independently investigating findings before another group verifies them. A separate security review can also block a merge if unresolved issues remain.

This approach also raises questions about the evolving boundaries between software engineering, testing, and quality assurance. As one commenter put it:

So code review is officially synonymous with testing now? Should the code review mechanism be owned by QA team? Is there still a QA team?

Human involvement depends on the risk associated with a change. Low-risk modifications, such as documentation updates or internal features behind feature flags, may require no human approval. Medium-risk changes require one person, while high-risk modifications need two approvals. Changes to particularly sensitive areas, including CI workflows, always require human oversight.

The team also introduced mechanisms to prevent automated reviews from generating excessive feedback. Review cycles are capped at three rounds before the author is asked to reconsider the implementation. Subsequent reviews focus on new changes rather than repeatedly examining the entire pull request.

These adjustments have improved review efficiency. According to Anthropic, the share of internal pull requests passing after one review and fix round increased from 65% to 78%. Meanwhile, the proportion requiring five or more rounds dropped from 8.9% to 1.5%.

Source: Cloude.dev

Human reviewers nevertheless remain responsible for architectural decisions, product direction, high-risk changes, and the final outcome. The team also emphasizes that the person directing an AI agent remains accountable for the code it produces.

Anthropic's approach extends beyond code review itself. Merged changes are typically released behind feature flags, tested internally, and gradually rolled out to users. Incidents and reverted changes are also incorporated into a growing evaluation dataset used to measure and improve the automated reviewers.

The central idea is to optimize code review around the risks a change introduces rather than the amount of code a human has personally read. As AI-generated code becomes more common, Anthropic's experience illustrates how engineering teams may need to rethink the balance between automated verification and human oversight.

Источник изображения: Nvidia

В некоторых мемах Хуанг танцует под популярные треки из TikTok, а также становится участником разных сцен из знаменитых фильмов, например, из киноленты «Реальная любовь», где он появился вместе с Элис Хуан (Alice Huang). Именно роман с этой женщиной, которую подозревают в шпионаже в пользу Китая, привёл к увольнению Хуанга из компании, которую он возглавлял более 30 лет.
«Многим кажется ироничным, что Хуанг стал мишенью для инструментов, которые работают на базе технологий, созданных им самим», — прокомментировал данный вопрос эксперт в области ИИ и дипфейков Генри Адждер (Henry Ajder). Хотя точное количество мемов с участием Хуанга подсчитать невозможно, Адждер подчеркнул, что его буквально поразил масштаб контента, который стремительно распространяется по соцсетям последние несколько дней.

Превращение скандальных ситуаций в интернет-мемы не является чем-то новым. Однако количество, разнообразие и пугающая реалистичность публикаций, связанных с Хуангом мемов, выделяются на общем фоне. Один из авторов таких роликов даже создал отдельный аккаунт в Instagram✴, посвящённый мемам с участием Хуанга. Он задействовал ИИ-модель Anthropic Claude Opus 5.5 для генерации идей для будущих роликов, а также платформу Higgsfield для создания самих видео. Всего за несколько дней один из опубликованных в новом аккаунте роликов набрал более 1,4 млн просмотров, что является впечатляющим результатом для недавно созданного аккаунта.

kuyytw.title: Kremlin Says It’s Ready for Civilian Evacuation From Ukraine’s Kostiantynivka
kuyytw.content:
Nov. 13, 2026

Nazar Vodzinsky (CC BY-SA 4.0)

The Kremlin said on Friday that it is ready to carry out a humanitarian operation to evacuate civilians fro the eastern Ukrainian city of Kostiantynivka, following a similar model that was used last month in the town of Oleshky, if it receives appropriate security guarantees.
President Vladimir Putin proposed the joint Russian-Ukrainian mission to U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner on Thursday, saying it would allow the world to understand who controlled Kostiantynivka. Putin’s aide Yury Ushakov claimed the U.S. envoys “actively supported” his idea.
“We call on both the Americans and the Europeans — if claims that they are striving for peace are true — to use their influence specifically on the Ukrainians to push them toward implementing this humanitarian operation in Kostiantynivka,” Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov told reporters during a daily briefing.

Kyiv has expressed concerns that Moscow might wish to use ceasefires for such missions to enable its military to regroup.
“Given that in Oleshky they brought in equipment and rotated troops under the cover of a humanitarian operation, it’s clear they want to do the same in Kostiantynivka,” Ukrainian presidential communications adviser Dmytro Lytvyn said Thursday.
Ukrainian human rights ombudsman Dmytro Lubinets, who oversaw the Oleshky mission with Russian counterpart Yana Lantratova, said Friday that Kostiantynivka “was not even mentioned” among the potential settlements where similar missions could be organized.
Kremlin spokesman Peskov said concerns of a possible military rotation into the city were “beyond any criticism” because any movements would be “clearly visible from satellites and drones.”
“If they believe we’ll it for troop rotation, then they’re agreeing that it is we who control Kostiantynivka,” he said.
Putin told Kushner and Witkoff the mission could settle disputes over contested “gray zones” along the frontline.
“If, as the Ukrainian authorities claim, they control this town, let them ensure security there. I believe this town is controlled by Russian troops,” Putin said.
“We will ensure security on our side. We need five days to de-mine the access roads to the town. If Ukraine controls it, let them do the same,” he said.
Reuters contributed reporting.

gh-1443519371.content:
Pokémon Pokopia (Switch 2) recompiled to run natively on Windows, with multiplayer support.
