m85smb.title: Elusive optical effect paves the way for advanced lidar and nanophotonic technologies
m85smb.content:
Credit: Vasily Fedotov, Skoltech

An international research team, led by scientists from Skoltech, has experimentally demonstrated for the first time the photonic spin Hall shift for light scattered off an optically small particle. This work, published in the Advanced Photonics journal, overcomes a long-standing challenge in optics and could contribute to the development of next-generation optical technologies, advanced radar and lidar systems.

Light can behave in surprising ways. One example is the photonic spin Hall effect: depending on its polarization, light can undergo a tiny sideways shift when interacting with matter. While this effect has been studied in various optical settings, observing it directly for light scattered off an optically small isolated single particle has so far remained a major experimental challenge. What makes the scattering form of the effect particularly intriguing is that it results in a shift of the perceived location of the particle itself.
An international team of scientists has now overcome the challenge. Their study shows how to enhance and observe the effect in scattering—an important step toward understanding and controlling the interaction of light with matter at the nanoscale.
Making a tiny shift observable
"The most important achievement of our work is that we have finally been able to directly observe the photonic spin Hall shift for a single optically small particle. This is notoriously difficult because not only is the shift itself tiny but also the portion of scattered light that gives away the shift is typically very small and goes in an awkward direction. We found a way to combine superscattering with strong spin–orbit interaction of light to overcome this seemingly indisputable limitation.
"Beyond its fundamental significance, this breakthrough provides new opportunities for exploring how light can be controlled and used in future nanophotonic technologies," said professor Vasily Fedotov from the Skoltech Photonics Center, head of the SPARQ laboratory and a co-author of this work.
The new approach proposed by the research team increased the scattering efficiency for the maximal shift and experimentally convenient observation angle by nearly two orders of magnitude, making it possible to observe the effect without relying on indirect measurement techniques and pre- and post-selection routines normally employed in such cases. The team has successfully validated its approach using a ceramic particle of a specially designed shape illuminated with microwave radiation and proved that it can be readily extended into the optical part of the spectrum.

From microwaves to optical technologies
"In fact, the idea of enhancing the so far elusive scattering form of the photonic spin Hall effect was first conceived and theoretically confirmed by our team for a silicon nanoparticle interacting with visible light. Yet, given that experimental demonstrations of many recent nanophotonic concepts have been initially performed in the microwave domain, we decided to employ the same tactic for its convenience.
"It is also accepted and widely adopted by the scientific community because all electromagnetic phenomena across different spectral domains are governed by exactly the same Maxwell's equations," explained principal research scientist Alexander Shalin from the Skoltech Photonics Center and the author of the idea.
The ability to observe and control spin-dependent shifts in scattered light could contribute to the development of technologies in which light must be manipulated with high precision. Potential directions include advanced radar and lidar systems, spin-controlled light routing, high-performance nanoantennas, integrated photonic circuits and precision optical measurements.

Publication details
Lei Gao, Direct observation of photonic spin Hall shift in Mie scattering, Advanced Photonics (2026). DOI: 10.1117/1.ap.9.1.016003

jhl22n.title: Justin Long & Kate Bosworth To Headline Indie Comedy Series ‘The Renovation’
jhl22n.content:
EXCLUSIVE: The resurgence of independent television series continues to grow with Justin Long (Barbarian, You Deserve Each Other) and Kate Bosworth (Still Alice, Along for the Ride) starring in The Renovation, a fully-financed indie comedy series. It hails from Lucas Carter (Summer of ’69), Nick Kreiss (Punk’d) who directs all episodes, Intrigue, Script2Screen and Hammerstone Studios.

Production has wrapped in Los Angeles, and EPs Intrigue, Script2Screen and Hammerstone will begin shopping the series to streaming platforms and television networks this month for distribution.

Blending scripted comedy with hidden-camera elements, The Renovation centers on a real, unsuspecting married couple, played by real-life married duo Long and Bosworth, who believe they are participating in a home renovation television show. What they are unaware of is the contractors, fellow contestants, and everyone around them are actors, following a carefully constructed storyline designed to test the couple’s instincts, decision-making and sense of right and wrong.

Conceived by writer and producer Carter, The Renovation takes a fresh approach to the hidden-camera format, combining the storytelling and structure of a scripted comedy with the unpredictable reactions of real people.

The concept for The Renovation was originally developed by Carter, who brought the idea to Tariq Jalil’s Intrigue, Carter’s former employer, where the pair further developed the project. Recognizing the unique nature of the format and the creative freedom required to bring it to life, the team decided to independently finance the series. From there, Script2Screen (By Any Means, Mister) and Hammerstone Studios (Bill & Ted Face the Music, By Any Means) came on board to fully finance the production.

The series is executive produced by Jalil, Carter, Kreiss, Alex Lebovici, Ibrahim Mohammed, Yasmyne Mohammed, Chase Vergari, Michael Mazzarra, along with Long and Bosworth. Dan Swimer, Oscar-nominated screenwriter for Borat Subsequent Moviefilm, also serves as an executive producer.

Long and Bosworth are repped by Independent Artist Group and Yorn Levine. Kreiss is repped by Underground and Morris Yorn.

1wdfvgr.title: Совет директоров Nvidia даже не обсуждает возвращение Хуанга, хотя его вовсю поддерживает Трамп
1wdfvgr.content:
Опрос

3DNews Технологии и рынок IT. Новости видеокарты Совет директоров Nvidia даже не обсуждае...

реклама

Новости Hardware

Самое интересное в обзорах

16.11.2026 [22:29], 

Совет директоров Nvidia не рассматривает возможность возвращения Дженсена Хуанга (Jensen Huang) на пост генерального директора, несмотря на поддержку со стороны представителей технологической отрасли и президента США Дональда Трампа (Donald Trump). Об этом CNBC сообщил источник, знакомый с ситуацией.
Источник изображения: Nvidia

По информации CNBC, руководство компании сейчас сосредоточено на расследовании обстоятельств, которые привели к отставке ее основателя. Nvidia привлекла юридическую фирму Wachtell Lipton для проверки действий Хуанга и выяснения того, могли ли они поставить под угрозу национальную безопасность США или коммерческие секреты производителя чипов. Обсуждений его восстановления в должности совет директоров не ведет.
Хуанг покинул пост генерального директора 12 ноября после 33 лет руководства основанной им компанией. Отставка последовала за публикациями о его личных отношениях с Элис Хуан (Alice Huang), бывшей сотрудницей одного из заказчиков Nvidia, которую подозревают в связях с китайской разведкой. Сам факт передачи секретной информации или нарушения экспортных ограничений со стороны Хуанга пока не доказан.

Несмотря на скандал, бывший руководитель сохранил поддержку части сотрудников, инвесторов и известных представителей Кремниевой долины. На выходных стало известно, что Хуанг обсуждал возможность возвращения с доверенными лицами, а его сторонники пытались убедить совет директоров пересмотреть кадровое решение. Петиция с требованием восстановить основателя Nvidia собрала более 180 тыс. подписей.
В поддержку возможного возвращения Хуанга высказался и Дональд Трамп. Американский президент заявил журналистам, что не возражал бы против восстановления предпринимателя в должности. При этом основатель инвестиционной компании Altimeter Capital Брэд Герстнер (Brad Gerstner), выступавший за внимательное рассмотрение кандидатур на пост главы Nvidia, сообщил CNBC, что Хуанг не обсуждал с ним свое возвращение.
Тем временем Nvidia продолжает поиски постоянного руководителя. Обязанности генерального директора исполняет финансовый директор Колетт Кресс (Colette Kress), назначенная после отставки Хуанга. Еще 13 ноября представители совета директоров заявили, что компания выбирает кадровое агентство для поиска нового главы и пока официально не обращалась к потенциальным кандидатам.

Смена руководства происходит накануне публикации квартальной отчетности Nvidia, запланированной на 17 ноября. Совет директоров ранее заверил, что компания намерена выполнять обязательства перед заказчиками и придерживаться установленного графика выпуска новых продуктов.

gh-1460210206.title: GitHub - Balderding/uwr: Ultima Underworld: The Stygian Abyss (1992) on Windows and Linux: the original's exact rules with a ray-traced Vulkan renderer, 3D sound and a modern interface. Bring your own copy of the game.
gh-1460210206.content:
uwr: Ultima Underworld Rekonfigmasturfication
Ultima Underworld: The Stygian Abyss (1992) running on Windows and Linux with a renderer, sound and interface of our
own, in plain C (clang). The game's rules are meant to be EXACTLY those of the original UW.EXE; only the presentation
(graphics, sound, interface, controls) and a few optional extras may differ, and each of those has a switch in the
Esc menu. The program is uwr (uwr.exe on Windows), short for Ultima Underworld Rekonfigmasturfication.
This repository holds only what we made ourselves: no original game files, no executables, no ROMs and no
third-party sources. You need your own copy of the game to run anything. It is a snapshot of our working tree,
taken by tools/uwr_export.py.
Built on others' work
This port would not exist without two projects, both under the MIT licence:

Underworld Exhumed by abedegno (https://github.com/abedegno/underworld-exhumed): a byte-matching rebuild of
UW.EXE in C. We borrowed from it heavily. Its code is the rules core the game runs on (compiled here unchanged,
with our own glue files beside it), and some of our own rule code is adapted from it, each routine naming its
source file and line. Its files are not in this repository.
Ultima Underworld Editor by Karl Clinckspoor (https://github.com/KarlClinckspoor/UltimaUnderworldEditorAvalonia):
a level editor. We built a test tool on its core library, uwcheck, which starts our game hidden, visits every
level, saves, and runs the editor's own checks on the saved levels. It is for testing only: nothing of the editor
is in the game, and the tool lives in a repository of its own.

The full list of what we use, with the licences, is in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md.
The published work and measurements behind our changes (fire, firelight's colour, water, acoustics, creature AI)
are listed in SOURCES.md.
What it looks like
The same places in the same game: the original 1992 display on the left of each pair, ours on the right with
ray tracing, upscaled textures, relief maps and the effects on. Click a picture for its full size (7824 x 5156).

Trying it

There is no download yet. This repository is the source only; a ready-to-run package for Windows and Linux
is planned.
You need your own copy of Ultima Underworld: The Stygian Abyss. The game reads its data files from it. The
Roland MT-32 sound also needs your own ROM files.
Building it yourself needs LLVM clang, the Underworld Exhumed source and its Exhume tools. The build scripts
still carry the folder paths of our own machine and have to be edited first. port/README.md
describes the Windows build, docs/LINUX_BUILD.md the Linux one.
The keys are listed in docs/KEYBINDS.md.

What is in it

Renderer. Vulkan, the default on both systems since 2026-11-16; the older Direct3D 12 renderer is still there
on Windows (the Esc menu's Renderer row). Hardware ray tracing (light, shadows, bounced light), DLSS / DLAA and
DLSS Ray Reconstruction, HDR output. DLSS 5 exists in the Direct3D 12 renderer only and is not being carried on.
Walls and floors. The game's own textures, or upscaled to 256 / 512 pixels in the same colours; normal maps,
joint shadows (AO) and relief shadows, with maps made at each texture size.
Effects. Particles, decals, water, fog and light shafts, firelight with the eye's adaptation.
Sound. The Roland MT-32's own voices, placed in space (OpenAL Soft, headphone 3D); walls and doors muffle,
rooms ring by their size, sound comes round corners; ray-traced echoes through the level's shape (Steam Audio);
footsteps by the floor.
Interface. A full-screen 3D view with our own HUD, character sheet, inventory, automap and conversation
screen, one smooth font, mouse-look and modern keys. The 1992 screen as it was is one menu row away.
Creatures. Optional AI levels above the original's (Original, Devious, Monstrous), by rules or by a small
language model run on the player's machine. Original is the game as shipped.
The original's 3D models (doors, portcullises, bridges, weapons on the floor) decoded from UW.EXE and drawn.

Where it is going

One Vulkan renderer for Windows and Linux; new renderer work goes there, Direct3D 12 stays as it is.
Linux: the target is Linux Mint. The Linux programs are cross-built on Windows
(docs/LINUX_BUILD.md) and have so far only been start-checked under WSL.
The rules core keeps being checked routine by routine against the original (ROUTINES.md).
Open at the last cut (2026-11-16): the newest sound rows and the Vulkan renderer's Linux side have been built and
started, not yet played through.

Where to start

You want to
Read

know the rules every session follows
CLAUDE.md, DECOMP_RULESET.md

see status and next steps
NOTES.md, ROADMAP.md

see which original routines are ported and proved
ROUTINES.md, re/README.md

read the decoded game mechanics
MECHANICS.md

understand the engine source
src/README-src-a.md, src/README-src-b.md

understand the Windows backend
port/README.md

build for Linux, and how the renderer got there
docs/LINUX_BUILD.md, docs/LINUX_RENDERER.md

understand our additions to the rules core
underworld-exhumed-additions.md

run or write tests
tests/README.md

use the proof, patch and build scripts
tools/README-tools-a.md, tools/README-tools-b.md

make normal maps
tools/laigter-cli/README.md

learn about the AI-driven creatures / models
LLM_NPC_AI.md, docs/MODELS.md

see design plans and specs
docs/superpowers/

see third-party credits
THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md

How the pieces fit

Rules core: underworld-exhumed's C (a byte-matching rebuild of UW.EXE, MIT) plus our own glue files. Our
additions to it are listed in underworld-exhumed-additions.md; its own files are
not in this repository.
Our engine (src/): front end, the two renderers (render_vk*.c Vulkan, render.c Direct3D 12, one set of
HLSL shaders in shaders/ for both), audio, inventory, level and world handling.
Backends (port/): win32/ is the Windows platform layer and holds the files both systems share (front
end, menu, audio, acoustics, input); sdl3/ is the Linux platform layer over SDL3.
Proof (tools/proof_*.py, tools/emu.py): each ported routine is run beside the original under an emulator
on the same inputs; matching routines are listed in re/proved.txt.
Data (data/): our own normal, height and occlusion maps only.

Notes and warnings

The tools/*_patch.py scripts were each run once, in 2026-11, to edit the source. They are history; do not re-run
them (their safety asserts do not always refuse a second run).
Root build.cmd, run-tests.cmd and play.cmd serve our own C engine (build/uw.exe); the exhumed-based port
is built by tools/portwin32.py.
src/render.c, src/render_vk*.c, src/render.h and src/shaders/ are not described in a guide yet; the Vulkan
renderer's plan and ledger are in docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-15-vulkan-renderer.md.

Known mismatches and open questions
The eight listed here until 2026-11-16 were checked against the source and the original's disassembly, and put right:

Fixed in the code: the inventory panel's "Carrying" weight now counts the item on the pointer, as the carry limit
does; main.c's two options that were tested twice have names of their own (--conv=N, --frame-picks=), so
the later branches can be reached. run-tests.cmd's chargen line still passes --picks= and behaves as before.
Fixed in the comments (the code was right): only data/lights.txt is read (lights.h, main.c); Mesh.grid
byte 2 is the floor's terrain (level.h); creatures are hostile by their attitude bits (game.c); core.py
takes no argument; tools/relief_section.c.txt is marked as history (relief v4; src/normals.c has v7).
Not mismatches after all: the two songs' addresses in songs.h and songs.c are both in UW.EXE (a block's start
and the lines inside it; the header now names both), and sfx_stop's test of slots 0-7 matches the original's
8-bit mask (four slots are ever set).
Still as it was: tools/laigter-cli/pixelart.preset is not used by make-normals.cmd; it is kept as the
settings sprite_op.preset was made from.

The per-area guides list more ("UNSURE" at the end of src/README-src-a.md and src/README-src-b.md); those have
not been checked yet.

ra6sdv.title: Grammy Nominations Snubs and Surprises: Harry Styles, Madonna, Noah Kahan Miss Top Nods as Raye, Rosalía Overperform
ra6sdv.content:
It was less than four years ago that Harry Styles won the Grammy for album of the year, but he won’t get a chance to defend his title or win another Grammy this go around for his latest album Kiss All the Time. Disco, Occasionally, as he was completely shut out of the 2027 Grammy nominations.

Kiss All the Time. Disco, Occasionally was a bit more sonically complex than Styles’ past album of the year winner Harry’s House, and heading into this year, Styles was widely looked at as a Grammy contender for his latest release, which debuted at No. 1 on the Billboard 200 album chart while lead single “Aperture” hit No. 1 on the Billboard Hot 100. Neither the album nor the single had the same staying power as Harry’s House or its lead single “As It Was,” though he gave the album more buzz with a 30-show Madison Square Garden residency as part of his Together, Together tour. Evidently, it wasn’t enough to sway the Grammy voters.

Other surprise shutouts this morning include Gracie Abrams, who wasn’t nominated for her third album Daughter From Hell, which hit No. 1 on the Billboard 200, and Hilary Duff, whose comeback record Luck … Or Something, for new label Atlantic Records, was released in February and debuted at No. 3 on the Billboard 200. While Abrams scored a best new artist nomination in 2024, it’s not her first time getting the Grammys‘ cold shoulder, also failing to land expected song and record of the year nods last year for “That’s So True.”

Others were lucky enough to score nominations but maybe not as many as pundits (or fans) had expected. Noah Kahan landed just one nomination, for best contemporary folk album, for his The Great Divide, despite a number of experts predicting the former best new artist nominee would score top nods for his latest effort.

“Life goes on,” Kahan tweeted on Monday.

And while Madonna‘s Confessions II was an eagerly awaited follow-up to 2005’s Confessions from the pop superstar and landed her four nominations, the release failed to net the seven-time Grammy winner any nominations in the major categories, including album, record and song of the year.

For anyone else, five Grammy nominations is an incredibly impressive feat, but even though that’s how many nods superstar singer-songwriter Taylor Swift received Monday — with noms in all three of the general categories — it’s perhaps an understated showing compared to what we’ve come to expect for the world’s biggest artist.

Speaking of superstar musicians, Paul McCartney was left out of the major categories for his latest release The Boys of Dungeon Lane, which only landed one nomination, for best traditional pop vocal album. But the former Beatle did land three nominations, two of which were for Morgan Neville’s Man on the Run documentary about McCartney’s departure from the iconic group.

Kanye “Ye” West continued his comeback with an unexpected Grammy nomination for best rap album for his latest release Bully, as the controversial rapper aims to move on from years of antisemitic comments.

Meanwhile, both Raye and Rosalía were looked at as contenders for some of the top prizes heading into announcement day, but few would’ve expected they’d be the most-nominated acts across the whole field. Raye’s 11 noms and Rosalía’s nine were some of the best surprises for two of the year’s most ambitious projects.

Other surprises include a handful of artists who landed nods despite not releasing an album during the most recent Grammys eligibility period. Beyoncé released one song, “Morning Dew (Donk),” on July 4, as part of the 20th anniversary edition of her 2006 album B’Day and netted her 100th Grammy nomination. Similarly, Sabrina Carpenter scored two nods, albeit both in the same category of best pop duo/group performance, for her collaborations with Swift and Madonna.

cmhwm9.title: Louis Carr Exits as BET President
cmhwm9.content:
Louis Carr has exited BET less than one year after he was named president. Carr was with the brand for 40 years.

“I’m deeply grateful to Louis. For four decades, he has been one of BET’s greatest champions, helping shape the brand, its business and its connection to Black audiences and culture,” George Cheeks, co-chair and chief content officer for Skydance TV, wrote in a memo shared with staffers (and obtained by The Hollywood Reporter on Monday.) “Louis built lasting partnerships with some of the world’s leading brands and helped cement BET as a cultural force. As President, he led BET with clarity and purpose, creating renewed momentum for the brand. His passion, vision and heart have been front and center in everything he does, and it has been a privilege to partner with him.”

Cheeks says Skydance “believe(s) deeply” in BET and “are committed” to its future.

Carr’s tenure will officially end when 2026 officially ends. It was Carr’s decision to exit, Cheeks says. Skydance acquired BET with its Paramount merger, which closed last summer. Carr was named BET president in December 2025.

“We will have more to share soon on BET leadership and structure,” Cheeks wrote on Monday.

Carr’s farewell email, like his tenure, was lengthy. Read his message in full below.

Dear Team,For 40 years, I have had one of the best jobs in the media and entertainment industry. Having a position that gives one the opportunity to carry out a purpose that is bigger than oneself is a privilege. Working for a brand whose mission from day one was to uplift and empower the Black community is an honor I’ll never forget.

That said, even as I write this email, I wrestle with my decision that the time has come to make a transition. Based on recent events within our community and our country, I’ve decided to chart a new path and my last day will be December 31.

BET has never been just a job to me. It has been a community, a culture and a place to serve. When I reflect on this journey, I am incredibly proud of what we have accomplished together. Over the years, we helped transform the multicultural advertising landscape, built meaningful relationships with some of the world’s most recognized brands and served as the launching pad for today’s top Black creators. We demonstrated the undeniable value, influence, and purchasing power of Black consumers while helping companies better understand and invest in our communities.

I am particularly proud of the momentum we have created and the work we have undertaken to strengthen the brand, expand our business and reaffirm BET’s place at the center of Black culture. Stepping into the role of President gave me the opportunity to see just how much the BET brand is loved by our talent, our consumers and the next generation.

We established our brand positioning as “Something You Can Believe In,” reinforcing the trust, purpose, and cultural connection that have always defined BET. We established a trusted Board of Advisors, one that would be envied by any Fortune 500 company, to help inform our direction and ensure that the voices and perspectives of our community remain part of the conversation.

And that was just the beginning. In 2026 alone, we:

Delivered the network’s highest television and digital ratings since 2019, with the 2026 BET Awards hosted by Druski.

Brought back the Soul Train Awards after a three-year hiatus.

Expanded our relationships with an impressive roster of Black creators such as Kev on Stage, Nick Cannon, Jason Lee, Manny Halley, Desmond Scott, Chris “CP” Powell, Ice Cube’s BIG 3, Kevin Frazier and Stephen A. Smith with HBCU Basketball and more.

Expanded the global reach of Black content through multiplatform partnerships with creators such as Tyler Perry and Ms. Pat.

Entered new content sectors and explored new ways to connect with audiences across platforms with the launch of our microdramas.

Relaunched the iconic ComicView franchise.

Launched a new social impact campaign “Get Your Mind Right,” focused on mental health to further support the communities we serve.

Created a new financial model for programming spend that makes our content more aligned and efficient to our potential ratings.

And so much more.

The work of this incredible BET team has afforded me the opportunity to earn an abundance of professional accolades and recognition, including five Lifetime Achievement Awards, induction into the American Advertising Federation’s Advertising Hall of Fame, and more than 14 community awards. I have also been privileged to sit on board seats across the industry, including with the International Radio and Television Society (IRTS), the Advertising Council, and the American Advertising Federation (AAF). Additionally, I am proud to be the longest-serving board member of the Video Advertising Bureau (VAB).

Thank you for your partnership, your commitment, and, most importantly, for allowing me to be part of your journey. It has been one of the greatest honors of my life.

I am proud of what we have built and proud of what we have accomplished.

With gratitude,Louis

ot5tdr.title: Trump says ex-Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with an alleged Chinese spy did not threaten national security
ot5tdr.content:
U.S. President Donald Trump told reporters on Monday that he does not believe the country’s national security was put at risk as a result of former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with an alleged Chinese spy.

“It was not put at risk,” Trump said when asked by reporters in light of his own friendship with Huang. “Our country is now stronger than ever before. And you know, China plays games with us, and we play games with China.”

Trump went on to contradict previous findings from U.S. officials by doubting that Huang’s paramour, former Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, is a Chinese spy.

“He probably shouldn’t have been doing on a personal basis what he did… That’s a different story,” Trump added. “But nobody’s proven that she’s a spy. She may not be a spy.”

Last year, U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio reportedly oversaw the production of an internal memo, circulated among top policymakers, which warned that Alice Huang was a spy for China’s Ministry of State Security. Trump was reportedly briefed about these intelligence findings at least twice, including once in May aboard Air Force One, shortly before the former Nvidia CEO joined him on a trip to China. But Trump has maintained that he was not aware of these claims.

The U.S. regulates the exports of Nvidia’s top chips to China as a way of maintaining a competitive advantage. But prior to news of Huang’s affair publicly emerging, both the U.S. and Singaporean governments had been investigating Megaspeed for illegally smuggling Nvidia chips into China. Huang has since stepped down from the role he has had for 33 years at Nvidia after more reporting revealed that he also had affairs with two Nvidia employees, at least one of whom was a direct report.

Given Huang’s importance to Nvidia, some prominent figures in the industry — including Elon Musk, Y Combinator President & CEO Garry Tan, and Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney — have signed a public letter calling for Nvidia to reinstate Huang.

“A lot of people are asking Jensen — they think Jensen should go back. That certainly isn’t a bad idea,” Trump said. Referring to former Apple chief executive, Trump added: “I recommended Tim Cook.”

1wxf2up.title: Nvidia представила Rubin HPC — у него почти в 2,5 раза больше ядер CUDA, чем у GeForce RTX 5090
1wxf2up.content:
Опрос

реклама

Новости Hardware

Самое интересное в обзорах

16.11.2026 [22:26], 

Компания Nvidia анонсировала графический процессор Rubin HPC, предназначенный для высокопроизводительных научных и инженерных вычислений, а также анализа больших данных. Ускоритель получит свыше 50 000 ядер CUDA, что почти в 2,5 раза превышает показатель игровой видеокарты GeForce RTX 5090.
Источник изображений: Nvidia

Rubin HPC станет частью платформы Vera Rubin, но будет ориентирован не столько на обучение и запуск ИИ-моделей, сколько на сложные вычислительные задачи. Среди областей применения Nvidia называет климатическое и инженерное моделирование, геномный анализ и оценку финансовых рисков.
Одной из ключевых особенностей GPU станет технология ускорения обработки разреженных данных (sparse data acceleration). Технология должна обеспечить более эффективную передачу данных вычислительным ядрам, чтобы те меньше времени простаивали в ожидании информации. Это особенно важно для научных задач, связанных с обработкой больших массивов данных и многократным выполнением однотипных вычислений.

Для обмена данными между графическими процессорами предусмотрена поддержка седьмого поколения NVLink, представляющая из себя высокоскоростную технологию последовательной связи типа «точка-точка» (interconnect). Rubin HPC также будет работать с библиотеками Nvidia CUDA-X, содержащими оптимизированные алгоритмы для научных вычислений и аналитики. В частности, их смогут использовать ИИ-агенты для проведения симуляций и проверки различных гипотез.
Nvidia пока не раскрыла точное количество ядер CUDA, объём видеопамяти, её пропускную способность, энергопотребление и производительность в вычислениях FP32 и FP64. Неизвестны также стоимость ускорителя и конфигурации систем на его основе, имена партнёров по производству Rubin HPC также пока не раскрываются.

Ожидается, что графический процессор станет доступен в 2028 году.

19j2lq6.title: Study of juries' decision-making addresses disagreement among jurors
19j2lq6.byline: Rutgers University Newark School of Criminal Justice
19j2lq6.content:
Credit: Pixabay/CC0 Public Domain

A new study shows that understanding decisions made by juries requires attention not only to their final verdicts but also to how jurors make decisions individually and work together to reach a verdict, especially when they disagree. Led by Tova Cohen, a Ph.D. student at Rutgers School of Criminal Justice, the research studied 35 participants in seven virtual mock juries to examine individuals' characteristics, deliberative participation, changed verdicts and dissent.

"Jury deliberation is a significant component of the U.S. criminal legal system and is important for collective legal decision-making," said Cohen. "Because jurors may feel pressured to conform to others' views, examining how jurors respond to disagreement and dissent is crucial to understanding the deliberative process underlying collective verdicts."
Published in Behavioral Sciences, the study found that jurors who preferred to manage conflict collaboratively were more active in deliberations. But other personal characteristics, including agreeableness, openness and civic engagement, were unrelated to jurors' participation and did not predict more involvement in deliberations.
The findings suggest that understanding jury decisions requires considering more than the final verdict. Also important is determining how jurors participate in discussions, work through uncertainty with others and deal with opposing viewpoints. The study also found that after one deliberation, individual verdict preferences shifted, with participants who initially voted not guilty ultimately reporting a guilty verdict. The authors suggest that disagreement created opportunities for jurors to speak about competing interpretations of the evidence before reaching consensus.
"The interpersonal dynamics of jury deliberation may be particularly important to understanding how jurors participate and ultimately reach consensus," noted Colleen Berryessa, associate professor at Rutgers School of Criminal Justice, who co-authored the study. "Although our study was small and should be replicated, the results highlight the crucial distinction between the outcome of deliberation and the processes by which jurors arrive at it."

More information
Tova Cohen et al., The Role of the Dissenting Voter on Jury Deliberation Online: A Pilot Study, Behavioral Sciences (2026). DOI: 10.3390/bs16101960

x2k8no.title: Mogging is the word of the year—but men have been doing it since Shakespearean times
x2k8no.content:
Portrait of Two Young Men by Giovanni Cariani (1520). Credit: Louvre Museum

The Collins English Dictionary has selected "mogging" as its 2026 word of the year.

The Collins website says that the word originated with the acronym AMOG—or "alpha male of the group"—which is often associated with bodybuilding forums and, more recently, the toxic culture of incels and the manosphere. But mogging has now entered mainstream language with its meaning slightly repurposed: to describe someone who is outperforming, outshining or upstaging someone.
While the verb is often used in reference to physical looks, it can also be applied in other contexts. Alex Beecroft, managing director of Collins, explained that the selection of mogging demonstrates how "each generation leaves its mark on language," with the term seeing a 210% increase in usage in 2026.
The male drive to assert dominance stretches back centuries, but what's striking is how closely today's posturing mirrors early modern ideals of manhood.

The meaning of mogging explained.
The Oxford English Dictionary contains four historic meanings of the base verb "mog." The earliest meaning and usage date to 1674, referring to card games: "to exchange a card with the dealer." A later usage means "to move on, depart, decamp." By the mid-1800s, two new possible meanings emerged: "to walk slowly but steadily" and "to shift (a person, animal etc.) to cause to move on (esp. quickly)."

What unites these historic meanings is the connection to movement or performance. For many men in the early modern period, the demonstration of superiority through action and movement was a key method to showcase, or perhaps fittingly, "mog" others.
New research by theater historian Eleanor Rycroft explores this link between movement, gender and social power. Rycroft examines theatrical works by playwrights such as Shakespeare and Ben Jonson alongside historical conduct books and household management guides, revealing just how much cultural capital was attached to a man's posture and stride. The findings are published in the journal English Literary Renaissance.
How-to guides and etiquette books from the time told men and women how to behave, labeling certain traits as respectable and others as improper. In the 1566 English translation of Ortensio Landi's Delectable Demaundes and Pleasaunt Questions, readers were shown how to outdo other men in wit and conduct. Yet in doing so, the text also exposed the cracks in this ideal, revealing how precarious that masculine status truly was.
In his influential Book of the Courtier (1528), courtier and diplomat Baldassare Castiglione defined this quality as a "certain nonchalance, which shall conceal design and show that what is done and said is done without effort and almost without thought."

Sprezzatura in Shakespeare and asserting manhood
Castiglione was first translated into English by Sir Thomas Hoby in 1561, and the concept of sprezzatura heavily influenced early modern English culture.
In many early modern plays, characters demonstrate the importance of asserting a mastery of manhood and, with it, upstaging others. While Shakespeare does not use the terms sprezzatura or mogging in any of his works, many men attempt to outperform or outshine other characters to assert or affirm their manly status.

In Much Ado About Nothing (first performed in 1598), the "merry war" between protagonists Beatrice and Benedick—a rapid-fire exchange loaded with insults as the two characters shield their true feelings for one another—is often a source of audience amusement and laughter. However, this "skirmish of wit" points to the different expectations for men and women: Across the play, Benedick is expected to match and ideally best Beatrice's skill in wordplay so as not to emasculate himself.

The sparring between Benedick and Beatrice in the 1993 adaptation of Much Ado About Nothing.
Beatrice seems to be aware of these dynamics of masculinity, noting that Benedick "gets nothing" from their verbal exchanges—after their last encounter, "four of his five wits went halting off, and now is the whole man governed with one." These scenes of verbal sparring might be understood as a trial of masculinity, testing Benedick's skills in rhetoric and wordplay.
A more direct trial is captured in the penultimate scene of Shakespeare's Henry IV Part 1 (first performed in 1597), which depicts the showdown between Prince Hal, who will eventually ascend to be Henry V, and Henry Percy, known as Harry Hotspur, a young yet accomplished knight who rebels against King Henry IV.
Both men recognize that the ultimate upstaging, trial by combat, would result in the consolidation of manhood and an admirable reputation for one man, and the death and diminished reputation of the other. Hal notes that "two stars keep not their motion in one sphere, nor can one England brook a double reign." The two men cannot coexist and claim to upstage one another.
The irony of modern "mogging" lies in how self-conscious it has become. Where Castiglione's sprezzatura demanded that dominance appear effortless and natural, today's digital posturing often betrays the very insecurity it tries to hide.
Collins may have christened "mogging" a defining term of our contemporary moment, but the performance itself is a familiar historical echo—men working hard to make looking superior appear easy and natural.

More information
Eleanor Rycroft, Elite Masculinity and Early Modern Performances of Walking, English Literary Renaissance (2026). DOI: 10.1086/740659

1bdux33.title: Original GTA 6 leaker pleads guilty to hacking Rockstar Games, years after first revealing Lucia
1bdux33.content:
Not Cyberleek.

Image credit: Rockstar

The 21-year-old responsible for hacking Rockstar Games and leaking in-development GTA 6 footage in 2022 has pleaded guilty to a number of offenses.
The GTA 6 leaker was initially sentenced to an indefinite stay at a hospital due to his severe autism, but was more recently deemed fit for trial and moved to a regular prison earlier this January. On Monday, at the Woolwich Crown Court in South East London, he pleaded guilty to hacking Rockstar Games and a number of other companies, including Uber and EE/BT, in cyber attacks estimated to have caused £10m in damages.

Watch on YouTube
At the time of his Rockstar hack - when he was between the ages of 16 and 17 - the leaker was already under police protection at a Travelodge hotel to keep him from rival hackers he had allegedly stolen Bitcoin from. Somewhat surprisingly, he then managed to hack the multi-billion dollar game maker with nothing but an Amazon Fire Stick, the hotel room's TV and a bluetooth-connected keyboard and mouse.
As the BBC reports, he also managed to break into the developer's Slack channels, before threatening to release the GTA 6 source code if Rockstar failed to contact him within the day. The leaker has yet to be sentenced.
Those 2022 leaks were quite substantial, too, revealing about an hour of unfinished gameplay and clueing the world in on Lucia's existence - the series' first female protagonist in years. Of course, those 2022 leaks shouldn't be confused with 2026's, which saw Cyberleek spill nuggets of nearly finished clips onto the internet, despite Rockstar's best efforts to keep GTA 6 a closely guarded secret."We recently suffered a network intrusion in which an unauthorised third-party illegally accessed and downloaded confidential information from our systems, including early development footage for the next Grand Theft Auto," Rockstar said at the time, before it had officially unveiled GTA 6. "At this time we do not anticipate any disruption to our live game services, nor any long-term effect on the development of our ongoing projects. We are extremely disappointed to have any details of our next game shared with you all in this way."
Four years later, GTA 6 is finally around the corner - you're probably already aware considering the marketing frenzy Rockstar's been drumming up.

1uhthxz.title: One wandering plume may have created several Atlantic volcanic chains
1uhthxz.content:
The bathymetric map around the New England Seamounts chain and the Azores hotspot. Credit: Science Advances (2026). DOI: 10.1126/sciadv.aee1780

Beneath the North Atlantic Ocean lies a series of underwater volcanic mountain chains stretching from the coast of North America toward the Azores. These include the New England Seamounts and the Great Meteor Seamounts.

While these volcanic chains provide valuable clues about the movement of Earth's tectonic plates over millions of years, considerable debate remains about their origins and whether they are connected.
Now, new research published in Science Advances offers a possible explanation for both. And it could all come down to a single source deep within Earth's mantle.
Reconstructing the volcanic past
To get their answers, Mengxue Liu of the China Earthquake Administration in Beijing and colleagues developed 3D computer simulations to reconstruct how the volcanic chains may have formed over millions of years.
They drew on reconstructions of past tectonic plate movements to model how hot material flowed beneath Earth's surface. The research team then compared their predictions with the known ages and locations of the underwater volcanoes.

Evolution of model 3B with a moving Azores Plume. Credit: Science Advances (2026). DOI: 10.1126/sciadv.aee1780

The results pointed to a single source for the volcanic chains. According to the researchers, this was a plume, or column of unusually hot material rising through Earth's mantle beneath the Azores.
The model that best matched the data suggested that the plume initially moved northeastward before changing direction around 70 million years ago and heading northwestward.
As the plume traveled and tectonic plates above it shifted, hot material rose toward the surface. This led to volcanic eruptions that created underwater volcanoes in different locations over millions of years.
The study authors propose that this process formed the New England Seamounts and Corner Seamounts on the North American Plate, followed by the Great Meteor Seamounts on the African Plate and eventually the Azores on the Eurasian Plate.
"Our models test whether a dynamically plausible connection could exist among the New England–Corner seamounts, the Great Meteor Seamounts, and the Azores seamounts," wrote the scientists in their paper.

Sinking tectonic plate
The team also investigated what influenced the shape of the rising plume. Their models suggested it was strongly influenced by the Farallon Plate, an ancient tectonic plate that was sinking beneath North America.
As the plate sank deeper into Earth's mantle, it created pressure differences that caused surrounding material to flow sideways. This bent the rising plume, influencing where the volcanoes formed.
"These findings offer a reinterpretation of hotspot-track formation and new constraints on how mantle flow reorganizes across multiple plates."
Although the paper provides strong support for a common origin, the results are based on computer simulations. They do not conclusively prove that the volcanic chains were formed by the same plume.

Written for you by our author Paul Arnold, edited by Gaby Clark, and fact-checked and reviewed by Robert Egan—this article is the result of careful human work. We rely on readers like you to keep independent science journalism alive.

3byj97.title: Rare North Atlantic right whale population drops, alarming scientists
3byj97.content:
A pair of North Atlantic right whales interact at the surface of Cape Cod Bay, March 27, 2023, in Massachusetts. Credit: AP Photo/Robert F. Bukaty, NOAA permit # 21371

The population of one of the world's rarest whales has fallen after trending upward in recent years, worrying scientists who fear the animal could still be at risk of extinction.

The North Atlantic right whale now numbers 382 animals, according to a consortium of scientists that released its annual population estimate for the animals on Monday. That represents about a 2% decline from last year's estimate, which showed a recent slow but steady climb in the whales' population continuing.
The whales were decimated by centuries of commercial whaling that mostly ended in the 1930s. The enormous animals have been slow to recover, and today they are threatened by entanglement in fishing gear and collisions with ships.
Those threats, combined with a warming ocean, have conspired to hold the population down, said Heather Pettis, chair of the North Atlantic Right Whale Consortium. Pettis said the warming of the ocean has caused the whales' food—tiny organisms called copepods—to move, and the whales have followed them into areas of ocean not protected from ship strikes and entanglements.

This photo provided by the Mingan Island Cetacean Study shows a North Atlantic right whale mother, Silt (#1817), swimming with her calf (no identification number yet) in the Jacques-Cartier Passage, Gulf of St. Lawrence in Canada on Sept. 25, 2026. Credit: Mathilde Laverdière/Mingan Island Cetacean Study via AP

"We know that this population can and will move around to find food, and if we aren't protecting them throughout their range, we may see another situation where we have this tremendous decline again," Pettis said.
The whales' population fell about 25% from 2010 to 2020 during a time when years of poor reproduction coincided with high mortality. Recent years have been slightly more encouraging, but scientists and conservationists have warned that the whales need years of high birth counts coupled with new protections to have a chance to rebuild.

The loss in population last year underscores the need to spare the whales from entanglements and ship strikes, said Nora Ives, a marine scientist on the environmental group Oceana's right whale campaign.
Oceana was one of several environmental groups that opposed a proposal in Congress to delay new right whale protections until 2035. The proposal, which has passed the U.S. House of Representatives, is intended to protect commercial fishing interests from regulations that members of the industry describe as burdensome.
"The latest numbers are disappointing and make the road to recovery longer for critically endangered North Atlantic right whales. This iconic whale will not escape extinction if its population cannot grow," Ives said.
The right whales, which can weigh 150,000 pounds (68,039 kilograms), give birth off the Carolinas, Florida and Georgia in the winter and venture north to feeding grounds off New England and Canada. Large groups of the animals that sometimes include a fifth of the entire population are seen off Massachusetts in spring. Last year was one of the most successful calving seasons on record, with more than 20 babies born.
The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration has said the last nine years have also been a time of unusually high numbers of injuries and deaths for the whales. The population is down to just 73 reproductive females, which makes replenishing the stock difficult.
They were hunted heavily because they tend to live fairly close to shore and floated when killed, and they yielded a high volume of oil. Some sources say they got their common name from the perception that they were the "right" whale to hunt.

gh-1427240681.title: GitHub - MnkyArts/ProjectAvalanche: A native PC port of SSX (2012), decoded with help from Claude from the Xbox 360 disc and rebuilt in Rust on Bevy.
gh-1427240681.content:
Project Avalanche

A ground-up native PC port of SSX (2012), rebuilt in Rust on the Bevy engine with help from Claude — no
emulation, no recompilation. The original formats are reverse-engineered from the retail Xbox 360 disc and
re-implemented as independent Rust code, and so is the game's behaviour, read from the game's own code.
Status: playable from start to finish, still in progress. The game runs in one window: the boot movies, the
menus and a new profile, World Tour and Explore, the drops with the rider physics decoded from the game's code, the
HUD, the music, speech and sound effects, the results, and the saved progress. Players have finished all nine World
Tour chapters and ridden every track of the disc in Explore without a major issue; the DLC tracks have seen less
play. Smaller bugs remain and get fixed release by release, so please report what you find on the
issue tracker. The launcher sets the game data up from your
own disc image. What is not decoded yet is approximated and marked in the code
(see Open questions in the code).
You need your own copy of the game: an ISO image dumped from your retail Xbox 360 disc of SSX (2012). No
game data is included in this repository or in its builds.
Servers, scripts and mods: the wiki covers hosting a server,
writing Luau scripts and making mods, maps and gamemodes.
Play on Windows

Download the Windows build (the ProjectAvalanche-windows-x64 artifact of a CI run, or a release) and
unpack it anywhere: Project Avalanche.exe, avalanche-game.exe (the game), avalanche-movie.exe (the game's
decoder of mods' movies, which it starts in a sandbox of its own) and the fonts folder must stay in the same
folder.
Start Project Avalanche.exe. On the first start, click the large SET UP GAME DATA tile, then
Select SSX (2012) Xbox 360 ISO…, and pick your own disc image (an .iso dumped from the retail Xbox 360
disc). The image is only read, never changed.
Click Extract game data. The game's archives and movies are extracted once (about 4.7 GB) to
%LOCALAPPDATA%\Project Avalanche\GameData (or a folder you choose); you can cancel and resume later.
Click the large PLAY SSX (2012) tile (the launcher returns to it when the setup is done). The game starts
in its own window; progress is saved to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Project Avalanche\Saves\ssxvprofile. The launcher
stays open and shows the game's output under Extras, Output.
Extras, Tools starts the asset viewer (fly camera) or a test ride on a single track, drop and rider:
development tools that need asset-viewer.exe, built from the source, next to the launcher; it is not in
the download.

Every choice is remembered in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Project Avalanche\settings.json. The launcher's pictures come
from your own game data once it is set up; your own PNGs in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Project Avalanche\LauncherArt\
replace them.
Play on Linux

Download the Linux build (the ProjectAvalanche-linux-x64 artifact of a CI run, or a release) and
unpack ProjectAvalanche-linux-x64.tar.gz into a folder of its own (it has no top-level folder:
mkdir ProjectAvalanche && tar -xzf ProjectAvalanche-linux-x64.tar.gz -C ProjectAvalanche):
project-avalanche (the launcher), avalanche-game (the game), avalanche-movie (the game's decoder of mods'
movies) and the fonts folder must stay in the same folder.
Start ./project-avalanche and set up the game data as on Windows (steps 2 to 4 above). The data goes to
~/.local/share/project-avalanche/GameData ($XDG_DATA_HOME/project-avalanche; PROJECT_AVALANCHE_HOME
overrides it), the progress to ~/.local/share/project-avalanche/Saves/ssxvprofile.

It needs a GPU with a Vulkan driver, ALSA for sound (PipeWire and PulseAudio provide it), Wayland or X11, and the
XDG desktop portal for the ISO file picker. The build is made on Ubuntu 24.04 (x86-64) and runs on distributions
with that glibc or newer.
DLC, title update and level 15
The port plays the DLC, the title update and the level-15 update from your own copies of them. Nothing is
downloaded and no game content is shared. All three are in the launcher under Settings, Game Data (scroll down
past the disc image and the language). Set the game data up first: the DLC and title-update buttons stay grey until
then. Changes apply the next time the game starts, and nothing needs to be extracted again.
DLC (section Downloadable content): the Japan range, Mount Eddie, the Presell Pack, and the Eddie and Mac packs.

Dump the DLC from your Xbox 360: the content packages (LIVE, CON or PIRS files), as their folder (for
example DLC- 4541096D) or a .zip of it.
Click Install folder… or Install .zip… and pick it. One folder or zip can hold several packages; a title
update inside it is installed as a title update.
Each package is checked (its STFS hash tree) and copied to the DLC folder in the launcher's data folder
(%LOCALAPPDATA%\Project Avalanche\DLC on Windows, ~/.local/share/project-avalanche/DLC on Linux). Your
originals are never changed. A damaged package is not installed, and a package whose data does not decode is
listed but not loaded.

Each installed package has a switch to turn it off and a Remove button (it goes to the system trash). The DLC's
tracks, riders, outfits, boards and texts then show up in the game as on the console. The DLC's Global Events needed
EA's servers and cannot be played.
Title update (section Title update): versions 3.02 (July 2012) and 1.02 (February 2012). Install it with
Install package… (a single file), Install folder… or Install .zip…. You can install both, but only one
applies: the newest one that is switched on, because each is a complete rebuild, not an add-on. 3.02 brings the
patched menus, scripts and texts, the drop screen's Freeride (the run loops through the helicopter pickup), the
3-2-1 GO! heat and a New Zealand track fix. 1.02 changes only code. They go to DLC/Title Updates in the same folder.
Level 15 (section Level 15 data (tuner pack and profile)): the level-15 update was not a title update but a
tuner pack that a level-15 profile carries in its save. Click Install a level-15 save or tuner pack… and pick the
save (ssxvprofile) or the pack. You get 15 rider levels instead of 10, the store's level tables and the changed
drops. The pack is kept as Tuner/tuner.bin; a save is also copied over your profile (Saves/ssxvprofile) after the
launcher asks you, so back up your own profile first if you want to keep it. Remove… deletes only the tuner
file, not the profile.
Updates
The launcher checks the project's latest release when
it starts; a newer version is shown under Extras, Updates (the running version is in the footer and on
Extras, About). It downloads the release's archive, checks it against the SHA-256 GitHub publishes, unpacks it
beside the launcher and restarts. Your settings, saves and game data stay where they are; only the launcher, the
game, the server and the fonts folder's files are replaced. --no-update-check (or SSX_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1) turns
the check off.
After an update from an older version. Game data set up by v0.2.0 or earlier has no content index, which joining a
server needs: the launcher says so and Settings, Game Data, Repair game data reads your disc image again, keeps
every file that is already right and writes only what is missing or differs. An installation updated by launcher
0.2.0 lacks avalanche-movie and the fonts folder: Extras, Updates, Repair the installation downloads this
version's release again and puts them back the same verified way.
The downloads above always take the latest release: the Windows .zip for a manual install, the Linux
.tar.gz; the launcher uses its own ProjectAvalanche-windows-x64.tar.gz /
ProjectAvalanche-linux-x64.tar.gz assets.
Discord
While the game runs and the Discord app is open on the same computer, your Discord profile shows what you are doing
in Project Avalanche: the menus, the mode and event, the drop and its mountain (or the map), a timer and your
result, with buttons to get the game and to join its Discord server. The game talks only to the Discord app on your
computer and sends nothing else: not your name, your save, your rider or the server you play on. It is on by
default; Settings, Discord turns it off (the game then does not connect to Discord at all). A change applies the
next time the game starts.
Host a server
On your computer: the launcher's HOST page sets up a server folder (the rules it needs come from your own game
data, about 21 MB), starts the dedicated server as its own program, shows its output, joins it with the game and stops
it with the launcher. It is on the game's Internet tab (the project's master server) unless you switch off Listed on
the public server list; friends on your network find it in the LAN tab, and anyone can join by your address.
On a server machine: the dedicated server (ProjectAvalanche-server-windows-x64 / ProjectAvalanche-server-linux-x64,
or cargo build --release -p avalanche-server) runs headless: no GPU, sound or display.

avalanche-server setup /path/to/your/ssx.iso --out data takes the rules from your own disc image (21 MB of it).
Copy server.toml.example to server.toml, edit it, and run avalanche-server check.
Start avalanche-server. It listens on port 27450 (UDP for the game, TCP for the join) and 27451 (UDP, the query);
bind = "::" listens on IPv6 and IPv4; [port_mapping] enabled = true maps the ports on your router (off by
default). It is listed on the public server list unless [discovery] public = false (then it sends the master
server no heartbeat; every server follows the master's resource blocklist). It makes its keys in data/ at the first start and logs to data/logs/server.log.

A systemd unit, a Windows service note and a Docker example are in Engine/assets/server/deploy/ (the systemd unit
and the Windows note are in the server downloads too).
A master server (the list of public servers; built from the source, not in the downloads): on
Coolify, create a resource from this repository, keep the build pack Docker Compose (or
choose Dockerfile), set the domain, and press Deploy. docker-compose.yaml and Dockerfile at the root are
configured for Coolify's proxy, which holds the certificate. On a plain host, Engine/assets/master/deploy/ has a
systemd unit, a certbot hook and a Compose file for direct TLS.
Controls
An Xbox-style gamepad with the game's own layout is recommended: the game was made for a pad. The keyboard
works too; the launcher lists the keys under Settings, Controls:

Keys

In the menus
Enter = START, Space = A, Backspace = B, X, Y, arrow keys = D-pad, Q / E = LB / RB, W A S D = left stick (the globe), F1 skips a movie

On the mountain
arrow keys or W A S D = left stick (steer, tuck, brake), Space = A (jump), I / J / L / K = Y / X / B / A, Shift = RT, Ctrl = LT, E = RB, Backspace = LB (rewind), Esc = START (pause)

Build from source
You need Rust (stable, 1.97.1 or newer, from rustup), a C++ compiler (Luau, the scripts' engine,
is built from source) and NASM 2.14 or newer on the PATH (the mod movies' AV1 decoder assembles
its x86-64 kernels with it). On Linux, Bevy also needs a few system libraries; on Debian or Ubuntu (build-essential
brings the C++ compiler):
sudo apt-get install build-essential pkg-config libasound2-dev libudev-dev libwayland-dev libxkbcommon-dev \
libgtk-3-dev nasm
On Windows: winget install NASM.NASM (or choco install nasm), then add C:\Program Files\NASM to the PATH.
Then, in Engine/:
cargo build --release -p avalanche-game -p avalanche-launcher -p ssx-movie # the game, the launcher, the movie decoder
cargo build --release -p asset-viewer # optional: the asset viewer
cargo build --release -p avalanche-server # optional: the dedicated server (headless)
target/release/project-avalanche # the launcher: set up the game data, then Play
The launcher expects avalanche-game (and asset-viewer) next to it in target/release/, and the game its movie
decoder avalanche-movie (without it a mod's movie is refused with that reason). On Linux it keeps
its data in ~/.local/share/project-avalanche ($XDG_DATA_HOME/project-avalanche; PROJECT_AVALANCHE_HOME
overrides it). Once the data is set up, the game also starts on its own:
target/release/avalanche-game --big-root <data folder>/GameData/big (--help lists the options).
The checks the CI runs on every push (it also builds the Windows and the Linux download; a v* tag makes a
release with both):
cargo fmt --all --check
cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo clippy -p ssx-movie --all-targets --features sandbox-probe -- -D warnings
cargo test --workspace
cargo test -p ssx-movie --features sandbox-probe --test sandbox # the movie decoder's sandbox (Linux x64, Windows)
Open questions in the code
Comments marked TODO(guess) mark behaviour that is approximated rather than decoded from the original game;
each names the game-code address or the open question that would settle it. Contributions that decode one are
welcome. Comments marked PORT(choice) record the port's own decisions where the original has nothing to decode
(the PC's input and windows, the launcher, mods and online play), each with what the console had instead.
Contributing
Bug reports, accuracy reports and decoded guesses are welcome: see CONTRIBUTING.md, the
Code of Conduct and the security policy. Questions and help with the setup:
the Discord server.
Layout
The Rust workspace is in Engine/:

Path

apps/game
the game, avalanche-game: movies, front end, levels, HUD and audio in one window

apps/launcher
the launcher, project-avalanche: the game data setup from your disc image, the options, Play

apps/asset-viewer
the asset viewer, asset-viewer: a track's terrain and objects with a fly camera, test rides (a development tool)

apps/avalanche-server
the dedicated multiplayer server, avalanche-server: headless, the join over HTTP, the game over UDP, setup of the rules from your own disc image, check, IPv6, port mapping (opt-in)

apps/avalanche-master
the master server, avalanche-master: the list of public servers (authenticated heartbeats, a reachability check, expiry, blocklists); the project runs it at https://masterlist.liamrbsn.com, the one master every program uses (no setting names another)

crates/ssx-core
the foundations every other crate shares: the world's conventions and units, common identifiers, how text from outside the program is shown (no Bevy)

crates/ssx-files
the files the programs write, replaced whole or not at all across a crash or a power cut: a partial file synced, renamed over the old one, the folder synced

crates/ssx-formats
parsers for the disc's file formats

crates/ssx-assets
the game data: extraction from the disc image and conversion

crates/ssx-physics
the collision world and the rider's physics

crates/ssx-rules
the game's rules data for the simulation and the dedicated server: the tracks' vault records, placements, locators and trigger volumes, the riders' tuning, the events and the trick table

crates/ssx-lua
a Lua 5.1 implementation for the game's scripts

crates/ssx-ui
the Scaleform player: the menus and the HUD

crates/ssx-bevy

AI tools were used to assist with parts of the development and documentation of this project.

Findings are verified against the retail disc wherever possible, including whole-disc verification for every parser, cross-checks against the game's code, and comparisons with reference decoders. However, errors may still exist. Treat the code and documentation as works in progress. Assumptions that have not yet been fully decoded are marked with TODO(guess) in the code.

f0kz9a.title: Посол України обговорив із Ле Пен підтримку Києва у Європарламенті та Національній асамблеї
f0kz9a.content:
Посол України у Франції Вадим Омельченко під час зустрічі з кандидаткою в президенти Франції від «Національного об’єднання» Марін Ле Пен обговорив подальшу підтримку України, перспективи її вступу до ЄС і НАТО та участь Європи в мирних переговорах.

Як передає Укрінформ, про це повідомило Посольство України у Франції у Фейсбуці.

«Радий, що зустрівся з пані Марін Ле Пен в Українському культурно-інформаційному центрі у Франції. Я подякував їй за послідовну підтримку України в Європейському парламенті та Національній асамблеї, а також за солідарність її виборців», – написав Омельченко в соцмережі X.

У посольстві розповіли, що  посол «подякував пані Ле Пен за підтримку резолюцій на користь України, ухвалених у Європейському парламенті та Національних зборах Франції, а також за підтримку України з боку її виборців і французьких громад».

Серед тем зустрічі були співпраця у сферах цифровізації, ядерної енергетики й оборонного виробництва та спільні ініціативи в міжнародній політиці. Сторони також обговорили розвиток українсько-французьких відносин і відбудову України після війни.

Окремо йшлося про дипломатичні зусилля для досягнення справедливого й тривалого миру.

«Посол запевнив, що Президент України Володимир Зеленський наполягатиме на участі Європи, зокрема Франції, за столом мирних переговорів», – ідеться в повідомленні посольства.

Омельченко також повідомить Зеленському про готовність Ле Пен зустрітися з ним у Парижі або Брюсселі. Посол підтвердив запрошення відвідати Україну й наголосив, що відкритий діалог і взаєморозуміння важливі для розвитку відносин між Україною та Францією.

Читайте також: Ті, хто закликає скоротити допомогу Україні, грають проти Франції - оточення Макрона

Як повідомлялося, у  своїй заяві після зустрічі Ле Пен пообіцяла виконати вже взяті Францією зобов’язання, зокрема щодо кредиту ЄС для України на 90 мільярдів євро.

yfriai.title: Protecting forests outside parks benefits the birds within
yfriai.content:
Credit: Diego Fraga from Pexels

Every year, around 3.5 billion birds migrate to North America to breed, finding safe havens and nesting grounds in our national parks along the way.

But the best way to ensure these protected areas continue to help birds, researchers have found, may be to focus on what lies just beyond their borders.
That's the takeaway of a study published Oct. 31 in the journal Landscape Ecology.
For the study, a team led by quantitative ecologist Elise Zipkin and doctoral student Bruna Amaral at Michigan State University analyzed 17 years of bird monitoring data collected between 2006 and 2023 in eight national parks in the northeastern United States.
Each year during the summer breeding season, National Park Service volunteers return to the same locations and record every bird they hear, from the high-pitched "pik!" of the downy woodpecker and the flute-like song of the wood thrush to the "teacher teacher teacher" of the ovenbird.

Credit: Jay Brand from Pexels

Amaral, Zipkin and the team also examined measures of forest structure at different spatial scales inside and outside each park, from within 400 meters (1,300 feet) of each bird sighting to the entire surrounding county.
The analysis clearly showed that the forest habitat in a bird's immediate vicinity matters.
"Which is not surprising," Amaral said. "That's where these birds are directly interacting with the forest to build nests, feed their young and hide from predators."
"We still saw a lot of variation in their specific needs," she added. Stands with more shrub cover were more popular with black-throated blue warblers, for example, whereas stands with larger, thick-trunked trees supported more red-eyed vireos.

But while the local forest habitat was important, it was only part of the story. When they zoomed in and out between scales, the researchers found that the larger landscape beyond park borders mattered even more than the forest within.
Brown creepers, for example, were more likely to choose parks surrounded on the outside by acres of big, mature trees and more open understory, and were not significantly affected by forest structure inside park boundaries.
"For most of the 16 bird species we looked at, forest condition outside of parks was the most important factor in determining whether a species was likely to be present," Amaral said.
"In other words, you can have a perfectly healthy park, but if it's sitting in a degraded landscape, the birds simply might not be there."
One possible reason why the surrounding landscape is important could be because fledglings must leave the nest and gradually become more independent before they are ready to migrate back south. "They have to disperse a little bit, so it's important that wherever they head offers them a chance of survival," Amaral said.
Pinpointing the spatial scales at which forests affect birds is important because birds across North America are in trouble, said Zipkin, who directs MSU's Ecology, Evolution, and Behavior program.
By one estimate, wild populations of eastern forest birds are down 17% from half a century ago. Indeed, another study led by Zipkin and colleagues found that many of these populations continue to decline even in protected areas.

This doesn't mean that national parks—places "set aside," in large part, for nature—don't benefit birds, Zipkin said.
Protected areas like national parks can offer birds and other wildlife a respite from stressors like hunting, development and other human activities.
Indeed, previous studies suggest that, worldwide, protected areas contain more bird species than unprotected sites, and they are five times more effective at stemming species' declines.
But while protected areas are important, they can't save birds on their own.
"Our research shows that unfortunately, managing these parks in isolation isn't enough," Amaral said. "We need to start to think beyond park boundaries."
The good news is that people can help. The results suggest that landowners can enhance the effectiveness of protected areas, even relatively small ones.
"What this study shows is that anything people do to make their backyards, farms and other privately owned land more bird-friendly can spill over into protected areas, making them better for birds too," Zipkin said.

More information
Bruna R. Amaral et al., Protecting birds in protected areas: a multi-scale analysis of forest structure and species occurrence, Landscape Ecology (2026). DOI: 10.1007/s10980-026-02477-x

t14y46.title: City crows and country crows don't see the world the same way
t14y46.content:
Credit: Unsplash/CC0 Public Domain

A country crow hesitates upon seeing a takeout food box. A city crow pauses the first time it sees an ear of corn. Both are taken aback when they find a strange wooden object next to the expected peanuts.

That hesitation when encountering new things is known as neophobia, and all animals experience it, including humans, explained biologist Dave J. Colucci, Ph.D. '25, the lead author of a new study published in the journal Behavioral Ecology that examined how experience shapes the behavior of urban and rural crows.
While known for their curiosity and smarts, corvid species worldwide also exhibit considerable neophobia. Of course, the birds have an advantage: Their ability to fly means that they can take a discreet position and observe phenomena before taking action, which may also contribute to their famed problem-solving skills, according to co-author and associate professor emerita of biological sciences Anne Clark.
"They're both wary of new things and somehow very curious. They overcome that fear sometimes and manage to take advantage of new opportunities," Colucci explained.
Rocks, corn and other new objects
The research project assessed both neophobia and crows' reaction to the human gaze in 10 families of urban crows in the Ithaca, New York, area and another 10 families in nearby rural Dryden. Both groups were fed their preferred food: peanuts in the shell.
Once the crows were habituated to the interaction, the researchers began presenting the peanuts alongside an object: a rock, an ear of corn, a takeout food box and a wooden lamp base. Familiar objects—a rock for both groups, corn for the rural crows and the paper takeout box for the urban ones—evoked little hesitation. Unfamiliar objects—the takeout box for rural crows, corn for urban crows and the lamp for both—resulted in increased wariness.

"What we wanted to show was that aversion would decrease with the amount of experience that we expected our crow to have had with these objects," Colucci explained.
Fun fact: Crows that establish territories near an Arby's or a McDonald's learn to recognize the takeout boxes from that business, Clark pointed out. In this case, the researchers' takeout box was generic and brand-neutral.
It turns out that crows in urban environments exhibited more neophobia than those that lived in the countryside, the researchers found. This was a somewhat surprising result, given that many studies have shown that urban birds were less neophobic than rural counterparts. But such studies have not controlled for experience with the novel object.
In some ways, it resembles the behavior of human city dwellers; urban humans, too, are peripherally on the lookout for strange phenomena and react accordingly. In this study, corn and lamps were really strange from the point of view of an urban crow.
"These are social animals; they're with a group, and they watch each other," Clark said of urban crows. "In an area that has a lot of new opportunities, there are also new threats, and it's good to maintain some level of uncertainty about how safe things are."
The human gaze
While rural crows may be less fearful when presented with novel objects, they were much more fearful of humans overall, research showed.
Urban crows pay attention to the direction of the human gaze. If the human isn't looking at them directly, they're less likely to fly away. Rural crows, by contrast, were more likely to fly away at a greater distance than urban crows, no matter what direction the approaching human was looking.

The reason may be simple: Crows, considered a nuisance species, are more likely to be shot in rural areas.
"You can think of it as a blunt, antipredator strategy in rural areas. Don't take any chances, don't stop to assess; let's just be safe," Clark said. "Whereas in urban areas, if you were fleeing at every human, you'd never spend any time on the ground. More evidence that urban crows are on the lookout for useful information about threats, including the behavior of individual humans!"
Both experiments demonstrate the importance of animals' lived experience in responding to novel phenomena in their environment—whether a takeout box or an approaching human. They also show how animals can adapt to increased urbanization without changing their fundamental attributes and overall survival strategies.
"It fits into a larger picture of how organisms adapt to a changing world," Clark said.

Publication details
Dave J Colucci et al., Experience affects novel object aversion and the use of human cues in rural and urban American crows, Behavioral Ecology (2026). DOI: 10.1093/beheco/arag135

1ablqmz.title: Shigeru Miyamoto to receive inaugural Legend Award at the 30th DICE Awards
1ablqmz.content:
The new honor will be presented no more than once a decade

Image credit: Kyodo News

Nintendo's Shigeru Miyamoto will be the first recipient of the Academy of Interactive Arts & Sciences' new Legend Award.
The AIAS said Miyamoto will be honored at the 30th annual DICE Awards, which take place at the Cosmopolitan in Las Vegas on February 18.
The Legend Award is designed to recognize "an industry icon whose enduring vision continues to redefine interactive entertainment," the organization said, confirming it will be presented "no more than once per decade."
"Shigeru Miyamoto is widely recognized as one of the most respected and impactful figures in the games industry and beyond," said AIAS president Meggan Scavio.
"We believe he perfectly embodies our inaugural Legend Award through his impact and reach, and we are so humbled and excited to have Mr. Miyamoto accept this award at the 30th anniversary of the DICE Awards."
Miyamoto joined Nintendo in 1977 after studying industrial design at Kanazawa College of Art. He created Donkey Kong in 1981, and went on to develop Super Mario Bros. and The Legend of Zelda, as well as the Pikmin series, Wii Sports, and Wii Fit. He has been Nintendo's representative director and fellow since 2015, and is currently focused on bringing Nintendo's characters to theme parks and film.
It isn't Miyamoto's first honor. Last month, he was announced as the first game developer to receive Japan's Order of Culture award.
