VR: Tears of the Kingdom and Breath of the Wild on a Meta Quest 3 (6DoF)

Play Tears of the Kingdom 1.4.3 in a Meta Quest 3, with full 6DoF. The game runs on your Mac and draws the view
for every head pose, streamed to the headset over the USB-C cable: turn your head and the camera turns; lean and crouch
and it moves (Head position, 6DoF). First or third person, the game's sound in the headset. Quest 3 controllers and
motion gestures are built in but not yet tested on a headset.

Tears of the Kingdom 1.4.3: the game renders one picture per frame, wide enough for both eyes, and each eye looks
it up along its own rays; turning the head reprojects it to the newest pose. The picture is what the game draws
without VR (grass, lighting, shadows). The stream to the headset is HEVC at the render size per eye chosen in the VR page
(at most 2048×2208); on an M4 at 1536×1656 a Quest 3 showed about 70 fps and about 70 ms from input to display
(measured 2026-11-10; 2048×2208 H.264, the setting before, gave 53 fps and 132 ms). Both eyes see the same picture, so there is
no stereo depth by default.
Stereo depth for Tears of the Kingdom (experimental, off by default): the game still runs each frame once; the
graphics layer replays the frame once per eye with the eye moved sideways by half the eye distance, so both eyes are
real renderings of the same moment. It costs about half the frame rate (about 30 fps against 53 with one picture, at
2048×2208 on an M4) and has no switch in the VR page yet. The game has no stereo renderer of its own, and an earlier attempt
that ran the game's render jobs twice was removed because it damaged the picture (no grass, wrong lighting).
Breath of the Wild 1.6.0 / 1.9.0: the game's own same-frame stereo renderer (the one of its Labo VR mode) draws
both eyes with the headset's projection and eye distance; see the install page for its settings and limits.

One script builds and installs it, the headset side included: zeldaVR/install.md (code in
zeldaVR). VR stays off in the normal app.
Windows games

and their runtime draws with Metal. As with the Switch games, you bring your own copy and nothing from the game is in the

Recommended install

Hand it to an AI assistant. Open this repository in Claude Code, Codex, or any other AI assistant you like, tell it where your own game file and prod.keys are, and ask it to build and install the app and to sort out whatever comes up on your Mac. It follows the install skill, runs every step and checks the result; you just wait with a coffee. Installing and testing by hand is not recommended: there are many steps, and every Mac, game version and dump is a little different. That's why I haven't provided a one-click build option: an AI assistant is my one-click build option. For Red Alert 2 it needs only your own Steam install (no prod.keys) and follows its own skill.

Install skill

The install skill (.claude/skills/install-zelda/SKILL.md) is a short guide written for the assistant: which of your files goes where, the command for your case, how long each step takes (a build is 20–40 minutes; it must not be stopped), and the fix for each common error. Claude Code finds it by itself (or type /install-zelda). With any other assistant, start with: "Read .claude/skills/install-zelda/SKILL.md and follow it to install Tears of the Kingdom for me."
Red Alert 2 has its own: .claude/skills/install-ra2/SKILL.md (/install-ra2), for the Mac and iPhone / iPad builds, the movies made smaller for the phone and the Chinese languages. "Read .claude/skills/install-ra2/SKILL.md and follow it to install Red Alert 2 for me."

Let's maintain the shader list together: no more stutter
TipEvery shader in the shared list is ready before you play. On a Mac the game does not stop to compile it, and on an iPhone or iPad nothing is missing from the picture. The more places players cover, the smoother the game gets for everyone.

The shared shader list now holds 18,290 shader variants (14,727 shaders) from the Mac, iPhone and iPad: only states a build does not make by itself, since every build makes each shader's default variant. Every build makes them from the player's own game files, so the list holds identifiers only, never game data. Helping takes no setup:

Play. Every build carries each shader of the game for its default bind state. When your game meets a shader in a state that variant does not serve, or builds a render pipeline the app's list lacks, it notes it in shader-list-contribution.txt; default variants are never noted.
Once the file holds 100 new rows (shaders and pipelines together), the game asks you one question before it starts, the same on a Mac, iPhone and iPad. With "Contribute shaders" the game sends the rows over HTTPS to the shader inbox (mac-native-games.com) on its own, shortly after it starts and then every half hour, and never interrupts your play. "Don't contribute" sends nothing. The switch in Settings changes your answer at any time.
Everyone's next build carries them. Nobody stutters there again.

Only shader and pipeline identifiers, the game and app versions, the device model and system version and a random id are sent (on a Mac also the random id and nickname of the contributors board): no game data, saves or personal information. Nothing is sent before you answer "Contribute shaders". There is nothing to file by hand: contributions are no longer taken as GitHub issues (since 12 November 2026).
Stuttering when you first start playing or enter a new scene is expected while new shaders compile—don't be surprised. Performance typically improves as the cache warms up, and every shader the shared list gains is one nobody stutters on again.

gh-1461792730.content:
FerrumMolibdenDoom is a DOOM source port rewritten in Rust, based on the MolibdenDoom source port.
About the Project
The primary goal of FerrumMolibdenDoom is to faithfully port the classic DOOM engine from C to Rust. By leveraging Rust's memory safety, strong type system, and modern tooling, this project aims to preserve the authentic gameplay and mechanics of MolibdenDoom while eliminating common C-level bugs and undefined behavior.
Acknowledgments

id Software for creating DOOM and releasing its source code.
MolibdenDoom for serving as the foundation and reference implementation for this port.

AI Disclosure
AI assistants were used during the development of this source port to assist with translating C code to Rust, refactoring, and writing documentation.

1f5xjab.title: Обзоры GTA 6 начнут появляться в 14:00 МСК - в одно время с релизом игры в Новой Зеландии
1f5xjab.content:
День снятия эмбарго на публикацию обзоров GTA 6 станет по-настоящему значимым событием. Компания Rockstar потратила годы упорного труда на создание Grand Theft Auto 6; и хотя оценки критиков не предопределят судьбу игры, они позволят понять, как она соотносится с другими выдающимися частями серии.
Уже не раз было сказано, что Grand Theft Auto 6 — это самая масштабная видеоигра в истории. Репутация Rockstar Games, формировавшаяся десятилетиями, колоссальные ожидания и ореол таинственности вокруг проекта — всё это ведет к одному ключевому моменту перед выходом игры: дню, когда будет снято эмбарго на публикацию обзоров GTA 6.
По информации Insider Gaming, полученной из метаданных и других источников, снятие эмбарго совпадает с маркетинговыми активностями, запланированными на момент выхода игры в Новой Зеландии — в полночь по местному времени (14:00 МСК).
Сообщается, что копии игры для обзоров были разосланы в конце октября 2026 года, что дало получившим их счастливчикам от трёх до четырёх недель на подготовку материала.

1g3ten3.title: Google's AI Overviews cut clicks to websites by 40%
1g3ten3.content:
Google's AI answers are taking clicks from websites in the search results. In a randomized experiment, researchers hid AI Overviews from some US desktop users. Comparing them with users who still saw Overviews shows that an Overview cuts clicks to outside websites by about 40%. Those Overviews now appear on more than half the US keywords DataForSEO tracks, up from 6% two years ago. The industry's answer, GEO (generative engine optimization), has yet to show a way to compensate for the loss. While AI citations correlate with the same kind of link profile that goes with higher Google rankings, in March AI assistants sent websites just 0.3% of their traffic.
Search engine optimization (SEO) still decides whether you can be found, but where an AI answer appears, a ranking
brings 40% fewer visits than it used to. Generative engine optimization (GEO), the
practice of getting your content cited in AI-written answers, looks mostly like SEO plus two additions: being present
on the third-party sites AI answers draw from, and writing pages that are easy to quote. We found little
evidence for any other tactic.
Google answers first
An AI Overview is a generated summary that Google places above the ordinary results, with links to the pages it drew
on. In DataForSEO's monthly panel of 20 million keywords, the share of results showing one climbed from 5.93% in
September 2024 to 61.43% in August 2026. The chart at the top of this post shows that climb. Over the same period the
featured snippet, the quoted passage Google used to show at the top of a page, fell from 8.96% to 0.44%, and the
discussions and forums block fell from 21.13% to 7.42%. Video results rose from 9.67% to 19.98%, though that is
down from a peak of 31.05% in October 2025, and local map listings rose from 19.98% to 25.99%. DataForSEO's dataset
covers 190 million keywords, 165 million AI answers, and 1.1 billion backlinks, mostly for US English searches.
Pew Research Center's data gives an independent check. Pew logged the searches of 900
US adults in March 2025, re-ran them in April, and found summaries on 18% of them. DataForSEO's figures for
those months are 14.67% and 17.63%, close to Pew's.

You can't reliably avoid Overviews by choosing different keywords. Between the fourth quarter of 2025 and the third
quarter of 2026, the rate rose for every type of search intent:
Search intentQ4 2025Q3 2026 Informational (looking something up)48.42%70.44% Commercial (comparing options)26.30%51.35% Navigational (looking for a site)17.04%34.03% Transactional (ready to buy)10.82%28.64%
Low-volume keywords aren't safer either. In the third quarter of 2026,
keywords with 201 to 300 monthly searches showed Overviews 58.59% of the time, against 48.62% for those above 600.
A separate dataset, from June to September 2026, covers
difficulty and price. The easiest keywords showed Overviews 60.64% of the time and the hardest 53.76%. Keywords costing
advertisers more than $5 a click were at 49.55% and those under 25 cents at 50.54%, with a low of 42.63% between $0.51
and $1.00. More than half the result pages have no price data and show Overviews 60.06% of the time.
The rate does vary by industry. Health is at 69.68% and finance at 68.80%, while apparel is at 37.48%, dining
at 29.37%, and real estate at 22.27%.

Queries are also getting longer, especially on desktop. Over a year, queries of five or more words grew from 29.3% to
34.8% of unique desktop queries and from 29.6% to 31.9% on mobile. Three and four word searches are still the most
common.
What happens to the clicks
The strongest evidence is an experiment. Saharsh Agarwal and Ananya Sen gave US desktop Chrome users an extension that
put each of them at random into a group. One group saw Google as usual, and another had AI Overviews hidden. The
researchers then watched two weeks of real searches in January and February 2026. On searches that would show an Overview, the group that could see them averaged 0.37 clicks
to outside websites per search, against 0.62 for the group that couldn't, which the authors report as a 39.8% reduction.
Searches ending with no outbound click went from 54% to 73%. Clicks on ads didn't change, which suggests Google takes
care not to cannibalize its own revenue. Across all searches, with and without an Overview, the authors put the loss
at roughly 18.5% of the organic clicks a site gets from Google. The authors expect the loss to grow as Overviews appear on more
searches. This is a randomized controlled trial, the most reliable kind of study for separating cause
from correlation or coincidence. The effect was statistically significant for informational searches.
The navigational and transactional samples were too small to settle anything.
This is a working paper, not yet peer reviewed, and it covers desktop only. A separate preregistered experiment by Wang and colleagues, with 1,100
people, also found that removing AI Overviews and AI Mode raised clicks to publishers.

Observational data points the same way. Pew found people clicked an ordinary result on 8% of visits to a results page
with a summary and on 15% without one, and ended their browsing session on 26% against 16%. Pew's comparison isn't a
controlled experiment, because the searches that draw a summary tend to be longer and phrased as questions.

Click-through rate (CTR) is the share of people shown a result who click it. Across more
than 2,000 websites in DataForSEO's panel, the desktop CTR of the first organic result fell from 17.83% in September
2025 to 7.43% in August 2026, a drop of 58%. Mobile fell from 25.17% to 20.80%, a drop of 17%.

Desktop lost nearly half its click-through rate in one month, March 2026, and stayed down. Mobile fell about as far
over five months, then recovered most of it. These figures come from Table A2 of the report.

Desktop plunged from 15.18% to 7.94% between February and March 2026. AI Overviews can't easily explain that step
since the report has them almost flat that month, at 42.79% and then 43.38%. A change in the format or quality of the
Overviews might explain part of it, though that is speculation on our part.
Mobile, meanwhile, sank to 12.96% and then rebounded to 22.49% by
May. The report itself says its data "does not establish" whether AI answers, layout changes, or changes in behavior
are the cause. Its sample may also be shifting underneath it, since the unique desktop queries it counts fell by a
third over the year, from 1.97 million to 1.32 million. Whatever the cause, a top ranking on desktop now earns less
than half the clicks it did a year earlier.

DataForSEO also estimates where clicks go on pages with and without an Overview. By its model, the first organic result
holds 9 to 16 points less click share on pages with one, though these are different searches on a single day's snapshot:
Search intent Position 1, no Overview Position 1, with Overview Overview's cited links Informational37.1%20.7%42.4% Navigational33.4%24.1%44.8% Transactional37.6%21.4%43.0% Commercial33.8%21.1%42.2%
The click share for the Overview's cited links looks promising, but it comes from a model. Pew, which logged real
browsing, saw people click a link inside a summary on just 1% of visits, against 8% for ordinary results. Eighteen months and a large change in the product
separate the two measurements, so it is difficult to say which is closer to the truth.

Google disputes that search traffic to websites is declining. In August 2025 its head of Search, Liz Reid, wrote that total organic clicks were
"relatively stable year-over-year" and that Google was sending "slightly more quality clicks", meaning clicks where
people don't quickly come back. She gave no figures to back that up.

Your site can't see whether someone goes back to Google, so you can't check Google's quality-clicks claim yourself, but
you can check what your Google clicks are worth. RevScope, our product, shows your revenue per visitor
from Google, AI Overviews included, and which landing pages earn the most.
Who the answers cite
If people read the summary and stop there, it matters which sites the summary cites. The report compares Google's AI
Overviews with ChatGPT. Their most-cited lists overlap, but a different kind of site leads each one.
RankGoogle AI OverviewsCitationsChatGPTAnswers citing it 1youtube.com51.9Mwikipedia.org4.88M 2reddit.com25.1Mreddit.com3.25M 3facebook.com20.4Mfandom.com670K 4wikipedia.org19.9Mbritannica.com486K 5google.com15.9Mnih.gov476K
The report warns that the two platforms' counts aren't comparable, so compare where a site ranks within each list. Reddit and
Wikipedia rank near the top of both, and by our count 16 of the 30 domains in each top 30 appear on both lists. The
differences are still large. YouTube is first in AI Overviews and nineteenth in ChatGPT. Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok
make Google's top ten and miss ChatGPT's top 30, while Reuters, The Guardian, AP News, and The Washington Post make
ChatGPT's top 30 and miss Google's. ChatGPT also often cites nobody: 27.3% of its answers had no source, against 0.7% for
AI Overviews. So, as the report puts it, strength on one platform "doesn't automatically guarantee" the same on another.

Reddit also appears in Google's ordinary top ten for 32.15% of the report's tracked results, nearly eight times Quora's
4.11%. Two limits apply to all of this. The first is that the answers come from prompts DataForSEO collected, and the report
doesn't explain how they were chosen or whether they match what people really ask. The second is that big platforms do
about as well in ordinary results: Pew found Wikipedia, YouTube, and Reddit made up 15% of the sources in AI summaries
and 17% of those in standard results. Still, the common belief that AI favors Reddit holds up in this data.
GEO looks mostly like SEO
Google's position is that there are "no additional requirements to appear in AI Overviews or AI
Mode, nor other special optimizations necessary", beyond a page being indexed and eligible to show with a snippet. Since
that is a company describing its own product, we looked at outside data on two questions. The first is
which sites get considered, and the second is which page on a site gets picked.
Which sites: link profiles correlate with citations
A referring domain is another website that links to yours. DataForSEO measured
how closely referring domains track AI citations using Spearman's correlation, a score where 0 means no relationship
between two rankings and 1 means they match exactly. The score was 0.406 for AI Overviews and 0.377 for ChatGPT. Links
marked as coming from user-generated content, such as forum posts, scored lower, at 0.342 and 0.314.

These are moderate relationships, and they don't show that links cause citations, since large, well-known sites tend
to have more of everything. The samples also contain only domains cited at least once, so they can't tell you what it
takes to get cited for the first time. A similar pattern shows up in ordinary rankings: domains ranking first had a
median of 111 referring domains against 85 for positions 4 to 10, with heavy overlap between the groups. For AI
Overviews, the median cited domain had 282 referring domains on the easiest keywords and 1,571 on the hardest, after the
report excluded giant platforms like YouTube and Amazon and any domain with fewer than 50 referring domains. Small sites
weren't measured at all. The ranges are also wide, at 518 to 5,765 for the middle half
of domains on the hardest keywords, so sites with very different link profiles get cited.
Which page: cited pages often don't rank for the query
Ranking for a query and being cited for it are drifting apart. Ahrefs found 76% of pages cited in AI Overviews ranked in
the top 10 for that query in
July 2025, and about 38% in
March 2026. The two studies differ in sample,
parsing, and the Gemini model behind the Overviews, so the size of that fall isn't a clean measurement. One possible
mechanism is what Google calls query fan-out: its documentation says these features may issue "multiple related searches
across subtopics and data sources". A page could then be cited because it ranks for a related question the reader never
typed. Ahrefs offers this only as a possibility, and its earlier study tested the idea and found that the data didn't
support it.

The most careful test of page-level tactics we found is a study by the SEO software company SISTRIX, published in October
2026. It paired 48,527 pages cited by ChatGPT, AI Mode, or AI Overviews with uncited pages from the same site, which
removes the site's overall strength from the comparison. In the table, a factor of 2.7 means pages with the
feature were cited 2.7 times as often as pages without it.
Page featureFactorWhat SISTRIX says about it Current year in the title2.7A rough stand-in for maintained content, not a title trick; an initial indication Table of contents with jump links1.7Only 14% of pages had one; 2.5 on editorial sites FAQ structured data1.5At 833 URLs it pointed the opposite way, a warning about small GEO studies Visible last-updated date1.31.9 on editorial sites, but 0.7 on shops; only 5% of pages showed one Ten or more external links1.3Linking out to sources Product structured data0.80.5 in AI Overviews, but "not a lever, but no cause for concern either"; it should stay Many features combined2.1Against barely optimized pages
An experiment in the paper that gave GEO its name points the same way as SISTRIX's correlations. Aggarwal and colleagues rewrote web pages
and measured how much of a generated answer drew on them. On their 10,000-query benchmark, adding quotations raised a
page's visibility by about 41%, adding statistics by about 31%, and citing sources by about 27%, while keyword stuffing
lowered it by about 8%, all on their main measure, the position-weighted share of the answer's words. Lower-ranked pages
gained the most: citing sources lifted a page ranked fifth by 115% and cut the top-ranked page by 30%.
They also tried Perplexity, an AI search product, on
200 samples, uploading the source text as files rather than letting it search. The gains on that measure were smaller, at
about 21% for quotations and 9% for statistics. The main test used GPT-3.5 reading the top five search results, which is
well behind today's products, so the percentages are dated even if the direction still holds.

The most debated shortcut has nothing behind it so far. llms.txt is a proposed file that tells AI systems what a site
contains. SE Ranking analyzed nearly 300,000 domains and found no correlation with citations. SISTRIX also concluded there
is "no measurable effect", though it cautions that domains with the file differ from others in many ways, so this part of
its data doesn't have the same-site pairing. Google says "you don't need to create new machine readable
files, AI text files, or markup" for its AI features. The data agrees about the files, though SISTRIX's FAQ structured
data result suggests some markup may help.
AI sends little traffic, but it is growing and may convert well
AI assistants sent 0.28% of total traffic across 74,752 websites in March 2026, according to Ahrefs. That was about 3.5
million visitors, against 345 million from Google, or roughly a hundred to one. Ahrefs describes it as small but growing fast.
The true figure is somewhat higher because some visits, especially from mobile apps, get counted as direct traffic.
The same Ahrefs article reports that on its own site, AI search visitors were 0.5% of visitors and 12.1% of signups.
Ahrefs sells SEO software, so its audience may be unusually likely to use AI tools, and one site proves little. Still,
on that site an AI visitor was about 24 times as likely to sign up as the average visitor.
Some of the value never shows up as traffic. People read an AI answer, form an opinion, and never click.

To count what AI visits are worth on your own site, RevScope reports when ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and
other assistants send visitors and whether they buy. It also tracks when AI and search engine bots crawl your pages.

Google's own reporting has a gap too. It counts traffic from its AI features inside the overall "Web" numbers in Search
Console. Since 2026 Search Console also has generative AI reports, which Google says show how often your URLs appeared in
those features, along with pages, countries, and devices. The announcement describes impressions and doesn't mention
clicks, so you learn how often you appear, not how many visits or sales that brings. Rank tracking can't fill the gap,
since a page can hold position 1 and earn fewer clicks than it used to.
What to do about it Keep the fundamentals. Pages must be indexable and eligible for a snippet. Referring domains correlated
with citations more strongly than user-generated links did, and higher-ranking domains had moderately more of them, so
links from other sites remain a reasonable investment, even though neither relationship proves cause.
Find out who gets cited on your topics, per platform. Check your important queries in AI Overviews and
ChatGPT and note the sources. Being described accurately there may matter as much as your own page.
Take part in the communities those answers cite, such as Reddit, so that you are mentioned there.
Write pages worth quoting. Answer related questions directly, add original data and named sources, and
use clear headings. If you run an editorial site, show when the page was last updated.
Skip the shortcuts. An llms.txt does no harm but has shown no benefit, AI-specific markup isn't
needed, and keyword stuffing lowered visibility in the GEO paper's test.
Judge the work by revenue. With fewer clicks to go around, it matters more which ones pay. Tie each
channel to the sales it produces rather than to its rank or its visit count.

The numbers above are mainly US English, and the
products change quickly, so the 2025 figures may already be out of date. Nearly all the large datasets come from
companies that sell SEO data or software, including DataForSEO, Ahrefs, SISTRIX, and SE Ranking, and we sell analytics.
Almost everything about what earns a citation is correlation. Three findings hold up. Controlled experiments show fewer clicks to outside websites when Google's AI
features are present, domains with more referring domains tend to be cited more often among those already cited, and we
found no proven shortcut to being cited.
Sources Search Insider: 2026 Edition DataForSEO · Annual research report · October 2026
DataForSEO collects search and AI answer data for a living and publishes its tables and methods, which allowed us to
check the monthly figures behind its headlines. It sells this data, its answer prompts aren't explained, and its click
shares are modeled. We rely on it for what appears where, and treat its click estimates and correlations as indications.
Our charts are redrawn from its published values.
The Impact of Google AI Overviews on Publisher Traffic and User Experience: Evidence from a Field Experiment Saharsh Agarwal and Ananya Sen · Working paper · SSRN · draft of June 2026
University researchers ran a preregistered randomized experiment on 1,065 US participants, 770 of them in the two groups
compared here. Random assignment makes it the best evidence that Overviews themselves reduce clicks. It isn't yet peer
reviewed, and it covers desktop Chrome for two weeks. We read a copy of the June draft hosted outside SSRN.
AI in Search Reduces Publisher Referrals Without Improving User Experience: Experimental Evidence Stephanie T. Wang, Jeffrey Gleason, and colleagues · Preprint · arXiv · August 2026
A second preregistered experiment, with 1,100 people, which independently supports the direction of the result. We read
its abstract only, so we use it for that direction and not for any figure.
Google users are less likely to click on links when an AI summary appears in the results Athena Chapekis and Anna Lieb · Short read · Pew

1rd0qo7.title: Rockstar опубликовала новые скриншоты уже вот-вот выходящей Grand Theft Auto 6
1rd0qo7.content:
До выхода Grand Theft Auto 6 (в некоторых регионах) осталось менее 12 часов — в это даже трудно поверить. Долгие годы ожиданий и догадок наконец подходят к концу. В социальных сетях были опубликованы новые скриншоты GTA 6; по словам одного из самых известных инсайдеров, следящих за серией, изображения попали в сеть из «внутренней системы сайта для обзоров».
На кадрах можно увидеть новые игровые сцены, занятия и виды оружия, которые позволяют лучше оценить проработанность штата Леонида. Если бы не присутствие главных героев — Джейсона и Люсии, — каждый из этих снимков можно было бы принять за кадр из совершенно другой игры.
Ниже представлены шесть новых скриншотов, которыми поделился в социальных сетях аккаунт iGrandTheftAuto. В комментариях к публикации уточняется, что источником стал Tex/Tez — авторитетный инсайдер и датамайнер, специализирующийся на проектах Rockstar; на его страницы в соцсетях подписано почти полмиллиона человек.
На скриншотах показаны тренировки в спортзале — с их помощью можно буквально изменить физическую форму Джейсона и Люсии. На одном из кадров запечатлена напряжённая сцена: герои держат в заложниках членов банды в полуразрушенном доме. Рядом видны сумки, доверху набитые деньгами, а на лбу Люсии проступили капли пота — всё это намекает на то, что происходит нечто серьёзное.

zsqd2w.title: Джефф Безос раскрыл подробности кастинга Роберта Паттинсона на роль Джеймса Бонда
zsqd2w.content:
Основатель Amazon Джефф Безос рассказал, как проходил отбор актера на роль нового Джеймса Бонда. По его словам, в финальный список вошли пять кандидатов, однако после просмотра проб команда практически единогласно остановилась на Роберте Паттинсоне, известном по фильмам «Бэтмен» и «Одиссея».
Выступая на мероприятии медиакомпании Semafor, Безос признался, что лично принимал активное участие в выборе исполнителя роли агента 007. Финалистов пригласили на полноценные экранные пробы: каждый актер примерил костюм, снимался на специально подготовленных декорациях и взаимодействовал с другими артистами. Для каждого кандидата подготовили по три сцены.
После этого Безос, режиссер следующего фильма Дени Вильнёв и другие участники отбора собрались, чтобы несколько часов просматривать записи. Все пятеро актеров показали высокий уровень, однако Паттинсон сразу выделился на их фоне.
«В игре Роба Паттинсона было что-то особенное. И это решение сразу перестало быть предметом споров. Дени и все остальные интуитивно склонились к Робу», — рассказал Безос.
При этом изначально команда даже рассматривала кандидатуру Паттинсона с некоторой осторожностью из-за его известности. Создатели думали, что на роль лучше подошел бы менее знаменитый актер. Однако экранные пробы развеяли сомнения: по словам Безоса, стало очевидно, что Паттинсон и есть Джеймс Бонд.
Интересно, что годом ранее Безос спрашивал поклонников, кого они хотели бы увидеть в роли следующего агента 007. Тогда в голосовании лидировал Генри Кавилл, известный по роли Супермена. В итоге роль досталась актеру, который, как и Кавилл, уже успел сыграть одного из самых известных супергероев DC.
Назначение Паттинсона на роль Бонда может повлиять и на его дальнейшее участие в другой крупной франшизе. Актер сейчас работает над фильмом «Бэтмен: Часть II», выход которого запланирован на 2028 год, однако совмещать обе роли в дальнейшем может оказаться непросто. Последний год и без того выдался для Паттинсона насыщенным: помимо съемок в «Бэтмене», он получил роль Бонда и участвовал в нескольких других крупных кинопроектах.

49pou.title: Nvidia promises that revenue will keep soaring — for now
49pou.content:
Despite the turmoil at Nvidia following the departure of its disgraced founder and CEO Jensen Huang, the company — as expected — delivered a solid quarter on Tuesday. More importantly, Nvidia reassured investors that its streak of record-breaking revenue won’t stop.

On Tuesday, CFO-turned-interim CEO Colette Kress reported revenue of $115.8 billion, up 103% from the year-ago quarter and a beat above the company’s guidance. Nvidia had told Wall Street to expect $108 billion in revenue for its third quarter of fiscal 2027. Kress also projected an even bigger fourth quarter, with revenue expected to reach $130 billion, plus or minus 3%.

She also said full-year revenue is on track to exceed expectations.

“We are raising our fiscal year 2028 outlook. We expect revenue to grow approximately 75% year over year, up from 70% and off what is now a higher fiscal 2027 base,” Kress said on the quarterly conference call on Tuesday. “Our outlook considers data center readiness, the strength and durability of end customer demand, and our customers’ access to capital.”

The company also reminded investors that it was using some of its billions in cash to buy back shares. In September 2026, Nvidia increased its share buyback program by $150 billion. It spent $28.1 billion on its own shares during the quarter and still had another $227.3 billion remaining in the kitty for additional repurchases.

Ironically, Nvidia could also benefit from the plunge in its share price following Huang’s resignation last week, should shares remain depressed over the longer term. The stock is down about 10% since his departure. Investors, however, celebrated Tuesday’s quarterly results, sending shares up about 4% in after-hours trading.

Kress stressed that the company was in good shape now and for the foreseeable future, even without Huang at the helm.

“We have the best technologists on the planet with a world-class multi-year roadmap,” Kress stressed. “From a business perspective, it’s business as usual. We’ve engaged with our customers, we’ve engaged with our suppliers, our partners. They’re all 100% behind us.”

She added that the company has secured memory and advanced packaging capacity and is working with its chip manufacturer, TSMC, to “narrow the supply and demand gaps.”

1qtf1xv.title: Jeff Bezos Describes How Amazon Decided On Robert Pattinson As The Next James Bond
1qtf1xv.content:
If anyone knows the glitzy, globetrotting world of James Bond it’s Bezos, Jeff Bezos.

The Amazon founder and world’s second-richest man today revealed that he brought his knowledge of that milieu to the process of choosing the next James Bond, who, if you haven’t heard yet, is Robert Pattinson.

“I was heavily involved,” said Bezos at the Semafor Silicon Valley & The World conference today.

“We ran a really tight process, and we made the final decision on Friday,” the Amazon MGM Studios overlord revealed. “There were a big group initially, and we down-selected to five finalists, and then we did real old-fashioned screen tests of those five finalists.

“It was really interesting. You know: full costume, real sets, other actors with them and three different scenes with each of the five finalists. And then we got together on Friday to spend a couple hours looking at all those screening tests or looking at all of that.”

While Bezos said, “all the actors were extraordinarily talented,” Pattinson stood out, even if they initially resisted selecting him.

“By the time we got to this list of five, they were all amazing. But there was something special about Rob Pattinson and his performances, and it was kind of immediately un-debated. Denis, the director, was…we all sort of gravitated to him. By the way, initially, I would say we were slightly biased a little against him because he’s already so famous. We sort of thought, maybe we should have somebody a little more unknown. But in the screening tests, it was so obvious: He is James Bond.”

gh-1451744046.title: GitHub - uvindusl/NFSProStreet_online: Static recompilation of Need for Speed: ProStreet (2007): x86 -> C, running natively on a hand-written Win32 / Direct3D 9 high-level emulation layer. Bring your own game.
gh-1451744046.content:
An experimental, from-scratch static recompilation of the 2007 PC game Need for Speed: ProStreet.
The game's x86 code is translated to C ahead of time. That C is compiled into a native binary (and, as a second target, to WebAssembly), and a hand-written Win32 / Direct3D 9 / D3DX high-level emulation layer stands in for Windows. The long-term goal is to run the game in a browser using WebGPU and Web Audio.

Status: early. The game does not run yet. The code lifts and loads, and parts of the graphics stack work in isolation, but the program stops during C runtime start-up and never reaches main. See Status for exactly what has been verified.

Bring your own copy of the game. This repository contains no game code, game data, shaders, or Microsoft DLLs. Everything derived from the game (lifted C, images, shader blobs) is generated locally and is git-ignored.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Electronic Arts. Need for Speed and ProStreet are trademarks of Electronic Arts Inc.

Status
Each row is only marked ✅ when there is a command that reproduces it on the current build. Anything else is listed as not done.

The full milestone table is in docs/milestones.md.
Known issues

Boot stops in the C runtime start-up. The program halts at an unresolved indirect call during static constructor 13. Nothing past that point has run, so no gameplay-related code (D3D9 from the game, audio, input, file loading) has been exercised by the real game.
"Valid WGSL" is not "correct WGSL". naga confirms the output is well-formed. It does not confirm it computes the right result. An earlier version silently skipped unsupported opcodes (dsx/dsy); those are now emitted, but other opcodes may still be unhandled. Each shader family needs a rendered-output comparison against a reference.
The CPU shader interpreter is incomplete. It has no cmp case and computes lrp with the operands reversed. The WGSL emitter is correct; the interpreter is not used on that path.
Performance and memory are unknown. A 2007 game's code and assets inside a browser's 4 GB WebAssembly limit has not been tested.

What you need

A legitimately owned copy of the game.
A readable, unprotected build of the game executable. The retail executable on some releases is wrapped in copy protection and cannot be lifted as shipped. This project does not provide, and does not document how to produce, an unprotected image. If you cannot obtain one legitimately, the lifter has nothing to work on.
To build: Linux x86-64, Python 3, Node.js 20 or newer, a C compiler, and wasi-sdk unpacked into deps/ for the web build. The tested setup is 8 cores and 15 GB of RAM; use J=2 to limit parallel jobs.
For shader validation: naga-cli. scripts/validate_wgsl.sh runs it over every extracted blob.
To view the web build: a Chromium-based browser with WebGPU enabled.

Build and run
scripts/lift_boot.sh # lift the boot set (JTSWITCH=1 is required)
STRICT=1 J=2 scripts/build_runtime.sh # native runtime -> out/prostreet
scripts/run_boot.sh <image> 60 # boot and print a report

scripts/build_runtime.sh compiles the generated shards with -w and the hand-written runtime with -Wall -Wextra. STRICT=1 turns any runtime warning into a build failure. Do not trust a build made without it.
Native tests:
tests/build_d3d9_htriangle.sh
tests/build_d3d9_textured_quad.sh
tests/d4_instruction_test.sh

Web build:
FULL=1 web/build.sh
cd web && npm ci && node build.mjs

How it works

lifter/tools/ — a Python lifter built on Capstone turns every reachable function of the executable into C. Switch tables, indirect calls, and function pointers held in data are seeded so the dispatcher can find them.
lifter/runtime/ — the hand-written runtime: CPU state, a flat 4 GB guest address space, thread-local storage, structured exception handling, the Win32 layer, and Direct3D 9 / D3DX emulation.
Shaders — ProStreet ships 591 precompiled D3D9 shader blobs (vs_1_1, vs_2_0, vs_3_0, ps_2_0, ps_3_0). An offline translator turns them into WGSL for WebGPU. The blobs are read from your own game files and are never committed.
web/ — the browser host: the WebGPU renderer, Web Audio, input, a worker-based game host, and a small server that serves the page, the module, and your local game folder.

More detail is in docs/.
Layout

Path
Role

lifter/tools/
x86-32 → C lifter, shader disassembler, shader → WGSL translator

lifter/runtime/
native runtime: CPU, memory, dispatch, Win32 and D3D9/D3DX emulation

web/
browser host and web build

scripts/
lift, build, and boot drivers

tests/
native graphics and shader tests

docs/
milestones and design notes

analysis/, debug/
working notes; some are historical and may be out of date, so prefer docs/milestones.md

Credits

Based on the browser-port approach and x86 → C lifter of th0mk/nfsu2-web (MIT), which in turn builds on Talha Müderrisoğlu's static recompilation of Need for Speed: Underground 2.
Method follows N64: Recompiled and XenonRecomp.
Parts of this project were developed with AI coding assistants.

Third-party attributions are listed in THIRD_PARTY.md.

s010v9.title: Hollywood Reacts to Robert Pattinson’s James Bond Casting: Florence Pugh, Brad Pitt, Rami Malek, More
s010v9.content:
After it was revealed that Robert Pattinson was tapped as the next 007, fellow industry notables are speaking out to congratulate him on the casting.

On Monday, it was announced that Pattinson would be taking over the iconic James Bond role from Daniel Craig, who concluded his run with 2021’s No Time to Die. He’ll star in the upcoming film from director Denis Villeneuve.

“I am overjoyed to welcome Robert Pattinson as our new James Bond. He has the timeless soul of 007 and brings a spirit that is completely new. I cannot wait to begin,” the filmmaker said in a statement.

Some of Pattinson’s former co-stars, such as Florence Pugh (Dune: Part Three), Elizabeth Debicki (Tenet), Bryce Dallas Howard (The Twilight Saga: Eclipse), Ralph Fiennes (Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire) and Rami Malek (The Twilight Saga: Breaking Dawn – Part 2), and fellow celebrities, including Brad Pitt and Joseph Zada, are among those reacting to the news.

“I’m so happy because he’s been the no. 1 vote in my household for like quite a long time,” Pugh told The Hollywood Reporter at Elle’s Women in Hollywood celebration. “He’s so unbelievably talented. He makes moves that you’re just not guessing, and it’s just so wonderful to see a career just float and be this unbelievably versatile thing. I’m so excited that he got that role. So good, and with Denis.”

Speaking with E! News, Howard praised her time working with Pattinson, saying, “He’s not schmoozy. He’s not trying to be cool. He’s just who he is, and he happens to be absolutely gorgeous. But he’s a true artist, and his career since Twilight has obviously demonstrated that a zillion times over.” So for her, “Him as James Bond feels really right”

Fiennes, who also appeared in three previous Bond films, learned about Pattinson’s casting during an interview with Andy Cohen on his SiriusXM show, alongside The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping castmembers. “I’m sorry. I’m in love with Daniel Craig still,” he said. “It’s hard. I’ve got the wrench in my heart.” However, Fiennes later clarified that he believes the Twilight alum is “a great actor,” adding, “I’m sure he’ll be great.”

Debicki told Variety she’s “so happy for Rob” at the Los Angeles premiere of The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth. “He is an enigma himself. He’s beautiful, and he’s funny, and he’s smart… I think he’s perfect. I’m so thrilled,” she added of his casting.

Pitt appeared shocked when ExtraTV broke the Bond news to him at the The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth premiere. “Is that right?!” he replied. “You know what? I love this idea. I love what he’s been doing; I love his choices. I think he’s the real deal. Yeah, that’s great. Good call; I like it.”

Malek told People that he “could not be more proud” of Pattinson, having “known Rob for quite some time.” He added, “I mean, the fact that people are recognizing, maybe they all know, how talented that man is. I’ve known him for years. We’ve worked together and we’ve become quite close friends and it’s been lovely to just share this moment with him.”

Sunrise on the Reaping star Zada also told Cohen, “He’s on such a roll,” referring to his stacked lineup of projects this year — The Drama, The Odyssey, Primetime and Dune: Part Three — and now his Bond casting. “He’s every young actor’s favorite actor right now,” he added.

iwi7u7.title: Federal Appeals Court Judges Press Nexstar About Its Quest To Narrow Tegna Merger Order
iwi7u7.content:
A three-judge panel at the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit peppered a Nexstar Media Group lawyer with questions about the company’s efforts to salvage its contested acquisition of rival Tegna.

Pay-TV operator DirecTV and attorneys general of 13 states sued last March to block the $6.2 billion transaction, which would create a local TV station behemoth with reach to some 80% of U.S. households. The day after the suit was filed, the FCC approved the merger and Nexstar swiftly declared it closed.

Just as the companies were starting to integrate, however, a federal judge granted the lawsuit plaintiffs’ request for a temporary restraining order, freezing the deal pending a trial. While Tegna shareholders were paid out and the company’s stock ceased trading, the company’s Virginia-based operations have been kept separate from Nexstar’s Texas-based footprint pending the outcome of the suit.

Nexstar lawyer Deanne Maynard sought to lay out the company’s view that the TRO should only apply to stations in 31 markets where the two companies both own stations. She asserted that the plaintiffs accepted that reduced scope in legal briefs filed during the appeal. Numerous times as she was starting to make her point, though, she was frequently interrupted by federal judges Marsha Berzon, Johnnie Rawlinson and Xavier Rodriguez during the proceeding in a Pasadena, CA courtroom.

“In this broadcast merger context,” Maynard argued, “it’s very common to hold separate stations. Across Democratic and Republican administrations, the federal DOJ has challenged mergers making very similar claims to the ones that plaintiffs make here.”

The judges all voiced skepticism that there was a clear playbook to reduce the number of stations to be held separate to just 31, rather than just blocking the entire deal, as the TRO did. “My major concern here is that we’re an appellate court,” Berzon said. “The district court is there, he’s considered what’s feasible and what isn’t, and for us to start redoing that, we’d have to have a very high confidence that there was a feasible alternative.” She later interjected, “This is a discrete kind of issue which requires an understanding of a large, integrated organization and how it can function.”

Rodriguez raised the possibility that the appellate court could remand the matter to the district court. “Why do we have to decide anything now?”

That question hung in the air as attorneys for DirecTV and the states stated their case. Emily Curran of the California Department of Justice, said focusing on 31 stations rather than the full Tegna portfolio “is not a coherent proposal.” In the lower-court proceedings, she said, “We presented evidence that a full unwinding of the merger, such that the previous version of Tegna would be fully restored, would restore that lost competition, for the simple reason that the day before the merger, it was competing. And it was competing as a integrated entity that was a successful company.”

Ben Horwich of DirecTV said the plaintiffs “challenged the transaction that they put together.” It is not the job of the plaintiffs, or the court, he added, “to figure out how to achieve their business objectives by fashioning some other transaction.”

While Maynard referred to the process of narrowing down the scope of the TRO as routine, Horwich countered that the question of antitrust harm raised in merger reviews has doomed some multi-billion-dollar deals. Sinclair’s attempts to merge with Tribune, and Tegna’s thwarted combination with private equity firm Standard General “couldn’t go forward, because there were these concerns.”

In the case of Nexstar-Tegna, he added, the notion of a subset of Tegna being kept separate as a quasi-subsidiary pending the outcome of the suit doesn’t fit with Nexstar’s M&A strategy. Already, eight agonizing months have passed without the usual post-merger focus on synergies and efficiencies, with Nexstar stock slipping 10% during the legal limbo period.

“It is the defendant’s own business thesis that you need to be at least a certain size to cut it in this industry,” Horwich said. “To be successful, to be competitive.” Carving out 31 stations, he said, would be tantamount to “creating a bunch of orphan stations, and then trying to find homes for them. That’s not what we’re aiming for here. We want the competition we had before the illegal hardship.”

After the oral arguments, the judges took the case under advisement and will now work on arriving at a decision, which is expected sometime in the early part of 2027. If the panel rules against Nexstar, the company could request an en banc hearing or appeal the matter to the U.S. Supreme Court.

Meanwhile, a jury trial of the lawsuit has been scheduled for next July in the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of California.

9gzoir.title: "Майами Хит" представила баскетбольную площадку в стиле GTA 6
9gzoir.content:
Баскетбольный клуб «Майами Хит» показал специальную площадку в стиле Grand Theft Auto 6, на которой команда проведет всего один матч. Игра против «Милуоки Бакс» состоится 18 ноября на домашней арене клуба Kaseya Center.
Оформление площадки посвящено Вайс-Сити — вымышленному городу, в котором развернутся события GTA 6. В центре паркета разместили логотип игры с римской цифрой VI и надпись Vice City, а вдоль боковых линий добавили фразу «I love Vice City». В дизайне использованы фирменные розовые и голубые цвета, ставшие частью визуального стиля новой игры Rockstar.
Для матча баскетболисты также наденут специальные игровые майки, оформленные в стилистике Вайс-Сити. Правда, на форме останется название клуба Heat, а не вымышленного города. Кроме того, болельщики смогут приобрести тематическую атрибутику в официальном магазине команды.
Матч примечателен и спортивной составляющей: центровой «Майами» Яннис Адетокумбо впервые встретится со своей бывшей командой после перехода из «Милуоки» в межсезонье.
Появление тематической площадки стало еще одной частью рекламной кампании GTA 6 перед долгожданным релизом. Rockstar готовится выпустить игру 19 ноября, а интерес к ней уже выходит далеко за пределы игровой индустрии.

1cvadxq.title: "Нет боевых намерений": В Париже прокомментировали миссию в Украине. Лавров говорил об "участии в войне"
1cvadxq.content:
Французские военнослужащие находятся в Украине для проведения учебных и технических миссий, у них нет "каких-либо боевых намерений". Об этом во вторник, 17 ноября, заявила замминистра обороны Франции Алис Руфо, комментируя слова главы МИД РФ Сергея Лаврова, сказавшего о "непосредственном участии в войне" французских войск. 

Минобороны Франции: Число военных ограничено

Руфо подчеркнула, что число задействованных в Украине французских военных "весьма ограничено". Она указала на "крайне точечный характер" миссий, которые проводятся "на очень большом расстоянии от линии фронта". У французских военных "нет каких-либо намерений вступать в боевые действия", говорить об их прямом участии в войне "абсурдно", добавила Руфо.

По ее словам, именно поэтому речь не идет о вооруженном военном вмешательстве за рубежом, при котором Конституция Франции требует парламентского контроля. Руфо подчеркнула, что в Украине действительно существует координационная структура, которая тесно сотрудничает с миссией по вопросам обороны (официальное военное представительство Франции), что позволяет проводить целевые обучающие мероприятия на разовой основе, а также осуществлять техническое обслуживание и ремонт оборудования.

Лавров: Это не поддержка, а прямое участие в войне

Лавров 17 ноября раскритиковал присутствие французских военных в Украине, заявив, что в их случае речь идет не о "поддержке Украины, а о прямом участии в войне". "Мы передавали по имеющимся каналам нашу озабоченность, предупреждая соответствующие страны", - добавил он.

О том, что французские военные минимум с лета 2026 года тайно находятся на территории Украины, сообщила 16 ноября радиостанция RFI, а затем агентство AFP.

dwrfob.title: Skydance Confirms New Cable Structure as Howard Lee Exits
dwrfob.content:
Skydance’s merged cable networks has a new division name: Skydance Global Cable Media. Warner Bros. TV Group and U.S. Networks head Channing Dungey also revealed the structure under the new entity, which combines the Warner Bros. Discovery and Paramount Global cable networks under one roof.

As part of that new organization, longtime exec Howard Lee, who had most recently served as chief creative officer of US Networks, is exiting after 28 years at Discovery. Lee’s oversight had included Discovery Channel, TLC, HGTV, Food Network and more.

“One of the hardest parts of any transition is saying goodbye to talented leaders who have contributed so much and, just as importantly, have been trusted colleagues, friends, and mentors,” Dungey said in a memo to staff. “I want to express my sincere thanks to Howard Lee for his excellent leadership. I’m deeply grateful for the immense talent, commitment, and passion he brought to Warner Bros. Discovery’s US Networks over the years and wish him the best in his future endeavors.”

As part of merging a huge portfolio of more than 50 cable networks, Dungey divided them into four buckets: unscripted lifestyle, broad-based entertainment, talent/music/live and comedy/animation.

In unscripted lifestyle, Food Network prexy Betsy Sanner Ayala will add Discovery, HGTV and Magnolia oversight, with Discovery head of content Joe Boyle reporting to her.

In broad-based entertainment, TNT/TBS/ID president Jason Sarlanis will also now oversee TLC, with TLC head of content Alon Orstein reporting to him.

In the talent/music/live division, OWN president Tina Perry will add BET and MTV/VH1 to her oversight. Sitarah Pendelton will continue as head of content for MTV/VH1, Brian Rikuda will serve as head of BET, and Aisha Summers-Burke will continue as head of BET content. All three execs report to Perry. (BET Media Group head Louis Carr announced his exit on Monday.)

Nickelodeon and Nickelodeon Animation Studios, Adult Swim, Cartoon Network, Warner Bros. Animation, Cartoon Network Studios and Hanna-Barbera Studios Europe will now be part of Skydance Television Animation, overseen by president Michael Ouweleen. Ouweleen will also continue oversight of Cartoon Network and Adult Swim. Overseeing the studios assets (Nickelodeon Animation Studios, Warner Bros. Animation, Cartoon Network Studios, and Hanna-Barbera Studios Europe) will be Peter Girardi and Alec Botnick, both reporting to Ouweleen. Botnick will continue to oversee Nickelodeon programming with Laurel Weir. Meanwhile, Comedy Central oversight will remain with Ari Pearce, reporting to Ouweleen.

As for Lee, he first joined Discovery Inc. in 1998 as VP of Travel Channel Development; he later helped launch Planet Green, then moved to TLC, where he was first exec VP of production and development and later rose to president of TLC originals — before taking over as preident of Discovery Channel Networks and TLC in 2022. He was named chief creative officer of US Networks at Warner Bros. Discovery in Dec. 2024.

Lee developed and launched pop cultural institutions like “90 Day Fiancé,” “Toddlers & Tiaras,” “Sister Wives,” “Dr. Pimple Popper” and “Baylen Out Loud.” Under his watch, Puppy Bowl delivered its biggest audience in eight years and Shark Week posted its largest year-over-year ratings growth in over a decade.

Here is Dungey’s memo:

Hi Team,

As we bring together our renowned cable brands across Warner Bros. Discovery and Paramount, I’m pleased to share an organizational update that will help us leverage the full strength of our combined portfolio and position us for future success.

Our newly formed group will be called Skydance Global Cable Media and will encompass a premier roster of 50+ cable networks, including such iconic brands as Adult Swim, BET, Comedy Central, Discovery, Food Network, HGTV, ID, MTV, TLC, and Nickelodeon, among many others. Together, these brands deliver culture-defining entertainment, compelling kids and family programming, and leading lifestyle content to audiences around the world.

The breadth and quality of programming this team delivers is truly unmatched, from Adult Swim’s Rick & Morty to TLC’s “90 Day Fiancé” franchise, from Discovery’s “Puppy Bowl” and “Shark Week” to the Soul Train Awards on BET and the VMAs on MTV, our brands are bigger than television. They are part of our audiences’ daily lives in meaningful and unique ways, and I look forward to stewarding their legacies into the future alongside you.

As we look ahead, our focus is clear: create exceptional stories, unlock the full potential of our programming, franchises and brands, and deepen our relationship with audiences. The quality and reach of our programming, together with the extraordinary talent across our organization, give us a strong foundation for what comes next.

To help achieve these strategic goals, we have created four distinct segments within the group. I’m pleased to announce our new structure and creative leadership for Skydance Global Cable Media:

Unscripted Lifestyle: Betsy Sanner Ayala, currently President of Food Network, will continue in that role and also oversee Discovery, HGTV, and Magnolia. Joe Boyle will continue as Head of Content for Discovery, reporting into Betsy.

Broad-Based Entertainment: Jason Sarlanis, currently President of TNT, TBS, and ID, will continue in that role, and will also oversee TLC. Alon Orstein will continue as Head of Content for TLC, reporting into Jason.

Talent, Music, and Live: Tina Perry, currently President of OWN, will continue in that role and add BET and MTV/VH1 to her purview. Sitarah Pendelton will continue as Head of Content for MTV/VH1, Brian Rikuda will serve as Head of BET, and Aisha Summers-Burke will continue as Head of BET Content, all reporting into Tina.

Our fourth network group will be comprised of Comedy and Animation. Skydance Television is now the home of some of the most incredible animation networks and studios in the industry, including Nickelodeon and Nickelodeon Animation Studios, Adult Swim, Cartoon Network, Warner Bros. Animation, Cartoon Network Studios, and Hanna-Barbera Studios Europe. I’m pleased to say that all these beloved assets will now be together as part of Skydance Television Animation, and this group will be overseen by Michael Ouweleen, President. Michael will also continue with day-to-day oversight of Cartoon Network and Adult Swim. Reporting to Michael and leading the work overseeing the studios assets (Nickelodeon Animation Studios, Warner Bros. Animation, Cartoon Network Studios, and Hanna-Barbera Studios Europe) will be Peter Girardi and Alec Botnick. Alec will also continue to oversee programming on Nickelodeon along with Laurel Weir. In addition, Comedy Central will roll up to Michael, with Ari Pearce continuing day-to-day oversight of the network.

I’m excited about this new structure and feel confident that this incredible team of leaders will help defend our core business while building out a multi-platform strategy for these brands that will allow us to reach audiences wherever they may be. We are continuing to work through the process and will share more about the international business in the coming weeks.

One of the hardest parts of any transition is saying goodbye to talented leaders who have contributed so much and, just as importantly, have been trusted colleagues, friends, and mentors. I want to express my sincere thanks to Howard Lee for his excellent leadership. I’m deeply grateful for the immense talent, commitment, and passion he brought to Warner Bros. Discovery’s US Networks over the years and wish him the best in his future endeavors.

I know we have a lot of work ahead and I am excited to get started. With our unrivaled portfolio of brands, incredibly talented teams, and shared passion for making great TV, there is nothing we can’t achieve together.

Best,

Channing Dungey

1lmfdkn.title: Собери идеальную клавиатуру своими руками - анонсирован уютный симулятор KeyCapy
1lmfdkn.content:
Независимый разработчик Войтех Петак (Vojtěch Peták) представил дебютный трейлер KeyCapy — необычного симулятора, посвящённого сборке, ремонту и чистке компьютерных клавиатур. Игра предложит спокойный игровой процесс без спешки, позволяя создавать собственные устройства и выполнять заказы клиентов.
В KeyCapy игрокам предстоит самостоятельно собирать клавиатуры, экспериментируя с их внешним видом и подбирая дизайн по своему вкусу. Процесс создания устройств станет одной из главных особенностей проекта.
Помимо сборки новых клавиатур, можно будет заниматься ремонтом уже существующих. Клиенты станут приносить устройства, которым требуется обслуживание, а игрокам придётся приводить их в порядок, устранять неисправности и тщательно очищать от загрязнений.
Разработчик делает ставку на расслабляющую атмосферу и удовольствие от кропотливой работы. Вместо напряжённых испытаний KeyCapy предложит возможность спокойно заниматься любимым делом в уютной обстановке.
KeyCapy выйдет на PC в Steam, однако точная дата релиза пока не объявлена. Уже сейчас желающие могут подать заявку на участие в игровом тестировании через страницу проекта в Steam.

pk826e.title: Три воина против космических врагов - приключенческая RPG Emptiness Sire получила дату выхода
pk826e.content:
Студия Oaks Games Studio представила новый трейлер Emptiness Sire — приключенческой игры с пошаговыми сражениями, в которой троим воинам предстоит отправиться в опасное путешествие и противостоять могущественным космическим противникам. Разработчики объявили, что игра выйдет 12 января 2027 года.
В центре истории окажутся три героя, которым предстоит объединить усилия ради борьбы с загадочными врагами. На протяжении путешествия они столкнутся с многочисленными испытаниями, требующими не только боевых навыков, но и сообразительности.
Игровой процесс Emptiness Sire сочетает пошаговые сражения с исследованием мира и решением головоломок. Игрокам придётся продумывать свои действия в боях, преодолевать препятствия и постепенно продвигаться навстречу новым угрозам.
Свежий трейлер знакомит с атмосферой приключения, демонстрирует противостояние героев космическим противникам и напоминает о приближающемся релизе.

1d2o1ok.title: Comedians Leah Rudick & Jessica Michelle Singleton Launch ‘People Pleasers’ Podcast With PodcastOne
1d2o1ok.content:
EXCLUSIVE: Comedian Leah Rudick and Jessica Michelle Singleton have announced the launch of People Pleasers, a new comedy podcast with a multi-year deal with PodcastOne, which will serve as its exclusive sales and distribution network.

With People Pleasers, Rudick and Singleton are set to offer an unfiltered weekly conversation about self-improvement, self-sabotage, and the never-ending quest to get everyone to like them. Each week, the duo tackles everything from woo-woo self-improvement and personal reinvention to blatant self-sabotage and the everyday absurdities of navigating life. Think of it as a conversation with your best (and possibly worst) millennial girlfriends.

Kit Gray, PodcastOne’s President and Co-Founder, told us: “When we founded PodcastOne, one of our tentpole goals was to amplify women’s voices and we’re thrilled to continue that legacy with the launch of People Pleasers. Leah and Jessica are two of the most sought after women in comedy and we feel privileged to provide them the space to create content that audiences and advertisers seek.”

Rudick is a Los Angeles-based actor, writer, and comedian who has amassed nearly two million followers across social media with her viral original characters, including Wealthy Woman, Joannie, and Love Coach. Known for her signature offbeat, ‘weird girl’ comedy, she was named one of Deadline’s Stand-Ups to Keep an Eye On in 2026. Her credits include HBO’s High Maintenance, IFC’s Commuters and Dropout TV’s Crowd Control. She has performed at Moontower, Just for Laughs, SF Sketchfest, and Laughing Skull festivals, and her debut comedy hour, Spiraling, is available on both Amazon and Apple TV.

Also a comedian, writer, and actor, Singleton broke out in Hulu’s Iliza’s Locals, the stand-up series from Iliza Shlesinger. Her comedy specials and Don’t Tell Comedy performances have garnered millions of views, with her sophomore comedy album, Horny for Death, debuting at No. 1 on iTunes and Amazon. Singleton has toured internationally alongside some of comedy’s biggest names, including Tom Segura, Theo Von, Mark Normand, Bobby Lee and Hannah Berner. Her screen credits include Showtime’s The Comedy Store docuseries and writing for The Roast of Whitney Cummings. She released her debut hour special, Hi Y’all!, in 2025.

PodcastOne’s roster of podcasts spans news, comedy, true crime, sports and society and culture and includes shows such as Karma and Chaos, Off the Vine with Kaitlyn Bristowe, LadyGang, Court Junkie, The Prosecutors and Varnamtown. Their shows are available through PodcastOne, Apple Podcasts, Spotify, YouTube, iHeart, Amazon and wherever podcasts are heard.

Both Rudick and Singleton are managed by Nate Dixon at Mosaic.

82ld3o.title: Летающие острова и воздушные сражения - Myth of Empires: Throne получит четвёртый сезон Voidbound Realm
82ld3o.content:
Студия Angela Game представила новый трейлер Myth of Empires: Throne, посвящённый четвёртому сезону под названием Voidbound Realm. Обновление добавит в бесплатный экшен новую область с парящими островами и возможностью сражаться с противниками прямо в воздухе. Запуск сезона состоится 20 ноября 2026 года.
Главным нововведением станет регион Voidbound Realm, где игрокам предстоит исследовать острова, парящие высоко над землёй. Необычное окружение откроет новые возможности для исследования и изменит привычные условия противостояния.
Особое внимание разработчики уделяют воздушным сражениям. Игрокам предстоит вступать в схватки с противниками над землёй и бороться за контроль над территориями. Таким образом, четвёртый сезон расширит возможности боевой системы и добавит новые испытания для участников.
Свежий трейлер демонстрирует летающие острова, столкновения с врагами и особенности нового региона. Разработчики делают ставку на динамичные сражения и борьбу за господство в необычном мире.

1aue7xc.title: Thom Velde Dead: Former AMC Theatres Executive Was 83
1aue7xc.content:
Thomas Velde, who served as head film buyer at AMC Theatres during his 27 years at the exhibitor, died Oct. 31. He was 83.

Velde died of cancer at his home in Rancho Mirage, Calif..

For 27 years, he worked at AMC Theatres, where he negotiated film agreements with domestic and international studios while also overseeing the entertainment company’s Canadian operations and real estate ventures. Following his time at AMC, he worked independently in motion picture distribution and would consult for clients that included Microspace Communications and CJ America.

Velde is survived by his wife, Deborah; his daughters, Andrea Ter-Velde and Courtney Ter-Velde, and their husbands, John McLoughlin and Greg Horton; his son, Sam; stepsons Matthew Castillo and Spencer Castillo and their wives, Crissy Castillo and Claire Castillo; grandchildren Aubrey Long and Jack Long; and step-grandchildren Jackson Castillo, Sammy Castillo, Cruz Castillo, Bianca Castillo and Capri Castillo.

A celebration of life will be held Dec. 8 at 3 p.m. at Woodland Hills Community Church. Donations can be made to the Will Rogers Motion Picture Pioneers Foundation or the Motion Picture and Television Fund, both of which serve the industry community Velde was a part of.

“Thom was an avid golfer and a devoted college football fan,” his family noted. “Above all, he loved his family and friends, who will remember his strength of character, his generosity and the way he made time for the people in his life. He was always willing to lend a hand and had a special gift for keeping friendships alive over the years.”

tiqapw.title: Nvidia is abandoning China after Jensen Huang’s ouster
tiqapw.content:
Nvidia will no longer sell its H200 chips in China, acting CEO Colette Kress said Tuesday, ending the company’s participation in a controversial loophole in the U.S. ban on the sale of advanced chips to the country.

China’s access to leading AI accelerators was an important topic during the company’s first earnings call since CEO and co-founder Jensen Huang stepped down last week. The disclosure comes the same day Nvidia announced it was creating a board-level committee to oversee national security policies, export control compliance, and global trade risks.

Nvidia’s deal to sell H200 chips in China was brokered by Huang and President Donald Trump. The arrangement required the chips to be shipped through the U.S., allowing the government to collect a 25% tariff.

The pathway angered China hawks who wanted to deny Chinese labs computing power and maintain the United States’ lead in AI, but Huang long argued that it was more important for the U.S. to compete in China. In April, he told podcaster Dwarkesh Patel that “to concede that market for the United States technology industry is a disservice to our country.”

Huang’s ouster — in part over an affair with the CEO of a company under investigation for smuggling chips into China — has coincided with new rules, issued Monday, barring advanced U.S. chips from foreign data centers that serve Chinese customers remotely.

Investment bank Jefferies forecast that those rules might trim between $44 billion and $62 billion from Nvidia’s data center revenue next year. Referencing the new export controls, Kress said that the backlog of demand for advanced chips like Vera Rubin means the rules would have no impact on the company’s top-line revenue.

In the long term, the company may face the loss of potential customers in Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, and Indonesia. Critics of Nvidia’s dependence on China claim that as much as 20% of its revenue comes from demand linked to the country — annual revenue at its Singapore subsidiary hit $104 billion in 2025 before Nvidia stopped disclosing those figures — but that’s clearly going to change.

Even before Nvidia decided to stop shipping H200s, China had largely refused to accept their delivery. The government would prefer to generate demand for the country’s domestic chip industry, even if major AI compute users want the still-superior Nvidia equipment, according to Jacob Feldgoise, a researcher at Georgetown’s Center for Security and Emerging Technology.

Meanwhile, Chinese frontier labs are finding ways to access Nvidia chips elsewhere. All of China’s leading AI models show evidence of having been trained on Nvidia Grace Blackwell chips that are prohibited from being exported to China.

That training may have taken place at data centers outside of China, but sales to those facilities will be barred under the new rules. If large data centers suited for training AI models want to buy Nvidia chips, they will have to certify they aren’t serving any Chinese customers, export control attorney Dan Fisher-Owens told TechCrunch.

If they can’t provide that certification, the new rules may force them toward other chip options and further eat into Nvidia’s market share.

fbghsh.title: Denis Villeneuve Says ‘Dune: Part Three’ Is “Something Even Better” Than The First Two Films
fbghsh.content:
Denis Villeneuve is teasing Dune: Part Three, saying the third film in the trilogy is his best yet.

In an interview with GQ, the filmmaker explained why he thinks the third one is his favorite.

“The second one was much better than the first one because I had learned, because the storytelling was better and the first one was more contemplative,” Villeneuve said on the One More Question podcast.

He continued, “It was meant to be like that, but I wanted to drift into something a bit more muscular. And I feel that I did something even better with the third one.”

Villeneuve added, “As an artist, I feel that I was able to do something that I was not able to achieve in the two first ones. There’s tension there. There’s an emotional journey that is strong, which I’m really happy with. How will it be perceived? How you will receive it? As a filmmaker, I’m satisfied that there was a progression.”

Dune: Part Three is set to open in theaters on December 18. The film, directed by Villeneuve, was co-written by him and Brian K. Vaughan and is based on Frank Herbert’s novel Dune Messiah.

RELATED: ‘Dune: Part Three’ Smashes BFI Imax Record With 33,000 Admissions Sold In First 24 Hours

The film stars Timothée Chalamet, Zendaya, Jason Momoa, Florence Pugh, Rebecca Ferguson, Isaach De Bankolé, with Charlotte Rampling, with Anya Taylor-Joy, and Robert Pattinson, and Javier Bardem, and features newcomers Nakoa-Wolf Momoa and Ida Brooke.

m099ly.title: ‘Wicker’ Star Alexander Skarsgard Will Be Pushed Differently for Golden Globes Than Other Awards (Exclusive)
m099ly.content:
Alexander Skarsgard, the Swedish actor who has garnered raves — and lust — for his portrayal of a hunk made of twigs in the eccentric dramedy Wicker, will be promoted in an unconventional way this awards season.

The Hollywood Reporter can exclusively report that the 50-year-old will be pushed by Wicker distributor Black Bear as a lead at the Golden Globes — specifically, in the category of best actor in a musical or comedy — but in the supporting category at the other major award shows where contests are not segregated by genre.

This path — lead for Globes, supporting for Oscars — has previously been employed by numerous others.

It worked well for some. Among them: Tatum O’Neal was nominated at the Globes and won at the Oscars for 1973’s Paper Moon; Maggie Smith won at both for 1978’s California Suite; Catherine Zeta-Jones was nominated at the Globes and won at the Oscars for 2002’s Chicago; and Alicia Vikander was nominated at the Globes and won at the Oscars for 2015’s The Danish Girl.

But it was less successful for others. For example, Cate Blanchett was nominated at the Globes but not at the Oscars for 2001’s Bandits; and Steve Carell was nominated at the Globes but not at the Oscars for 2017’s Battle of the Sexes.

A Black Bear rep tells THR, “We made the decision to position Alexander in lead actor for the Globes’ musical/comedy category because it gives the opportunity to recognize his unconventional romantic performance within the film’s unique blend of dark comedy, fantasy and romance. For other awards, where comedy and drama are not distinguished, supporting actor offers a more appropriate path to recognition reflecting the impact of his performance within the ensemble.”

Alexander Skarsgard and Olivia Colman in Wicker.

Everett Collection

Skarsgard, who won a Golden Globe for Big Little Lies in 2018 and was nominated for another for Succession in 2024, delivered his Wicker performance, opposite Oscar winner Olivia Colman, beneath elaborate WETA Workshop prosthetics and a full creature suit. Playing a character who barely speaks, the actor had to exaggerate his expressions in order for them to be visible, but not so much that they would seem over-the-top. The resulting nuanced, tender characterization, with much communicated through subtle gestures and soulful eyes, has left many audience members as smitten as — and even envious of — the lonely fisherwoman who commissioned the wicker man in the first place.

Wicker, based on the short story The Wicker Husband by Ursula Wills, was adapted for the screen and directed by Alex Huston Fischer and Eleanor Wilson. Its strongest award prospects are probably in the best makeup and hairstyling and best visual effects Oscar races.

zedtoc.title: Subaru WRX STI Sport R Is a New Manual Variant Exclusive to Japan
zedtoc.content:
The Subaru WRX STI Sport R brings a mass-produced manual transmission back into Subaru’s Japanese lineup for the first time since 2019.
The performance sedan pairs an updated version of Subaru’s TY85 transmission with the WRX’s 271-hp turbocharged 2.4-liter four-cylinder boxer engine.
The STI Sport R will go on sale this week for about $34,399, but it’ll only be available in Japan.Subaru hasn’t sold a mass-produced manual car in Japan since 2019, when national regulations forced the automaker to stop selling stick-shift cars in its home country. Aside from the limited-edition WRX STI Sport#, which required winning a lottery to get one of the 600 models available, Japan hasn’t seen a manual Subaru in quite a while.SubaruHowever, Subaru is a big proponent of saving the manuals, and the new WRX STI Sport R is finally putting six-speeds back into mass production in Japan. While the STI Sport R won’t be available in the United States, some of its features mirror what’s available stateside on the WRX tS.Don’t be fooled—the STI Sport R still isn’t exactly a true STI. But it does have the TY85 six-speed manual transmission that’s lived in other STIs, and Subaru’s engineers claim to have refined it to reduce shift play by up to 60 percent. The transmission is paired with a 271-hp turbocharged 2.4-liter four-cylinder boxer engine. An auto-blipping “RevSync” function ensures smooth downshifts every time, and Brembo brakes allow for stable braking in any environment.SubaruThe Sport R sedan uses ZF electronically controlled dampers, which can change the handling performance and ride comfort depending on the selected drive mode. Drivers can choose from five modes: Comfort, Normal, Sport, Sport+, and Individual, which is more than what’s available in U.S. WRX models.Orders for the WRX STI Sport R open on November 19, but it will only be available in Japan. The performance model sits at the top of Subaru’s Japanese sedan lineup, priced at the equivalent of about $34,399. It’s a standard production model, meaning nobody will need to enter a lottery or cross their fingers and toes to get one. Subaru expects to sell about 330 units per month.Subaru➡️ Skip the lot. Let Car and Driver help you find your next car.Alayna Wilkening grew up reading motorsport magazines and following her grandpa around his Chevrolet dealership's showroom floor. In true Hoosier fashion, her first car was a hot pink custom cardboard "Fiero-vette" for her kindergarten Kindy 500 race. She now autocrosses a 1994 Miata with her dad, which she learned to drive the night before her first event. Alayna went to Indiana University and graduated with a degree in journalism and a minor in graphic design. As a testament to her great taste in cars, her first real one was a metallic orange 2007 Chevy HHR, which she lovingly called "The Dumptruck."
