y6q8s0.title: Thom Velde Dies: Longtime Head Film Buyer For AMC Theatres Was 83
y6q8s0.content:
Thomas “Thom” Velde, a longtime head film buyer for AMC Theatres who also oversaw its Canadian operations, has died. He was 83. His family said he died October 31 of cancer in Rancho Mirage, near Palm Springs.

Velde spent more than a quarter-century at AMC Theatres as head film buyer, negotiating film agreements with domestic and international studios. He also oversaw AMC’s Canadian ops and real estate ventures.

He joined AMC in 1978, rising to become SVP Film Buyer of its Central Division before being promoted to SVP and managing director of AMC international film marketing in 1998. Tasked in that post with handling film buying policies in Canada, Asia, Europe and other regions, he forged relationships with film companies, distributors and government agencies around the world. He also supervised and trained film buyers for the exhibition chain.

After leaving AMC, he launched T Velde Consulting, working independently in motion picture distribution and consulting for clients including Microspace Communications and CJ America.

Velde’s family said was an avid golfer and a devoted college football fan who will remembered for his strength of character, his generosity and the way he made time for the people in his life.

He is survived by his wife, Deborah; daughters Andrea Ter-Velde (John McLoughlin) and Courtney Ter-Velde (Greg Horton); son, Sam Velde; stepsons Matthew Castillo (Crissy Castillo) and Spencer Castillo (Claire Castillo), two grandchildren and five step-grandchildren.

A celebration of life is set for 3 p.m. December 8 at Woodland Hills Community Church, with a reception to follow there. Velde’s family said donations in his memory may be made to to the Will Rogers Motion Picture Pioneers Foundation or the Motion Picture & Television Fund.

1mphzu.title: Slay the Spire 2 is one of this year's best selling games despite only being available on PC, and its players are "obsessed"
1mphzu.content:
An Ironclad success.

Image credit: Mega Crit

One million copies for each month on sale, it seems. Slay the Spire 2, Mega Crit's roguelike deckbuilder, is estimated to have sold 7.9m copies since its release in Steam Early Access in March.
That's according to estimates by Alinea Analytics industry analyst Rhys Elliott, who revealed in a LinkedIn post that those sales translate to $157.6m (~£119.6m) in revenue for the small studio.
Slay the Spire 2 is now the sixth best-selling 2026 release across Steam, PlayStation and Xbox. That is notable, as the game is only out on Steam, meaning it has sold enough copies to outpace games on platforms it's not even available on.
We already knew Slay the Spire 2 was one of the year's biggest releases. In its first week on sale, the game sold over 3m copies. It quickly became March's top-selling game on Steam, beating blockbuster competition in Crimson Desert and Resident Evil Requiem. Slay the Spire 2, alongside other indie titles such as Meccha Chameleon, have helped Steam deliver another record year of revenue.It was such a hit, even, that other indie developers felt it negatively impacted sales of their own games. Mewgenics maker Edmund McMillen recently told Eurogamer "it sucked everybody out". "The same players who liked Mewgenics, they were Slay The Spire players. So they all went woosh and right over," McMillen said.
Slay the Spire 2 has been consistently popular with players, too, and that popularity has seemingly continued. Elliott noted the game never fell below 2.5 million active players each month since March.
Slay the Spire 2's loyal following also meant that the recently released beta patch, which added a new character, was enough to bring back millions of players. Despite only being available for players who opt into the beta branch of the game, Slay the Spire 2 more than doubled its daily active users to reach its highest daily player count in six months.
"Simply put: Slay the Spire 2 players are obsessed," wrote Elliott. "And it's not just a niche group of dedicated players, either. The average play time is nearly 84 hours, sure. But zooming out, 1.9 million folks have played for over 100 hours."
Incidentally, nearly 100,000 players bought the game but never played it, which Elliott added could explain the discrepancy between player numbers and copies sold.
Looking ahead, Slay the Spire 2's road to version 1.0 is expected to be long, with several features and gameplay additions still in the works. Then there are the console ports, which have yet to be announced, but are very much expected.
In Eurogamer's Slay the Spire 2 early access review, Bertie Purchese called it "a deceptively familiar sequel" whose confident design and smart new additions build on what made the original work so well.

gh-1461011334.content:
Sakura Wars / Sakura Taisen · Sega SaturnStatic SH-2 recompilation · Windows x64

A return to the Imperial Theater with recompiled SH-2 code, integer-scaled pixels, and optional presentation upgrades. Public project by MatyMeatBoy.
v0.2.0-alpha is the first public release, not the certified complete game. It includes the AOT fix for the first battle's closing sequence, HD narrative from the preloaded catalog, the 201-portrait checkpoint, and a first Spanish-language draft of chapter 1 (translated and cross-checked against the Japanese script), with all limits documented below. Chapter 1 end-to-end and the full campaign are not yet verified. Scope of this release. The v0.1.2 and v0.1.5 packages are kept intact. The launcher defaults to English; a Spanish script/menu patch is available (see Development below) and more languages are planned.
Play
Extract the Windows release into a writable folder and open Play.bat. DLLs and the save importer are bundled: you don't need to install Python, MSYS2, compilers, or an SDK to play. This build boots without an external BIOS.
The standard Git release does not include discs, BIOS, binary translations, save files, or original PC assets. Bring your own translated discs. The owner's personal transfer package is separate and not published: it bundles the build with only their own English disc 1 and processed HD assets, already placed for auto-detection.
The final game is planned as a unified release with mandatory import of both discs. A personal single-disc test does not certify that transition or replace the pending work on the final importer.
Presentation and controls

Option
Behavior

Original
Keeps the original Saturn composition and integer scale of the original raster.

Enhanced
Recomposes recognized scenes, up to 16:9, with an original fallback.

Image and dialogue share a single scale.

Image and dialogue use independent integer scales to best fit; a shadow sits behind the dialogue.

Compatible backgrounds and portraits; can use an already-processed pack without a PC install.

HD Preload
Loads enabled assets before playing; optional, with higher memory use.

Controllers
SDL3 with remapping; M30 Bluetooth/2.4G profiles, with manual selection when XInput hides the model.

Pixels are scaled with nearest-neighbor and integer multipliers. Output keeps the square raster; no fractional aspect correction is applied. On wider surfaces the 16:9 area is centered, with no ultrawide mode. The frame sits outside the playable content.
F11 toggles fullscreen. Esc/F1 or Start+Select/Back opens settings. The launcher and the game share configuration; the launcher closes once the first frame is confirmed ready. View logs.bat opens diagnostics. Save import works on copies, without modifying the sources.
Verifiable status

Status and evidence

Boot and AOT
Cold boot and tested paths without a guest SH-2 interpreter.

Exploration
119,781 continuous frames of one exploration route; does not equal a complete chapter.

Save/load
Specific points in episode 1 and research save files; full campaign and real disc swapping still pending.

Combat
Tutorial, movement, defense, and Sakura/Sumire attacks tested. Separate submenus in Enhanced mode; AOT/interpreter SDK tests do not certify victory or campaign completion.

HD
Backgrounds and portraits integrated with validation and fallback. Full bodies/poses/expressions still pending.

PixelGen v1
Stage01 right-hand strip integrated and anchored to world scroll; camera and sprites checked on specific routes.

Tactical 16:9/HUD
Stage01 enabled in Enhanced mode with corrected menus. Other stages, the full HUD, and the entire battle remain pending.

Pending: no online/offline achievements are announced as available.

PC
Assets are used for the Saturn HD mod; running and translating the PC version itself are on hold.

Chapter 1 complete, translated and cross-checked against Japanese. Chapters 2-7 have a first English→Spanish draft, validated for line/length/choice rules but not yet cross-checked against Japanese. Chapters 8-10 in progress. Menus pending a language selector in the launcher.

PC body assets will keep a single height-based scale, with the head/torso axis aligned to the original; they will not be stretched to fill a box. Full hardware compatibility across all M30 firmware revisions and the target machine's RX 6900 XT still needs checking there.

gh-1462709294.content:
Port nativo de Onimusha 2: Samurai's Destiny para Android y PC, basado en
ps2-native-recomp. Traduce
el ejecutable de tu propio disco a C++ y lo ejecuta de forma nativa; no incluye
ISO, ELF, APK con código del juego ni export de Ghidra.

Android PAL/español (SLES_509.78): docs/onimusha2-pal.md
Android NTSC (SLUS_203.93): android/port/README.md
PC: scripts/port.sh <nombre> "ruta\al\juego.iso" o las instrucciones de
docs/onimusha2-pal.md.

Necesitas tu propio disco de Onimusha 2. El código generado a partir del juego
(generated/, ISO, ELF y APK) queda fuera del repositorio.
Estado: verificado en PC (idioma, 50 Hz, menú e introducción con subtítulos en
español) y en Android (aviso y pantalla de título, 512x448). Todavía no se ha
completado una partida entera.
Base
Turns a PS2 game disc you own into a native Windows or Linux program by static recompilation: the code of the PS2's
main processor is translated to C++ and compiled, and the rest of the console is emulated. 32 games work as far as they
have been tested, 19 of them out of the box, with zero game-specific code. God of War II has been played from start to
end. This project is at an early stage and still changes a lot.
How it works, from the disc to the picture: read the explanation.
Built on ps2-web-recomp by Samir Nuri (MIT).

ps2-native-recomp-demo-github.mp4

19 games ran out of the box, with zero game-specific code: God of War, Gran Turismo 4, Tekken 4, The King of Fighters XI, God Hand, Ecco the
Dolphin: Defender of the Future, The Super Dimension Fortress Macross, Armored Trooper VOTOMS, Ben 10: Alien Force, Samurai
Western, Thunder Force VI, Raiden III, Heavenly Guardian, Shin Megami Tensei: Nocturne, Persona 4, Tales of the Abyss, Digimon World Data Squad, Football Kingdom and College Basketball 2K5. Out of the box means nobody changed anything for these games: the
tool recompiled the disc as it is, and the game played (as far as it has been played, see What runs). Gran Turismo 4 needs one small build step that
unpacks its program; the runtime has no code for it.
The goal is a universal tool: any PS2 game, recompiled the same way, with no work for each game. When a game doesn't run
yet, the fix goes into the tool, so it helps every game.
Don't expect every game to work on the first try. Only a few games have been tried so far, and each game uses the
console a little differently, so many still stop at a black screen, crash, or play with missing sound or wrong pictures.
When a game doesn't work, please send me a report (see Playtesters wanted): every report shows
me what to fix next, and one fix often helps several games at once.
What it does

Turns your disc into a PC game: in the app, choose the disc image, press Build, then Play. You get a program of
its own with a desktop shortcut. The app downloads its own build tools, so nothing has to be installed.
Windows and Linux, drawing through Direct3D 12 or Vulkan.
Keyboard and mouse or a game controller, with a key card (F1) and keys you can change.
Saving: quick saves (F5 and F8) and the game's own memory card saves.
A clearer picture: sharper text and HUD, smoother edges, picture styles to switch between (F2), and twice the
resolution on a strong graphics card.
Widescreen and other patches from PCSX2's community, picked in the app.
Smooth sound when a game runs below full speed: it is stretched instead of chopped.
Nothing left out: game code the first build did not see is translated while you play and kept for the next start.

How far it is
Still early: the project went public on 28 October 2026. God of War II has been played from start to end. 31
other games play as far as testers got, among them God of War, Gran Turismo 4, Resident Evil 4, Silent Hill 2,
Shadow of the Colossus and Tekken 4 (the full list is in What runs). Most PS2 games have not been tried
yet, and some still stop at a black screen or crash. 54 of the 55 programs of a free PS2 test suite print exactly what a
real console prints. It is not faster than PCSX2 yet: on the same laptop PCSX2 is faster in every scene I measured (see
Not faster than PCSX2 yet).
Why recompile instead of emulate
An emulator works like a whole PS2 inside your PC: while you play, it reads the game's code piece by piece and works out
what each piece means. This project does the biggest part of that work once, before you play: it translates the code of
the PS2's main processor into C++ and compiles it into a normal program. That gives you:

A real PC program for each game, with its own shortcut, instead of an emulator with a game loaded into it.
No translating while you play: the main processor's code is already translated, so the PC does not have to work
it out piece by piece. That part is fast, but it is only a small part of the work (see below).
A game whose code can be changed: fixes and improvements can go right into the game itself, not only around it.
That is what opens the door to the ideas below.

Not faster than PCSX2 yet
I measured both on the same laptop (Intel Core 5 120U with its built-in Intel graphics, Windows 11, November 2026), in
the same scenes, at the PS2's own resolution. PCSX2 was faster in every scene. But the goal still is to beat PCSX2
performance-wise.
PCSX2 also runs far more games today and has many years of work behind it. If your game doesn't run here yet, or runs too
slowly, PCSX2 is the better choice for now.
Under the hood, the rest of the console (graphics chip, vector units, sound, disc, controller, memory card) is rebuilt
in a runtime that draws with WebGPU (wgpu-native, on Vulkan or Direct3D 12). How that works.
Ideas for later
Not promises, just where this can go:

An in-game menu for resolution, picture look and 16:9.
A folder you can move: the game program and your disc image together, to take to another PC.
60 fps for games that run at 30, where the game allows it, and mods that change the game's code directly.
Faster than PCSX2, so more games reach full speed on built-in laptop graphics (today it is slower, see above).
The Steam Deck and other handhelds: Linux already works; it needs testing there.
More games: every report shows me what to fix next.

Offline runtime inspection
Developers can request exact screenshot frames and opt-in EE RAM window captures for repeatable offline recompilation
work. See docs/aot-window-capture.md. Capturing RAM does not itself prove that a
translated cache is complete or correct; the offline build and cache validation must establish that.

Playtesters wanted
I'm looking for people who try this with their own PS2 discs and tell me how it went: which games start, how far they
get, how fast they run, and what looks or sounds wrong. Every report helps, "it just worked" too, and so does every PC I
don't have, from weak laptops to big graphics cards.

Build a game you own (see Get started below) and play it.
When something looks, sounds or behaves wrong, press F9 right there. It notes the spot, and the game goes on.
Open a playtest report: the game,
your PC, how far you got, what went wrong, and the text of log.txt and info.txt from the newest folder in
reports\. If you'd rather not use GitHub, write to me at exoteric54@gmail.com.

Please don't attach disc images, save states or other files from the game; if I need more, I'll ask. Questions, ideas
and fixes are welcome too, as issues, pull requests or by e-mail.
Get started on Windows
With the app (nothing to install): on this page press Code, then Download ZIP. Unpack all of it into a short
folder such as C:\PS2Native and double-click Start.cmd (Windows asks once whether to run it: press Run). Press
Add a game, choose the disc image (an .iso, or a .zip or .7z that holds one), press Build, then Play. The
first build downloads the build tools it needs (about 312 MB, from their official release pages) into that folder;
building a game takes several minutes. Make desktop shortcut puts the game on the desktop.
From the command line (for developers):

Install llvm-mingw (UCRT), CMake, Ninja, Python 3 and Git for Windows. scripts\bootstrap.ps1 installs them with
winget. No Visual Studio is needed.
In Git Bash: bash scripts/setup.sh --native-only
bash scripts/port.sh mygame "/c/Games/My Game.iso" --native-only
Run the line port.sh prints at the end, for example
build/native-mygame/ps2run.exe games/mygame/disc/BOOT.ELF --disc games/mygame/disc.iso --window --memcard mygame.ps2

Get started on Linux
You need git, clang, CMake, Ninja, Python 3, the SDL2 development files and a Vulkan driver. Then
bash scripts/setup.sh --native-only and bash scripts/port.sh mygame "My Game.iso" --native-only, and run the line it
prints. Checked on CachyOS with an NVIDIA graphics card.
macOS: n0madic is the macOS maintainer: builds and tests it on an Apple Silicon Mac and looks after Mac issues and pull requests. GitHub also builds every change on macOS.
Playing

F1 shows all keys. They can be changed in keys.ini (the F1 card has a button for it).
Keyboard and mouse: W A S D is the left stick, the mouse buttons, Space, E, Q, F and Shift are the
game's buttons (the F1 card shows which is which), Esc is Start.
A game controller works too (any controller SDL knows).
F5 quick save, F8 quick load, F11 full screen, F2 switches between picture styles (including FSR 1,
FSR 1 + FXAA and a fast nearest-neighbour style), F3 sets the FPS limit (console, 30, 50, 60, 75, 90, 120, 144, 165,
240 or unlimited; above the console's speed the game runs faster and its sound is left out). F1's quick menu has the same
settings, plus FSR sharpness and FXAA strength.
Twice the resolution: set PS2_SCALE=2 before starting the game (for a strong graphics card).
Start without the keyboard: PS2_FPS_LIMIT (console, unlimited or a number from 1 to 1000), PS2_LOOK
(crisp, sharp_edges, fsr, fsr_fxaa, fast, ...), PS2_FSR_SHARPNESS and PS2_AA_STRENGTH (0 to 100).
Widescreen and other patches: in the app, Choose extras... looks up PCSX2's community patches for the game when you
ask it to. On the command line: port.sh --pnach FILE --pnach-section "Widescreen 16:9".
Parts of a game that the first build did not see are translated while you play and kept for the next start. The first
time, they can run slowly for a few seconds.

Your own disc
Everyone uses a disc image of their own disc. This repo contains no game code or data and never will: no disc images,
extracted files, generated C++, built game programs, screenshots, recordings or saves. The generated C++ and the built
programs are translations of the game's own code and belong to the game's owners: keep them on your own machine and do
not share them. Please do not ask for disc images here. There is no decryption or copy-protection code in this repo
(PS2 discs need none).
How it works
This explains the idea and what happens to a game, without going through the code. The basic design comes from the original
project, ps2-web-recomp: a translator plus a runtime, and the graphics chip as
programs on the graphics card. Windows, translating during play and most of the compatibility work came later.
The idea
A PS2 game is machine code for the console's processors. Here the code of the main processor is translated to C++ once,
before you play, and an ordinary compiler turns it into an ordinary program.
Only the main processor works that way. The game still expects a whole PS2 around it, so the program also carries a
runtime: C++ code that behaves like the rest of the console. The translated game writes to the graphics chip, starts
transfers and calls the system as it would on a PS2, and the runtime answers.

flowchart LR
subgraph once["Once per game: the build"]
disc["Your disc image"] --> tr["Translator: game code to C++"]
tr --> cc["C++ compiler"]
cc --> game["A program of its own"]
game -.->|"test runs find missed code"| tr
end
subgraph play["While you play"]
ee["Main processor: the translated game"] -->|"3D data"| vu["Vector units"]
vu -->|"shapes"| gs["Graphics chip: programs on your graphics card"]
ee <-->|"requests"| iop["Second processor: sound, disc, pads, memory card"]
end
game --> play

Loading

Part of the PS2
Its job
Here

Emotion Engine (EE), the main processor
runs the game
translated to C++ ahead of time

Vector units (VU0, VU1)
small processors for 3D maths, running short programs
programs translated ahead of time where they are known, otherwise interpreted (read and run one instruction at a time)

Graphics Synthesizer (GS)
draws shapes into its own 4 MiB of memory
compute programs on your graphics card

IOP, the second processor
runs driver programs from the game's disc
interpreted

SPU2 and IPU
the sound chip and the film decoder
rebuilt in C++

Kernel (the BIOS system services)
threads, interrupts, starting programs
rebuilt in C++; no BIOS image is used

Disc, memory card, pads

the disc image is read directly, the card is a file, the pads are your keyboard, mouse or controller

Building a game

Find the program. A small text file on the disc names the game's main program, and the build extracts it. Patches
such as widescreen are applied to it now, because a change to the code has to be in the translation. Gran Turismo 4 needs
one step written just for it: its program is packed on the disc and is unpacked first.
Find the code. A program file mixes code and data. The translator starts where the program starts and follows every

1u318q4.title: India’s Humyn Labs raises $47M to feed U.S. robotics companies the data they need
1u318q4.content:
As demand grows for real-world data to train robots, India’s Humyn Labs has raised $47 million in Series A financing to help U.S. AI and robotics companies build models that can operate in physical environments.

The funding comprises $26 million in equity led by Accel alongside Cactus Partners, with participation from Prosus Ventures, BeeGlobal, Bajaj Finance’s Finserv Intelligence and Bajaj Alts AI Opportunities Fund, Dallas Venture Capital, Lighthouse Canton, and Jump Trading. It also includes $21 million in venture debt led by Lighthouse Canton Growth Debt Fund II, with participation from Trifecta Capital.

Companies around the world are trying to build robots capable of performing everyday human tasks, but getting enough quality data to train them remains difficult. Startups including Mecka AI, XDOF, and MicroAGI are already tackling the problem by collecting real-world data for robotics training. Bengaluru-based Humyn Labs aims to compete with them.

Humyn Labs has developed its own two-camera hardware to record people performing everyday tasks. It then uses its software to process and label the footage, which means tagging what happens in each clip so AI can learn from it. The startup collects data across over 20 countries in Latin America and Asia, with Brazil, India, and South Korea serving as its main hubs, co-founder Manish Agarwal (pictured above, right) said in an interview.

Agarwal, the former CEO of Indian gaming company Nazara Technologies, founded Humyn Labs in February with Ishank Gupta (pictured above, left), a former executive at the brewing giant AB InBev. The duo previously founded Kratos Studios, now known as KGeN. KGeN has a network of contributors across emerging markets, and that network helps Humyn Labs collect data in people’s homes, the founders told TechCrunch.

Collecting footage of human activity is only part of the challenge, Agarwal said. He added that Humyn Labs also uses software to track hand movements, interactions with objects, and other details, turning raw recordings into data that AI models can learn from.

“Scale, diversity, and quality are important aspects, and they need to work in tandem,” Agarwal said.

Humyn Labs says it has 12 paying customers, including frontier AI labs, robotics companies, and developers of world models. About 90% of its revenue comes from the U.S., Gupta said, though he declined to name specific customers.

The startup generated $10 million in revenue between April and October and has another $20 million in signed contracts, Agarwal told TechCrunch, adding that a further $20 million in deals has yet to be finalized.

That growth has also increased Humyn Labs’ need for working capital, Agarwal said, explaining the $21 million venture debt component. The startup pays workers and data collection partners daily or weekly but typically waits 30 to 60 days to receive payments from its AI lab customers. Borrowing helps bridge that gap and is less dilutive than selling more equity, he said.

Over the last few months, India has emerged as a hub for collecting training data for so-called physical AI, with startups including Human Archive and BuildAI tapping into the country’s large workforce to record people performing everyday tasks. However, the practice has also raised questions about privacy and consent, particularly when people are recorded inside their homes.

Agarwal said Humyn Labs collects data from people doing their usual work or household chores instead of asking them to perform staged activities. The startup works with local partners to identify collection sites and oversee the process. “The worker is a worker who is incentivized, but he needs to be monitored and supervised for the right input,” he stated.

Humyn Labs currently has 51 full-time employees, most based in Bengaluru, plus a network of local partners across the countries where it collects data, Agarwal said.

g7f1gr.title: Президент Фінляндії відкинув можливість виходу країни з НАТО на вимогу Росії
g7f1gr.content:
Президент Фінляндії Александр Стубб заявив, що країна не переглядатиме свого членства в НАТО і не змінюватиме політику безпеки під тиском Росії.

Як передає Укрінформ, про це повідомляє Yle.

Стубба попросили прокоментувати інформацію про те, що під час мирних переговорів щодо України Росія нібито вимагала виходу Фінляндії з НАТО.

«Фінляндія залишиться у НАТО. Її членство в Альянсі за жодних обставин не буде переглянуто. Розмови про це не можна сприймати всерйоз», – заявив президент.

Стубб також наголосив, що Європа не змінюватиме систему безпеки під тиском Москви. Обговорювати відносини Росії з ЄС і НАТО можна буде лише після завершення війни проти України.

За словами Стубба, рішення про припинення війни може ухвалити лише очільник РФ Володимир Путін.

Як повідомлялося, за даними ЗМІ, під час неофіційних переговорів в Абу-Дабі російська делегація нібито вимагала виходу Фінляндії з НАТО, відмови Альянсу від військових баз у країнах Балтії та передавання Росії всього Донбасу.

8p914x.title: Grand Theft Auto 6 is currently the highest scoring video game of all time, according to Metacritic
8p914x.content: Grand Theft Auto 6 is currently the highest scoring video game of all time.That’s according to reviews aggregation site Metacritic, which currently has the game’s score sitting at 99 on both PlayStation 5 (after 109 reviews) and Xbox Series X/S (after nine reviews).This means at the time of writing the game is easily the highest rated game of the year so far, ahead of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake (which has a score of 96).More importantly, however, it also means the game is currently sitting at the number one spot on Metacritic’s Best Games of All Time list.Only one other game on this list – the original Nintendo 64 version of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time – also has a Metacritic score of 99.Metacritic’s internal calculations, however, which will define the game’s ‘true’ rating on a more granular level, have determined that at the time of writing Grand Theft Auto 6 has overtaken it.The site’s 10 Best Games of All Time reads as follows (with Metacritic score for its highest-scoring platform in parentheses):Grand Theft Auto 6 (PS5) (99)The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (N64) (99)SoulCalibur (Dreamcast) (98)Super Mario Galaxy 2 (Wii) (98)Grand Theft Auto 4 (Xbox 360) (98)Super Mario Galaxy (Wii) (97)Grand Theft Auto 5 (Xbox 360( (97)The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild (97)Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3 (PS2) (97)Perfect Dark (N64) (97)VGC’s Grand Theft Auto 6 review calls it “the game of the generation”, saying Rockstar “delivers its modern masterpiece with a remarkable artistic achievement that exceeds all expectations”.“Rockstar’s developers have created a remarkable open world that excels in storytelling, gameplay, visuals, music and technology to achieve something truly unmatched,” we wrote. “Minor performance issues don’t dull the sparkle of an absolute must-play experience. GTA 6 was more than worth the wait. “

14swi3s.title: Genomic breakthrough offers new hope for southern corroboree frog
14swi3s.content:
Southern corroboree frog and conservation settings. a Captive bred southern corroboree frog (Pseudophryne corroboree), b captive breeding colony of P. corroboree at Melbourne Zoo, and c) disease-free enclosures for P. corroboree within Mount Kosciuszko National Park. Credit: Mikaeylah J. Davidson et al. / npj Biodiversity (2026). DOI: 10.1038/s44185-026-00166-1

Researchers have shown for the first time that genomic selection—a breeding technique widely used in agriculture—could help one of Australia's most threatened frogs become more resilient to a deadly disease.

The southern corroboree frog (Pseudophryne corroboree) is considered functionally extinct due to chytridiomycosis, an infectious disease caused by the amphibian chytrid fungus. Captive breeding has kept the critically endangered species alive, but returning frogs to the wild remains difficult because the fungus persists in the environment.
The research published in npj Biodiversity found that southern corroboree frogs differ in how long they survive after exposure to chytrid fungus and that some of this variation is inherited.
Survival differences can be inherited
Lead author Dr. Mikaeylah Davidson completed the work as part of her Ph.D. at the University of Melbourne and said the study marks the first application of genomic selection in conservation.
"Using genomic data, we were able to show that survival following chytrid infection is a heritable trait, meaning some of the differences in survival are due to genetic differences that can be passed on to the next generation," Davidson said.
"This means there is genetic variation we could potentially use to improve survival through selective breeding.
"Excitingly, this approach is a potential way to move beyond simply keeping endangered frogs alive in captivity, toward actively improving their ability to cope with the threats preventing their recovery in the wild."

Predicting gains while protecting genetic diversity
The team of researchers from the University of Melbourne, James Cook University, the New South Wales government, Zoos Victoria and Taronga Conservation Society combined laboratory experiments with genome-wide genetic information, including a custom genotyping array developed for the southern corroboree frog.
Modeling indicated that genomic information could be used to guide breeding decisions and potentially increase average survival time after exposure to chytrid fungus by around 9% in the next generation, while managing inbreeding and retaining genetic diversity.
An established captive breeding program, supported through partnerships with Zoos Victoria and Taronga Conservation Society, provided an opportunity to see if genomic selection could work in practice.
Importantly, the research suggests improved disease resilience does not need to come at the expense of genetic diversity. This is particularly significant for small, critically endangered populations, where maintaining diversity and limiting inbreeding are central to long-term population health and evolutionary potential.
Potential beyond the corroboree frog
Senior author University of Melbourne professor Lee Skerratt said the approach may also have potential for other threatened wildlife affected by persistent disease, particularly species already managed through captive breeding.
"Amphibians are an important focus, with hundreds of species now maintained in captivity for conservation as chytrid fungus continues to threaten populations globally," Skerratt, from the Melbourne Veterinary School, said.
"Genomic selection could help conservation breeding programs move beyond preventing extinction by moving animals into captivity toward actively supporting animals' ability to survive threats in the wild."
This research builds on six years of work to develop the genomic tools and disease data sets needed to explore new conservation strategies for the critically endangered southern corroboree frog. By combining a newly mapped genome and custom genotyping array with extensive disease-resilience data, researchers were able to investigate selective breeding as a proactive approach to species recovery.
Testing whether gains translate to the wild
The next stage of the research is to improve and validate the predictions using genomic information from more of the breeding population and to explore other genetic approaches to improve disease resistance.
Researchers will also test whether predicted improvements are realized in subsequent generations and, critically, whether greater survival under laboratory conditions translates into better outcomes in the wild.
Davidson is now a research fellow at James Cook University.

More information
Mikaeylah J. Davidson et al., Genomic selection to enhance disease resilience in an endangered species, npj Biodiversity (2026). DOI: 10.1038/s44185-026-00166-1

18sn90i.title: Ukraine Sidesteps Starlink Throttling With Crimea Bridge Strike
18sn90i.content:
Ukraine struck the bridge linking Russia to annexed Crimea without using Elon Musk’s Starlink satellite networks, Britain’s The Times newspaper reported Tuesday, citing an unidentified military officer involved in the operation. 
The Kerch Bridge’s main road arch crumbled into the sea after two drone and missile attacks in as many days. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky called it retaliation for Russian strikes on Ukrainian infrastructure.
Meanwhile, Zelensky criticized SpaceX’s speed restrictions on its military-grade Starshield satellite terminals for the second time in as many months, arguing that the limits hampered Ukraine’s military capabilities, including air defense capabilities against Russian drones.
A Ukrainian officer quoted by The Times said the Kerch Bridge strike proved that Kyiv no longer needs to rely on Starshield networks for these types of missions.
“For the first time in history, we used all these drones to pass video signals to missiles so they could hit precise points on the bridge. We showed we can conduct such operations without Starlink,” the officer said.
“The Americans tried to paralyze our connectivity to conduct such operations, but this mission proved we can develop our own connections to relay radio signals,” he added.

Zelensky said the strike followed an unprecedented operation that methodically destroyed Russian air defenses, radar systems and electronic warfare capabilities.
Zelensky said the final stage was the decisive one. Palianytsia drones hit the road section of the bridge, while the rail section was hit by Neptune missiles and by Ruta and FP-5 drones.
Zelensky said Ukrainian forces carried out a precision-guided strike using Flamingo missiles, with the communications uplink working “flawlessly until the very last seconds.”
The 19-kilometer (12-mile) bridge is a flagship project inaugurated by Putin in 2018 and a symbol of Russia's attachment to the peninsula it captured and annexed from Ukraine in 2014.
The bridge over the Kerch Strait was once a key supply route for Russian forces in Ukraine, but the military now relies more heavily on a land corridor running through parts of eastern and southern Ukraine that Russia has captured since launching a full-scale war with its neighbor in 2022.

Ukraine has attacked the bridge several times during the war. A truck bomb in October 2022 killed four people and limited the bridge's capacity for months. In July 2023, a section of the road bridge was destroyed, and a couple crossing by car were killed.
The Kremlin has vowed to rebuild the span “even better than before.” But Russian military bloggers and other experts said repairs would be challenging given Ukraine's capacity for further attacks.
The timing was awkward for the Kremlin leader ahead of his meeting in Shenzhen on Thursday with U.S. President Donald Trump and China's Xi Jinping, where the three are expected to discuss the Ukraine war among other topics.
Reuters contributed reporting.

fgzz.title: Газель NN стала доступнее: стартовали продажи обновленной версии «Стандарт»
fgzz.content: Компания «Современные транспортные технологии» объявила о начале продаж автомобилей Газель NN в обновленной комплектации «Стандарт».Заказать такую машину уже можно у официальных дилеров.Новая версия сочетает в себе выразительный внешний вид поколения NN и неприхотливость Газели NEXT. Главное визуальное отличие – оперение кабины от флагманской модели со светодиодными фарами, которые обеспечивают раздельные модули ближнего и дальнего света.Теперь семейство NN делится на две линейки в едином фирменном стиле: богатую «Комфорт» и более доступную «Стандарт». В салоне бюджетной версии установлены панель приборов, сиденья и дверные карты от модели NEXT. При этом все автомобили «Стандарт» оснащаются подушкой безопасности, системой динамической стабилизации ESC и дисковыми тормозами на всех колесах, а также широким выбором силовых агрегатов.Генеральный директор СТТ Олег Марков отметил, что появление новой комплектации – это шаг навстречу клиентам, которым нужен современный облик и эффективный светодиодный свет, но по более доступной цене, чем полностью оснащенная модель NN.Раньше владельцы Газелей NEXT самостоятельно устанавливали переднее оперение от NN, а теперь такой тюнинг не нужен, поскольку заводское решение с гарантией уже доступно.Автомобили Газель NN Стандарт предлагаются во всех кузовных модификациях полной массой 3,5 и 4,6 тонны. На выбор доступны четыре двигателя: дизельный G51А мощностью 149,6 л.с., бензиновый Evotech A275 на 107 л.с., битопливный Evotech A2755 для работы на пропан-бутане и метановый Evotech A3055 на 122 л.с.В базовое оснащение входит 5-ступенчатая коробка передач, для дизельных версий опционально доступна 6-ступенчатая. Задний мост имеет двухскатную ошиновку, а для дизельных машин полной массой 3,5 тонны можно заказать усиленную подвеску в рамках опции «тяжелые условия эксплуатации».Понравилась публикация?Тогда добавьте «За рулем» в список интересных источников: 1. Откройте https://google.com... 2. Поставьте галочку напротив нашего изданияГотово – остаемся на связи! «За рулем» можно читать и в ТелеграмИсточник:  СТТ

g3bdxn.title: GTA VI использует AMD FSR 4 на Xbox Series S: масштабирование с 720p до 1080p и трассировка лучей
g3bdxn.content:
Во время подготовки обзора Grand Theft Auto VI компания Rockstar Games предоставила возможность задать несколько вопросов разработчикам. Поскольку наше издание специализируется на технологиях, нас интересовало множество подробностей о целях студии при разработке новой версии движка RAGE.
Пытались ли разработчики добиться частоты кадров выше 30 FPS? Какое разрешение рендеринга используется на каждой консоли? С какими трудностями столкнулась команда при внедрении глобального освещения с трассировкой лучей и какой подход был выбран для поддержки HDR?
Ответы на все эти вопросы содержатся в подробном заявлении, подготовленном старшим вице-президентом по технологиям Джонатоном Эшкрофтом (Jonathon Ashcroft), техническим директором по движку и графике Крисом Оутом (Chris Oat), а также директором по производству технологий Марком Чемберсом (Marc Chambers).
«Уже на ранних этапах разработки стало ясно, что с учётом масштабов наших амбиций мы будем ориентироваться на 30 кадров в секунду на оборудовании текущего поколения. Мы приложили немало усилий, чтобы найти баланс между визуальным качеством, симуляцией и игровым процессом, а также обеспечить значительно меньшую задержку ввода по сравнению с Grand Theft Auto V и Red Dead Redemption 2.
Частью этого процесса стало определение базового разрешения и технологии масштабирования. Мы оценили различные подходы для каждой консоли, после чего выбрали сочетание решений, обеспечивающее необходимое качество изображения и производительность.

PlayStation 5 и Xbox Series X: базовое разрешение составляет 1440p, которое масштабируется до 4K с помощью нашей собственной технологии временного сглаживания TAA.
Xbox Series S: используется базовое разрешение 720p, масштабируемое до 1080p с помощью AMD FSR Upscaling 4 (примечание редакции: технология появилась на Xbox Series всего несколько недель назад).
PlayStation 5 Pro: мы используем PSSR2 для масштабирования изображения с базового разрешения 1440p до 4K.

На всех платформах полученное изображение затем объединяется с пользовательским интерфейсом в разрешении 4K и выводится на экран. Для каждой консоли мы подбирали решение после тщательной оценки как визуального качества, так и производительности.
С самого начала мы создавали основные системы освещения, обработки кадров и финального вывода изображения с учётом поддержки HDR и SDR. Источники света внутри игрового движка были откалиброваны в соответствии с реальными физическими свойствами естественного и искусственного освещения.
Мы также разработали новую библиотеку физически корректных материалов, которая используется для отображения всех типов поверхностей, встречающихся в игре. От того, как влажная кожа аллигатора блестит под солнцем Леониды, до реакции волос и одежды на динамическое световое шоу в ночном клубе, а также сложных взаимодействий света с экзотической автомобильной краской, когда машина проносится под уличными фонарями на шоссе, — всё создавалось с учётом физических законов распространения света.
Наконец, сформированный кадр проходит через систему обработки изображения, смоделированную по принципам работы настоящих кинокамер и обработки киноплёнки, как это можно ожидать от современного фильма. Наша цель всегда заключалась в создании и сохранении эффекта погружения, чтобы игроки могли воспринимать игру именно так, как её задумала команда, независимо от того, используют они HDR или SDR.
Такое внимание к освещению сделало крайне важным использование единого решения на всех консолях, включая Xbox Series S, где ограничения памяти представляли определённую сложность. Однако полученные результаты оправдали усилия по преодолению этой проблемы.
Разумеется, между реализациями на разных консолях существуют некоторые различия, поскольку мы корректируем возможности глобального освещения с трассировкой лучей (RTGI), чтобы добиться наилучшего изображения с учётом характеристик каждой платформы. Как и во всём остальном, мы настраиваем технологию под конкретное оборудование для достижения желаемого визуального результата, поэтому универсального решения здесь нет».
Кроме того, я задал Rockstar ещё несколько вопросов художественного характера. На них отдельно ответил вице-президент студии по художественному направлению Майкл Кейн (Michael Kane). Его ответы приведены ниже.
Вопрос: Углы экрана в игре часто выглядят немного затемнёнными, словно используется эффект виньетирования. Можете ли вы подтвердить, что это действительно так? Если да, можно ли добавить возможность отключения этого эффекта для тех, кому он не нравится?
Майкл Кейн, вице-президент по художественному направлению:
Динамический эффект виньетирования — это художественное решение. В настоящее время мы не предусматриваем возможности его отключения, однако недавно обнаружили и исправили проблему, из-за которой в определённых обстоятельствах эффект становился сильнее, чем предполагалось.
Вопрос: На ключевых иллюстрациях Grand Theft Auto VI Джейсон заметно отличается от своего игрового воплощения, тогда как Люсия выглядит гораздо ближе к нему. Как менялся дизайн каждого персонажа в процессе разработки и можете ли вы рассказать о конкретных источниках вдохновения или референсах?
Майкл Кейн, вице-президент по художественному направлению:
Восприятие персонажей на ключевых иллюстрациях и непосредственно в игре может различаться, особенно в случае Джейсона. Поскольку оба персонажа обладают широкими возможностями персонализации, мы предполагаем, что многие игроки захотят, чтобы "их Джейсон" носил усы, длинные волосы определённой причёски или цвета и так далее.
Пока мы показывали такие разнообразные варианты его внешности только на скриншотах, но не на основных рекламных иллюстрациях. Поэтому именно его внешний вид непосредственно в игре лучше всего отражает наш первоначальный замысел.

gh-1439286882.title: GitHub - gustavomorinaga/project-vekta: Killzone HD // Unofficial PC Port (static recompilation). Work in progress, partly playable. Builds on your PC from your own game.
gh-1439286882.content:
Killzone HD: unofficial PC port (static recompilation)

Install · Status · Features ·
Screenshots · Requirements ·
Getting your files · Building · How it works · Known issues ·
Roadmap · Glossary · AI use ·
Contributing · Forking
Vekta is the ISA colony world where the first Killzone is fought. Project Vekta is a fan project, not official and
not affiliated with or endorsed by Sony Interactive Entertainment or Guerrilla Games.
What this is: a static recompilation of Killzone HD, the PS3 remaster of the first Killzone (title NPUA80856,
the package on the Killzone Trilogy disc). The game's PowerPC (PPU) and Cell SPU code is translated to C++ ahead of
time with ps3recomp (pinned at v0.19.0, plus this project's patches in
port/patches/) and compiled into a native Linux or Windows x64 program. It is not an emulator (no CPU emulator
runs at play time) and not a rewrite (the game's logic is the game's own code). Around that code, the PS3's
system libraries and hardware behaviour are reimplemented on PC APIs, and the game's graphics commands are replayed
on Vulkan.
You need your own copy of the game. This repository contains only the port: source code, patches to the
recompiler, tools and documentation. It contains no game code, data, assets, keys or firmware, and it never will.
Each player translates and builds the game's code on their own machine, from their own files.
What you need

Your own game: Killzone HD (NPUA80856), installed from your own Killzone Trilogy disc, and PS3 system
software 4.93 (its dev_flash, for the music). When both are installed in your RPCS3, the installers use them and
your RPCS3 makes decrypted copies of the game's EBOOT and the firmware's libsre; otherwise you give those two
decrypted files yourself. The game's data archive is read as it is installed. What each file must be, and how the
scripts check them: docs/GETTING-FILES.md; every install step:
docs/INSTALL.md.
A PC: Windows x64 or Linux x64, a CPU with AVX2 (x86-64-v3), and a Vulkan graphics card and driver
(docs/requirements.md).
Disk space: about 4 GB for the game files, plus, free, about 2.4 GB on Windows (5.6 GB where Windows cannot
make links) or 1.9 GB on Linux for the port and its build, and 3.1 GB more when the game's data archive is opened
from the installed game (docs/requirements.md).

The release downloads bring their own build tools: nothing else to install on Windows, and on Linux only Python 3.10
or newer, glibc 2.31 or newer, SDL2 and a Vulkan driver.
How to play
Latest release: v0.5.2, a pre-release.
Every download builds the port on your PC from your own files, once, in about five minutes. Each download has its
SHA-256 sum in SHA256SUMS and in a .sha256 file beside it.

Windows, setup program (project-vekta-X.Y.Z-setup.exe): it asks where your files are, builds, and puts
Project Vekta in the Start menu.
Windows, zip (project-vekta-X.Y.Z-windows.zip): the same folder without the setup. run.cmd asks where your
files are and builds; play.cmd plays.
Linux folder (project-vekta-X.Y.Z-linux.tar.gz): ./run.sh builds, ./play.sh plays.

Step by step, with what you see at each step: docs/INSTALL.md. To build from a Git clone or
the source archive instead: For developers.
Status
As of 2026-11-16, on Linux x64 with an NVIDIA RTX 3070 Ti, the maintainer's machine:

Code translation
the whole EBOOT is translated (about 23,400 PPU functions) plus the SPU programs, job modules and the firmware pieces the game loads; this repository's scripts rebuild it byte for byte from the player's files

Boot, menus, movies
work: intro movies, front end, options, pause menu, saves and Continue

Campaign
the whole campaign, levels 1 to 11, played from start to end on Linux and on Windows (2026-11-16); the levels are not yet each compared with reference footage

Frame rate
a steady 60 frames per second by default (the game logic runs at 60 Hz instead of the PS3's 30); an optional 144 Hz mode reaches about 131 to 134 frames per second in Level 1 and Level 7

Sound
stereo, 5.1 and 7.1 output (the game's own mixer fills the extra channels); music through the firmware's MP3 decoder

Windows
the Windows exe is cross-built on Linux and runs under Wine, Proton and on a real Windows; the whole campaign plays there from start to end (2026-11-16); speed under Wine and Proton is lower (about 100 frames per second in Level 7)

Distribution
you build the port from your own files: on Windows the setup program or folder builds it on your PC (since 0.2.0); on Linux from source, or (since 0.3.0) a Linux folder with its own toolchain (no compiler or packages needed)

What works and what does not, item by item: docs/FEATURES.md. Open problems:
docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md.
PC features
All optional, set in a PC page inside the game's own Options and Pause menus and kept in kz1hd_pc.ini:

display mode (window, borderless, fullscreen), output resolution, internal resolution scale, V-Sync (on, off,
adaptive), VRR, frame-rate limit (30, 60, 144), NVIDIA Reflex
AMD FSR 1 upscaling and RCAS sharpening, anisotropic filtering (the game's own or 2x to 16x)
temporal upscaling on Linux and Windows: AMD FSR 3.1 in every build, and NVIDIA DLSS (Super Resolution and DLAA)
when you choose to download it at install (docs/dev/upscalers.md)
any aspect ratio (Hor+ for 21:9, 32:9 and wider, the game's own 4:3 view for 4:3 and 16:10, a forced ratio if you
want one, with the menus and movies kept 16:9), field of view for the world and,
apart, the first-person weapon (70 to 120 degrees at 16:9), HUD size and position
presets: Original (PS3), Performance, Balanced, Quality
keyboard and mouse (direct mouse look, mouse in menus, remappable keys), Xbox, PlayStation, Nintendo and generic
controllers through SDL, with button prompts that follow the device in use
stereo, 5.1 or 7.1 sound; game language; skip the opening movie; local trophies from the game's own trophy set

What goes online
Nothing, unless you choose it. The port and its scripts make no network connection of their own. The downloads are
the ones you start: cloning this repository with its ps3recomp submodule, your system's packages, the build tools'
Python packages, and these, only when you choose them:

NVIDIA DLSS: only if you accept NVIDIA's DLSS SDK licence when tools/install.sh or run.cmd asks, or tick
the Windows setup's DLSS box (unticked by default), or pass --dlss accept, the build downloads the DLSS SDK's files from NVIDIA's repository on GitHub
(raw.githubusercontent.com/NVIDIA/DLSS, pinned to v310.9.16 and checked by SHA-256) into
work/toolchain-cache/dlss-sdk/. The question first downloads the licence's text from there, for you to read.
Declined, nothing is downloaded and the build has no DLSS.
New-version check (off by default): turned on with KZ_VERSION_CHECK=1, or with
tools/release/version_check.py --enable in an install made by the setup program, the launcher asks GitHub's public
API for this project's latest release (api.github.com/repos/gustavomorinaga/project-vekta/releases) at most
once a day, before the game starts, and names a newer one. The request carries no identifier; nothing is downloaded
or installed. tools/release/version_check.py --disable or KZ_VERSION_CHECK=0 turns it off.

Where your data goes
Everything stays in the folder the game runs from, work/vfs/ (made by tools/setup-vfs.sh): the PC settings in
kz1hd_pc.ini, the key map in kz1hd_keys.ini, saves under gamedata/dev_hdd0/home/00000001/savedata/, and the
local trophy log in gamedata/trophies/. The log of a run goes to work/play.log. Nothing is written outside the
repository's work/ folder, and nothing is written into your game files. The Windows setup program is the one
exception: unless you pick its "Portable" option, the settings and saves go to %APPDATA%\Project Vekta instead.
How it works, briefly

PPU: the game's PowerPC functions are lifted to C++ by ps3recomp's lifter and compiled with clang; a few hot
functions are reimplemented natively (port/kz1hd/native_ppu/).
SPU: the SPU programs and the WWS job modules are lifted the same way; SPURS runs on host threads; some SPU
jobs run as native C (port/kz1hd/native/).
Graphics: the game's RSX command stream is replayed on Vulkan, with PC options (scaling, FSR 1, widescreen)
applied around it.
Data: the game reads its own archive through its own file system code; movies are decoded with FFmpeg.

More: docs/HOW-IT-WORKS.md. General fixes are offered to ps3recomp upstream.
How AI was used
This project is developed by one person with AI coding agents (Claude Code). The agents did most of the work of
reading the game's binary and reference material, writing and testing patches, tools and documentation, and running
the builds, with the maintainer setting the goals, playing and checking the game, reviewing what they produced and
deciding what is published. Findings are dated; an ASSUMPTION: in the code or the docs is not fact. If you find a
statement here that was not verified, please open an issue.
Related projects

Project Helghast (Killzone 3) and
Project Pyrrhus (Killzone 2), by undecuple: the same approach for
the rest of the trilogy, and the model for this repository's layout. Credits: NOTICE.md.
ps3recomp, the recompiler this port is built on.

Official channels
Project Vekta is made by Gustavo Morinaga: GitHub @gustavomorinaga, and
the project site https://gustavomorinaga.github.io/project-vekta/. Code and, when there are any, builds come only
from this repository. We never ask anyone to paste a command they were sent into a terminal or PowerShell.
Anyone else offering builds, "fixes" or donations in this project's name is not us.
Contributing
Tests on other hardware, reports with logs, and fixes are welcome: CONTRIBUTING.md. The
rules for everyone, people and AI coding agents alike, are in AGENTS.md. Security problems and rights
holders' reports go privately through the Security tab (SECURITY.md).
For developers: building from source
On Linux, from a clone or the release's source archive, you need clang, CMake, Ninja, Python 3, SDL2, zlib,
glslang and the Vulkan headers; for the Windows exe, the MinGW-w64 sysroot as well. All of it is in
docs/BUILDING.md.
The short way, from a release's archive or a clone: one command asks where your files are, checks them, and builds
with one progress bar; it remembers the paths, so afterwards tools/play.sh is all you need.
tools/install.sh
tools/play.sh
Step by step (what tools/install.sh runs):
git clone --recurse-submodules https://github.com/gustavomorinaga/project-vekta
cd project-vekta
tools/ps3recomp-patched.sh # ps3recomp v0.19.0 with port/patches applied, in work/
tools/lift.sh # translates your EBOOT, SPU code and firmware pieces, in work/lift
tools/setup-vfs.sh # the folder the game runs from, in work/vfs
tools/build.sh # work/build/KZ1HD
tools/play.sh # plays in a window
Repository layout

Path
What it holds

port/kz1hd/
the program: boot, game clock, window, HLE overrides, the PC menu, native SPU and PPU code

port/patches/
numbered patches to ps3recomp and series, the order they apply in

third_party/ps3recomp/
the recompiler, a pinned submodule (never edited in place)

tools/
patch, lift, build, run and check scripts; data and profiling tools

re/
tables the tools read; numbers only

docs/
the public documentation; docs/dev/ holds engineering notes

site/, assets/
the project page and its images

Licence
The port is MIT (LICENSE): that licence covers the port only, its code, patches, tools and documentation.
Third-party parts and credits are in NOTICE.md. Killzone and Killzone HD are (c) Sony Interactive
Entertainment; nothing of the game is licensed or included here.

arm64 macOS, built on XenonRecomp.
ImportantFM4 Recomp is an unofficial fan project, not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by
Microsoft, Xbox Game Studios or Turn 10 Studios. No game files are included or distributed.
You need your own legally obtained Xbox 360 copy of Forza Motorsport 4; please do not request
or share game files or disc images. What this repository and the macOS DMG contain:

first public beta. It plays the game in a window with sound, from the title screen through the
menus into a race, with a gamepad or the keyboard, from your own Disc 1 (Disc 2 is optional). It
is an early, unoptimised build: expect a low frame rate. To install it, follow
Getting started; the release notes list its known issues.
Changes by release are in CHANGELOG.md. The public status of each milestone, the
beta's contents and its known issues are in docs/status.md. See also
Compatibility and the FAQ.
Approach
FM4 Recomp statically recompiles the game's executable code for arm64 and runs it on a native
runtime that reimplements the platform it was written for. Here the guest is the Xbox 360
(PowerPC code, the console's kernel and system functions, the Xenos GPU, XMA audio), so the
runtime replaces those, drawing through Vulkan on Metal. A release ships FM4 Recomp: the setup
app, the runtime and open-source tools and libraries. It contains no game data; setup reads your
own disc. Its program contains code translated by machine from the game's executable
(docs/LEGAL.md). See How it works; the design notes are in
reference/.
Building from source
scripts/setup_tools.sh # pinned tools into tools/
scripts/extract_game.sh <dir with your ISOs> <out dir> # unpack your discs outside the repo
mkdir -p game && ln -sfn <out dir>/disc1 game/files
The remaining steps and the rules for changes are in CONTRIBUTING.md. Saves of
a development build are stored in game/user-data/ and use a fixed, built-in compatibility key
(the console's own key is unknown). Compatibility with real Xbox 360 saves is unverified:
saves made here are expected to load only here.
Contributing and security
See CONTRIBUTING.md and SUPPORT.md for support and reporting
channels. Report security problems privately, as described in SECURITY.md.
Community conduct reports are covered in CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md.
License
FM4 Recomp is free software under the GNU General Public License, version 3 or (at your option)
any later version (GPL-3.0-or-later): see COPYING and NOTICE. Third-party
components and their licences are listed in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

1earaag.title: Rockstar официально подтвердила: в GTA 6 не добавят режимы 60 или 40 FPS даже на PS5 Pro
1earaag.content:
Компания Rockstar Games впервые дала официальный комментарий по поводу частоты кадров в Grand Theft Auto 6 и окончательно закрыла вопрос о возможном появлении режима повышенной производительности в будущих патчах. Разработчики подтвердили изданию Kotaku, что игра останется заблокированной на 30 кадрах в секунду на всех консолях текущего поколения, включая флагманскую PlayStation 5 Pro.
Ранее многие владельцы PS5 Pro и телевизоров с частотой 120 Гц рассчитывали, что студия добавит поддержку 60 или хотя бы компромиссных 40 FPS после релиза. Однако директор по технологическому производству Rockstar Марк Чемберс официально заявил, что этого не произойдёт из-за ограничений центрального процессора консоли.
«В базовой версии мы используем отражения и глобальное освещение с трассировкой лучей. На PS5 Pro картинка дополнительно улучшена за счёт теней с трассировкой лучей, а также повышенной чёткости благодаря технологии масштабирования PSSR. В PS5 Pro установлен более мощный графический чип и продвинутый апскейлер, которые мы задействовали для улучшения качества изображения. Однако центральный процессор этой консоли лишь немного быстрее, чем в базовой PS5, и его мощности недостаточно для обработки сложной симуляции мира игры при более высокой частоте кадров», — заявил Марк Чемберс.
Таким образом, единственными платформами, где Grand Theft Auto 6 сможет работать при 60 FPS и выше, останутся мощные игровые ПК, а также консоли следующего поколения после выхода соответствующих переизданий.

193kxep.title: Netflix UK Swoops For Ms Apple’s Pre-School Learning Adventures
193kxep.content:
EXCLUSIVE: Netflix UK might have found its British Ms. Rachel.

The streamer’s UK and Ireland team has acquired a 10-episode collection of pre-school programmes from British kids entertainer duo Ms Apple, which goes live next week.

Ms Apple, whose YouTube channel has more than 200,000 subs, is the creation of Emma Wilson and Dhruva Grant, a duo with backgrounds in music and education. After teaching young children and later welcoming their son, they built the channel around the kind of content they wanted for their own family, in a similar vein to Ms. Rachel.

The Netflix UK collection takes babies and toddlers on learning adventures exploring first words, sensory play, farm animals, woodland discoveries and sing-along songs. Through music, play and gentle, lower-stimulation storytelling, it introduces language, colours and counting in a calm, engaging way.

The move comes a couple of years after Netflix worldwide swooped for Ms. Rachel’s collection, which is frequently in its top-10 most-viewed shows and is one of its top-rated kids shows of all time. Children’s content has proved lucrative for Netflix, which is having its own struggles at present. No word yet on whether Ms Apple could make it to Netflix U.S.

Grant said: “We’re so excited to be bringing Ms Apple to Netflix UK and Ireland. Over the last four years, we’ve worked really hard to create authentic, gentle and quality music and videos for little ones and their families. It’s something we’re incredibly passionate about, so to now be able to share what we do with even more families is just wonderful.”

Ms Apple’s “Learn with Ms Apple” channel is repped globally by MVE, which said Ms Apple has “created something so special.” “Bringing her learning adventures to Netflix is an exciting next step in her journey,” added the agency. “We’re proud to represent her and can’t wait for families to enjoy her content.”

1ou9z7w.title: Art experiments reveal artists' intuitive grasp of what makes images memorable
1ou9z7w.content:
Credit: Mikhail Nilov from Pexels

Why do some artworks stick in our minds, while others fade away soon after we view them?

A new study published in Psychological Science suggests that it's partly because the artists themselves can imbue their works with memorability.
Researchers at the University of Chicago tested this ability by conducting a nationwide art contest, asking artists across the country to create works that were intended to be either memorable or forgettable. They found not only that artists were successful in completing this task, but also that a deep learning model was most adept at predicting memorability. These findings provide insights into how artists may intuitively understand memory and how technology can predict it.
"Our study suggests that artists can offer valuable insights into memory," said Yifei Chen, a co-author of the new study. "They seem to have an intuitive sense of what makes artworks actually stick in people's minds."
Memorable art holds up in the gallery
Chen and her colleagues collected art contest submissions over the course of three months for the study. They received a total of 86 submissions that adhered to the contest's rules and first tested the memorability of the artworks with a group of online participants. Overall, the researchers found that the works submitted to the "memorable" category were more likely to be remembered and that "forgettable" works tended to slip the mind. Analyses also showed that simpler artworks, as well as ones with fewer repetitive elements and less symmetry, were more memorable.
The team then chose 20 of the most memorable and 20 of the most forgettable artworks from these subsets. They asked the artists to ship their art to Chicago for a monthlong gallery exhibit. When the exhibition opened, visitors could freely move through the gallery, after which their memory of the artworks was tested. "The same pattern held in the gallery: Artworks that were more memorable online were also better remembered in person," Chen said.
"It was a very risky experiment for our lab," noted Wilma Bainbridge, senior author of the paper and Chen's adviser, as the gallery had only 40 pieces and an overarching theme of memory. The experiment was also captured in a short documentary.
"But even still, they forgot the forgettable pieces and remembered the memorable ones, which shows how strong this effect really is," she said. "It works on the order of just a few minutes, even in highly motivated people in this real-world setting."

AI outperforms human predictions
Finally, the researchers tested whether memory of artworks could be predicted by artists, online laypeople without any art expertise or a neural network model called ResMem that was developed by researchers to predict image memorability. In the new study, ResMem performed best at distinguishing the most and least memorable artworks, followed by artists' submission categories, then ratings by laypeople.
"ResMem had only been trained on photographs," Chen explained, making these new, original works a test of its ability. And yet, it did "much better than any human can do," she said, highlighting that "what people think is memorable is different from what actually is."
Designing visuals to support memory
Although artists weren't as proficient as AI in predicting memorability, their success in designing for memory suggests they could be valuable scientific collaborators. Studying their creative choices could help researchers understand which visual features support memory and how those features might be deliberately shaped. "This gives us so much potential for tapping into what drives memorability," Chen said.
Refining models like ResMem could also help artists find tangible ways to make their works stand out or help exhibit designers arrange galleries.
Bainbridge adds that ResMem could also be applied in a broader educational context, such as finding out what kinds of visuals may help children, patients or other groups learn information that is difficult to remember. "Our preliminary findings are that if you have a memorable picture with all this information, they learn that additional information better, too," Bainbridge said.
These findings contribute to a growing body of work examining how the properties of images and the real-world contexts in which they are encountered can shape what we remember, Chen said. Because memory research has often focused on processes within the viewer, studying the relationships between visuals and memory in everyday settings is, as Chen says, "a direction that the whole field could explore further in the future."

Publication details
Trent M. Davis et al., Artists Can Design Memory, and AI Can Predict It, Psychological Science (2026). DOI: 10.1177/09567976261483544

Who's behind this story?

Swati Mestri

Swati Mestri holds a bachelor's degree in Electronics Engineering and has worked as a content editor since 2019. She has experience editing research documents across technology, health care, and materials science, and has a particular interest in technology and space.

Full profile →

Andrew Zinin

Master's in physics with research experience. Long-time science news enthusiast. Plays key role in Science X's editorial success.

Full profile →
