y2h9aw.content:
PC

Featuring five stages, five main bosses, and two secret bosses.
Wuxia hack-and-slash action game Burning Sword: Death Sun is now available in Early Access for PC via Steam at a 10 percent-off launch discount price of $17.99, developer Nomadic Games announced. The Early Access version includes the following content:Five handcrafted stages, each with secrets off the main path.Five bosses and two secret bosses.The full combat system: Power Gauge, Ignite, Quick Shot, Qi Drain, and three equipped skills.The Hub for customization, and Arena Mode for an endless, arcade-style score attack.The game will be updated throughout Early Access with more stages, bosses, and skills, before an eventual version 1.0 release.Here is an overview of the game, via its Steam page:About
Burning Sword: Death Sun tells the story of Zhang Yixian and his pursuit of power and vengeance for the death of his master. Hardcore action combat meets epic boss battles and careful customization, interwoven with subtle environmental storytelling and worldbuilding. Burning Sword: Death Sun emphasizes challenge, progression, and deep combat systems.Explore 12th Century ChinaThe story is told subtly, but is full of character, political intrigue, and power dynamics. Starting in the year 1139 during the Southern Song Dynasty, you play as Zhang Yixian just as he’s cast down and nearly killed by the Elder of the Northern Mountain. The martial arts emerged during moments in history like this, when tyranny and brutality must be met with strength and passion.Intense Chinese Martial Arts CombatEnter the Burning Sword. Key combat features include:JianfaWuxia-based swordplay and bodily attacks combine into a fierce and flexible combat style that leaves lots of room for experimentation.Players will dodge, parry, strike, combo, and acquire powerful techniques to carve a bloody path through mobs of enemies and make their way back to the Elder to finish the job. The combat rewards skill and timing, and punishes mistakes harshly.QiYixian’s fury gives birth to a fiery Qi and the ability to wield a burning sword. Qi restores vitality, fuels techniques, and augments combat abilities. It is a scarce but critical resource.Qi Drain – A forbidden technique that drains life and Qi from enemies when their Qi vessel is exposed.Rebound – Launch nearby objects into enemies to create an opening for your next attack.QinggongThis martial art also emphasizes agility, speed, lightness and ease of traversal, letting Yixian jump, wall-run, glide, and explore an expansive world.Replayability Through the ArenaFinally, because the combat is this fun and rewarding, the game also includes an arena that allows for endless replayability, with a high score system that can be pushed as far as your skill allows.Attain power. Achieve vengeance. Restore order… or let the world burn.Watch a new trailer below.Early Access Launch Trailer

15siowx.title: ‘Secret Lives of Mormon Wives’ EPs on How ‘Orange County’ Became the First Franchise Extension, Season 2 Hopes and “Exploring” More Spinoffs
15siowx.content:
Logo text

Hulu’s first extension of The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives franchise arrived on the streamer last Thursday, introducing viewers to a brand-new pool of women based in Southern California who are in some way connected to the LDS faith.

The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County has caused a stir online, proving that the format of the original series works with the franchise treatment. The online buzz has translated into viewership: season one accumulated 20 million hours in its first five days of streaming, a 12 percent increase over season five of the original series.

So, what actually is in the secret sauce in Hulu’s The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives format? Executive producers Jeff Jenkins and Lisa Filipelli both agree everything boils down to casting.

“A docuseries, in my opinion, is only as good as the folks who are the subject, who are on camera, right? So we just try really hard to collaborate with our cast members and bring their stories forward,” Jenkins says. “It just goes back to story and sharing. We look for subjects, castmembers, who are really ready to share. It’s not an easy thing to do.”

Most of the women, like the original show, have built a presence on social media before reality television cameras began capturing their lives. Among them are Aspyn Ovard, an original family channel YouTuber who is now in a throuple; Madison Bontempo, another family-style YouTuber who used to be close with the Paul brothers; and Bobbi Althoff, the podcaster behind those viral Drake and Lil Yachty interviews.

Jen Affleck, of course, hails from the original Utah-based Mormon Wives series, while Avery Woods and Salomé Andrea also have large platforms online; Ashleigh Pease, Jordan McClanahan and McCall Dapron did not have massive social media careers pre-Hulu, leaving them as hidden gems who bring more insight into the religious perspective of the what secret life of a Mormon wife can look like without content creation.

EP Jeff Jenkins says his team is “always exploring opportunities for new series, new ‘spinoffs,’ quote unquote,” though expanding the Mormon Wives franchise comes down to “if there are other groups of women out there who have compelling stories.”

Ovard opened up about her daughter’s terminal cancer diagnosis in season one, marking one of the most vulnerable admissions across the Mormon Wives franchise. When navigating how to share her story, Jenkins says, “It’s up to Aspyn to share what she wants to share, especially with the very delicate situations that she’s living in and through.”

“We don’t direct the ladies of this show or any other show that [Jeff Jenkins Productions] is producing on what to share and what to hold back. That is their decision, but they understand if they’re working with us, collaborating together, that the more you share, the more powerful the experience is going to be for the viewer,” Jenkins says, while also citing Pease opening up about the abuse she experienced in her childhood as another moving story from season one of Mormon Wives: Orange County.

The executive producer says he was “knocked on the floor by [Pease’s] resilience and her ability to overcome and build a life that she could only dream of when she was growing up.” Jenkins also commends DaPron and McClanahan’s strong ties to their faith, while noting he found Althoff opening up about her social anxiety to be “relatable to so many younger people who experience social anxiety or awkwardness.”

The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County was initially critiqued when announced due to the name of the show; fans believed most of the cast were not Mormon. Castmembers DaPron and McClanahan also repeatedly highlighted during season one that they were on a show about Mormon wives, with the title itself bleeding into the dynamics amongst the cast.

“I think what’s so interesting for so many people who grow up in religious households is, even if you are not practicing, it impacts the way that you live every single day,” Filipelli says. “Everyone in this cast has been touched by the faith. And so I think the title, it is what it is. But I think the story from the show and the experience that these women have is so valid and informs who they are as adults, as mothers, as wives today.”

There could be an argument that Hulu could have expanded the franchise merely as Secret Lives, to make room for a different group of religious wives (e.g. The Secret Lives of Catholic Wives).

But Jenkins says there’s something so “mysterious” about the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints that lends itself well to the show where “we’re all learning about it together.”

“A docuseries, in my opinion, is only as good as the folks who are the subject, who are on camera, right? So we just try really hard to collaborate with our cast members and bring their stories forward,” Jenkins adds.

Disney/Ashley Rose

Hulu also revealed in its reported viewership numbers that The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives franchise as a whole has driven over half a billion hours globally. That would mean continuing to expand the franchise into its own universe, similar to Bravo’s Real Housewives, would likely be imminent.

Jenkins says they’re “always exploring opportunities for new series, new ‘spinoffs,’ quote unquote.” Although it ultimately comes down to “if there are other groups of women out there who have compelling stories.”

Jenkins assures there are “other cities in America and different states in America that do have significant populations of folks who are following the Mormon faith.”

He also teases a potential international aspect of the Mormon religion: “There’s also an international aspect to this faith in Europe and in some of the other countries that are English-speaking. So, Lisa and I and Hulu, we’re all exploring.”

“If we can find another city with another great group that wants to share, and it’s somehow a shade different from Utah and different from OC, heck yeah!” Jenkins offers.

As for the future of Mormon Wives: Orange County, he jokes, “As far as production and producers, we’re ready to pick cameras back up tomorrow.”

“Go ask Hulu!” Filipelli says with a laugh as Jenkins adds, “We need a greenlight from Hulu.”

Season one of The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County is available to stream on Hulu.

rjqrhm.title: На рынок вышла обновленная версия известного в России кроссовера: все изменения
rjqrhm.content: В Китае стартовали продажи нового кроссовера Jetour X70M. За базовую версию просят 65 900 юаней – это примерно 815 тысяч рублей без учета скидок, всего же предложено три комплектации.Jetour X70MСемейство X70 в Китае – это целая линейка: X70, X70S, X70 Coupe, X70L, X70 Pro и X70 Plus. Часть моделей давно не обновляли, и постепенно их убирают с рынка.Так вышло и с прежним X70M: последнее обновление пришлось на 2023 год, сейчас в Поднебесной его не купить. Однако Jetour неожиданно вернула название в строй, выпустив полностью новый вариант.Вот только под прежним именем скрывается совсем другая машина – переименованный Jetour X50. Это компактный кроссовер на базе Soueast DX5 2019 года. В Китае он не продавался, зато в России был официально представлен с ноября 2024-го по март 2026-го.ЭкстерьерПо сравнению со знакомым россиянам X50 дизайн нового X70M изменился несильно. Самое заметное нововведение – более лаконичная трапециевидная решетка радиатора вместо массивной «бороды» с вертикальными ламелями.Форму поменял и передний бампер. Правда, капот и головная оптика остались прежними. Сбоку машина почти не изменилась, если не считать новых колесных дисков.А вот сзади перемен куда больше – по сути, ни одного прежнего элемента. Паркетник получил другой бампер, фонари и дверь багажника; номерной знак теперь размещен прямо на новом бампере.Jetour X70MИнтерьерИнтерьер переделали незначительно. На передней консоли остался прежний моноблок, объединяющий цифровую приборную панель и сенсорный экран управления: оба дисплея диагональю 10,25 дюйма стоят под общим стеклом.На разделительном тоннеле – знакомый селектор коробки передач и пара подстаканников. Зато рулевое колесо поставили новое.Управление кондиционером перевели на физические кнопки вместо сенсорной панели. Глянцевый пластик на центральной консоли тоже заменили – теперь поверхность матовая.Интерьер Jetour X70MГабариты и техникаПрежний X70M, уже снятый с продажи, был крупнее: 4755 x 1885 x 1710 мм при колесной базе 2745 мм, да и салон предлагали в пяти– и семиместном исполнении.Новый вариант заметно компактнее – 4400 x 1841 x 1690 мм, база составляет 2615 мм. Внутри только пять мест.Подвеска полностью независимая: спереди McPherson, сзади многорычажная система. Клиренс – 145 мм, топливный бак вмещает 45 литров. Объем багажника в обычном положении – 398 литров, со сложенным вторым рядом – 1262 литра. Снаряженная масса машины – 1410 кг, полная – 1785 кг.Цены, мотор и комплектацииНа китайском рынке новинку предлагают в трех комплектациях. Базовая оценина в 65 900 юаней (около 815 тысяч рублей), а с максимальной скидкой цену можно снизить до 62 900 юаней – примерно 780 тысяч.Под капотом – 1,5-литровый турбомотор мощностью 156 лошадиных сил и 230 Нм, работающий в паре с 6-ступенчатой механикой.Уже в начальной версии есть 16-дюймовые диски, бесключевой доступ и запуск двигателя кнопкой, задние датчики парковки, галогенная оптика со светодиодными ходовыми огнями, черная ткань на креслах, передние подушки безопасности, климат-контроль и аудиосистема с четырьмя динамиками.Две старшие версии стоят 75,9 и 80,9 тысячи юаней (0,94-1 миллион рублей), со скидками – 72,9 и 77,9 тысячи (900-965 тысяч рублей). Там с двигателем агрегатируется 6-ступенчатый робот. Расход топлива независимо от коробки – 7,4 литра на 100 километров по циклу WLTC, максимальная скорость – 185 км/ч.Средняя комплектация вдобавок получила 17-дюймовые легкосплавные диски, круиз-контроль, полностью светодиодную оптику, отделку сидений из экокожи и камеру заднего вида. В топовой есть боковые подушки безопасности, электролюк в крыше, камеры кругового обзора с функцией прозрачного шасси, а также электропривод двери багажника и водительского кресла.О другом кроссовере, который тоже недавно обновился для российского рынка, «За рулем» рассказал.Понравилась публикация?Тогда добавьте «За рулем» в список интересных источников: 1. Откройте https://google.com... 2. Поставьте галочку напротив нашего изданияГотово – остаемся на связи! «За рулем» можно читать и в Телеграм

guwv28.title: Bond Theme Contenders for Robert Pattinson’s 007: Swift, Raye and More
guwv28.content:
Nov 18, 2026 2:58pm PT

The Next Bond Theme: From Taylor Swift to Raye, 16 Singers Who Could Croon for Robert Pattinson’s 007

Collage: Variety; Photos: GettyImages; Background: Adobe Stock

The James Bond films are filled with traditions: the martinis are shaken, not stirred; the tuxes are immaculately tailored; the women are gorgeous; the villains are fascinating. Importantly, the films wouldn’t be true Bond stories without a dramatic theme song written and performed by a star. Nancy Sinatra, Shirley Bassey, Paul McCartney & Wings, Madonna, Jack White and Adele are just some of the acts who have brought soaring anthems to the films’ introductions. With Robert Pattinson’s Bond just announced, it’s prime time to dreamcast a new singer for the new film. Check out Variety‘s top picks below.

Marc Anthony

Image Credit: Getty Images

Many Bond numbers are heavy on brass and horns. Insert Marc Anthony, who can make any song feel cinematic. In 2024, Lin-Manuel Miranda penned an op-ed for Variety calling the 58-year-old the Latino community’s Frank Sinatra, writing: “He is our Sinatra and when we hear him, we also hear the echoes of all the unforgettable moments in our own lives.” The salsa king will have his “The Last Dance World Tour” in 2027, so perhaps he can fit in a nice writing credit to bring some excitement to the new iteration of 007? Let’s give him a sweeping bilingual ballad about loving someone who’s going to betray you, and the audience will melt in their seats. — C.D.

Bad Bunny

Image Credit: Greg Swales for Variety

Bond can always use some Latin flavor! Who wouldn’t be more iconic than the biggest artist on the planet? Bad Bunny already conquered the Super Bowl, and his album “DeBÍ TiRAR MáS FOTOS” became the first fully Spanish-language album to win the Grammy for album of the year. The Puerto Rican superstar already has a bit of assassin experience with his scene-stealing turn in the film “Bullet Train.” Can you imagine a moody, reggaeton-laced theme in Spanish playing over the opening titles, followed by a revolutionary performance on the Oscars telecast? A global event, indeed. — C.D.

Beyoncé

Image Credit: Michael Buckner/Billboard

The Queen can do no wrong. Beyoncé already has some experience in the spy business, having played Foxxy Cleopatra in “Austin Powers in Goldmember.” Now it’s time for her to take on the real deal. Fresh off winning Album of the Year at the 2025 Grammys for “Cowboy Carter,” and with two Oscar-nominated songs to her credit— “Listen” from “Dreamgirls” and “Be Alive” from “King Richard” — expectations would be sky-high. A Tina Turner-inspired Bond theme, complete with powerhouse vocals and a rock-and-soul edge, could be the perfect way to usher in a new era of 007. — C.D.

Mariah Carey

Image Credit: Ethan James Green

Do we remember the Winter Olympics in Milan? That soaring high note on the Italian classic “Volare” reminded us that Mariah Carey still has it, and it’s almost criminal that she hasn’t conquered this kingdom yet. That five-octave range is tailor-made for an iconic Bond finale: the orchestra drops out, the tension builds, and Mariah unleashes one final, earth-shattering note on a slow-burning ballad. Give us Mariah! — C.D.

Olivia Dean

Image Credit: Gilbert Flores/Billboard

The Bond universe isn’t averse to fresh blood when it comes to picking artists for theme songs (see: Billie Eilish and Adele), so it’s not entirely out of the realm of possibility that Olivia Dean could be tapped to record an original for the new Bond film. She’s got the range and poise that live up to the most classic of Bond themes, plus her British pedigree suits her cleanly for the role. Put her in the studio with an orchestra and you’ve got yourself a formula for Bond magic. — S.H.

Lana Del Rey

Image Credit: Gilbert Flores/Billboard

Few artists make more sense to record a Bond theme than Lana Del Rey, whose sweeping ballads and cinematic songwriting scream 007. And it would be something of a redemptive arc for her, considering that she previously revealed that she had penned and recorded the song “24” from her “Honeymoon” album for “Spectre,” only for Sam Smith to get the job. Del Rey has since inched closer to Bond glory earlier this year with “First Light,” the theme for the video game “007 First Light,” but the big ticket is just out of reach. — S.H.

Cynthia Erivo

Image Credit: Michael Buckner/Variety

Earlier this year, Cynthia Erivo performed at the Hollywood Bowl and delivered a remarkable rendition of Gladys Knight’s “Licence to Kill” from the James Bond film of the same name. Dear Denis Villeneuve and the Bond producers: you must watch the performance on YouTube and consider Erivo. She’s perfectly British, and her vocals are elegant, soulful and filled with grandeur. She also has a cinematic style and would be a perfect entry into the Bond franchise. — J.T.

Celine Dion

Image Credit: Getty Images

The Canadian chanteuse is back in the public eye after struggling with health issues, and who better to deliver a soaring anthem that unites the world? She’s no stranger to the genre, delivering gems such as the indelible “My Heart Will Go On” for “Titanic” and the underrated “Ashes” for “Deadpool 2.” Plus her powerful four octave range is sure to match the intensity of any orchestra she’s singing alongside. Step aside and let Dion put the “power” in “power ballad.” — W.E.

Lady Gaga

Image Credit: Variety

Lady Gaga knows how to write music for film. She won an Oscar for “Shallow” from “A Star Is Born,” and she wrote “Harlequin,” an album inspired by her “Joker: Folie à Deux” character Harley Quinn. This week, she landed two Grammy nominations for “Runway,” from “The Devil Wears Prada 2.” She also has the vocal range to deliver jazz standards, as displayed during her Las Vegas Residency, “Jazz and Piano.” Gaga checks the boxes to write a soaring classic 007 theme. — J.T.

Image Credit: Rich Polk/Billboard

Raye, who was recently named Variety’s 2026 Hitmaker of the Year, is one of music’s hottest stars. And yet her voice has a timeless quality which would certainly speak to old-school Bond fans who are looking for a more classically-sounding theme. Plus, her smoky vocals can stand alongside complex arringements, which come with the territory on Bond songs. Plus, she has the secret agent bona fides down, as she’s best known for solving a mystery … after all, where the hell is her husband? — W.E.

Rosalía

Image Credit: Beth Savaro

We already have a James Bond theme song preview from Rosalía if anyone has listened to “Lux,” her fourth studio album, where she sings in 13 languages, paired with operatic vocals and a thundering choice with Björk. The Spanish-born pop star is incredibly hot at the moment, as shown by pulling in nine Grammy nominations this year and a résumé that includes 13 number-one hits. She can bring the drama, the intrigue and a little flamenco flair to the next 007 adventure. — C.D.

Sienna Spiro

Image Credit: Variety

She’s not quite the superstar, yet, that virtually all the others on this list are, but she’s certainly on or approaching that bubble. That the British upstart styles herself like someone right out of a ’60s swinging-London film helps set the mood for thinking of her as a Bond girl: You could visually picture her silhouette fitting right into the title sequence, without having to hire a ringer. But it’s not so much about her nostalgic look — it’s that voice, which one of her obvious inspirations, former Bond theme-stress Adele, has cosigned. The most obvious sign it could or should be Spiro: one great song on her new album, called “Time, You and Me,” already sounds like a classic Bond theme. If it were, it’d be one of the two or three best 007 songs this century. Spiro could surely find another one where that came from. — C.W.

Harry Styles

Image Credit: Zak Hussein/Billboard

Harry Styles would be the perfect candidate to write the new James Bond theme. Having gone from One Direction breakout to a hugely successful solo performer, Styles can deliver both pop and rock with strong vocals. He also co-wrote the Bleachers song “Alfie’s Song (Not So Typical Love Song)” for the 2018 film “Love, Simon,” but that was more of a pop bop. Think instead of 2017’s “Sign of the Times.” The song is a perfect power ballad. For Bond, Styles would be matched with a large orchestra. And despite a screen test, if he can’t get to play James Bond, delivering a Bond song for the franchise would be the next best thing. — J.T.

Taylor Swift

Image Credit: Gilbert Flores/Variety

Hiring an A-list Bond? Consider an A-list superstar to do the theme. Swift is certainly ambitious enough to consider doing a 007 song, an elite club of music’s best and brightest. She’s certainly open to writing for films, as her current hit “I Knew It, I Knew You” is from “Toy Story 5” — and she’s already hitting the promotional trail to ensure it gets ample Oscar consideration. But we know she could have an interesting take on the drama, intrigue and romance that fuels every Bond song … after all, her catalogue is filled with big emotions. — W.E.

Suki Waterhouse

Image Credit: Zoe McConnell for Variety

Sure, there’s novelty in getting Pattinson’s longtime fiancée in the mix to sing his theme song. But Waterhouse is a respected musician with three albums and plenty of touring under her belt, and a sultry alto that adds texture to her indie rock hits. Her most recent album, “Loveland” has some complex arrangements, and she’s still able to hold her own, which is necessary as the inevitable Bond theme orchestra swells. Hell, while we’re at it, make her a Bond Girl, too, and tickets will sell like crazy. — W.E.

Hayley Williams

Image Credit: Rolling Stone

The Paramore belter has shown, between her band’s genre experimentation and her own freewheeling solo material, that she’s not constrained by sound. Although 007-style bombast would be yet another gear, it’d be fascinating for to try that style on for size. Besides, the Villeneuve Bond will inevitably be edgy: Williams is the perfect choice to bring some grit to the secret agent glam. Besides, Pattinson ushered in an era of the emo Batman … could an emo Bond be next? If so, who better than Williams to sing his feelings! — W.E.

More from Variety

vy6otv.title: Satya Nadella predicts AI agents will reshuffle the economics of the web
vy6otv.content:
Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella predicts that the rise of AI agents is going to reshape the economics of the internet, impacting the business models of the companies that rely on advertising and what he referred to as “human web” traffic.

Speaking at The New York Times DealBook Summit on Wednesday, the tech executive argued that the shift to an agentic web could change which companies pay others for traffic and for transactions, similar to how the transition from web portals like Yahoo to search engines like Google did years ago.

“The current aggregators who have a business model which was for the human web will get, in some sense, reshuffled,” said Nadella. “And if you were monetizing ads because of the eyeballs, you now have to probably get down to essentially maybe CPC [cost-per-click] wins; maybe it’s more transactional,” he continued. “And so if you don’t accept the agent, somebody else will.”

The discussion turned to Amazon and its decision to block AI agents from accessing its retail website, preventing them from browsing its catalog and making purchases on behalf of their users. Nadella suggested that companies trying to protect their existing business models could lose out to others that are more willing to embrace the AI agents. For instance, if Amazon continues blocking agents, another shopping platform such as Shopify, could allow them, and gain an advantage.

“I think this is going to be interesting,” he said, speaking to the changing models. “It’s the same thing that’s happening in other categories, right? Which is, if you’re in love with a particular business model, you have to kind of scramble,” he said.

12vuaxq.title: GTA 6 Home Sweet Home Mission Walkthrough
12vuaxq.content: Home Sweet Home is the twenty-first mission of this GTA 6 walkthrough. In this guide, we’ll explain everything you need to know about the Home Sweet Home mission, highlight any collectables, and explain any choices that can be made as part of the mission.Note: Home Sweet Home takes place after Tourist Trap, and is the second of three missions at the end of Chapter 1 which will stop you roaming the open world for a while. Check out our GTA 6 Guides Hub for everything you need to know about Rockstar‘s latest epic.In our complete walkthrough of GTA 6, we’re striving to avoid spoilers as much as possible. As such, we’ll be describing the playable elements of these missions, while totally avoiding (where possible) any cutscene spoilers that we can.Like with previous games in the series, many missions in GTA 6 can be accessed at the same time. For the sake of this GTA 6 walkthrough, we’ve listed the missions in the order that they appear in the in-game story recap.Some missions in GTA 6 can only be done by one character or the other, and some can only be completed at certain times of day. In this case, we’ve noted which character you need to play as, and when they can be accessed.Guides: If you're playing Grand Theft Auto 6, make sure to check out our complete walkthrough hub, featuring beginner tips, navigation experience explained, GTA 6 cheats, and more.Home Sweet Home WalkthroughHome Sweet Home takes place immediately following Tourist Trap, during the conclusion of Chapter 1 of GTA 6.As Lucia, enter the house, at which point you’ll find mysterious masked figures. They’ll fight Lucia as she tries to recover Jason’s stash. Fight the intruders and stop them from taking the stash. Watch out for the flames around the house, as being set on fire will deplete your health very quickly.After fighting off both intruders, you need to leave the house. On your way out, grab the photos by the door, just in time to be blown off the balcony. When you wake back up, cops are on their way, so it’s time to escape.Lucia needs to leave the area. There are multiple ways to do this. You can either call Andy, then get to her car by stealthing through the neighbourhood or you can leave via the water. There are multiple trailers and buildings in the area you can sneak through, though you will have to break into to most of them in order to access the interiors. The police are everywhere in the area, and there’s a police helicopter overhead, so escaping on open roads is very difficult.If you decide to escape via the water, there are boats and jetskis in the docks around Jason’s and his neighbours houses, but if you steal these vehicles, that can further alert the police. The next part of the mission plays out differently depending on what you do.If you make your way to Andy, she’ll take you to the hospital, at which point she’ll give you a unique jacket. If you leave the area via the water, or via another car, you’ll get a slightly different cutscene, but either way, you will end up at the hospital, ready to complete the final mission of Chapter 1.That’s the end of Home Sweet Home, and now it’s time for Discharge Time.

1pfxapo.title: GTA 6 Discharge Time Mission Walkthrough
1pfxapo.content: Discharge Time is the twenty-second mission of this GTA 6 walkthrough. It’s also the final mission in Chapter 1 of GTA 6.In this guide, we’ll explain everything you need to know about the Discharge Time mission, highlight any collectables, and explain any choices that can be made as part of the mission.For even more GTA 6, check out our GTA 6 Guides Hub, and get it bookmarked. We’ll be updating that page every day with new guides, walkthroughs and more from the world of GTA 6.In our complete walkthrough of GTA 6, we’re striving to avoid spoilers as much as possible. As such, we’ll be describing the playable elements of these missions, while totally avoiding (where possible) any cutscene spoilers that we can. If there’s something extremely spoilery that we can’t avoid, we’ll signpost it so that you can watch the in-game moment yourself, rather than read about it.In GTA 6, once Lucia has been released from jail and you have access to both playable characters, many missions in GTA 6 can be accessed at the same time.So for the sake of this GTA 6 walkthrough, we’ve listed the missions in the order that they appear in the in-game story recap. You can find the story recap by via the progress menu.Some missions in GTA 6 can only be done by one character or the other, and some can only be completed at certain times of day. In this case, we’ve noted which character you need to play as, and when they can be accessed.Guides: If you're playing Grand Theft Auto 6, make sure to check out our complete walkthrough hub, featuring beginner tips, navigation experience explained, GTA 6 cheats, and more.GTA 6 Discharge Time WalkthroughDischarge Time follows on from Home Sweet Home and is the final mission in Chapter 1 of GTA 6.At the hospital, Lucia notices that the men who are after them have already tracked down where Jason is being kept. Head up to the second floor, and find Jason in the ICU. Go to his room and wake him up, it’s time to escape.During this next sequence, you’ll play as Jason, who is in a wheelchair, shooting enemies that are bursting from every door in the hospital. It’s very easy to die in this sequence due to the sheer number of enemies, so we recommend using focus mode as much as possible.Jason and Lucia work their way through the hospital, before eventually control switches to Lucia again. Defend Jason from the hordes of enemies. When you get to the ambulance bay, Lucia will leave Jason in order to go to find a way out. Eventually, Jason will be knocked from his wheelchair and have to crawl to a gun.Lucia will return in the ambulance, taking us to the final sequence of this mission, and this chapter. As Jason, sit in the back of the ambulance and shoot at the enemies chasing you and Lucia. You can either shoot the driver, shoot the person shooting at you, or shoot at the engine/wheels of the cars. Disabling the cars by shooting the wheels can also cause enemy cars to ricochet onto other cars, making it an effective way to clear the road.After a while, the mission will end, as will Chapter 1 of GTA 6.

1ey3i9o.content: Tourist Trap is the twentieth mission of this GTA 6 walkthrough. Once you begin Tourist Trap, you’ll be locked into the subsequent missions, and won’t be able to return to the open world until you’re in Chapter 2.If you’re following along with our GTA guides, you should bookmark our GTA 6 Guide Hub. We’ll be updating it throughout launch and beyond.For our GTA 6, we’re striving to avoid spoilers as much as possible. As such, we’ll be describing the playable elements of these missions, while totally avoiding (where possible) any cutscene spoilers that we can. We want you to be able to see the best bits for yourself.Once Lucia has been released from jail and you have access to both playable characters, many missions in GTA 6 can be accessed at the same time. For the sake of this GTA 6 walkthrough, we’ve listed the missions in the order that they appear in the in-game story recap.Some missions in GTA 6 can only be done by one character or the other, and some can only be completed at certain times of day. In this case, we’ve noted which character you need to play as, and when they can be accessed.Guides: If you're playing Grand Theft Auto 6, make sure to check out our complete walkthrough hub, featuring beginner tips, navigation experience explained, GTA 6 cheats, and more.GTA 6 Tourist Trap WalkthroughStart the Tourist Trap mission by heading to the Visitor Center. Jason and Lucia will both equip a disguise, before exploring the Visitor Center. Head to the lockers, and pick up the bag. When you do, you’ll be prompted to head down the stairs, at which point the police will intercept you.After the cutscene, you’ll be in the interrogation room, underneath the Visitor Center. Watch as the chaos plays out, and then you’ll be in control of Jason. Shoot the enemies coming towards you and head for the bag.As you do this, Jason will be injured and you’ll switch to Lucia. Fight your way out of the Visitor Center, making sure to pick up ammo and weapons from the enemies as you pass them. Remember to use Zombix when you can, and any adrenaline shots you may have. As you progress through the area, you’ll need to protect Jason, who is badly injured.There’s a fail state here if Jason is killed, so stay close to him as you fight your way to the dock. Eventually, you’ll see a boat that you need to board. Drag Jason towards the boat, and hold off the enemies. When they start driving towards the dock, look for the flammable canisters that you can shoot, which will cause their cars to explode, thinning them out.If you’re curious if something will explode when you shoot it, enter Focus Mode using L3 and R3, and you’ll see that anything glowing red is flammable. Once you’re on the boat, head for open water. Jason is hurt, and hurt badly. Call Cal, and watch the cutscene playout.That’s the end of the Tourist Trap mission, but as we said in the intro, this mission and the following mission two missions, Home Sweet Home and Discharge Time, form the end of Chapter 1 of GTA 6, and are all sequential, so you won’t be able to head back to the open world until you’ve completed this portion of the game.Next up, it’s Home Sweet Home.

On the way, you’ll jump to the liquor store to buy a 6-pack for Cal. When you get to Cal’s place, get on the boat and head off for some fishing. Go to the fishing spot, and start to catch some fish with Cal.To fish in GTA 6, use L2 to grip the fishing rod, then use R2 to cast the rod. Rotate the R stick in order to attract the fish, and then when the fish begins to bite, you can use R2 to pull it in. When you pull the fish in, it will fight, use the L stick to fight against it, while using R to reel it towards you. Once it’s close enough, Jason will automatically grab the fish.Catch a few fish with Cal, then you’ll head back to the dock to cook them. Grill the fish, making sure to flip them before they burn, then serve them to Cal and Lucia. Lucia will head off after a while, at which point Jason will go after her.The pair will have a short conversation outside Cal’s house, before heading back to Jason’s house. This is the end of the Recalibration mission.

td4su7.title: Rose Byrne on What Lured Her to ‘The Good Daughter’ and Why That Complicated Ending Wraps the Series
td4su7.content:
Logo text

[This story contains major spoilers from The Good Daughter finale.]

Rose Byrne keeps outdoing herself. Her explosive limited series The Good Daughter co-starring Meghann Fahy quickly became the top show on Peacock. Just last year, she grabbed a best actress Oscar nomination and won both the Golden Globe and Independent Spirits Award for If I Had Legs I’d Kick You — the film nobody saw coming. She also wrapped season two of her Apple TV comedy Platonic.

Even for an actress with a pedigree like Byrne’s spanning over 30 years, projects like The Good Daughter are rare opportunities, she shared last year while still filming in the Atlanta Metro area. “Sam is the sort of role written for a man,” the Australian actress confessed. “It’s very dominant, kind of self-possessed, and she has physical trauma. Like she has scars, and she has a history. She has all this rich stuff that’s not always the case with the female roles you read.”

It’s the kind of story that Byrne, who also serves as executive producer alongside fellow Aussie, Big Little Lies Emmy winner Bruna Papandrea, sees as bestselling author and fellow EP Karin Slaughter’s superpower. “She writes incredibly rich female characters who are complicated and complex, and not all good and not all bad, and who have a lot to work with,” Byrne continued.

For the first time ever, Slaughter, who has had other books grace the screen with Pieces of Her for Netflix and, of course, Will Trent for ABC, adapted her own work and served as showrunner. The psychological thriller revolves around estranged sisters Samantha and Charlotte Quinn who, as teens, suffer a brutal attack in response to their father Rusty’s (an excellent Brendan Gleeson) work as an attorney that has left them scarred. Partial blindness and a permanent limp serve as enduring physical reminders for Sam. Spared many of the physical scars, Charlie’s show up in other ways. And they both lost their beloved mother Gamma (an effective Olivia Williams).

As the older sister, Sam sacrificed herself to ensure Charlie would be hurt the least, but that act created emotional and physical distance between the two. Rusty’s failing health has brought Sam back home from New York City, where she is a patent lawyer, to Pikeville, Georgia. It’s his defense of Kelly Wilson (impressive newcomer Shayna Benardo), a special needs high school girl seemingly behind a horrific school shooting that killed the school’s principal and a freshman girl that keeps her there.

What seems like an open-and-shut case is anything but. Because Charlie witnessed part of the shooting and is also an attorney, the two women can’t avoid each other. Any degree of separation disappears in a small town, especially for a polarizing case like this one, so emotional landmines abound. As the mystery surrounding Kelly’s actions lingers, the attack that the sisters survived years before also figures more prominently, forcing both Sam and Charlie to tackle all they have left unsaid and unresolved.

“One of the pleasures of this is that I wrote everything from the perspective of two women. So much to probably Meghann and Rose’s dismay, one of them always has to be in every single scene, because we get their perspective, and it’s a very internalized kind of storytelling,” Slaughter said on set. “But also, in a way, it shows their growth as sisters and as daughters, and gives me an opportunity to frame something that happens every day in America, basically through these very personal stories of these sisters who have been victims of violence before.”

On set when speaking to The Hollywood Reporter, Byrne noted “it’s rare you get to work side by side with a fellow actress.” That female energy is also directly sustained behind the camera with Oscar and Emmy-nominated director Steph Green (New Boy, Duster, Watchmen) and Australian cinematographer Zoë White (The Handmaid’s Tale). Below, she probes beyond the many plot twists to delve into aspects of the series that move her professionally and emotionally. Of course, we asked if there would be more and if she felt what happens to Kelly, the young girl at the center of the mystery, is fair.

***

In addition to playing Sam, you’re also an executive producer. What made you want to take on roles in front and behind the camera?

Being an EP was really like more of a seat at the table, particularly with casting. Getting Meghann Fahy on board was a huge deal for us. She’s so effervescent as Charlie; so magnetic and funny and heartbreaking. You just believe her straight away. She jumps. She lights up the screen, and she’s just gorgeous. I adore her. She’s so extraordinary, so talented.

And then Brendan Gleeson, who’s a legend at this point — so extraordinary and such a gifted storyteller — and so magnanimous with his work. I’ve known him since I was 23 when I did Troy. So that was a great thread. I worked with his son Domhnall Gleeson, so it was a lovely full circle to then have him playing my father. And that’s a tough character; it’s very polarizing. There’s a lot of fury that my character has at her father, a lot of anger and disappointment, and Brendan makes that hard because he’s so charming, but that’s what makes it interesting.

Reading the screenplay and the novel… it’s a classic origin story for Sam, where going back to where she came from, she’s dealing with all of her truths and all of the lies, and trying to uncover the past through this case; understanding her father more, but it felt to me almost a role written for a man, not particularly something you would see necessarily for a female character. That really intrigued me.

How did you pull off Sam’s physical transformation to convey her disability or disabilities?

Well, she has dysarthria, [her] speech disability from her trauma, and so I worked with my voice coach Kate Wilson, who’s extraordinary. She’s the head of voice [and speech] at Juilliard. I’ve worked with her for years and she’s incredible. She’s the most alive, passionate, compassionate teacher, and she’s really very sage. She and I delved in with what that would sound like, listening to tapes and recordings, and also working on the accent of Georgia and how my character had lived in New York for 20 years, and what it would sound like returning, and when it would return, and in what situations. When I return to Australia, my accent becomes a lot broader, and you know how you’re influenced by your environment.

Then with the limp, I worked with this wonderful PT trainer who works in rehab with people who’ve suffered injuries and so on. We homed in on what her limp would look like, and then did a million videos and would send them to Steph and figure out how far to go with it because we didn’t want it ever to be comical. Sometimes what reads on screen is very different in real life.

Jake McDorman as Mason ‘Huck’ Hukabee, Rose Byrne as Sam Quinn, Meghann Fahy as Charlie Quinn.

Mark Hill/PEACOCK

The younger Charlie [Drew Ann Cheek] and Sam [Audrey Grace Marshall] really match the older Charlie and Sam.

I was very front seat with the casting of that, so there was a lot of weighing in with everybody about who we felt the best lead was and, also, physically you have to have a lot of resemblance to them. I thought the girls were so wonderful, and that’s again a very hard job to do. I thought they just captured both Meghann and myself in really specific ways, and we watched a lot of footage of them as well. With Sam, obviously there’s a real before and after physically with what she goes through, so that was something I had to separately have work on. But establishing them as young women was so important.

While Sam and Charlie, in particular, experience extraordinary circumstances, the series seems to center on this whole idea of women holding onto very traumatic events or violations but still functioning in their lives.

Which we do every day. If you read the statistics about it, like one in six women have been sexually assaulted. A lot of people in America have suffered gun violence in their families. These statistics are horrific, and we worked very closely with RAINN who work with survivors of rape and incest and other horrific things, and they were incredible. We always had resources on set if people were being triggered or needed to talk. It was a safe space.

To Steph Green, our director, my first question was: “How will this be portrayed? I’m not interested in anything gratuitous or exploitative.” And Steph was so determined to tell the story in a way that had none of those tonal qualities in it. So absolutely the story has elements of trauma, but it’s dealt with in a very delicate way that I think is powerful but never gratuitous or exploitative.

Speaking of Steph, the way she, and Zoë White the cinematographer, handle the traumatic flashbacks is such an innovative technique that I don’t think I’ve seen.

I agree. I remember her telling me about that, how she was going to focus on hands and this and moments and shoot close-ups of various things to sort of link the story. And it’s beautifully told. The sense of memory was really vivid, I felt, [in] a lot of those flashbacks to me. I feel like they achieved something quite innovative.

When Rusty dies, everything is understandably sad. But the coffin scene at the funeral home manages to be both light and heavy. Did it come at a time when you guys kind of needed a break?

Meghann was so heartbreaking in that scene, and she’s so funny, too. That was actually great because what was harder was the flashback scene when we’re in New York, and it precipitates the estrangement. That scene was a lot harder because we’re through a closed door, sort of screaming a monologue and it’s a flashback, and I’ve got a wig on. That to me was more of a leap of faith. I think that was a harder needle to thread. Whereas the coffin scene, as you called it, was so gratifying to be able to look at her and really have a scene like two actors opposite one another and have such rich material. It was definitely strange for Brendan because he was in the coffin for a little bit. That’s no fun. But that was a scene I was both scared and excited to do.

There are so many powerful scenes, what are some of your favorite moments, or what stands out most to you?

The scene that haunts me so much is when Charlie confronts Judith over the kitchen table. I remember reading it in the novel, and I remember the first one I read in the screenplay, and my hair on my body was just standing on end. It was so suspenseful, so tightly drawn, and the history alone between these two women across each other from this table to then reach this boiling point of this scene was just masterful storytelling.

And it’s interesting because Sam and Charlie don’t have that traumatic relationship with them that Kelly has. Then considering that she’s special needs. So it’s unfathomable that the Pinkmans could do something like this to Kelly, right?

Yeah Karin, she’s a master storyteller, and just when you think you know where something is going. I found myself reading the novel and reading the screenplay [drawn to] the turns of what these people do and the perspectives that she puts on each situation. But that scene still haunts me.

Do you think Kelly’s punishment is fair?

I think it’s a very, very complicated answer and question. It’s such a nuanced and complicated story that has led her to this horrific situation that we made her in at the beginning. I really was fascinated with the process of that. I spoke to many lawyers who work in the criminal justice system about the process and how it works, and where you end up, and how you interrogate a witness, and like the defense team, and all of that. And Karin so beautifully captures how hard that system is and how it fails again and again and again for people, but how also you can have some wins. But it’s very nuanced and it’s very complicated.

It was a learning curve for me to even begin to understand that. So I think [Karin] has such a great understanding of that, and also the genre of a thriller, you know, and creating the suspense of that. Right until the very last episode, you’re really on the edge of your seat, as she just twists and turns and uses the perspective of one character then the other, and you constantly have shifting alliances, and she’s just very unflinching in her portrait of things. And that’s brave.

That’s why I ask if what happens to Kelly is fair because it’s very clear in the end how manipulated she was. And given her mental capacity, she wasn’t really aware of what she was doing.

Absolutely. None of it is fair.

Rose Byrne as Sam Quinn.

Do you see a continuation to The Good Daughter?

I don’t. It feels contained to this series, like the novel, to me. I have hope for the characters that they would, I mean, selfishly, continue to have a better relationship with one another after all the trauma and all the things they’ve weathered or the storms they’ve weathered. But it felt, to me, pretty contained about this specific thing they had to go through.

I’m sure you take lessons from each project that you do. What is your biggest takeaway from this one?

I think diving back into this genre was really interesting for me [because] I hadn’t done it for many years. [There are] tropes that are really fun in there, and the challenges of a very complicated plot at times, and being ahead of it for myself. But Karin, the author, is really ahead of everybody. So, it was interesting. Also to work with an author who then wrote the screenplay, that was also something I’d never done creatively, and how fun that was. Also, we would have rigorous conversations where we would disagree about things, and that was fun too. I think I learned a lot.

***

All six episodes of The Good Daughter are streaming on Peacock.

ht1ex.title: Евросоюз намерен дать Украине еще 45 млрд евро: кто вернет кредит и при чем тут российские активы
ht1ex.content:
Евросоюз готовится увеличить финансовую поддержку Украины. В среду, 18 ноября, Еврокомиссия предложила предоставить Киеву дополнительный кредит до 45 млрд евро на 2027 год. До 25 млрд предназначены на оборону, до 20 млрд - на поддержку бюджета.

Сигналом президенту РФ Владимиру Путину назвал это предложение еврокомиссар по обороне Андрюс Кубилюс. "Расчет на то, что время работает против Украины и Европейского Союза, не оправдается", - заявил он, представляя проект Еврокомиссии вместе с ее главой Урсулой фон дер Ляйен (Ursula von der Leyen) и коллегой Валдисом Домбровскисом в Брюсселе.

Однако для запуска нового кредита Украине необходимо одобрение Совета ЕС и Европарламента, а также согласие всех 27 стран блока на предоставление бюджетных гарантий. Вопрос о том, кто будет оплачивать за Украину проценты по кредиту, предстоит решать отдельно.

Почему Украине нужно больше денег

В конце 2025 года Евросоюз уже согласовал кредит для Украины на 90 млрд евро на 2026-2027 годы - по 45 млрд евро ежегодно. Однако прежние расчеты исходили из технического предположения, что война завершится к концу 2026 года, пояснил журналистам на брифинге высокопоставленный представитель Еврокомиссии. Продолжение боевых действий и усиление российских атак привели к росту расходов на оборону и ухудшению экономического положения Украины. Россия разрушает инфраструктуру и затрудняет торговлю Украины, в том числе блокируя экспортные маршруты через Черное море.

Дополнительный дефицит финансирования на 2027 год и Киев, и Брюссель теперь оценивают в 70 млрд евро: 30 млрд нужны для поддержания бюджета и 40 млрд - для обороны. Это потребности Украины сверх уже предусмотренного финансирования. По словам представителей Еврокомиссии, эта оценка была согласована с украинскими властями при участии МВФ и НАТО.

Еще одна причина нехватки средств - не все обещания партнеров выполнены. В частности, остаются нереализованными обязательства по военной поддержке, взятые на саммите НАТО в Анкаре, сообщил высокопоставленный представитель Еврокомиссии. А закладывать в бюджет надежду на то, что все обещанное поступит, было бы недальновидно, отметил он.

Предлагаемая сумма покроет около двух третей дефицита в 70 млрд евро, а оставшуюся часть Еврокомиссия рассчитывает закрыть за счет международных партнеров. При этом окончательных договоренностей об этом пока нет.

Оборонная часть кредита - до 25 млрд евро - предназначена для закупки вооружений, включая средства ПВО, дроны и системы борьбы с ними, ракеты и боеприпасы. При закупках будет действовать приоритет европейских производителей с возможностью исключений. Кроме того, Еврокомиссия рассчитывает использовать кредит для развития сотрудничества оборонных предприятий ЕС и Украины.

При этом даже наличие средств не гарантирует немедленной поставки вооружений Украине: производство ракет-перехватчиков не успевает за потребностями. По оценке Кубилюса, по итогам 2026 года число баллистических ракет, примененных Россией против Украины, может достичь 2 тысяч - против примерно тысячи в 2025 году. При этом США производят около 700 перехватчиков PAC-3 в год. Поэтому, как пояснил еврокомиссар, Еврокомиссия убеждает страны ЕС передать Украине ракеты из собственных запасов. Взамен они получат новые ракеты, которые Киев уже законтрактовал с поставками в 2028-2029 годах.

Бюджетная часть кредита - до 20 млрд евро - должна помочь обеспечить работу государства и основных общественных служб, в том числе школ и больниц. Эта часть выплат будет связана с продолжением Украиной реформ в сфере верховенства права, борьбы с коррупцией и управления государственными финансами.

Украине придется возвращать кредит?

Украина будет обязана вернуть основную сумму кредита только после получения репараций от России. Однако поскольку гарантий того, что Москва возместит причиненный Украине ущерб, нет, срок возврата кредита фактически остается неопределенным. Такое же условие предусмотрено для действующего кредита ЕС на 90 млрд евро.

Офис депозитария Euroclear в БрюсселеФото: Nicolas Tucat/AFP/Getty ImagesЕсли Россия не выплатит репарации, Украина не будет обязана возвращать основную сумму кредита. Однако Евросоюзу все равно придется рассчитываться с инвесторами. Гарантией этих выплат служит бюджет ЕС, поэтому риск в конечном счете берет на себя европейская сторона. Для погашения долга Еврокомиссия предлагает использовать будущие доходы от замороженных российских активов. Но если этих средств не хватит, Евросоюзу придется выполнять обязательства за счет собственного бюджета.

С обслуживанием самого кредита ситуация другая: по предложенной схеме эти расходы должна нести Украина, однако ЕС сможет субсидировать их по запросу Киева. Еврокомиссия рекомендует покрывать их полностью, чтобы не увеличивать долговую нагрузку Украины. Такое решение еще предстоит принять.

Первые расходы на обслуживание нового кредита возникнут в 2028 году. Поэтому вопрос о субсидировании Евросоюзом процентов для Украины должен обсуждаться на переговорах о следующем многолетнем бюджете ЕС на 2028-2034 годы.

Откуда ЕС возьмет деньги и сколько это будет стоить?

Еврокомиссия привлечет средства на финансовых рынках, а гарантией послужит бюджет ЕС. Это уже отработанная схема, по которой финансируется действующий кредит Украине на 90 млрд евро.

Однако новые заимствования увеличат расходы на обслуживание долга. По оценкам, озвученным на брифинге, в следующем бюджетном периоде с 2028 по 2034 год ежегодные расходы по нынешнему кредиту на 90 млрд евро могут составлять около 3,5 млрд евро, а по новому - еще 2-2,5 млрд. Фактические суммы будут зависеть от рыночных ставок и графика привлечения и перечисления средств.

Кто покроет эти расходы, предстоит решить при согласовании бюджета ЕС на 2028-2034 годы. Еврокомиссия предлагает оплачивать их через отдельный инструмент, средства на который будут выделяться дополнительно к установленному максимальному объему расходов бюджета ЕС, а не за счет других программ. Но страны Евросоюза и Европарламент эту схему еще не согласовали.

По оценке высокопоставленного представителя Еврокомиссии, способность Евросоюза продолжать такую поддержку - прежде всего вопрос политического выбора, а не отсутствия экономических возможностей.

Чтобы привлечь помощь партнеров вне ЕС, Еврокомиссия предлагает разрешить странам с наивысшим кредитным рейтингом предоставлять гарантии, под которые Евросоюз сможет занять для Украины еще до 5 млрд евро. Это общий лимит, а не сумма от каждой страны. В отличие от нового кредита на 45 млрд евро, эти займы Украина должна будет возвращать независимо от получения российских репараций.Почему не получится заплатить замороженными российскими активами?

В Евросоюзе заблокированы активы российского Центробанка примерно на 210 млрд евро. Однако новое предложение не предусматривает использования самой этой суммы для финансирования Украины.

Эти активы приносят доходы, которые уже используются для погашения кредитов примерно на 45 млрд евро, предоставленных Украине странами G7 в рамках инициативы ERA. На брифинге высокопоставленный представитель Еврокомиссии ориентировочно оценил ежегодные поступления в 4-6 млрд евро, подчеркнув, что сумма зависит от процентных ставок.

Таким образом, на эти доходы уже стоит очередь: сначала ими нужно погасить кредиты G7. Лишь затем их можно будет направлять на возврат действующего кредита ЕС на 90 млрд евро и нового - на 45 млрд. Доходы будут покрывать только основную сумму этих двух кредитов. Для выплаты процентов понадобятся другие средства.

Такими темпами, если единственным источником погашения останутся доходы от российских активов, возврат займов продлится десятилетия, признал представитель Еврокомиссии. "Пока эти деньги вернутся, я уже давно буду на пенсии - или, вероятно, даже хуже", - пошутил он.

Срок зависит от будущих доходов от замороженных активов, процентных ставок и объема новых кредитов. ЕС также сохраняет за собой право использовать сами замороженные российские активы для погашения займов в соответствии с европейским и международным правом. Однако нового решения об этом сейчас не объявлено.

Все 27 или снова 24? Какие страны ЕС поддержат новый кредит

Лидеры стран ЕС обсудят эту инициативу на специальном саммите 26-27 ноября. Сам инструмент должен пройти рассмотрение Советом ЕС и Европарламентом. Для изменения правил многолетнего бюджета, необходимого для предоставления гарантии кредиторам, требуется единогласие стран Евросоюза.

Напомним, что согласование действующего кредита на 90 млрд евро уже потребовало политического компромисса. На саммите в декабре 2025 года после многочасовых переговоров лидеры стран ЕС договорились о совместных заимствованиях, однако не согласовали использование самих российских активов - тогдашняя инициатива называлась "репарационный кредит" для Украины, и против нее выступила Бельгия.

Альтернативную идею кредита поддержали все, однако Венгрия, Словакия и Чехия - лишь при условии неучастия в его финансировании. Выход нашли в схеме с участием остальных 24 стран. При этом отдельно предусмотрели, что использование бюджета ЕС для гарантирования кредита не создаст для этих трех стран дополнительных финансовых обязательств.

А что же теперь? Урсула фон дер Ляйен рассчитывает обойтись без таких исключений. Правительствам, не желающим финансировать военную помощь Украине, предлагают связать свое участие только с гражданской частью нового кредита. Для этого суммы на военную помощь и поддержку бюджета предлагается сразу закрепить в правилах предоставления нового кредита. Убедит ли это столицы, до сих пор остававшиеся в стороне от финансирования, станет ясно на переговорах.

Даже если обсуждение затянется, Украина с 1 января без финансирования не останется: на 2027 год предусмотрены оставшиеся средства действующего кредита, подчеркнули чиновники. На сколько их хватит, они не уточнили.

1800doz.title: GTA 6 Podcasts explained: How to listen to podcasts in GTA 6
1800doz.content: Podcasts are a new addition in GTA 6. This guide explains how to listen to podcasts in GTA 6 and lists which podcasts are in the game.GTA 6 is finally here, and millions of players are exploring Leonida for the first time. GTA 6 adds many new things to the series, with podcasts being one of them. While the GTA radio stations are a classic element of the series, the new podcasts are also well worth listening to, especially for longtime fans of the series.Without anything further, here’s how to listen to podcasts in GTA 6.If you’re looking for GTA 6 guides, our GTA 6 Guide Hub is full of everything you need to know.Guides: If you're playing Grand Theft Auto 6, make sure to check out our complete walkthrough hub, featuring beginner tips, navigation experience explained, GTA 6 cheats, and more.How to listen to podcasts in GTA 6You can listen to podcasts in GTA 6 in cars, via a portable radio, or via headphones.When in a car, press left on the D-pad, which will bring up the radio menu. When here, move the right stick down, which will swap to the podcast library.There are 5 different podcast series in GTA 6. They are:F*ck, Marry, MurderThe Safe TripVice City True StoriesDrunk Kings Final ActEach of these podcast series feature multiple episodes, which can be accessed from the individual podcast pages. While you’ll have a few podcasts unlocked at the start of the game, as you continue to play GTA 6, more podcast episodes will unlock.You can see which podcasts you’ve already listened to in each individual podcast page. Frustratingly, your podcast doesn’t stop if you leave the car, so you may have to scrub around to find out where you left off, if you happen to leave your car before the podcast ends.It’s worth checking out these podcasts, especially because a few of them directly reference some events and characters from earlier in the GTA series. The F*ck, Marry, Murder podcast may also be the most explicit dialogue in a Rockstar game yet.

gh-1380558566.title: GitHub - alondero/worlddriverchampionship-recomp: First playable World Driver Championship N64 recompilation using N64Recomp, N64ModernRuntime, and RT64
gh-1380558566.content:
World Driver Championship: Recompiled
Experimental native Windows build of the Nintendo 64 game using N64Recomp,
N64ModernRuntime, and RT64. CPU code and the custom BOSS graphics microcode
are statically recompiled; RT64 renders the resulting low-level RDP commands.

Windows x64 / Direct3D 12 has been tested through the intro, menus, and
Hawaii practice driving (acceleration, steering, automatic gears, pause/resume).
This is an early development build, not a finished port.
Supply your own USA ROM, then run:
./build.ps1
./play.ps1
Gamepads are supported: left stick steers, A accelerates, B brakes, Start pauses,
and Back/View opens settings (Xbox button labels). Keyboard defaults remain
Enter for Start/pause, X for A/accelerate, Z for B/brake, and arrows/WASD to steer.
Use Settings > Controls to rebind either device; see Controllers.
For the tested path: skip intro with Enter, press Enter at the title, then
X for Quick Race, Down and X for Practice Laps, X for Hawaii, and X for automatic transmission.
Controller Pak saves are enabled on port 1 and persist in
build/user-data/saves/worlddriverchampionship.us.mpk. See
save configuration for backup and failure behavior.
The frontend-enabled player supports rumble alongside Controller Pak saves on
port 1, with strength in General settings. Physical controller compatibility
and feel remain unverified. Rendering glitches remain, and SDL audio output is experimental. Linux and Android
are not validated. No ROM, generated game code, or binary is committed.
Graphics: automatic or 1-8x resolution scaling, MSAA, output filtering, saved
settings, and fullscreen (F11 / Alt+Enter). Press Escape or F1 for the tabbed
settings overlay, with Apply/Discard, Restore Defaults, editable controls,
and session cheats for tracks and GT1 or GT2 cars.
Race presentation widens the camera to match the window, preserves car/HUD
proportions and removes the outer TV borders. Original 4:3 remains available.
Experimental presentation-rate controls are available; interpolated motion
remains future work. See Graphics settings and the
peer capability review.
See Building, First-playable evidence,
Testing, and Peer research.
License and contents
Project source is provided under GPL version 3. Dependency and font
licenses remain with their respective components; the overlay's font notices
are included in assets/frontend.
The original game and its assets are not included. This is an unofficial project.
Maintainers: see publishing checks before changing visibility
or distributing build artifacts.

145ii9h.title: Росіяни застосовують «Молнії» з керуванням через оптоволокно на різних ділянках фронту - «Флеш»
145ii9h.content:
На різних ділянках фронту протягом кількох діб зафіксували використання російськими військами безпілотників «Молнія» з керуванням через оптоволокно.

Як передає Укрінформ, про це позаштатний радник Президента Сергій «Флеш» Бескрестнов повідомив у Фейсбуці.

«Ще рік тому ми фіксували перші спроби застосування оптоволокна на «Молніях», але це не набуло поширення», - зазначив він.

За словами Бескрестнова, протягом останніх кількох діб такі безпілотники зафіксували на різних фронтах. Вони літають на висоті близько 50 метрів, а дальність їхнього польоту сягає 30 км у тил України.

«Небезпека таких БПЛА полягає у відсутності радіосигналу для їх виявлення, низькій висоті польоту (що ускладнює виведення РЛС), можливості проводити розвідку під час польоту завдяки високій якості зображення, а також у нездатності РЕБ вплинути на БПЛА», - наголосив радник Президента.

Читайте також: Оптоволокном від дронів РФ на правобережжі Херсонщини можна 5-7 разів обмотати Землю по екватору - експерт

Він також подякував українським екіпажам за виявлення та збиття таких безпілотників.

Як повідомляв Укрінформ, раніше позаштатний радник Президента Сергій «Флеш» Бескрестнов заявив, що росіяни випробовують новий безпілотник крилатого типу на оптоволокні.

1ily5kn.title: К «Искусственному интеллекту» с Юрой Борисовым вышел русскоязычный трейлер — в России с 21 января
1ily5kn.content:
Биографическая драма «Искусственный интеллект» режиссёра Луки Гуаданьино получила русскоязычный трейлер. Его опубликовала кинопрокатная компания «Вольга». В России фильм выйдет 21 января 2027 года.
«Искусственный интеллект» расскажет о карьере одного из сооснователей OpenAI и создателей ChatGPT Сэма Альтмана (это ему не нравится, что оперативная память простаиваетв компьютерах простых пользователей). Главные роли сыграли номинанты на премию «Оскар» Эндрю Гарфилд («По соображениям совести») и Юра Борисов («Анора»).
В полном актёрском составе: Моника Барбаро, Купер Хоффман, Марк Райлэнс, Айк Баринхолц, Фёдор Федотов, Крис ОʼДауд и другие.

«Новая картина Луки Гуаданьино посвящена созданию OpenAI. В центре сюжета — молодой учёный Илья Суцкевер (Юра Борисов), который вместе с Сэмом Альтманом (Эндрю Гарфилд) и командой единомышленников разрабатывает технологию, подарившую миру ChatGPT.
Но чем мощнее становится искусственный интеллект, тем острее встаёт вопрос: кто должен им управлять? За право контролировать изобретение, способное повлиять на судьбу человечества, разворачивается настоящая борьба», — кинопрокатная компания «Вольга».

1wfpq5b.title: Почтовый AI-ассистент на Python: текст, фото и голос через одного провайдера
1wfpq5b.content:
Привет! В этой статье разберём, как связать облачные модели с Python-приложением: дать ИИ-агенту инструменты, добавить обработку изображений, голосовой ввод и озвучку ответов. Для примеров я собрал AI Inbox, почтовый ассистент с веб-интерфейсом на FastAPI и OpenAI Agents SDK. Почта здесь даёт конкретные задачи, на которых можно проследить работу агента, а сами механики пригодятся и в других проектах.Для экспериментов хотелось подключить всё через одного провайдера: основную модель для текста, изображений и вызова инструментов, ASR для распознавания речи и TTS для озвучки. При этом не хотелось тратить много денег и отдельно разбираться с подключением и оплатой каждой модели.В AI Inbox агент может читать письма, делать по ним сводки, создавать задачи со сроками и готовить ответы. Например, можно загрузить фотографию счёта и попросить перенести его данные в задачу. Или продиктовать команду: приложение распознает речь и покажет текст, который можно проверить и отредактировать перед отправкой агенту. Ответы и дайджесты по непрочитанным письмам и открытым задачам можно озвучить и прослушать в браузере.Сначала покажу запуск и несколько сценариев работы, затем перейду к реализации. Разбирать весь проект по косточкам не буду: остановлюсь на том, как модель выбирает инструменты, как приложение выполняет их вызовы, сохраняет историю диалога и передаёт ответ в браузер. На примере отправки письма разберу, как связать действие с конкретной версией черновика и отдельным подтверждением пользователя. Покажу и программную работу с почтой через IMAP и SMTP, которую используют интерфейс и агент.Сразу оставлю исходный код проекта, чтобы по ходу статьи можно было открыть нужный модуль и посмотреть реализацию целиком.Что понадобится для проектаПриложение запускается локально, запросы к моделям отправляются в облако. Для этого нужны:Почтовый ящик с доступом по IMAP для чтения писем и SMTP для отправки.Доступ к трём моделям: LLM с поддержкой изображений и вызова инструментов, ASR для распознавания речи и TTS для озвучки текста. Извлекать текст и данные из фотографий будет сама LLM. Все три модели можно подключить через одного прокси-провайдера, как в моём случае, или через разные сервисы. Принцип работы приложения останется тем же.Python 3.12 или новее, uv для установки зависимостей, ffmpeg и ffprobe для обработки аудио.Подготовка почтыДля статьи я завёл отдельный ящик на Mail.ru и покажу настройку на его примере. Выбор сервиса здесь не принципиален: для этого проекта подойдёт другой ящик с доступом по IMAP и SMTP через логин и пароль приложения. Общий принцип похожий: разрешить внешнему приложению доступ к почте, получить данные для подключения и указать серверы. Регистрацию, таблицу пользователей и роли я намеренно не добавлял: для этого проекта достаточно пары AUTH_USERNAME и AUTH_PASSWORD из окружения. При запуске приложение читает их через Settings и передаёт сервису JwtTokens. Пароль почтового ящика и ключ провайдера моделей в этой проверке не участвуют.Вход состоит из двух этапов. Сначала приложение проверяет логин и пароль, это аутентификация. После успешной проверки выдаёт токен, по которому разрешает доступ к защищённым маршрутам. Отдельного разграничения прав здесь нет: действующий токен владельца даёт доступ к почте, задачам и чату.Выдача токенаДля API вход находится по адресу POST /api/v1/auth/token. Обработчик принимает поля формы username и password через OAuth2PasswordRequestForm и передаёт их в сценарий Authenticate, который вызывает JwtTokens.authenticate.Проверить вход можно через кнопку Authorize в Swagger UI. В username и password укажу значения AUTH_USERNAME и AUTH_PASSWORD. Поля client_id и client_secret в этом проекте заполнять не нужно: обработчик использует только логин и пароль владельца. Форма Authorize в Swagger UIЭтот метод сравнивает оба значения с настройками владельца. При несовпадении возвращается ошибка 401. После успешной проверки создаётся JWT. Вот фрагмент метода из infrastructure/auth/jwt.py; импорты и предыдущая проверка логина и пароля опущены:now = self.clock.now()
token = jwt.encode(
{
"sub": self.username,
"iat": now,
"exp": now + timedelta(seconds=self.ttl),
"iss": self.issuer,
"aud": self.audience,
"csrf": secrets.token_urlsafe(32),
},
self.secret,
algorithm="HS256",
)
return {"access_token": token, "token_type": "bearer", "expires_in": self.ttl}В sub записан логин владельца, в iat время выдачи, в exp срок действия. iss и aud задают издателя токена и приложение, для которого он предназначен. Поле csrf понадобится для запросов из браузера. По умолчанию токен действует 60 минут, срок задаётся через ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES.self.secret получает значение JWT_SECRET_KEY из конфигурации. Этот ключ используется для подписи HS256 и остаётся на сервере. Содержимое такого JWT можно прочитать без ключа, поэтому паролей и ключей моделей в нём нет. Назначение подписи и устройство JWT также описаны в документации FastAPI.Проверка защищённых запросовВ ответ на вход клиент получает access_token. Дальше при обращении к API он передаёт эту строку в HTTP-заголовке:Authorization: Bearer <access_token>Bearer означает, что для обращения к ресурсу клиент предъявляет сам токен. JWT задаёт формат токена в этом проекте. Порядок передачи через Authorization определён в RFC 6750.Из заголовка строку извлекает OAuth2PasswordBearer, подключённый через Depends. Сам по себе он не проверяет подпись JWT. Эту работу выполняет сервис приложения, который вызывается из зависимости current_owner. В presentation/api/dependencies.py выбор источника токена выглядит так:c = container(request)
header_present = "authorization" in request.headers
token = bearer if header_present else request.cookies.get(c.settings.auth_cookie_name)

u186fd.title: GTA 6 Mandy explained: Can you romance Mandy in GTA 6?
u186fd.content: Can you romance Mandy in GTA 6?GTA 6 is finally here, and now that players have finally got their hands on GTA 6, many characters have quickly become fan favourites. None more so than Mandy from the mission Pipework.In Pipework, Jason goes to Mandy’s house because she owes Brian rent, however what Jason didn’t bargain for was Mandy wanting to rip the clothes off him. But the question is, can you romance Mandy in GTA 6? Can Jason recipricate Mandy’s advances, and betray Lucia before the game even starts?In this GTA 6 Mandy explained guide, we’ll break down how Jason can interact with Mandy, and if there’s anything you’re missing during the Pipework mission.For more GTA 6 guides, check out our GTA 6 Guide Hub.Guides: If you're playing Grand Theft Auto 6, make sure to check out our complete walkthrough hub, featuring beginner tips, navigation experience explained, GTA 6 cheats, and more.Can you romance Mandy in GTA 6?No, Jason can’t romance Mandy in GTA 6. Despite her best efforts, no matter how long Jason stays in Mandy’s house, there is no way to romance Mandy. All you can do with Mandy is ask her for the Plunger when you get into her room, and rebuff her advances.Eventually, she’ll demand that you leave her house. While you can still speak to Mandy, she will be upset with Jason, and eventually her reponses will repeat.After a while, once you’ve finished the Pipework mission, you’ll get a text message from Mandy, in which she tells Jason that she knows he wants her, but he can’t admit it. Even at this point, there’s nothing you can do. Frankly, there’s nothing you should want to do, because Lucia is out of jail, and she’s better at robbing banks than Mandy is, so the favourite is clear.That’s everything you need to know about Mandy in GTA 6. No character has caught the attention of the fanbase in the early game of GTA 6 quite like Mandy, but your time with her is short and sweet.
